-- Pure client state. Server data is authoritative; no optimistic reactions/success.
local State={};State.__index=State
function State.new(request,clock,id)
	return setmetatable({request=request,clock=clock,id=id,notes={},sort="Newest",leaseUntil=0,generation=0,
		pageCursor=nil,nextCursor=nil,moderator=false,staff=false,status="Loading feedback…",backend=true,onChanged=function()end},State)
end
function State:changed() self.onChanged() end
function State:capabilities()
	local out=self.request("Capabilities",{})
	if out.ok then self.moderator=out.data.moderator;self.testMode=out.data.testMode end
end
function State:clear(message)
	self.notes={};self.leaseUntil=0;self.status=message;self:changed()
end
function State:refresh(reset)
	if self.refreshing then return end
	if reset then self.pageCursor=nil end
	self.refreshing=true;local generation=self.generation;local started=self.clock()
	local out=self.request(if self.staff then "ModerateList" else "List",{sort=self.sort,category=self.category,cursor=self.pageCursor,reportedOnly=self.reportedOnly,archived=self.archived})
	self.refreshing=false
	if generation~=self.generation then return end
	if not out.ok then
		if out.code=="INVALID" then self.pageCursor=nil end
		self:clear(out.message or "Feedback unavailable.");return
	end
	-- Lease begins when the request began, not after a delayed response arrived.
	if self.clock()>=started+5 then self:clear("Feedback verification expired. Refreshing…");return end
	self.notes=out.data.notes;self.nextCursor=out.data.cursor;self.stats=out.data.stats
	self.leaseUntil=started+math.min(5,out.data.leaseSeconds or 5)
	self.status=if #self.notes==0 then (if (out.data.withheld or 0)>0 then "Notes withheld until filtering and visibility can be verified." else "No feedback on this page yet.") else ""
	self:changed()
end
function State:expire()
	if self.leaseUntil>0 and self.clock()>=self.leaseUntil then self:clear("Revalidating feedback…");return true end
	return false
end
function State:setSort(sort)
	self.sort=sort;self.generation+=1;self.pageCursor=nil;self.nextCursor=nil;self:clear("Loading feedback…")
end
function State:nextPage()
	if not self.nextCursor then return end
	self.generation+=1;self.pageCursor=self.nextCursor;self.nextCursor=nil;self:clear("Loading next page…")
end
function State:list(_mode) return self.notes end
function State:submit(category,message,_author,_timestamp)
	if self.mutating then return nil,"Please wait for the current request." end
	if not self.pendingSubmit or self.pendingSubmit.category~=category or self.pendingSubmit.message~=message then
		self.pendingSubmit={op=self.id(),category=category,message=message}
	end
	self.mutating=true;local result=self.request("Submit",self.pendingSubmit);self.mutating=false
	if not result.ok then return nil,result.message or "The server could not confirm storage. Retry this draft." end
	self.pendingSubmit=nil;self:setSort("Newest")
	return {id=result.data.id,pendingListing=result.data.pendingListing},nil
end
function State:toggle(note)
	if self.mutating then return false,"Please wait for the current request." end
	local pending=note.pendingSupport
	if not pending then pending={id=note.id,op=self.id(),desired=not note.supported,expected=note.supportRevision};note.pendingSupport=pending end
	self.mutating=true;local result=self.request("Support",pending);self.mutating=false
	if not result.ok then
		if result.code=="CONFLICT" then note.pendingSupport=nil;self:clear("Reaction changed. Refreshing…") end
		return false,result.message or "Reaction not confirmed."
	end
	self.generation+=1;note.supported=result.data.supported;note.supportRevision=result.data.supportRevision;note.pendingSupport=nil
	return true
end
function State:report(note,reason)
	if self.mutating then return false,"Please wait for the current request." end
	self.mutating=true;local out=self.request("Report",{id=note.id,op=self.id(),reason=reason});self.mutating=false
	if not out.ok then return false,out.message or "Report not confirmed." end
	self.generation+=1;note.reported=true;return true
end
function State:hide(note,reason)
	if self.mutating then return false,"Please wait for the current request." end
	self.mutating=true;local out=self.request("Hide",{id=note.id,op=self.id(),reason=reason});self.mutating=false
	if not out.ok then return false,out.message or "Hide not confirmed." end
	self.generation+=1;self:clear("Note hidden. Refreshing…");return true
end
return State

-- Public protocol only. No permissions or storage configuration belong here.
local P = {}
P.Categories = {"Bug Report", "Feature Suggestion", "Gameplay Feedback", "Balance Issue", "General Feedback"}
P.Reasons = {"Inappropriate", "Personal information", "Spam", "Other"}
P.Sorts = {"Newest", "Oldest", "Most supported"}
P.Messages = {
	INVALID="That request is invalid.", UNAVAILABLE="Feedback is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.",
	CAPACITY="New submissions are temporarily unavailable: storage capacity has been reached.",
	COOLDOWN="Please wait 60 seconds between successful submissions.", DAILY_LIMIT="You can submit five notes per UTC day.",
	DUPLICATE="You already submitted this message in the last 24 hours.", BUSY="Please wait before trying again.",
	FORBIDDEN="You do not have permission for that action.", FILTER="Text could not be safely filtered. Your draft was not submitted.",
	WITHHELD="This note cannot currently be displayed.", CONFLICT="This note changed. Refresh and try again.",
}
local function token(value,maximum)
	return type(value)=="string" and #value>=1 and #value<=maximum and value:match("^[%w_%-]+$")~=nil
end
P.token=token
function P.integer(n,minimum,maximum)
	return type(n)=="number" and n==n and n%1==0 and n>=minimum and n<=maximum
end
function P.message(value)
	if type(value)~="string" or #value>1200 then return nil end
	local length=utf8.len(value)
	if not length or length>300 or value:find("[%z\1-\8\11\12\14-\31\127]") then return nil end
	local clean=value:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
	if clean=="" or not clean:find("[^%s]") then return nil end
	return clean
end
local fields={
	List={sort=true,category=true,cursor=true}, Submit={op=true,category=true,message=true},
	Support={op=true,id=true,desired=true,expected=true}, Report={op=true,id=true,reason=true},
	ModerateList={sort=true,category=true,cursor=true,reportedOnly=true,archived=true},
	Hide={op=true,id=true,reason=true}, ReviewReports={id=true}, Capabilities={},
}
function P.validate(action,payload)
	local allowed=fields[action]
	if not allowed or type(payload)~="table" or getmetatable(payload)~=nil then return false end
	local count=0
	for k in pairs(payload) do count+=1;if count>6 or not allowed[k] then return false end end
	if action=="Submit" then return token(payload.op,40) and table.find(P.Categories,payload.category)~=nil and P.message(payload.message)~=nil end
	if action=="Support" then return token(payload.op,40) and token(payload.id,40) and type(payload.desired)=="boolean" and P.integer(payload.expected,0,1e9) end
	if action=="Report" or action=="Hide" then return token(payload.op,40) and token(payload.id,40) and table.find(P.Reasons,payload.reason)~=nil end
	if action=="ReviewReports" then return token(payload.id,40) end
	if action=="List" or action=="ModerateList" then
		return table.find(P.Sorts,payload.sort)~=nil and (payload.category==nil or table.find(P.Categories,payload.category)~=nil)
			and (payload.cursor==nil or token(payload.cursor,40)) and (payload.reportedOnly==nil or type(payload.reportedOnly)=="boolean")
			and (payload.archived==nil or type(payload.archived)=="boolean")
	end
	return true
end
return P

local Transport={}
function Transport.new(network)
	local http=game:GetService("HttpService");local pending={};local count=0
	network.Response.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(sequence,result)
		local entry=pending[sequence]
		if entry and type(result)=="table" then entry.result=result;entry.done=true end
	end)
	return function(action,payload)
		if count>=2 then return {ok=false,code="BUSY",message="Please wait for the current request."} end
		local sequence=http:GenerateGUID(false);local entry={done=false};pending[sequence]=entry;count+=1
		network.Request:FireServer(sequence,action,payload)

	end
end

--!strict
-- Audio decisions only; no changes to weapon eligibility, hits, damage or rewards.
local ActionCues = {}
local metal = { Metal = true, DiamondPlate = true, CorrodedMetal = true, Foil = true }
local soft = {
	Air = true,
	Water = true,
	Sand = true,
	Ground = true,
	Grass = true,
	LeafyGrass = true,
	Fabric = true,
	Snow = true,
	Mud = true,
}
function ActionCues.impactCue(material: string, character: boolean): string?
	if character or soft[material] then
		return nil
	end
	if metal[material] then
		return "ImpactMetal"
	end
	if material == "Wood" or material == "WoodPlanks" then
		return "ImpactWood"
	end
	return "ImpactHard"
end
function ActionCues.impacts(hits: { any }): { any }
	local result, seen = {}, {}
	for _, hit in hits do
		if not hit.instance or not hit.material then
			continue
		end
		local cue = ActionCues.impactCue(hit.material.Name, hit.isCharacter == true)
		if cue and not seen[cue] then
			seen[cue] = true
			table.insert(result, { cue = cue, position = hit.position })
			if #result == 2 then
				break
			end
		end
	end
	return result
end
function ActionCues.newClock(): any
	return { round = nil, phase = "", previous = math.huge, warned = false }
end
function ActionCues.clock(s: any, round: number, phase: string, left: number): string?
	if s.round ~= round then
		s.round, s.phase, s.previous, s.warned = round, "", math.huge, false
	end
	local previousPhase, previousTime = s.phase, s.previous
	s.phase, s.previous = phase, left
	if phase == "Overtime" and previousPhase ~= "Overtime" then
		return "Overtime"
	end
	if
		phase == "Active"
		and previousPhase == "Active"
		and not s.warned
		and previousTime > 30
		and left <= 30
		and left > 0
	then
		s.warned = true
		return "TimeWarning"
	end
	return nil
end
function ActionCues.skinChanged(previous: any, snapshot: any): (string?, boolean)
	local skin = typeof(snapshot) == "table" and typeof(snapshot.equipped) == "table" and snapshot.equipped.skin
	if typeof(skin) ~= "string" then
		return previous, false
	end
	return skin, typeof(previous) == "string" and previous ~= skin
end

function ActionCues.ambience(mode: string, participant: boolean, phase: string, arena: any): string?
	if mode == "Practice" then
		return "RangeAir"
	end
	if mode ~= "Match" or not participant then
		return nil
	end
	if phase ~= "Starting" and phase ~= "Active" and phase ~= "Overtime" and phase ~= "Results" then
		return nil
	end
	if arena == "AmbWarehouse" or arena == "AmbDustTown" or arena == "AmbRooftops" then
		return arena
	end
	return nil
end
return ActionCues

--!strict
-- Presentation decisions only. Damage and eligibility remain server-authoritative.
local Feedback = {}

function Feedback.pumpCue(event: string): string?
	return if event == "PumpBack" or event == "PumpForward" then event else nil
end

function Feedback.hit(results: { any })
	local hits = {}
	local headshot, killed, playerKill, doublePump = false, false, false, false
	for _, result in results do
		if result.protected or typeof(result.damage) ~= "number" or result.damage <= 0 then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(hits, result)
		headshot = headshot or result.headshot == true
		killed = killed or result.killed == true
		playerKill = playerKill or (result.killed == true and result.dummy ~= true)
		doublePump = doublePump or (result.killed == true and result.dummy ~= true and result.doublePump == true)
	end
	local cue = if #hits == 0
		then nil
		elseif playerKill then (if doublePump then "DoublePumpElim" else "Elimination")
		elseif headshot then "HitHead"
		else "HitBody"
	return { hits = hits, headshot = headshot, killed = killed, cue = cue }
end

return Feedback

--!strict
-- Presentation only: called with server-validated occupancy, never client intent.
local LobbyCues = {}
export type State = { queued: boolean, phase: string, second: number?, boundaryAt: number }
function LobbyCues.new(): State
	return { queued = false, phase = "Waiting", second = nil, boundaryAt = -math.huge }
end
function LobbyCues.step(
	s: State,
	queued: boolean,
	phase: string,
	second: number,
	now: number,
	selected: boolean
): string?
	local previousQueued, previousPhase, previousSecond = s.queued, s.phase, s.second
	s.queued, s.phase = queued, phase
	s.second = if queued and phase == "Countdown" then second else nil
	if selected then
		return nil
	end -- Admission gets its own cue only after reservation.
	if previousQueued ~= queued then
		if now - s.boundaryAt < 1 then
			return nil
		end
		s.boundaryAt = now
		return if queued then "QueueJoin" else "QueueLeave"
	end
	if queued and previousPhase == "Countdown" and phase == "Waiting" then
		return "QueueCancel"
	end
	if queued and phase == "Countdown" and second > 0 and (previousPhase ~= phase or previousSecond ~= second) then
		return "QueueCountdown"
	end
	return nil
end
local allowed = {
	Assist = true,
	Overtime = true,
	TimeWarning = true,
	QueueJoin = true,
	QueueLeave = true,
	QueueCountdown = true,
	QueueCancel = true,
	Admitted = true,
	ReturnToRange = true,
}
function LobbyCues.accept(last: number, payload: any): (number, string?)
	if
		typeof(payload) ~= "table"
		or typeof(payload.serial) ~= "number"
		or payload.serial ~= payload.serial
		or payload.serial == math.huge
		or payload.serial % 1 ~= 0
		or payload.serial <= last
		or typeof(payload.cue) ~= "string"
		or not allowed[payload.cue]
	then
		return last, nil
	end
	return payload.serial, payload.cue
end
function LobbyCues.rewardCue(reward: any): string
	if
		typeof(reward.masteryBefore) == "number"
		and typeof(reward.masteryAfter) == "number"
		and reward.masteryAfter > reward.masteryBefore
	then
		return "MasteryMilestone"
	end
	if
		typeof(reward.levelBefore) == "number"
		and typeof(reward.levelAfter) == "number"
		and reward.levelAfter > reward.levelBefore
	then
		return "LevelUp"
	end
	if typeof(reward.unlocks) == "number" and reward.unlocks > 0 then
		return "Unlock"
	end
	return "Reward"
end
return LobbyCues

--!strict
-- Presentation-only distance cadence. Never writes movement or combat state.
local MovementCues = {}
MovementCues.Stride = 4
MovementCues.MinimumInterval = 0.16

export type State = {
	travel: number,
	elapsed: number,
	air: number,
	downward: number,
	grounded: boolean?,
	established: boolean,
}

function MovementCues.new(): State
	return { travel = 0, elapsed = 0, air = 0, downward = 0, grounded = nil, established = false }
end

function MovementCues.surface(material: string): string?
	if material == "Air" or material == "Water" then
		return nil
	elseif material == "Metal" or material == "DiamondPlate" or material == "CorrodedMetal" then
		return "StepMetal"
	elseif material == "Sand" or material == "Ground" then
		return "StepSand"
	elseif material == "Wood" or material == "WoodPlanks" then
		return "StepWood"
	end
	return "StepConcrete"
end

function MovementCues.advance(
	s: State,
	dt: number,
	distance: number,
	grounded: boolean,
	speed: number,
	vertical: number,
	enabled: boolean
): string?
	if not enabled or dt <= 0 or dt > 0.25 or distance > 12 then
		s.travel, s.elapsed, s.air, s.downward, s.grounded = 0, 0, 0, 0, nil
		s.established = false
		return nil
	end
	s.elapsed += dt
	if not grounded then
		s.air += dt
		s.downward = math.min(s.downward, vertical)
		s.travel = 0
		s.grounded = false
		return nil
	end
	local landed = s.established and s.grounded == false and s.air >= 0.08 and s.downward <= -5
	s.grounded, s.air, s.downward = true, 0, 0
	s.established = true
	if landed then
		s.travel, s.elapsed = 0, 0
		return "Landing"
	end
	if speed < 1.5 or distance > math.max(2, speed * dt * 3) then
		s.travel = 0
		return nil
	end
	s.travel += distance
	if s.travel >= MovementCues.Stride and s.elapsed >= MovementCues.MinimumInterval then
		-- At most one event per sample; a stall cannot produce a catch-up burst.
		s.travel %= MovementCues.Stride
		s.elapsed = 0
		return "Step"
	end
	return nil
end

return MovementCues
ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Collision:
--!strict
-- Collision groups and raycast parameters shared by client and server.
--
-- HumanoidRootPart is an invisible upright box; shots must ignore it (it doesn't
-- crouch with the body), so root parts live in "RootParts", which the "Shots" group
-- doesn't collide with. Map pieces marked "ShotsPassThrough" (railings, fences)
-- go in "ShotThrough": players collide with them, pellets fly through.

local PhysicsService = game:GetService("PhysicsService")

local Collision = {}

Collision.ROOT = "RootParts"
Collision.SHOTS = "Shots"
Collision.SHOT_THROUGH = "ShotThrough"
Collision.EFFECTS = "Effects"

function Collision.setup()
	for _, name in { Collision.ROOT, Collision.SHOTS, Collision.SHOT_THROUGH, Collision.EFFECTS } do
		if not PhysicsService:IsCollisionGroupRegistered(name) then
			PhysicsService:RegisterCollisionGroup(name)
		end
	end
	PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable(Collision.SHOTS, Collision.ROOT, false)
	PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable(Collision.SHOTS, Collision.SHOT_THROUGH, false)
	PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable(Collision.SHOTS, Collision.EFFECTS, false)
	-- Spent shells and debris bounce on the map but never push players around
	PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable(Collision.EFFECTS, Collision.ROOT, false)
	PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable(Collision.EFFECTS, "Default", true)
	PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable(Collision.EFFECTS, Collision.EFFECTS, false)
end

-- Raycast params for pellets: everything except the given list, in the Shots group.
function Collision.shotParams(exclude: { Instance }): RaycastParams
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = exclude
	params.CollisionGroup = Collision.SHOTS
	params.IgnoreWater = true
	return params
end

-- Raycast params that only see the map geometry (walls), for occlusion checks.
function Collision.worldParams(mapRoots: { Instance }): RaycastParams
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = mapRoots
	params.CollisionGroup = Collision.SHOTS
	params.IgnoreWater = true
	return params
end

return Collision
ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Combatants:
--!strict
-- Identifies things that can be shot: player characters and practice dummies.
-- Both are Models with a Humanoid, tagged "Combatant". The server sets a "Team"
-- attribute ("Red"/"Blue") on player characters in a match; dummies have "Dummy" = true.

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Combatants = {}

Combatants.TAG = "Combatant"

-- The combatant model + humanoid that a hit part belongs to, if any.
function Combatants.fromPart(part: Instance?): (Model?, Humanoid?)
	local current = part
	while current and current ~= workspace do
		if current:IsA("Model") and CollectionService:HasTag(current, Combatants.TAG) then
			local humanoid = current:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if humanoid then
				return current, humanoid
			end
			return nil, nil
		end
		current = current.Parent
	end
	return nil, nil
end

function Combatants.player(model: Model): Player?
	return Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
end

function Combatants.isDummy(model: Model): boolean
	return model:GetAttribute("Dummy") == true
end

function Combatants.team(model: Model): string?
	return model:GetAttribute("Team") :: string?
end

-- Can `attacker` damage `target`?
function Combatants.isEnemy(attacker: Model, target: Model): boolean
	if attacker == target then
		return false
	end
	local ac, bc = attacker:GetAttribute("CombatContext"), target:GetAttribute("CombatContext")
	if ac == "Lobby" then
		return Combatants.isDummy(target) or bc == "Lobby"
	end
	if ac ~= nil or bc ~= nil then
		if
			ac ~= "Match"
			or bc ~= "Match"
			or attacker:GetAttribute("CombatMatchId") ~= target:GetAttribute("CombatMatchId")
		then
			return false
		end
	end
	if Combatants.isDummy(target) then
		return true
	end
	local a, b = Combatants.team(attacker), Combatants.team(target)
	if a == nil or b == nil then
		-- Outside a match (practice range) players can't hurt each other
		return false
	end
	return a ~= b
end

function Combatants.isAlive(model: Model): boolean
	local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	return humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0 and model:GetAttribute("Dead") ~= true
end

function Combatants.all(): { Model }
	local list = {}
	for _, inst in CollectionService:GetTagged(Combatants.TAG) do
		if inst:IsA("Model") and inst:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			table.insert(list, inst)
		end
	end
	return list
end

-- Body parts tracked for lag compensation (R15 + R6 names).
Combatants.HitParts = {
	"Head",
	"UpperTorso",
	"LowerTorso",
	"Torso",
	"LeftUpperArm",
	"LeftLowerArm",
	"LeftHand",
	"RightUpperArm",

	"LeftFoot",
	"RightUpperLeg",
	"RightLowerLeg",
	"RightFoot",
	"Left Arm",
	"Right Arm",
	"Left Leg",
	"Right Leg",
}

return Combatants

ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Match.LobbyQueu:
--!strict
-- Pure FIFO queue. Occupancy is supplied by the server on every step, including
-- the final step at the countdown deadline. No client can enqueue itself.
local LobbyQueue = {}

export type Queue = {
	config: { Minimum: number, Capacity: number, Countdown: number },
	order: { any },
	deadline: number?,
}

function LobbyQueue.new(config: { Minimum: number, Capacity: number, Countdown: number }): Queue
	return { config = config, order = {}, deadline = nil }
end

function LobbyQueue.contains(cframe: CFrame, size: Vector3, point: Vector3): boolean
	local p = cframe:PointToObjectSpace(point)
	return math.abs(p.X) <= size.X / 2 and math.abs(p.Y) <= size.Y / 2 and math.abs(p.Z) <= size.Z / 2
end

function LobbyQueue.step(q: Queue, occupants: { any }, now: number, available: boolean): ({ any }, string)
	local present, seen = {}, {}
	for _, key in occupants do
		present[key] = true
	end
	local order = {}
	for _, key in q.order do
		if present[key] then
			seen[key] = true
			table.insert(order, key)
		end
	end
	for _, key in occupants do
		if not seen[key] then
			seen[key] = true
			table.insert(order, key)
		end
	end
	q.order = order
	if not available or #order < q.config.Minimum then
		q.deadline = nil
		return {}, if available then "Waiting" else "Pending"
	end
	if not q.deadline then
		q.deadline = now + q.config.Countdown
	end
	if now < (q.deadline :: number) then
		return {}, "Countdown"
	end
	local selected = {}
	for _ = 1, math.min(q.config.Capacity, #order) do
		table.insert(selected, table.remove(order, 1))
	end
	q.deadline = nil
	return selected, "Admitting"
end

return LobbyQueue
ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Match.MatchRule:
--!strict
-- The match state machine as pure logic (no Roblox APIs), driven by a single step()
-- with a time delta, so there is exactly one timer and transitions can't overlap.
--
--   Waiting -> Intermission -> Starting -> Active [-> Overtime] -> Results -> Voting -> Starting ...
--
-- step() returns a list of events for MatchService to act on (spawn players, load a
-- map, award wins). Score changes go through addScore(), which can end the match.

export type State = "Waiting" | "Intermission" | "Starting" | "Active" | "Overtime" | "Results" | "Voting"

export type Event =
	{ kind: "State", from: State, to: State }
	| { kind: "MatchStarted" }
	| { kind: "MatchEnded", winner: string?, reason: string }
	| { kind: "VotingEnded" }
	| { kind: "Countdown", seconds: number }

export type Match = {
	config: any,
	state: State,
	timeLeft: number,
	scores: { [string]: number },
	target: number,
	winner: string?,
	endReason: string?,
	lowPlayerTime: number,
	matchNumber: number,
	lastCountdown: number,
}

local MatchRules = {}

MatchRules.TEAMS = { "Red", "Blue" }

function MatchRules.new(config: any): Match
	return {
		config = config,
		state = "Waiting",
		timeLeft = 0,
		scores = { Red = 0, Blue = 0 },
		target = config.ScoreToWin,
		winner = nil,
		endReason = nil,
		lowPlayerTime = 0,
		matchNumber = 0,
		lastCountdown = -1,
	}
end

-- Kill target for the number of players in the match.
function MatchRules.targetFor(config: any, players: number): number
	if not config.ScaleScoreWithPlayers then
		return config.ScoreToWin
	end
	local scaled = math.ceil(config.ScoreToWin * math.clamp(players, 1, config.MaxPlayers) / config.MaxPlayers)
	scaled = math.ceil(scaled / 5) * 5
	return math.clamp(scaled, config.ScoreToWinMin, config.ScoreToWin)
end

local function enter(m: Match, to: State, duration: number, events: { Event })
	local from = m.state
	m.state = to
	m.timeLeft = duration
	m.lastCountdown = -1
	table.insert(events, { kind = "State", from = from, to = to } :: any)
end

local function leader(m: Match): string?
	local r, b = m.scores.Red, m.scores.Blue
	if r > b then
		return "Red"
	elseif b > r then
		return "Blue"
	end
	return nil
end

local function finish(m: Match, winner: string?, reason: string, events: { Event })
	m.winner = winner
	m.endReason = reason
	table.insert(events, { kind = "MatchEnded", winner = winner, reason = reason })
	enter(m, "Results", m.config.ResultsTime, events)
end

local function startMatch(m: Match, players: number, events: { Event })
	m.scores.Red = 0
	m.scores.Blue = 0
	m.winner = nil
	m.endReason = nil
	m.target = MatchRules.targetFor(m.config, players)
	m.matchNumber += 1
	m.lowPlayerTime = 0
	enter(m, "Active", m.config.Duration, events)
	table.insert(events, { kind = "MatchStarted" })
end

export type Context = {
	players: number, -- players taking part (deployed)
	teamCounts: { [string]: number }?,
	soloAllowed: boolean?,
	voluntary: boolean?, -- production: only a server-selected physical queue roster
	admitted: boolean?, -- one-shot admission after the queue's final occupancy check
}

local function enough(m: Match, ctx: Context): boolean
	local need = if ctx.soloAllowed then 1 else m.config.MinPlayersToStart
	return ctx.players >= need
end

function MatchRules.step(m: Match, dt: number, ctx: Context): { Event }
	local events: { Event } = {}
	local c = m.config
	local s = m.state
	m.timeLeft = math.max(0, m.timeLeft - dt)

	if s == "Waiting" then
		if enough(m, ctx) and (not ctx.voluntary or ctx.admitted) then
			enter(
				m,
				if ctx.voluntary then "Voting" else "Intermission",
				if ctx.voluntary then c.VotingTime else c.IntermissionTime,
				events
			)
		end
	elseif s == "Intermission" then
		if not enough(m, ctx) then
			enter(m, "Waiting", 0, events)
		elseif m.timeLeft <= 0 then
			enter(m, "Starting", c.StartingCountdown, events)
		end
	elseif s == "Starting" then
		if not enough(m, ctx) then
			enter(m, "Waiting", 0, events)
		else
			local whole = math.ceil(m.timeLeft)
			if whole ~= m.lastCountdown and whole > 0 then
				m.lastCountdown = whole
				table.insert(events, { kind = "Countdown", seconds = whole })
			end
			if m.timeLeft <= 0 then
				startMatch(m, ctx.players, events)
			end
		end
	elseif s == "Active" or s == "Overtime" then
		-- Too few players for a while (people left): end the match on the current score.
		if not enough(m, ctx) then
			m.lowPlayerTime += dt
			if m.lowPlayerTime >= 10 then
				finish(m, leader(m), "NotEnoughPlayers", events)
				return events
			end
		else
			m.lowPlayerTime = 0
		end
		if m.timeLeft <= 0 then
			local winner = leader(m)
			if winner then
				finish(m, winner, if s == "Overtime" then "Overtime" else "Time", events)
			elseif s == "Active" and c.OvertimeEnabled then
				enter(m, "Overtime", c.OvertimeDuration, events)
			else
				finish(m, nil, "Draw", events)
			end
		end
	elseif s == "Results" then
		if m.timeLeft <= 0 then
			enter(m, if ctx.voluntary then "Waiting" else "Voting", if ctx.voluntary then 0 else c.VotingTime, events)
		end
	elseif s == "Voting" then
		if m.timeLeft <= 0 then
			table.insert(events, { kind = "VotingEnded" })
			if enough(m, ctx) then
				enter(m, "Starting", c.StartingCountdown, events)
			else
				enter(m, "Waiting", 0, events)
			end
		end
	end
	return events
end

-- Records an elimination for `team`. Returns events (may end the match).
function MatchRules.addScore(m: Match, team: string, amount: number?): { Event }
	local events: { Event } = {}
	if m.state ~= "Active" and m.state ~= "Overtime" then
		return events
	end
	if m.scores[team] == nil then
		return events
	end
	m.scores[team] += amount or 1
	if m.scores[team] >= m.target then
		finish(m, team, "Score", events)
	elseif m.state == "Overtime" then
		-- Sudden death: the first elimination in overtime wins it
		finish(m, team, "Overtime", events)
	end
	return events
end

function MatchRules.inCombat(m: Match): boolean
	return m.state == "Active" or m.state == "Overtime"
end

return MatchRules
ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Match.SpawnScor:
--!strict
-- Picks the safest team spawn: far from living enemies, not in an enemy's line of sight,
-- and not the spawn someone just used. Pure; the line-of-sight test is passed in.

local SpawnScoring = {}

export type Candidate = { position: Vector3, lastUsed: number }

function SpawnScoring.score(
	c: Candidate,
	enemies: { Vector3 },
	now: number,
	radius: number,
	visible: (Vector3, Vector3) -> boolean
): number
	local nearest = math.huge
	local seen = false
	for _, enemy in enemies do
		local d = (enemy - c.position).Magnitude
		nearest = math.min(nearest, d)
		if not seen and d < radius * 3 and visible(enemy, c.position) then
			seen = true
		end
	end
	local score = math.min(nearest, radius * 4)
	if nearest < radius then
		score -= 200 -- an enemy right next to it
	end
	if seen then
		score -= 120
	end
	-- Spread spawns out: penalise ones used in the last few seconds
	local since = now - c.lastUsed
	if since < 4 then
		score -= (4 - since) * 25
	end
	return score
end

-- Index of the best candidate (ties: the first).
function SpawnScoring.best(
	candidates: { Candidate },
	enemies: { Vector3 },
	now: number,
	radius: number,
	visible: (Vector3, Vector3) -> boolean
): number?
	local bestIndex, bestScore = nil, -math.huge
	for i, c in candidates do
		local s = SpawnScoring.score(c, enemies, now, radius, visible)
		if s > bestScore then
			bestIndex, bestScore = i, s
		end
	end
	return bestIndex
end

return SpawnScoring
ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Match.TeamBalan:
--!strict
-- Team assignment and balancing as pure functions over team member lists.

local TeamBalance = {}

export type Teams = { [string]: { any } }

-- Team a newcomer should join: the smaller team; on a tie, the one with the lower
-- score (helps the losing side); on a further tie, Red.
function TeamBalance.pick(teams: Teams, scores: { [string]: number }?, maxSize: number): string?
	local red, blue = #teams.Red, #teams.Blue
	if red >= maxSize and blue >= maxSize then
		return nil
	end
	if red < blue then
		return "Red"
	elseif blue < red then
		return "Blue"
	end
	if scores and scores.Blue < scores.Red then
		return "Blue"
	end
	return "Red"
end

-- If the teams differ by `gap` or more, returns (fromTeam, toTeam) for one move.
function TeamBalance.needsMove(teams: Teams, gap: number): (string?, string?)
	local red, blue = #teams.Red, #teams.Blue
	if red - blue >= gap then
		return "Red", "Blue"
	elseif blue - red >= gap then
		return "Blue", "Red"
	end
	return nil, nil
end

-- Splits a list of players into two teams of equal size (± 1), keeping input order.
function TeamBalance.split(list: { any }): Teams
	local teams: Teams = { Red = {}, Blue = {} }
	for i, p in list do
		table.insert(if i % 2 == 1 then teams.Red else teams.Blue, p)
	end
	return teams
end

return TeamBalance
ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Match.VoteTally:
--!strict
-- Map vote counting. Ties are broken by a seeded random pick among the tied maps, so
-- every tied map has an equal chance; with no votes at all, a random option other
-- than the map just played (when possible).

local VoteTally = {}

-- votes: voter -> option id. options: the ids on offer.
function VoteTally.counts(votes: { [any]: string }, options: { string }): { [string]: number }
	local counts = {}
	for _, id in options do
		counts[id] = 0
	end
	for _, id in votes do
		if counts[id] ~= nil then
			counts[id] += 1
		end
	end
	return counts
end

function VoteTally.winner(votes: { [any]: string }, options: { string }, previous: string?, rng: Random): string
	local counts = VoteTally.counts(votes, options)
	local best = -1
	local tied: { string } = {}
	for _, id in options do
		local n = counts[id]
		if n > best then
			best = n
			tied = { id }
		elseif n == best then
			table.insert(tied, id)
		end
	end
	if best == 0 and previous and #tied > 1 then
		local filtered = {}
		for _, id in tied do
			if id ~= previous then
				table.insert(filtered, id)
			end
		end
		if #filtered > 0 then
			tied = filtered
		end
	end
	return tied[rng:NextInteger(1, #tied)]
end

-- Up to `count` options from all maps. With more maps than slots the previous map is
-- left out; with exactly `count` maps all are offered.
function VoteTally.options(all: { string }, count: number, previous: string?, rng: Random): { string }
	local pool = table.clone(all)
	if #pool > count and previous then
		local i = table.find(pool, previous)
		if i then
			table.remove(pool, i)
		end
	end
	-- Fisher-Yates
	for i = #pool, 2, -1 do
		local j = rng:NextInteger(1, i)
		pool[i], pool[j] = pool[j], pool[i]
	end
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, math.min(count, #pool) do
		out[i] = pool[i]
	end
	return out
end

return VoteTally

ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Mobile.FireSequ:
--!strict
-- One fire press; one outstanding swipe intent. No timers/animation callbacks,
-- retries, remote calls or independent cooldowns. The weapon state decides readiness.
local FireSequence = {}
FireSequence.__index = FireSequence
export type State = typeof(setmetatable({} :: { held: boolean, pending: number? }, FireSequence))
function FireSequence.new(): State
	return setmetatable({ held = false, pending = nil }, FireSequence)
end
function FireSequence.press(self: State, fire: () -> ())
	if self.held then
		return
	end
	self.held = true
	self.pending = nil
	fire()
end
function FireSequence.release(self: State)
	self.held = false
	self.pending = nil
end
function FireSequence.swipe(self: State, swap: () -> number?): boolean
	local slot = swap()
	if not slot then
		return false
	end
	if self.held then
		-- A fresh deliberate gesture may switch again before the previous gun is
		-- ready. Replace that intent; never queue a shot for a holstered weapon.
		self.pending = slot
	end
	return true
end
function FireSequence.step(
	self: State,
	active: boolean,
	equipped: number,
	ready: boolean,
	reason: string?,
	fire: () -> ()
)
	if not active then
		self:release()
	end
	if not self.held or self.pending ~= equipped then
		self.pending = nil
		return
	end
	if ready or reason == "Empty" then
		self.pending = nil -- consume before callback; rejected requests never retry
		fire()
	end
end
return FireSequence
ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Mobile.Layout:
--!strict
-- Logical GUI pixels within DeviceSafeInsets. One layout, reflected horizontally.
local Layout = {}
export type Rect = { x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number }
export type Result = { unit: number, rects: { [string]: Rect } }

Layout.Gesture = { MaxDuration = 0.30, MinDistance = 72, Dominance = 1.8, MaxUpward = 16 }

function Layout.contains(r: Rect, x: number, y: number): boolean
	return x >= r.x and x <= r.x + r.w and y >= r.y and y <= r.y + r.h
end

function Layout.overlaps(a: Rect, b: Rect, gap: number?): boolean
	local g = gap or 0
	return a.x < b.x + b.w + g and a.x + a.w + g > b.x and a.y < b.y + b.h + g and a.y + a.h + g > b.y
end

function Layout.calculate(width: number, height: number, left: boolean, saved: any?): Result
	width, height = math.max(width, 320), math.max(height, 240)
	local portrait = height > width
	local u = math.clamp(math.min(width / 844, height / 390), 0.8, 1.5)
	local rects: { [string]: Rect } = {}
	local function circle(name: string, x: number, y: number, size: number)
		local d = size * u
		rects[name] =
			{ x = math.clamp(x * width - d / 2, 8 * u, width - d - 8 * u), y = y * height - d / 2, w = d, h = d }
	end
	circle("LegacyV2Constraint", 0.86, 0.62, 104)
	circle("Fire", 0.72, 0.70, 78)
	circle("Crouch", 0.86, 0.35, 56)
	circle("Reload", 0.95, 0.35, 56)
	circle("EquipA", 0.66, 0.47, 50)
	circle("EquipB", 0.75, 0.35, 50)
	circle("Move", 0.13, 0.77, 104)
	circle("Jump", 0.94, 0.87, 72)
	circle("Scoreboard", 0.56, 0.08, 42)
	circle("Menu", 0.63, 0.08, 42)
	for _, name in { "Scoreboard", "Menu" } do
		rects[name].y = math.max(height * 0.08, 116 * u) - rects[name].h / 2
	end
	rects.Swipe = { x = width * 0.24, y = height * 0.31, w = width * 0.23, h = height * 0.46 }
	rects.Ammo = { x = width * 0.72 - 105 * u, y = height - 60 * u, w = 210 * u, h = 120 * 210 / 460 * u }
	rects.Health =
		{ x = math.max(8 * u, width * 0.13 - 70 * u), y = height - 34 * u, w = 140 * u, h = 74 * 140 / 380 * u }
	if portrait then
		circle("LegacyV2Constraint", 0.84, 0.62, 104)
		circle("Fire", 0.59, 0.74, 78)
		circle("Crouch", 0.84, 0.35, 56)
		circle("Reload", 0.62, 0.35, 56)
		circle("EquipA", 0.61, 0.48, 50)
		circle("EquipB", 0.61, 0.22, 50)
		circle("Jump", 0.86, 0.82, 72)
		circle("Scoreboard", 0.45, 0.12, 42)
		circle("Menu", 0.80, 0.12, 42)
		for _, name in { "Scoreboard", "Menu" } do
			rects[name].y = math.max(height * 0.12, 116 * u) - rects[name].h / 2
		end
		rects.Swipe = { x = width * 0.06, y = height * 0.27, w = width * 0.38, h = height * 0.25 }
	end
	-- Version-2 saved positions are in canonical right-handed space. Reject unsafe
	-- overrides rather than allowing an invisible hit area to cover another control.
	if typeof(saved) == "table" then
		for _, name in
			{
				"LegacyV2Constraint",
				"Fire",
				"Crouch",
				"Reload",
				"EquipA",
				"EquipB",
				"Move",
				"Jump",
				"Scoreboard",
				"Menu",
			}
		do
			local v = saved[if name == "LegacyV2Constraint" then "Look" else name]
			if typeof(v) == "table" and typeof(v[1]) == "number" and typeof(v[2]) == "number" then
				local old = rects[name]
				local sc = if typeof(v[3]) == "number" then math.clamp(v[3], 0.8, 1.3) else 1
				local d = old.w * sc
				local candidate = { x = v[1] * width - d / 2, y = v[2] * height - d / 2, w = d, h = d }
				local valid = candidate.x >= 0
					and candidate.y >= 0
					and candidate.x + d <= width
					and candidate.y + d <= height
				for other, r in rects do
					if other ~= name and Layout.overlaps(candidate, r, 6 * u) then
						valid = false
					end
				end
				if valid then
					rects[name] = candidate
				end
			end
		end
	end
	-- Compatibility only: keep old override validation, but expose no look bounds/UI.
	local visible: { [string]: Rect } = {}
	for name, r in rects do
		if name ~= "LegacyV2Constraint" then
			visible[name] = r
		end
	end
	rects = visible
	if left then
		for _, r in rects do
			r.x = width - r.x - r.w
		end
	end
	return { unit = u, rects = rects }
end

return Layout

ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Mobile.TouchSta:
--!strict
-- No engine events: ownership and gesture decisions can be replayed in tests.
local Layout = require(script.Parent.Layout)
local TouchState = {}
TouchState.__index = TouchState
type Touch = { role: string, x: number, y: number, born: number, consumed: boolean, minY: number, maxX: number }
export type State = typeof(setmetatable(
	{} :: { touches: { [any]: Touch }, owners: { [string]: any }, unit: number },
	TouchState
))

function TouchState.new(unit: number): State
	return setmetatable({ touches = {}, owners = {}, unit = unit }, TouchState)
end

function TouchState.begin(self: State, id: any, role: string, x: number, y: number, now: number): boolean
	if self.touches[id] or self.owners[role] then
		return false
	end
	self.touches[id] = { role = role, x = x, y = y, born = now, consumed = false, minY = y, maxX = 0 }
	self.owners[role] = id
	return true
end

function TouchState.move(self: State, id: any, x: number, y: number, now: number): boolean
	local t = self.touches[id]
	if not t or t.role ~= "Swipe" or t.consumed then
		return false
	end
	local g = Layout.Gesture
	local dx, dy = math.abs(x - t.x), y - t.y
	t.minY = math.min(t.minY, y)
	t.maxX = math.max(t.maxX, dx)
	if now - t.born > g.MaxDuration or t.y - t.minY > g.MaxUpward * self.unit then
		t.consumed = true
		return false
	end
	if dy >= g.MinDistance * self.unit and dy >= t.maxX * g.Dominance then
		t.consumed = true
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function TouchState.finish(self: State, id: any): string?
	local t = self.touches[id]
	if not t then
		return nil
	end
	self.owners[t.role] = nil
	self.touches[id] = nil
	return t.role
end

function TouchState.clear(self: State)
	table.clear(self.touches)
	table.clear(self.owners)
end

function TouchState.stick(x: number, y: number, radius: number): Vector2
	local v = Vector2.new(x, y) / math.max(radius, 1)
	return if v.Magnitude > 1 then v.Unit else v
end

return TouchState
ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Net:
--!strict
-- Every RemoteEvent / RemoteFunction the game uses, created by the server at startup.
-- Weapon traffic goes through ONE ordered remote (WeaponAction) so an Equip always
-- arrives before the Fire that follows it.
--
-- Client -> server payloads are never trusted: every handler type-checks its arguments
-- and is rate limited (see Server/Services/Remotes.luau).

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Net = {}

Net.Events = {
	-- client -> server
	"WeaponAction", -- ("Equip", slot) | ("Fire", payload) | ("Reload") | ("CancelReload")
	"PlayerAction", -- ("Crouch", bool) | ("Look", pitch) | ("Deploy") | ("Practice") | ("Menu") | ("Vote", mapId) ...
	"ShopAction", -- ("Buy", itemId) | ("Equip", category, itemId) | ("BuyRobux", productKey)
	"SettingsAction", -- ("Save", settingsTable) | ("TutorialDone")

	-- server -> client
	"WeaponEvent", -- ("Snapshot", state) | ("Hit", results) | ("Shot", shooterCharacter, info) | ("Reset")
	"CombatEvent", -- ("Elimination", info) | ("Damaged", info) | ("Respawn", delay, killerName)
	"MatchEvent", -- ("Countdown", n) | ("Started") | ("Ended", results) | ("Voting", options) | ...
	"ProfileEvent", -- ("Profile", snapshot) | ("Reward", info) | ("Unlock", item)
	"Notify", -- (text, kind)
}

Net.Functions = {
	"GetLeaderboards",
	"GetProfile",
}

local FOLDER_NAME = "Remotes"

-- Server: create everything. Safe to call more than once.
function Net.setupServer(): Folder
	assert(RunService:IsServer(), "Net.setupServer is server-only")
	local folder = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(FOLDER_NAME) :: Folder?
	if not folder then
		local newFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
		newFolder.Name = FOLDER_NAME
		newFolder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
		folder = newFolder
	end
	assert(folder, "Remotes folder missing")
	for _, name in Net.Events do
		if not folder:FindFirstChild(name) then
			local remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
			remote.Name = name
			remote.Parent = folder
		end
	end
	for _, name in Net.Functions do
		if not folder:FindFirstChild(name) then
			local remote = Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
			remote.Name = name
			remote.Parent = folder
		end
	end
	return folder
end

local function folder(): Folder
	return ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild(FOLDER_NAME) :: Folder
end

function Net.event(name: string): RemoteEvent
	return folder():WaitForChild(name) :: RemoteEvent
end

function Net.func(name: string): RemoteFunction
	return folder():WaitForChild(name) :: RemoteFunction
end

return Net

ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Progression.Cha:
--!strict
-- Daily and weekly challenges. Each period picks a fixed set from the pool using the
-- period number as a seed, so every server shows the same challenges on the same day
-- without any shared storage. Progress is stored per player with the period it
-- belongs to; a new period starts fresh.

local Challenges = {}

export type Stat = "kills" | "headshots" | "doublePumps" | "assists" | "wins" | "matches" | "damage"

export type Def = {
	id: string,
	text: string,
	stat: Stat,
	goal: number,
	xp: number,
	coins: number,
}

Challenges.Daily = {
	{ id = "d_kills10", text = "Get 10 eliminations", stat = "kills", goal = 10, xp = 300, coins = 40 },
	{ id = "d_kills20", text = "Get 20 eliminations", stat = "kills", goal = 20, xp = 450, coins = 60 },

	{ id = "d_dp2", text = "Land 2 double pumps", stat = "doublePumps", goal = 2, xp = 400, coins = 50 },
	{ id = "d_assist5", text = "Get 5 assists", stat = "assists", goal = 5, xp = 250, coins = 35 },
	{ id = "d_win1", text = "Win a match", stat = "wins", goal = 1, xp = 350, coins = 45 },

	{ id = "d_dmg1500", text = "Deal 1,500 damage", stat = "damage", goal = 1500, xp = 300, coins = 40 },

Challenges.Weekly = {
	{ id = "w_kills100", text = "Get 100 eliminations", stat = "kills", goal = 100, xp = 1500, coins = 200 },
	{ id = "w_head30", text = "Get 30 headshot eliminations", stat = "headshots", goal = 30, xp = 1400, coins = 180 },
	{ id = "w_dp15", text = "Land 15 double pumps", stat = "doublePumps", goal = 15, xp = 1600, coins = 220 },
	{ id = "w_win8", text = "Win 8 matches", stat = "wins", goal = 8, xp = 1500, coins = 200 },
	{ id = "w_play15", text = "Play 15 matches", stat = "matches", goal = 15, xp = 1200, coins = 160 },
	{ id = "w_dmg12k", text = "Deal 12,000 damage", stat = "damage", goal = 12000, xp = 1300, coins = 170 },
} :: { Def }

Challenges.PerPeriod = { daily = 3, weekly = 3 }

local DAY = 86400
-- Weeks start Monday 00:00 UTC (1970-01-01 was a Thursday).
local WEEK_OFFSET = 3 * DAY

function Challenges.dayNumber(unix: number): number
	return unix // DAY
end

function Challenges.weekNumber(unix: number): number
	return (unix + WEEK_OFFSET) // (7 * DAY)
end

function Challenges.secondsLeft(kind: "daily" | "weekly", unix: number): number
	if kind == "daily" then
		return (Challenges.dayNumber(unix) + 1) * DAY - unix
	end
	return (Challenges.weekNumber(unix) + 1) * 7 * DAY - WEEK_OFFSET - unix
end

-- Deterministic pick of `count` distinct challenges for a period.
function Challenges.pick(pool: { Def }, period: number, count: number): { Def }
	local rng = Random.new(period * 7919 + #pool)
	local indices = {}
	for i = 1, #pool do
		indices[i] = i
	end
	for i = #indices, 2, -1 do
		local j = rng:NextInteger(1, i)
		indices[i], indices[j] = indices[j], indices[i]
	end
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, math.min(count, #pool) do
		table.insert(out, pool[indices[i]])
	end
	return out
end

function Challenges.find(id: string): Def?
	for _, pool in { Challenges.Daily, Challenges.Weekly } do
		for _, def in pool do
			if def.id == id then
				return def
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

export type Entry = { id: string, progress: number, done: boolean }
export type Set = { period: number, entries: { Entry } }

-- Returns the set for the current period, rolling over to new challenges if the stored
-- set is from an older period.
function Challenges.current(kind: "daily" | "weekly", stored: Set?, unix: number): Set
	local period = if kind == "daily" then Challenges.dayNumber(unix) else Challenges.weekNumber(unix)
	if stored and stored.period == period then
		return stored
	end
	local pool = if kind == "daily" then Challenges.Daily else Challenges.Weekly
	local entries = {}
	for _, def in Challenges.pick(pool, period, Challenges.PerPeriod[kind]) do
		table.insert(entries, { id = def.id, progress = 0, done = false })
	end
	return { period = period, entries = entries }
end

-- Adds match stats to a set. Returns the defs completed by this call (reward once).
function Challenges.progress(set: Set, delta: { [string]: number }): { Def }
	local completed = {}
	for _, entry in set.entries do
		local def = Challenges.find(entry.id)
		if def and not entry.done then
			local amount = delta[def.stat] or 0
			if amount > 0 then
				entry.progress = math.min(def.goal, entry.progress + amount)
				if entry.progress >= def.goal then
					entry.done = true
					table.insert(completed, def)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return completed
end

return Challenges
