ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Progression.Lev:
--!strict
-- Player level, match rewards and shotgun mastery. Pure functions, shared so the
-- server computes rewards and the client can show the same numbers.
--
-- Anti-idle: completion and win rewards scale with how much of the match the player
-- was actually playing (moving, aiming, shooting). A player who stands still all match
-- gets nothing beyond what they earned with eliminations.

local Levels = {}

Levels.MaxLevel = 100

-- XP needed to go from `level` to `level + 1`.
function Levels.xpToNext(level: number): number
	return math.min(400 + 100 * (level - 1), 2000)
end

export type LevelInfo = { level: number, into: number, need: number, isMax: boolean }

function Levels.fromXp(totalXp: number): LevelInfo
	local level = 1
	local remaining = math.max(0, math.floor(totalXp))
	while level < Levels.MaxLevel do
		local need = Levels.xpToNext(level)
		if remaining < need then
			return { level = level, into = remaining, need = need, isMax = false }
		end
		remaining -= need
		level += 1
	end
	return { level = Levels.MaxLevel, into = 0, need = 0, isMax = true }
end

Levels.Rewards = {
	Kill = 50,
	Assist = 20,
	Headshot = 10, -- bonus on top of Kill
	DoublePump = 25, -- bonus on top of Kill
	Completion = 100, -- for playing a whole match, scaled by time and activity
	Win = 150,
	CoinsPerKill = 5,
	CoinsCompletion = 25,
	CoinsWin = 50,
	MinActiveFraction = 0.35, -- below this, no completion/win reward at all
}

export type MatchSummary = {
	kills: number,
	assists: number,
	headshotKills: number,
	doublePumps: number,
	won: boolean,
	timePlayed: number,
	matchLength: number,
	activeTime: number, -- seconds with real input (moved, turned, fired)
}

export type Reward = { xp: number, coins: number, breakdown: { { label: string, xp: number } }, idle: boolean }

function Levels.matchReward(s: MatchSummary): Reward
	local R = Levels.Rewards
	local breakdown = {}
	local xp, coins = 0, 0
	local function add(label: string, amount: number)
		if amount > 0 then
			xp += amount
			table.insert(breakdown, { label = label, xp = amount })
		end
	end
	add("Eliminations", s.kills * R.Kill)
	add("Assists", s.assists * R.Assist)
	add("Headshots", s.headshotKills * R.Headshot)
	add("Double pumps", s.doublePumps * R.DoublePump)
	coins += s.kills * R.CoinsPerKill

	local length = math.max(1, s.matchLength)
	local presence = math.clamp(s.timePlayed / length, 0, 1)
	local active = if s.timePlayed > 0 then math.clamp(s.activeTime / s.timePlayed, 0, 1) else 0
	local idle = active < R.MinActiveFraction
	if not idle then
		local factor = presence * math.min(1, active / 0.7)
		add("Match played", math.floor(R.Completion * factor))
		coins += math.floor(R.CoinsCompletion * factor)
		if s.won then
			add("Victory", math.floor(R.Win * presence))
			coins += math.floor(R.CoinsWin * presence)
		end
	end
	return { xp = xp, coins = coins, breakdown = breakdown, idle = idle }
end

-- Shotgun mastery: eliminations with the pump shotgun.
Levels.Mastery = {
	{ kills = 25, name = "Bronze", color = Color3.fromRGB(205, 127, 50) },
	{ kills = 100, name = "Silver", color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 205, 215) },
	{ kills = 250, name = "Gold", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 60) },
	{ kills = 500, name = "Diamond", color = Color3.fromRGB(110, 220, 255) },
	{ kills = 1000, name = "Pump Master", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 40) },
}

export type MasteryInfo = { tier: number, name: string, kills: number, nextAt: number? }

function Levels.mastery(kills: number): MasteryInfo
	local tier = 0
	for i, t in Levels.Mastery do
		if kills >= t.kills then
			tier = i
		end
	end
	local nextTier = Levels.Mastery[tier + 1]
	return {
		tier = tier,
		name = if tier > 0 then Levels.Mastery[tier].name else "Unranked",
		kills = kills,
		nextAt = if nextTier then nextTier.kills else nil,
	}
end

return Levels
ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Progression.Pro:
--!strict
-- Saved profile schema. `sanitize` turns whatever came out of the DataStore (old
-- version, missing fields, corrupted values) into a valid current profile, keeping
-- everything that is still valid. Never throws.

local Challenges = require(script.Parent.Challenges)
local Cosmetics = require(script.Parent.Cosmetics)

local Preferences = require(script.Parent.Parent.Preferences)

local Profile = {}

Profile.Version = 3
Profile.MaxReceipts = 200

export type Stats = {
	kills: number,
	deaths: number,
	assists: number,
	headshots: number,
	doublePumps: number,
	wins: number,
	losses: number,
	matches: number,
	damage: number,
	pelletsFired: number,
	pelletsHit: number,
	timePlayed: number,
}

export type Data = {
	version: number,
	xp: number,
	coins: number,
	stats: Stats,
	masteryKills: number,
	owned: { [string]: boolean },
	equipped: { skin: string },
	daily: Challenges.Set?,
	weekly: Challenges.Set?,
	settings: { [string]: any },
	tutorialDone: boolean,
	receipts: { string }, -- PurchaseIds already granted (newest last)
	createdAt: number,
}

local STAT_KEYS = {
	"kills",
	"deaths",
	"assists",
	"headshots",
	"doublePumps",
	"wins",
	"losses",
	"matches",
	"damage",
	"pelletsFired",
	"pelletsHit",
	"timePlayed",
}
Profile.StatKeys = STAT_KEYS

function Profile.new(now: number): Data
	local stats = {}
	for _, key in STAT_KEYS do
		stats[key] = 0
	end
	return {
		version = Profile.Version,
		xp = 0,
		coins = 0,
		stats = stats :: any,
		masteryKills = 0,
		owned = { Default = true },
		equipped = { skin = "Default" },
		daily = nil,
		weekly = nil,
		settings = { controlLayout = "right", weaponHand = "right", touchLayoutV2 = {} },
		tutorialDone = false,
		receipts = {},
		createdAt = now,
	}
end

local function num(v: any, fallback: number): number
	if typeof(v) == "number" and v == v and v ~= math.huge and v ~= -math.huge then
		return math.max(0, v)
	end
	return fallback
end

local function challengeSet(v: any): Challenges.Set?
	if typeof(v) ~= "table" or typeof(v.period) ~= "number" or typeof(v.entries) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	local entries = {}
	for _, e in v.entries do
		if typeof(e) == "table" and typeof(e.id) == "string" and Challenges.find(e.id) then
			table.insert(entries, { id = e.id, progress = num(e.progress, 0), done = e.done == true })
		end
	end
	return { period = v.period, entries = entries }
end

function Profile.sanitize(raw: any, now: number): Data
	local p = Profile.new(now)
	if typeof(raw) ~= "table" then
		return p
	end
	p.xp = math.floor(num(raw.xp, 0))
	p.coins = math.floor(num(raw.coins, 0))
	p.masteryKills = math.floor(num(raw.masteryKills, 0))
	p.createdAt = num(raw.createdAt, now)
	p.tutorialDone = raw.tutorialDone == true
	if typeof(raw.stats) == "table" then
		for _, key in STAT_KEYS do
			(p.stats :: any)[key] = num(raw.stats[key], 0)
		end
	end
	if typeof(raw.owned) == "table" then
		for id, owned in raw.owned do
			if owned == true and Cosmetics.exists(id) then
				p.owned[id] = true
			end
		end
	end
	if typeof(raw.equipped) == "table" and Cosmetics.exists(raw.equipped.skin) and p.owned[raw.equipped.skin] then
		p.equipped.skin = raw.equipped.skin
	end
	p.daily = challengeSet(raw.daily)
	p.weekly = challengeSet(raw.weekly)
	if typeof(raw.settings) == "table" then
		for k, v in raw.settings do
			local t = typeof(v)
			if typeof(k) == "string" and (t == "number" or t == "boolean" or t == "string" or t == "table") then
				p.settings[k] = v
			end
		end
	end
	-- v1 -> v2: preserve legacy button positions separately; new control roles use
	-- a fresh layout so an old FIRE position cannot become an overlapping fire pad.
	-- v2 -> v3: retain both sides of the old coupled preference, then save separately.
	local presentation = Preferences.normalize(raw.settings)
	p.settings.controlLayout = presentation.controlLayout
	p.settings.weaponHand = presentation.weaponHand
	if typeof(p.settings.touchLayoutV2) ~= "table" then
		p.settings.touchLayoutV2 = {}
	end
	if typeof(raw.receipts) == "table" then
		for _, id in raw.receipts do
			if typeof(id) == "string" then
				table.insert(p.receipts, id)
			end
		end
		while #p.receipts > Profile.MaxReceipts do
			table.remove(p.receipts, 1)
		end
	end
	return p
end

function Profile.hasReceipt(p: Data, purchaseId: string): boolean
	return table.find(p.receipts, purchaseId) ~= nil
end

function Profile.addReceipt(p: Data, purchaseId: string)
	table.insert(p.receipts, purchaseId)
	while #p.receipts > Profile.MaxReceipts do
		table.remove(p.receipts, 1)
	end
end

return Profile
ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util.RateLimite:
--!strict
-- Token bucket per key (usually a Player). Allows a short burst, then `rate` per second.

local RateLimiter = {}
RateLimiter.__index = RateLimiter

type Bucket = { tokens: number, last: number }
export type Limiter = typeof(setmetatable(
	{} :: { burst: number, rate: number, buckets: { [any]: Bucket } },
	RateLimiter
))

function RateLimiter.new(burst: number, rate: number): Limiter
	return setmetatable({ burst = burst, rate = rate, buckets = {} }, RateLimiter)
end

function RateLimiter.allow(self: Limiter, key: any, now: number, cost: number?): boolean
	local bucket = self.buckets[key]
	if not bucket then
		bucket = { tokens = self.burst, last = now }
		self.buckets[key] = bucket
	end
	bucket.tokens = math.min(self.burst, bucket.tokens + (now - bucket.last) * self.rate)
	bucket.last = now
	local c = cost or 1
	if bucket.tokens < c then
		return false
	end
	bucket.tokens -= c
	return true
end

function RateLimiter.forget(self: Limiter, key: any)
	self.buckets[key] = nil
end

return RateLimiter
ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util.Signal:
--!strict
-- Minimal script signal for module-to-module events on one side of the network.

local Signal = {}
Signal.__index = Signal

export type Connection = { Disconnect: (self: Connection) -> (), Connected: boolean }
export type Signal<T...> = {
	Connect: (self: Signal<T...>, fn: (T...) -> ()) -> Connection,
	Once: (self: Signal<T...>, fn: (T...) -> ()) -> Connection,
	Fire: (self: Signal<T...>, T...) -> (),
	DisconnectAll: (self: Signal<T...>) -> (),
}

function Signal.new<T...>(): Signal<T...>
	return (setmetatable({ handlers = {} }, Signal) :: any) :: Signal<T...>
end

function Signal:Connect(fn)
	local handlers = self.handlers
	local connection
	connection = {
		Connected = true,
		Disconnect = function(c)
			if c.Connected then
				c.Connected = false
				local i = table.find(handlers, connection)
				if i then
					table.remove(handlers, i)
				end
			end
		end,
		fn = fn,
	}
	table.insert(handlers, connection)
	return connection
end

function Signal:Once(fn)
	local connection
	connection = self:Connect(function(...)
		connection:Disconnect()
		fn(...)
	end)
	return connection
end

function Signal:Fire(...)
	-- Copy so handlers may disconnect while firing
	for _, connection: any in table.clone(self.handlers) do
		if connection.Connected then
			task.spawn(connection.fn, ...)
		end
	end
end

function Signal:DisconnectAll()
	for _, connection: any in self.handlers do
		connection.Connected = false
	end
	table.clear(self.handlers)
end

return Signal
ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Util.Trove:
--!strict
-- Collects connections, instances and cleanup functions so they can all be released at
-- once (on death, respawn, map unload). Prevents event and instance leaks.

local Trove = {}
Trove.__index = Trove

export type Trove = typeof(setmetatable({} :: { items: { any } }, Trove))

function Trove.new(): Trove
	return setmetatable({ items = {} }, Trove)
end

function Trove.add<T>(self: Trove, item: T): T
	table.insert(self.items, item)
	return item
end

function Trove.connect(self: Trove, signal: RBXScriptSignal, fn: (...any) -> ()): RBXScriptConnection
	local connection = signal:Connect(fn)
	table.insert(self.items, connection)
	return connection
end

local function release(item: any)
	local kind = typeof(item)
	if kind == "RBXScriptConnection" then
		item:Disconnect()
	elseif kind == "Instance" then
		item:Destroy()
	elseif kind == "function" then
		item()
	elseif kind == "thread" then
		pcall(task.cancel, item)
	elseif kind == "table" then
		if item.Destroy then
			item:Destroy()
		elseif item.destroy then
			item:destroy()
		elseif item.Disconnect then
			item:Disconnect()
		end
	end
end

function Trove.clean(self: Trove)
	local items = self.items
	self.items = {}
	for i = #items, 1, -1 do
		release(items[i])
	end
end

Trove.Destroy = Trove.clean

return Trove
ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Weapons.AnimPla:
--!strict
-- Plays the shotgun's baked Blender animations (ShotgunAnimData) by sampling bone deltas.
-- One looping base clip (Idle) plus one action clip at a time, with short crossfades.
-- Animations are purely visual: gameplay timing lives in WeaponState, and callers can
-- stop/replace a clip at any moment (cancellation never touches cooldowns).

local AnimData = require(script.Parent.ShotgunAnimData)

local AnimPlayer = {}
AnimPlayer.__index = AnimPlayer

type Clip = {
	fps: number,
	duration: number,
	loop: boolean,
	events: { [string]: number },
	frames: { [string]: { CFrame } }, -- bone -> frame CFrames
}

type Playing = {
	clip: Clip,
	name: string,
	time: number,
	speed: number,
	weight: number,
	fadeIn: number,
	fadingOut: boolean,
	fadeOut: number,
	firedEvents: { [string]: boolean },
	onEvent: ((string) -> ())?,
	onEnd: (() -> ())?,
	hold: boolean, -- keep the last frame instead of fading out
}

export type AnimPlayer = typeof(setmetatable(
	{} :: {
		set: { [string]: Clip },
		base: Playing?,
		action: Playing?,
		previous: Playing?, -- fading-out action
		pose: { [string]: CFrame },
	},
	AnimPlayer
))

local clipCache: { [string]: { [string]: Clip } } = {}

local function buildClips(setName: string): { [string]: Clip }
	if clipCache[setName] then
		return clipCache[setName]
	end
	local raw = (AnimData :: any)[setName]
	local clips = {}
	for name, data in raw do
		local frames = {}
		for bone, list in data.tracks do
			local cframes = table.create(#list)
			for i, f in list do
				cframes[i] = CFrame.new(f[1], f[2], f[3], f[4], f[5], f[6], f[7])
			end
			frames[bone] = cframes
		end
		local short = name:gsub("^PumpShotgun_", "")
		clips[short] = {
			fps = data.fps,
			duration = data.duration,
			loop = data.loop,
			events = data.events,
			frames = frames,
		}
	end
	clipCache[setName] = clips
	return clips
end

-- setName: "FirstPerson" or "ThirdPerson"
function AnimPlayer.new(setName: string): AnimPlayer
	return setmetatable({
		set = buildClips(setName),
		base = nil,
		action = nil,
		previous = nil,
		pose = {},
	}, AnimPlayer)
end

function AnimPlayer.has(self: AnimPlayer, name: string): boolean
	return self.set[name] ~= nil
end

function AnimPlayer.duration(self: AnimPlayer, name: string): number
	local clip = self.set[name]
	return if clip then clip.duration else 0
end

function AnimPlayer.eventTime(self: AnimPlayer, name: string, event: string): number?
	local clip = self.set[name]
	return clip and clip.events[event]
end

local function sampleClip(clip: Clip, t: number, out: { [string]: CFrame })
	local position = t * clip.fps
	for bone, frames in clip.frames do
		local n = #frames
		local i = math.floor(position)
		local alpha = position - i
		if i >= n - 1 then
			out[bone] = frames[n]
		elseif i < 0 then
			out[bone] = frames[1]
		else
			out[bone] = frames[i + 1]:Lerp(frames[i + 2], alpha)
		end
	end
end

function AnimPlayer.playBase(self: AnimPlayer, name: string)
	local clip = self.set[name]
	if clip then
		self.base = {
			clip = clip,
			name = name,
			time = 0,
			speed = 1,
			weight = 1,
			fadeIn = 0,
			fadingOut = false,
			fadeOut = 0,
			firedEvents = {},
			hold = false,
		}
	end
end

export type PlayOptions = {
	speed: number?,
	fadeIn: number?,
	fadeOut: number?,
	startAt: number?, -- seconds into the clip
	hold: boolean?,
	onEvent: ((string) -> ())?,
	onEnd: (() -> ())?,
}

-- Starts an action clip, replacing (and fading out) any current one.
function AnimPlayer.play(self: AnimPlayer, name: string, options: PlayOptions?)
	local clip = self.set[name]
	if not clip then
		return
	end
	local o = (options or {}) :: PlayOptions
	local current = self.action
	if current then
		current.fadingOut = true
		current.fadeOut = math.max(o.fadeIn or 0.05, 0.001)
		self.previous = current
	end
	self.action = {
		clip = clip,
		name = name,
		time = o.startAt or 0,
		speed = o.speed or 1,
		weight = if (o.fadeIn or 0.05) <= 0 then 1 else 0,
		fadeIn = o.fadeIn or 0.05,
		fadingOut = false,
		fadeOut = o.fadeOut or 0.08,
		firedEvents = {},
		onEvent = o.onEvent,
		onEnd = o.onEnd,
		hold = o.hold == true,
	}
end

function AnimPlayer.current(self: AnimPlayer): string?
	return if self.action and not self.action.fadingOut then self.action.name else nil
end

function AnimPlayer.stop(self: AnimPlayer, fadeOut: number?)
	if self.action then
		self.action.fadingOut = true
		self.action.fadeOut = fadeOut or 0.08
	end
end

local function advance(p: Playing, dt: number)
	local before = p.time
	p.time += dt * p.speed
	if p.onEvent then
		for event, at in p.clip.events do
			if not p.firedEvents[event] and before <= at and p.time >= at then
				p.firedEvents[event] = true
				p.onEvent(event)
			end
		end
	end
	if p.clip.loop and p.time >= p.clip.duration then
		p.time %= p.clip.duration
		table.clear(p.firedEvents)
	end
end

-- Steps time and returns the blended pose (bone -> model-space delta).
function AnimPlayer.update(self: AnimPlayer, dt: number): { [string]: CFrame }
	local pose = self.pose
	table.clear(pose)
	if self.base then
		advance(self.base, dt)
		sampleClip(self.base.clip, self.base.time, pose)
	end

	local function blend(p: Playing)
		local layer = {}
		sampleClip(p.clip, math.min(p.time, p.clip.duration), layer)
		for bone, cf in layer do
			local under = pose[bone]
			pose[bone] = if under and p.weight < 1 then under:Lerp(cf, p.weight) else cf
		end
	end

	local prev = self.previous
	if prev then
		prev.weight -= dt / prev.fadeOut
		if prev.weight <= 0 then
			self.previous = nil
		else
			blend(prev)
		end
	end

	local action = self.action
	if action then
		advance(action, dt)
		if action.fadingOut then
			action.weight -= dt / action.fadeOut
		elseif action.weight < 1 then
			action.weight = math.min(1, action.weight + dt / math.max(action.fadeIn, 1e-3))
		end
		if not action.clip.loop and action.time >= action.clip.duration and not action.fadingOut then
			local onEnd = action.onEnd
			action.onEnd = nil
			if not action.hold then
				action.fadingOut = true
			end
			if onEnd then
				onEnd()
			end
		end
		if self.action == action then
			if action.weight <= 0 then
				self.action = nil
			else
				blend(action)
			end
		elseif self.action then
			-- onEnd started another clip; still show this one's last frame this step
			blend(action)
		end
	end
	return pose
end

return AnimPlayer
ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Weapons.Damage:
--!strict
-- Pellet damage maths: hit zones, distance falloff, caps. Pure functions.

local Damage = {}

export type Zone = "Head" | "Torso" | "Arm" | "Leg"

-- R15 and R6 body part names -> zone. Anything else (accessories, tools) is not a hit.
local PART_ZONES: { [string]: Zone } = {
	Head = "Head",
	UpperTorso = "Torso",
	LowerTorso = "Torso",
	Torso = "Torso",
	HumanoidRootPart = "Torso",
	LeftUpperArm = "Arm",
	LeftLowerArm = "Arm",
	LeftHand = "Arm",
	RightUpperArm = "Arm",
	RightLowerArm = "Arm",
	RightHand = "Arm",
	["Left Arm"] = "Arm",
	["Right Arm"] = "Arm",
	LeftUpperLeg = "Leg",
	LeftLowerLeg = "Leg",
	LeftFoot = "Leg",
	RightUpperLeg = "Leg",
	RightLowerLeg = "Leg",
	RightFoot = "Leg",
	["Left Leg"] = "Leg",
	["Right Leg"] = "Leg",
}

function Damage.zoneForPart(partName: string): Zone?
	return PART_ZONES[partName] :: Zone?
end

-- 1 up to FalloffStart, linear down to FalloffMinMultiplier at FalloffEnd, flat after.
function Damage.falloff(damageConfig: any, distance: number): number
	local start, finish = damageConfig.FalloffStart, damageConfig.FalloffEnd
	if distance <= start then
		return 1
	end
	if distance >= finish then
		return damageConfig.FalloffMinMultiplier
	end
	local alpha = (distance - start) / (finish - start)
	return 1 + (damageConfig.FalloffMinMultiplier - 1) * alpha
end

function Damage.pellet(damageConfig: any, zone: Zone, distance: number): number
	if distance > damageConfig.MaxRange then
		return 0
	end
	local multiplier = damageConfig.Multipliers[zone] or 0
	return damageConfig.PelletDamage * multiplier * Damage.falloff(damageConfig, distance)
end

-- Most damage one shot can do to one target: every pellet a point-blank headshot.
function Damage.maxShotDamage(damageConfig: any): number
	local best = 0
	for _, m in damageConfig.Multipliers do
		best = math.max(best, m)
	end
	return damageConfig.PelletCount * damageConfig.PelletDamage * best
end

-- Sums a list of pellet hits on one target: { {zone=, distance=} } -> total, headshot?
function Damage.total(damageConfig: any, hits: { { zone: Zone, distance: number } }): (number, boolean)
	local sum, head = 0, false
	for _, hit in hits do
		sum += Damage.pellet(damageConfig, hit.zone, hit.distance)
		if hit.zone == "Head" then
			head = true
		end
	end
	return math.min(sum, Damage.maxShotDamage(damageConfig)), head
end

return Damage
ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Weapons.Positio:
--!strict
-- Ring buffer of body-part CFrames per character for lag compensation: the server
-- checks a claimed hit against where the target was when the shooter saw it.

local PositionHistory = {}
PositionHistory.__index = PositionHistory

export type Snapshot = { t: number, parts: { [string]: CFrame } }
export type History = typeof(setmetatable({} :: { snapshots: { Snapshot }, maxAge: number }, PositionHistory))

function PositionHistory.new(maxAge: number): History
	return setmetatable({ snapshots = {}, maxAge = maxAge }, PositionHistory)
end

function PositionHistory.record(self: History, t: number, parts: { [string]: CFrame })
	table.insert(self.snapshots, { t = t, parts = parts })
	-- Drop old ones (keep at least one older than maxAge so interpolation has a bracket)
	while #self.snapshots > 2 and self.snapshots[2].t < t - self.maxAge do
		table.remove(self.snapshots, 1)
	end
end

-- CFrame of a part at time t (linear interpolation between snapshots; clamps to ends).
function PositionHistory.sample(self: History, partName: string, t: number): CFrame?
	local snaps = self.snapshots
	local n = #snaps
	if n == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	if t >= snaps[n].t then
		return snaps[n].parts[partName]
	end
	if t <= snaps[1].t then
		return snaps[1].parts[partName]
	end
	for i = n - 1, 1, -1 do
		local a = snaps[i]
		if a.t <= t then
			local b = snaps[i + 1]
			local ca, cb = a.parts[partName], b.parts[partName]
			if not ca or not cb then
				return ca or cb
			end
			local alpha = (t - a.t) / math.max(b.t - a.t, 1e-6)
			return ca:Lerp(cb, alpha)
		end
	end
	return snaps[1].parts[partName]
end

function PositionHistory.clear(self: History)
	table.clear(self.snapshots)
end

return PositionHistory
ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Weapons.ShotVal:
--!strict
-- Geometry checks the server runs on each pellet hit a client claims. Pure maths on
-- Roblox datatypes so it is unit-testable; CombatService supplies the world queries.

local ShotValidation = {}

export type HitCheck = {
	origin: Vector3, -- validated shot origin
	direction: Vector3, -- this pellet's unit direction, computed by the server
	hitPosition: Vector3, -- where the client says the pellet hit
	partCFrame: CFrame, -- the target part where the server thinks it was (rewound)
	partSize: Vector3,
	maxRange: number,
	rayTolerance: number,
	hitboxTolerance: number,
}

-- Distance from a point to an oriented box (0 if inside).
function ShotValidation.distanceToBox(point: Vector3, boxCFrame: CFrame, size: Vector3): number
	local localPoint = boxCFrame:PointToObjectSpace(point)
	local half = size / 2
	local dx = math.max(math.abs(localPoint.X) - half.X, 0)
	local dy = math.max(math.abs(localPoint.Y) - half.Y, 0)
	local dz = math.max(math.abs(localPoint.Z) - half.Z, 0)
	return math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz)
end

-- Returns ok, reason, distanceAlongRay
function ShotValidation.checkHit(c: HitCheck): (boolean, string?, number)
	local toHit = c.hitPosition - c.origin
	local along = toHit:Dot(c.direction)
	if along <= 0 then
		return false, "Behind", along
	end
	if along > c.maxRange then
		return false, "Range", along
	end
	-- The claimed point must lie on this pellet's line.
	local off = (toHit - c.direction * along).Magnitude
	if off > c.rayTolerance then
		return false, "OffRay", along
	end
	-- And on (or near) the target part, where the server last saw it.
	if ShotValidation.distanceToBox(c.hitPosition, c.partCFrame, c.partSize) > c.hitboxTolerance then
		return false, "OffTarget", along
	end
	return true, nil, along
end

-- Sanity checks on a vector from the network (NaN / inf / huge values).
function ShotValidation.isFiniteVector(v: any, maxMagnitude: number?): boolean
	if typeof(v) ~= "Vector3" then
		return false
	end
	local x, y, z = v.X, v.Y, v.Z
	if x ~= x or y ~= y or z ~= z then
		return false
	end
	local m = v.Magnitude
	if m == math.huge or m ~= m then
		return false
	end
	return maxMagnitude == nil or m <= maxMagnitude
end

-- Tolerance that grows with the shooter's ping, capped.
function ShotValidation.scaled(base: number, perSecond: number, cap: number, ping: number): number
	return math.min(base + perSecond * math.clamp(ping, 0, 1), cap)
end

return ShotValidation
ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Weapons.Shotgun:
--!strict
-- Builds a pump shotgun model and drives its bones.
--
-- Normally this clones the imported Blender asset from
--   ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Weapons.PumpShotgun_FP   (first-person viewmodel)
--   ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Weapons.PumpShotgun_TP   (third-person world model)
-- (see docs/ASSET_PIPELINE.md for importing it in Studio). Until those exist, it builds a
-- clearly-labelled stand-in from parts with the same bone layout, prints a warning once,
-- and sets the model's "StandIn" attribute, so the game is testable before import.
--
-- Animation data (ShotgunAnimData) gives each bone a model-space delta D. For a bone b
-- with rest pose R_b (model space) the animated world pose is  Root * D_b * R_b.
-- With imported Bones we convert that to Bone.Transform; with the stand-in we place parts.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local ShotgunRig = require(script.Parent.ShotgunRig)

local ShotgunModel = {}
ShotgunModel.__index = ShotgunModel

export type Kind = "FirstPerson" | "ThirdPerson"

export type Skin = {
	metal: Color3,
	wood: Color3,
	accent: Color3?,
	material: Enum.Material?,
	tint: Color3?, -- multiplies the imported textures
}

type BoneEntry = {
	bone: Bone,
	parentBone: Bone?, -- nil when the parent is the mesh part
	parentPart: BasePart?,
	rest: CFrame, -- model-space rest pose (relative to the root)
	animated: boolean,
}

type PartEntry = { part: BasePart, bone: string, rest: CFrame }

export type ShotgunModel = typeof(setmetatable(
	{} :: {
		kind: Kind,
		model: Model,
		standIn: boolean,
		root: CFrame,
		deltas: { [string]: CFrame },
		-- imported asset
		bones: { [Bone]: BoneEntry },
		boneOrder: { Bone },
		rootToPivot: CFrame,
		-- stand-in
		parts: { PartEntry },
		shells: { [string]: { BasePart } },
		baseColors: { [BasePart]: Color3 },
	},
	ShotgunModel
))

local TEMPLATE_NAMES = { FirstPerson = "PumpShotgun_FP", ThirdPerson = "PumpShotgun_TP" }
local warned = false

local function findTemplate(kind: Kind): Model?
	local assets = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Assets")
	local weapons = assets and assets:FindFirstChild("Weapons")
	local template = weapons and weapons:FindFirstChild(TEMPLATE_NAMES[kind])
	if template and template:IsA("Model") then
		return template
	end
	return nil
end

function ShotgunModel.isImported(kind: Kind): boolean
	return findTemplate(kind) ~= nil
end

local function prepPart(part: BasePart, kind: Kind)
	part.Anchored = kind == "FirstPerson"
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.Massless = true
	part.CastShadow = kind == "ThirdPerson"
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Stand-in geometry (only used until the Blender asset is imported)

local DEFAULT_SKIN: Skin = {
	metal = Color3.fromRGB(40, 44, 54),
	wood = Color3.fromRGB(150, 88, 48),
	accent = Color3.fromRGB(24, 26, 30),
}

local function standInPart(
	model: Model,
	name: string,
	shape: "Block" | "Cylinder",
	size: Vector3,
	cf: CFrame,
	colorKey: "metal" | "wood" | "accent" | "brass" | "red",
	bone: string,
	parts: { PartEntry }
)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = name
	part.Shape = if shape == "Cylinder" then Enum.PartType.Cylinder else Enum.PartType.Block
	part.Size = size
	part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	part.Material = if colorKey == "wood" then Enum.Material.Wood else Enum.Material.Metal
	part:SetAttribute("ColorKey", colorKey)
	part.Color = if colorKey == "brass"
		then Color3.fromRGB(196, 160, 70)
		elseif colorKey == "red" then Color3.fromRGB(170, 30, 30)
		else (DEFAULT_SKIN :: any)[colorKey]
	part.CFrame = cf
	part:SetAttribute("Bone", bone)
	part:SetAttribute("Rest", cf)
	part.Parent = model
	table.insert(parts, { part = part :: BasePart, bone = bone, rest = cf })
	return part
end

-- Cylinders in Roblox run along X; this turns them to run along Z (the bore).
local ALONG_Z = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0)

local function buildStandIn(kind: Kind): (Model, { PartEntry }, { [string]: { BasePart } })
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = TEMPLATE_NAMES[kind] .. "_StandIn"
	model:SetAttribute("StandIn", true)
	local parts: { PartEntry } = {}
	local B = ShotgunRig.Bones
	local boreY = B.Muzzle.Y
	local tubeY = B.ShellLive.Y

	local function p(...)
		return standInPart(model, ...)
	end
	-- Receiver and action
	p("Receiver", "Block", Vector3.new(0.18, 0.27, 0.86), CFrame.new(0, -0.02, -0.13), "metal", "Weapon", parts)
	p("SightRib", "Block", Vector3.new(0.05, 0.03, 0.86), CFrame.new(0, 0.13, -0.13), "accent", "Weapon", parts)
	p(
		"Barrel",
		"Cylinder",
		Vector3.new(1.62, 0.11, 0.11),
		CFrame.new(0, boreY, -1.36) * ALONG_Z,
		"metal",
		"Weapon",
		parts
	)
	p(
		"Muzzle",
		"Cylinder",
		Vector3.new(0.06, 0.125, 0.125),
		CFrame.new(0, boreY, -2.14) * ALONG_Z,
		"accent",
		"Weapon",
		parts
	)
	p(
		"FrontSight",
		"Block",
		Vector3.new(0.04, 0.05, 0.05),
		CFrame.new(0, boreY + 0.075, -2.08),
		"accent",
		"Weapon",
		parts
	)
	p(
		"MagTube",
		"Cylinder",
		Vector3.new(1.3, 0.095, 0.095),
		CFrame.new(0, tubeY, -1.2) * ALONG_Z,
		"metal",
		"Weapon",
		parts
	)
	p(
		"MagCap",
		"Cylinder",
		Vector3.new(0.09, 0.11, 0.11),
		CFrame.new(0, tubeY, -1.86) * ALONG_Z,
		"accent",
		"Weapon",
		parts
	)
	p("BarrelBand", "Block", Vector3.new(0.13, 0.2, 0.06), CFrame.new(0, -0.01, -1.72), "accent", "Weapon", parts)
	p("TriggerGuard", "Block", Vector3.new(0.05, 0.12, 0.34), CFrame.new(0, -0.2, 0.08), "accent", "Weapon", parts)
	p("Trigger", "Block", Vector3.new(0.03, 0.09, 0.03), CFrame.new(0, -0.17, 0.1), "metal", "Trigger", parts)
	-- Stock: comb, wrist and butt
	p(
		"StockWrist",
		"Block",
		Vector3.new(0.15, 0.22, 0.42),
		CFrame.new(0, -0.08, 0.5) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-10), 0, 0),
		"wood",
		"Weapon",
		parts
	)
	p(
		"Stock",
		"Block",
		Vector3.new(0.15, 0.36, 0.78),
		CFrame.new(0, -0.14, 1.06) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-7), 0, 0),
		"wood",
		"Weapon",
		parts
	)
	p(
		"ButtPad",
		"Block",
		Vector3.new(0.16, 0.42, 0.07),
		CFrame.new(0, -0.18, 1.48) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-7), 0, 0),
		"accent",
		"Weapon",
		parts
	)
	-- Pump (forend) with grooves
	p("Pump", "Block", Vector3.new(0.2, 0.17, 0.56), CFrame.new(0, tubeY - 0.02, -1.13), "wood", "Pump", parts)
	for i = -2, 2 do
		p(
			"PumpGroove",
			"Block",
			Vector3.new(0.205, 0.02, 0.03),
			CFrame.new(0, tubeY - 0.03, -1.13 + i * 0.09),
			"accent",
			"Pump",
			parts
		)
	end
	p("ActionBar", "Block", Vector3.new(0.02, 0.03, 0.62), CFrame.new(0.08, tubeY + 0.02, -0.8), "metal", "Pump", parts)
	p("Bolt", "Block", Vector3.new(0.06, 0.07, 0.16), CFrame.new(0.06, B.Bolt.Y, B.Bolt.Z), "metal", "Bolt", parts)
	-- Shells for the eject/reload beats (hidden at rest)
	local spent = p(
		"ShellSpent",
		"Cylinder",
		Vector3.new(0.25, 0.08, 0.08),
		CFrame.new(B.ShellSpent) * ALONG_Z,
		"red",
		"ShellSpent",
		parts
	)
	local live = p(
		"ShellLive",
		"Cylinder",
		Vector3.new(0.25, 0.08, 0.08),
		CFrame.new(B.ShellLive) * ALONG_Z,
		"red",
		"ShellLive",
		parts
	)
	spent.Transparency = 1
	live.Transparency = 1

	for _, entry in parts do
		prepPart(entry.part, kind)
	end
	model.PrimaryPart = parts[1].part
	return model, parts, { Spent = { spent }, Live = { live } }
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Imported asset

local function partWorld(entry: BoneEntry, worlds: { [Bone]: CFrame }): CFrame
	if entry.parentBone then
		return worlds[entry.parentBone]
	end
	return (entry.parentPart :: BasePart).CFrame
end

local function setupImported(self: any, template: Model, clone: boolean)
	local model = if clone then template:Clone() else template
	self.model = model
	if clone then
		for _, d in model:GetDescendants() do
			if d:IsA("BasePart") then
				prepPart(d, self.kind)
				-- The prepared exports separate the original geometry into palette regions.
				-- FBX custom properties are not guaranteed to survive Studio import.
				local key = d.Name:match("^[FT]P_Region_(%a+)$")
				if key == "metal" or key == "wood" or key == "accent" then
					d:SetAttribute("ColorKey", key)
					d.Material = if key == "wood" then Enum.Material.Wood else Enum.Material.Metal
				end
			elseif d:IsA("Bone") then
				d.Transform = CFrame.identity
			end
		end
	end
	-- Shell meshes (FP_Shell_Live / FP_Shell_Spent) start hidden
	self.shells = { Spent = {}, Live = {} }
	for _, d in model:GetDescendants() do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			if d.Name:find("Shell_Spent") then
				table.insert(self.shells.Spent, d)
				d.Transparency = 1
			elseif d.Name:find("Shell_Live") then
				table.insert(self.shells.Live, d)
				d.Transparency = 1
			end
		end
	end

	-- A multi-mesh FBX can import with a separate copy of the rig below each mesh.
	-- Index by instance so every copy receives the same model-space animation delta.
	local allBones: { Bone } = {}
	local rootBone: Bone? = nil
	for _, d in model:GetDescendants() do
		if d:IsA("Bone") then
			table.insert(allBones, d)
			if d.Name == "ViewmodelRoot" and not rootBone then
				rootBone = d
			end
		end
	end
	local worlds: { [Bone]: CFrame } = {}
	local order: { Bone } = {}
	local function visit(bone: Bone)
		local parent = bone.Parent
		local parentWorld = if parent and parent:IsA("Bone")
			then worlds[parent]
			elseif parent and parent:IsA("BasePart") then parent.CFrame
			else CFrame.identity
		worlds[bone] = parentWorld * bone.CFrame
		table.insert(order, bone)
		for _, child in bone:GetChildren() do
			if child:IsA("Bone") then
				visit(child)
			end
		end
	end
	for _, bone in allBones do
		local parent = bone.Parent
		if not parent or not parent:IsA("Bone") then
			visit(bone)
		end
	end
	local rootOffset = model:GetAttribute("AnimationRootOffset") or CFrame.identity
	local rootWorld = if rootBone then worlds[rootBone] * rootOffset else model:GetPivot()
	self.rootToPivot = rootWorld:ToObjectSpace(model:GetPivot())
	self.bones = {}
	for _, bone in allBones do
		local parent = bone.Parent
		self.bones[bone] = {
			bone = bone,
			parentBone = if parent and parent:IsA("Bone") then parent else nil,
			parentPart = if parent and parent:IsA("BasePart") then parent else nil,
			rest = rootWorld:ToObjectSpace(worlds[bone] or rootWorld),
			animated = table.find(ShotgunRig.Animated, bone.Name) ~= nil,
		}
	end
	self.boneOrder = order
	if not rootBone then
		warn(
			"[Double Pump] Imported shotgun has no ViewmodelRoot bone; animations disabled. See docs/ASSET_PIPELINE.md"
		)
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

function ShotgunModel.new(kind: Kind): ShotgunModel
	local self = setmetatable({
		kind = kind,
		standIn = false,
		root = CFrame.identity,
		deltas = {},
		bones = {},
		boneOrder = {},
		rootToPivot = CFrame.identity,
		parts = {},
		shells = { Spent = {}, Live = {} },
		baseColors = {},
	}, ShotgunModel) :: any

	local template = findTemplate(kind)
	if template then
		setupImported(self, template, true)
	else
		self.standIn = true
		local model, parts, shells = buildStandIn(kind)
		self.model = model
		self.parts = parts
		self.shells = shells
		self.rootToPivot = model:GetPivot()
		if not warned then
			warned = true
			warn(
				"[Double Pump] Shotgun asset not found in ReplicatedStorage.Assets.Weapons; using the parts stand-in."
					.. " Import the Blender model as described in docs/ASSET_PIPELINE.md."
			)
		end
	end
	self.model:SetAttribute("ShotgunKind", kind)
	return self
end

-- Wraps a third-person gun that already exists (the server-made "WorldShotgun" on a
-- character) so each client can animate its pump locally.
function ShotgunModel.wrap(model: Model): ShotgunModel
	local self = setmetatable({
		kind = "ThirdPerson",
		standIn = model:GetAttribute("StandIn") == true,
		root = CFrame.identity,
		deltas = {},
		bones = {},
		boneOrder = {},
		rootToPivot = CFrame.identity,
		parts = {},
		shells = { Spent = {}, Live = {} },
		baseColors = {},
	}, ShotgunModel) :: any
	if self.standIn then
		self.model = model
		local receiver = model:FindFirstChild("Receiver")
		for _, d in model:GetDescendants() do
			if d:IsA("BasePart") and d:GetAttribute("Bone") then
				local entry =
					{ part = d, bone = d:GetAttribute("Bone"), rest = d:GetAttribute("Rest") or CFrame.identity }
				if d == receiver then
					table.insert(self.parts, 1, entry)
				else
					table.insert(self.parts, entry)
				end
			end
		end
	else
		-- Bone rest poses are measured from the current pose, so wrap before animating
		setupImported(self, model, false)
	end
	self:syncRoot()
	return self
end

-- Moves the whole gun so its ViewmodelRoot sits at `root` (world space).
function ShotgunModel.setRoot(self: ShotgunModel, root: CFrame)
	self.root = root
	if self.standIn then
		self:_placeStandIn()
	else
		self.model:PivotTo(root * self.rootToPivot)
		self:_applyBones()
	end
end

-- deltas: bone name -> model-space delta (from AnimPlayer). Missing bones = rest.
function ShotgunModel.setPose(self: ShotgunModel, deltas: { [string]: CFrame })
	self.deltas = deltas
	if self.kind == "ThirdPerson" then
		self:syncRoot()
	end
	if self.standIn then
		self:_placeStandIn()
	else
		self:_applyBones()
	end
end

function ShotgunModel._placeStandIn(self: ShotgunModel)
	local root, deltas = self.root, self.deltas
	if self.kind == "FirstPerson" then
		local cframes, partsList = {}, {}
		for i, entry in self.parts do
			partsList[i] = entry.part
			local d = deltas[entry.bone]
			cframes[i] = if d then root * d * entry.rest else root * entry.rest
		end
		workspace:BulkMoveTo(partsList, cframes, Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged)
	else
		-- Third person parts are welded to the receiver; only moving parts are re-posed
		local rootRest = self.parts[1].rest
		for i, entry in self.parts do
			if i > 1 and entry.bone ~= "Weapon" then
				local weld = entry.part:FindFirstChild("StandInWeld") :: Weld?
				if weld then
					local d = deltas[entry.bone] or CFrame.identity
					weld.C0 = rootRest:Inverse() * d * entry.rest
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function ShotgunModel._applyBones(self: ShotgunModel)
	local root, deltas = self.root, self.deltas
	local worlds: { [Bone]: CFrame } = {}
	for _, indexedBone in self.boneOrder do
		local entry = self.bones[indexedBone]
		local bone = entry.bone
		local parentWorld = partWorld(entry, worlds)
		local d = if entry.animated then deltas[bone.Name] else nil
		if d then
			local desired = root * d * entry.rest
			bone.Transform = (parentWorld * bone.CFrame):ToObjectSpace(desired)
			worlds[bone] = desired
		else
			if entry.animated then
				bone.Transform = CFrame.identity
			end
			worlds[bone] = parentWorld * bone.CFrame * bone.Transform
		end
	end
end

-- Third person: the gun is moved by physics (welded to a character), so read the root
-- back from the parts.
function ShotgunModel.syncRoot(self: ShotgunModel)
	if self.standIn then
		local first = self.parts[1]
		self.root = first.part.CFrame * first.rest:Inverse()
	else
		self.root = self.model:GetPivot() * self.rootToPivot:Inverse()
	end
end

-- World CFrame of a bone or reference point (Muzzle, ShellEject, Grip, SupportHand...).
function ShotgunModel.point(self: ShotgunModel, name: string): CFrame
	local rest = ShotgunRig.Bones[name] or Vector3.zero
	local carrier = ShotgunRig.Carrier[name] or "Weapon"
	local d = self.deltas[carrier] or CFrame.identity
	return self.root * d * CFrame.new(rest)
end

function ShotgunModel.setShellVisible(self: ShotgunModel, which: "Spent" | "Live", visible: boolean)
	local list: { BasePart } = self.shells[which] or {}
	for _, part in list do
		part.Transparency = if visible then 0 else 1
	end
end

function ShotgunModel.setVisible(self: ShotgunModel, visible: boolean)
	for _, d in self.model:GetDescendants() do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			local isShell = table.find(self.shells.Spent, d) or table.find(self.shells.Live, d)
			if not isShell then
				d.LocalTransparencyModifier = if visible then 0 else 1
			end
		end
	end
end

function ShotgunModel.applySkin(self: ShotgunModel, skin: Skin?)
	local s = skin or DEFAULT_SKIN
	for _, d in self.model:GetDescendants() do
		if d:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
			local parent = d.Parent
			local key = if parent and parent:IsA("BasePart") then parent:GetAttribute("ColorKey") else nil
			local color = if key == "metal"
				then s.metal
				elseif key == "wood" then s.wood
				elseif key == "accent" then s.accent or DEFAULT_SKIN.accent :: Color3
				else Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			local tint = s.tint or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			local surface = d :: any
			surface.Color = Color3.new(color.R * tint.R, color.G * tint.G, color.B * tint.B)
		elseif d:IsA("BasePart") and d:GetAttribute("ColorKey") then
			local key = d:GetAttribute("ColorKey")
			if key == "metal" then
				d.Color = s.metal
				d.Material = s.material or Enum.Material.Metal
			elseif key == "wood" then
				d.Color = s.wood
			elseif key == "accent" then
				d.Color = s.accent or DEFAULT_SKIN.accent :: Color3
			end
		end
	end
end

function ShotgunModel.destroy(self: ShotgunModel)
	self.model:Destroy()
end

-- Third person: weld every part to one root part so the gun can be mounted on a body.
-- Returns the root part (the Weapon bone's carrier).
function ShotgunModel.weldForThirdPerson(self: ShotgunModel): BasePart
	local rootPart: BasePart
	if self.standIn then
		rootPart = self.parts[1].part
		local rootRest = self.parts[1].rest
		for i, entry in self.parts do
			entry.part.Anchored = false
			if i > 1 then
				local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
				weld.Name = "StandInWeld"
				weld.Part0 = rootPart
				weld.Part1 = entry.part
				weld.C0 = rootRest:Inverse() * entry.rest
				weld.Parent = entry.part
			end
		end
	else
		local primary = self.model.PrimaryPart or self.model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
		assert(primary, "Imported shotgun has no parts")
		rootPart = primary
		for _, d in self.model:GetDescendants() do
			if d:IsA("BasePart") then
				d.Anchored = false
				if d ~= rootPart then
					local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
					weld.Part0 = rootPart
					weld.Part1 = d
					weld.Parent = d
				end
			end
		end
	end
	self.model.PrimaryPart = rootPart
	return rootPart
end

ShotgunModel.DefaultSkin = DEFAULT_SKIN

return ShotgunModel

ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Weapons.Spread:
--!strict
-- Deterministic pellet pattern. Given the aim direction and the shot number, every client
-- and the server compute exactly the same pellet directions, so the server never has to
-- trust the client's pellet list and players can learn the pattern.

local Spread = {}

export type PatternPoint = { radius: number, angle: number }

-- Orthonormal right/up vectors for an aim direction (handles looking straight up/down).
local function basis(aim: Vector3): (Vector3, Vector3)
	local worldUp = if math.abs(aim.Y) > 0.98 then Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) else Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
	local right = aim:Cross(worldUp).Unit
	local up = right:Cross(aim).Unit
	return right, up
end

-- Returns one unit direction per pellet.
--   aim: unit vector the player is looking along
--   shotNumber: from WeaponState.fire, rotates the pattern deterministically
--   multiplier: scales the cone (crouch / airborne)
function Spread.directions(spreadConfig: any, aim: Vector3, shotNumber: number, multiplier: number?): { Vector3 }
	local right, up = basis(aim)
	local roll = math.rad((spreadConfig.RollPerShotDegrees or 0) * shotNumber)
	local scale = multiplier or 1
	local out = table.create(#spreadConfig.Pattern)
	for i, point: PatternPoint in spreadConfig.Pattern do
		local radius = math.rad(point.radius * scale)
		local theta = math.rad(point.angle) + roll
		-- Offset on a plane one stud in front of the muzzle, then normalise.
		local offset = (right * math.cos(theta) + up * math.sin(theta)) * math.tan(radius)
		out[i] = (aim + offset).Unit
	end
	return out
end

-- Cone multiplier from the shooter's movement state.
function Spread.stateMultiplier(spreadConfig: any, crouching: boolean, airborne: boolean): number
	local m = 1
	if crouching then
		m *= spreadConfig.CrouchMultiplier
	end
	if airborne then
		m *= spreadConfig.AirborneMultiplier
	end
	return m
end

return Spread
ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Weapons.WeaponS:
--!strict
-- The rules of the two shotguns, as pure data + functions (no Roblox APIs), so the exact
-- same code runs on the client (prediction) and the server (authority), and in unit tests.
--
-- Rules:
--   * Each slot has its own ammo, its own fire cooldown and its own reload.
--   * A shot needs: the slot equipped and raised (swap finished), the slot's own cooldown
--     over, the player's global MinShotInterval over, and at least one shell.
--   * Swapping never resets or shortens a cooldown; holstered guns keep counting down.
--   * Reloads insert one shell at a time and are interrupted by firing or swapping
--     (shells already inserted are kept).
--
-- Times are seconds on whatever clock the caller uses (os.clock on the server,
-- os.clock on the client). `tolerance` lets the server accept a request that arrives a
-- little early because of network jitter. Next-allowed times advance from
-- max(now, nextAllowed), so tolerance can be gained once but never accumulates.

export type Timing = {
	FireCooldown: number,
	MinShotInterval: number,
	SwapTime: number,
	EquipTime: number,
	ReloadStartTime: number,
	ReloadInsertTime: number,
}

export type Rules = {
	timing: Timing,
	magazineSize: number,
}

export type Slot = {
	ammo: number,
	nextFireTime: number, -- this slot's cooldown ends here
	lastFireTime: number,
	reloading: boolean,
	reloadStartedAt: number,
	reloadBaseAmmo: number,
	shotsFired: number,
}

export type State = {
	rules: Rules,
	slots: { Slot },
	equipped: number,
	readyAt: number, -- the equipped gun is raised and may fire from here
	nextShotTime: number, -- global min-interval gate across both guns
	shotCounter: number, -- total shots, used for the deterministic spread roll
	lastSwapAt: number,
}

export type FailReason = "NotEquipped" | "Swapping" | "Cooldown" | "ShotInterval" | "Empty" | "Reloading" | "BadSlot"

local WeaponState = {}

local NEVER = -math.huge

function WeaponState.rulesFromConfig(weaponConfig: any): Rules
	return {
		timing = weaponConfig.Timing,
		magazineSize = weaponConfig.Ammo.MagazineSize,
	}
end

local function newSlot(magazineSize: number): Slot
	return {
		ammo = magazineSize,
		nextFireTime = NEVER,
		lastFireTime = NEVER,
		reloading = false,
		reloadStartedAt = 0,
		reloadBaseAmmo = 0,
		shotsFired = 0,
	}
end

function WeaponState.new(rules: Rules, now: number, slotCount: number?): State
	local slots = {}
	for i = 1, slotCount or 2 do
		slots[i] = newSlot(rules.magazineSize)
	end
	return {
		rules = rules,
		slots = slots,
		equipped = 1,
		readyAt = now + rules.timing.EquipTime,
		nextShotTime = NEVER,
		shotCounter = 0,
		lastSwapAt = NEVER,
	}
end

-- Shells inserted by an in-progress reload at time `now` (not yet applied).
local function reloadShellsAt(state: State, slot: Slot, now: number): number
	local timing = state.rules.timing
	local elapsed = now - slot.reloadStartedAt - timing.ReloadStartTime
	if elapsed < 0 then
		return 0
	end
	local shells = math.floor(elapsed / timing.ReloadInsertTime + 1e-9)
	return math.clamp(shells, 0, state.rules.magazineSize - slot.reloadBaseAmmo)
end

-- Brings a slot's ammo up to date with its reload; finishes the reload when full.
function WeaponState.syncReload(state: State, slotIndex: number, now: number)
	local slot = state.slots[slotIndex]
	if not slot or not slot.reloading then
		return
	end
	slot.ammo = slot.reloadBaseAmmo + reloadShellsAt(state, slot, now)
	if slot.ammo >= state.rules.magazineSize then
		slot.ammo = state.rules.magazineSize
		slot.reloading = false
	end
end

-- Stops a reload, keeping inserted shells.
local function interruptReload(state: State, slotIndex: number, now: number)
	local slot = state.slots[slotIndex]
	if slot and slot.reloading then
		WeaponState.syncReload(state, slotIndex, now)
		slot.reloading = false
	end
end

-- When the reload of a slot will be complete (nil if not reloading).
function WeaponState.reloadDoneAt(state: State, slotIndex: number): number?
	local slot = state.slots[slotIndex]
	if not slot or not slot.reloading then
		return nil
	end
	local timing = state.rules.timing
	local missing = state.rules.magazineSize - slot.reloadBaseAmmo
	return slot.reloadStartedAt + timing.ReloadStartTime + missing * timing.ReloadInsertTime
end

function WeaponState.canFire(state: State, slotIndex: number, now: number, tolerance: number?): (boolean, FailReason?)
	local tol = tolerance or 0
	local slot = state.slots[slotIndex]
	if not slot then
		return false, "BadSlot"
	end
	if slotIndex ~= state.equipped then
		return false, "NotEquipped"
	end
	if now < state.readyAt - tol then
		return false, "Swapping"
	end
	if slot.reloading then
		-- Firing interrupts a reload only if a shell is in. Count shells as of now+tol.
		local shells = slot.reloadBaseAmmo + reloadShellsAt(state, slot, now + tol)
		if shells <= 0 then
			return false, "Reloading"
		end
	elseif slot.ammo <= 0 then
		return false, "Empty"
	end
	if now < slot.nextFireTime - tol then
		return false, "Cooldown"
	end
	if now < state.nextShotTime - tol then
		return false, "ShotInterval"
	end
	return true, nil
end

-- Applies a shot if allowed. Returns ok, reason, shotNumber (for the spread roll).
function WeaponState.fire(
	state: State,
	slotIndex: number,
	now: number,
	tolerance: number?
): (boolean, FailReason?, number)
	local ok, reason = WeaponState.canFire(state, slotIndex, now, tolerance)
	if not ok then
		return false, reason :: FailReason?, state.shotCounter
	end
	local slot = state.slots[slotIndex]
	local timing = state.rules.timing
	if slot.reloading then
		-- Use the tolerant count so a shot that was legal on the client stays legal here.
		slot.ammo = slot.reloadBaseAmmo + reloadShellsAt(state, slot, now + (tolerance or 0))
		slot.reloading = false
	end
	slot.ammo -= 1
	slot.lastFireTime = now
	slot.shotsFired += 1
	slot.nextFireTime = math.max(now, slot.nextFireTime) + timing.FireCooldown
	state.nextShotTime = math.max(now, state.nextShotTime) + timing.MinShotInterval
	state.shotCounter += 1
	return true, nil, state.shotCounter
end

-- Switches to another slot. Returns false if it's already equipped or doesn't exist.
function WeaponState.equip(state: State, slotIndex: number, now: number): boolean
	if not state.slots[slotIndex] or slotIndex == state.equipped then
		return false
	end
	interruptReload(state, state.equipped, now)
	state.equipped = slotIndex
	state.lastSwapAt = now
	-- Swapping mid-swap restarts the raise; it can never make a gun ready sooner.
	state.readyAt = now + state.rules.timing.SwapTime
	return true
end

function WeaponState.otherSlot(state: State): number
	return if state.equipped == 1 then 2 else 1
end

function WeaponState.startReload(state: State, now: number): boolean
	local slotIndex = state.equipped
	local slot = state.slots[slotIndex]
	WeaponState.syncReload(state, slotIndex, now)
	if slot.reloading or slot.ammo >= state.rules.magazineSize then
		return false
	end
	slot.reloading = true
	-- If the gun is still being raised, shells start going in once it's up.
	slot.reloadStartedAt = math.max(now, state.readyAt)
	slot.reloadBaseAmmo = slot.ammo
	return true
end

function WeaponState.cancelReload(state: State, now: number)
	interruptReload(state, state.equipped, now)
end

-- Full ammo, no cooldowns (on respawn).
function WeaponState.reset(state: State, now: number)
	for i, _ in state.slots do
		state.slots[i] = newSlot(state.rules.magazineSize)
	end
	state.equipped = 1
	state.readyAt = now + state.rules.timing.EquipTime
	state.nextShotTime = NEVER
	state.shotCounter = 0
	state.lastSwapAt = NEVER
end

--!strict
-- Session-locked profile storage on top of a DataStore-like object (anything with
-- UpdateAsync). Kept free of Roblox services so it can be unit tested with a fake store.
--
-- Record layout: { data = <profile>, lock = { jobId = string, at = number }? }
--
-- Session locking: a server that loads a profile stamps its JobId on it and refreshes the
-- stamp on every autosave. Another server that wants the same profile (the player
-- rejoined quickly) waits for the lock to be released; a lock that hasn't been refreshed
-- for `lockTimeout` seconds belongs to a dead server and is taken over. A server that
-- finds its lock taken stops saving that profile, so two servers never overwrite each
-- other.

local Profile = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.Progression.Profile)

local ProfileStore = {}
ProfileStore.__index = ProfileStore

export type Store = { UpdateAsync: (any, string, (any) -> any) -> any }

export type Options = {
	jobId: string,
	clock: () -> number,
	sleep: (number) -> (),
	lockTimeout: number?,
	lockWaits: number?, -- how many times to wait for a held lock before taking it
	lockWaitTime: number?,
	retries: number?, -- retries for DataStore errors (throttling, outages)
}

export type ProfileStoreT = typeof(setmetatable(
	{} :: {
		store: Store,
		jobId: string,
		clock: () -> number,
		sleep: (number) -> (),
		lockTimeout: number,
		lockWaits: number,
		lockWaitTime: number,
		retries: number,
	},
	ProfileStore
))

function ProfileStore.new(store: Store, options: Options): ProfileStoreT
	return setmetatable({
		store = store,
		jobId = options.jobId,
		clock = options.clock,
		sleep = options.sleep,
		lockTimeout = options.lockTimeout or 600,
		lockWaits = options.lockWaits or 5,
		lockWaitTime = options.lockWaitTime or 4,
		retries = options.retries or 5,
	}, ProfileStore)
end

-- Calls UpdateAsync, retrying errors with exponential backoff. Returns (ok, result, err).
local function update(self: ProfileStoreT, key: string, transform: (any) -> any): (boolean, any, string?)
	local lastErr: string? = nil
	for attempt = 1, self.retries + 1 do
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return self.store:UpdateAsync(key, transform)
		end)
		if ok then
			return true, result, nil
		end
		lastErr = tostring(result)
		if attempt <= self.retries then
			self.sleep(math.min(2 ^ attempt, 16))
		end
	end
	return false, nil, lastErr
end

-- Loads and locks a profile. Returns (data, nil) or (nil, reason).
function ProfileStore.load(self: ProfileStoreT, key: string): (Profile.Data?, string?)
	for attempt = 1, self.lockWaits + 1 do
		local now = self.clock()
		local blocked = false
		local loaded: Profile.Data? = nil
		local force = attempt > self.lockWaits
		local ok, _, err = update(self, key, function(record: any)
			record = if typeof(record) == "table" then record else {}
			local lock = record.lock
			if
				not force
				and typeof(lock) == "table"
				and lock.jobId ~= self.jobId
				and typeof(lock.at) == "number"
				and now - lock.at < self.lockTimeout
			then
				blocked = true
				return nil -- cancel the write; someone else holds it
			end
			loaded = Profile.sanitize(record.data, now)
			return { data = loaded, lock = { jobId = self.jobId, at = now } }
		end)
		if not ok then
			return nil, err or "DataStore error"
		end
		if not blocked and loaded then
			return loaded, nil
		end
		self.sleep(self.lockWaitTime)
	end
	return nil, "locked"
end

-- Saves a profile. `release` also drops the session lock (player leaving). Returns
-- (true) on success, (false, "lost") if another server has taken the profile, or
-- (false, err) on DataStore failure.
function ProfileStore.save(self: ProfileStoreT, key: string, data: Profile.Data, release: boolean): (boolean, string?)
	local lost = false
	local now = self.clock()
	local ok, _, err = update(self, key, function(record: any)
		record = if typeof(record) == "table" then record else {}
		local lock = record.lock
		if typeof(lock) == "table" and lock.jobId ~= self.jobId then
			lost = true
			return nil
		end
		return {
			data = data,
			lock = if release then nil else { jobId = self.jobId, at = now },
		}
	end)
	if not ok then
		return false, err
	end
	if lost then
		return false, "lost"
	end
	return true, nil
end

return ProfileStore
ServerScriptService.Server.Data.Receipts:
--!strict
-- Developer Product receipt decisions, with the player/profile/save lookups injected so
-- the logic is unit tested (tests/monetization.spec.luau). Used by MonetizationService.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Products = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config.Products)
local Profile = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Progression.Profile)

local Receipts = {}

export type Receipt = {
	PlayerId: number,
	ProductId: number,
	PurchaseId: string,
	CurrencySpent: number?,
	PlaceIdWherePurchased: number?,
}

function Receipts.process(
	receipt: Receipt,
	deps: {
		getPlayer: (number) -> Player?,
		getProfile: (Player) -> Profile.Data?,
		save: (Player) -> boolean,
		onGranted: (Player, number) -> (),
	}
): Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision
	local pack = Products.byProductId(receipt.ProductId)
	if not pack or not Products.available(pack) then
		warn(`[Monetization] receipt for unknown or disabled product {receipt.ProductId}; leaving it pending`)
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	local player = deps.getPlayer(receipt.PlayerId)
	local data = player and deps.getProfile(player)
	if not player or not data then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet -- Roblox retries when they're back
	end
	if Profile.hasReceipt(data, receipt.PurchaseId) then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
	end
	data.coins += pack.coins
	Profile.addReceipt(data, receipt.PurchaseId)
	if not deps.save(player) then
		-- Roll back so the retry grants exactly once
		data.coins -= pack.coins
		local index = table.find(data.receipts, receipt.PurchaseId)
		if index then
			table.remove(data.receipts, index)
		end
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	deps.onGranted(player, pack.coins)
	return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
end

return Receipts
ServerScriptService.Server.Maps.DustTown:
--!strict
-- DUST TOWN: a sun-baked adobe town at golden hour. A main street with a fountain plaza
-- in the middle, buildings you can fight through on both sides, flat roofs you can
-- climb, and back alleys for flanking. Point-symmetric: Red owns -X, Blue +X.
--
-- Every lane along the street is broken at least once (statue, wagon, market stall),
-- so fights happen around corners and doorways instead of across the map.

local MapKit = require(script.Parent.MapKit)

local DustTown = {}

DustTown.id = "DustTown"
DustTown.displayName = "Dust Town"
DustTown.description =
	"Adobe streets, a fountain plaza and climbable rooftops. Fight through the cantina or flank down the alleys."
DustTown.ambience = "AmbDustTown"
DustTown.killY = -40
DustTown.extents = { min = Vector2.new(-76, -52), max = Vector2.new(76, 52), top = 30, bottom = -1 }

local rgb = Color3.fromRGB
local M = Enum.Material

local SAND = rgb(222, 186, 130)
local STREET = rgb(176, 136, 92)
local ADOBE = { rgb(214, 160, 110), rgb(200, 140, 96), rgb(226, 182, 132), rgb(190, 128, 88) }
local TRIM = rgb(240, 222, 190)
local WOOD = rgb(112, 72, 40)
local WOOD_LIGHT = rgb(160, 112, 66)
local STONE = rgb(200, 178, 140)
local TEAM = { [1] = rgb(200, 52, 52), [-1] = rgb(48, 110, 210) }
local TEAM_NAME = { [1] = "Red", [-1] = "Blue" }

local X, Z = 76, 52

local p, cf = MapKit.p, MapKit.cf

type Opening = { at: number, width: number, height: number, bottom: number? }
type Openings = { south: { Opening }?, north: { Opening }?, west: { Opening }?, east: { Opening }? }

-- Adobe building in half `s`, corners given in Red-half coordinates (x0 < x1, z0 < z1).
-- Openings are measured from the low corner along each wall. `skip` leaves one roof
-- parapet edge open where stairs arrive.
local function adobe(
	b: MapKit.Builder,
	s: number,
	x0: number,
	z0: number,
	x1: number,
	z1: number,
	h: number,
	color: Color3,
	openings: Openings,
	skip: string?
)
	b:wall(p(s, x0, 0, z0), p(s, x1, 0, z0), h, 1, M.Plaster, color, openings.south)
	b:wall(p(s, x0, 0, z1), p(s, x1, 0, z1), h, 1, M.Plaster, color, openings.north)
	b:wall(p(s, x0, 0, z0), p(s, x0, 0, z1), h, 1, M.Plaster, color, openings.west)
	b:wall(p(s, x1, 0, z0), p(s, x1, 0, z1), h, 1, M.Plaster, color, openings.east)
	b:span(
		p(s, x0 - 0.5, h, z0 - 0.5),
		p(s, x1 + 0.5, h + 0.8, z1 + 0.5),
		M.Plaster,
		color:Lerp(TRIM, 0.25),
		{ name = "Roof" }
	)
	local top = h + 0.8
	local edges: { [string]: { Vector3 } } = {
		south = { p(s, x0 - 0.5, top, z0 - 0.5), p(s, x1 + 0.5, top + 1.4, z0 + 0.3) },
		north = { p(s, x0 - 0.5, top, z1 - 0.3), p(s, x1 + 0.5, top + 1.4, z1 + 0.5) },
		west = { p(s, x0 - 0.5, top, z0 - 0.5), p(s, x0 + 0.3, top + 1.4, z1 + 0.5) },
		east = { p(s, x1 - 0.3, top, z0 - 0.5), p(s, x1 + 0.5, top + 1.4, z1 + 0.5) },
	}
	for side, span in edges do
		if side ~= skip then
			b:span(span[1], span[2], M.Plaster, color:Lerp(TRIM, 0.4), { name = "Parapet" })
		end
	end
	-- Vigas: roof beams poking out of the long walls (decoration)
	for x = x0 + 1.5, x1 - 1, 3 do
		for _, z in { z0 - 0.9, z1 + 0.9 } do
			b:cylinder(1.8, 0.6, CFrame.new(p(s, x, h - 0.6, z)) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0), M.Wood, WOOD, {
				collide = false,
				query = false,
				parent = b.props,
				name = "Viga",
			})
		end
	end
	b:span(p(s, x0 + 0.5, 0, z0 + 0.5), p(s, x1 - 0.5, 0.06, z1 - 0.5), M.CeramicTiles, rgb(176, 96, 64), {
		collide = false,
		query = false,
		name = "Tiles",
	})
end

local function wagon(b: MapKit.Builder, at: CFrame)
	b:box(Vector3.new(4.2, 1.2, 9), at * CFrame.new(0, 2.2, 0), M.WoodPlanks, WOOD_LIGHT, { name = "Wagon" })
	b:box(
		Vector3.new(4.4, 4.2, 7.4),
		at * CFrame.new(0, 4.9, 0.4),
		M.Fabric,
		rgb(236, 226, 204),
		{ name = "WagonCover" }
	)
	for _, z in { -3.2, 3.2 } do
		for _, x in { -2.3, 2.3 } do
			b:cylinder(
				0.4,
				3,
				at * CFrame.new(x, 1.5, z),
				M.Wood,
				WOOD,
				{ collide = false, parent = b.props, name = "Wheel" }
			)
		end
	end
	b:box(Vector3.new(0.3, 0.3, 4), at * CFrame.new(0, 1.6, -6.4), M.Wood, WOOD, { collide = false, parent = b.props })
end

local function stall(b: MapKit.Builder, at: CFrame, canopy: Color3)
	b:box(Vector3.new(7, 3, 2.4), at * CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0), M.WoodPlanks, WOOD_LIGHT, { name = "StallCounter" })
	for _, x in { -3.3, 3.3 } do
		for _, z in { -1.4, 1.4 } do
			b:box(
				Vector3.new(0.3, 7.5, 0.3),
				at * CFrame.new(x, 3.75, z),
				M.Wood,
				WOOD,
				{ parent = b.props, name = "StallPost" }
			)
		end
	end
	b:box(Vector3.new(8, 0.3, 4), at * CFrame.new(0, 7.6, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(8), 0, 0), M.Fabric, canopy, {
		collide = false,
		parent = b.props,
		name = "Canopy",
	})
	b:crate(at * CFrame.new(2.4, 4.6, 0), 2.6, WOOD_LIGHT)
	b:crate(at * CFrame.new(2.4, 7.0, 0), 2.2, WOOD_LIGHT)
end

local function cactus(b: MapKit.Builder, position: Vector3, height: number)
	local green = rgb(76, 128, 70)
	b:cylinder(
		height,
		1.6,
		CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, height / 2, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)),
		M.Grass,
		green,
		{
			parent = b.props,
			name = "Cactus",
		}
	)
	b:cylinder(
		2.6,
		1,
		CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(1.2, height * 0.55, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)),
		M.Grass,
		green,
		{
			parent = b.props,
			collide = false,
		}
	)
	b:box(Vector3.new(1.6, 0.9, 0.9), CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0.7, height * 0.42, 0)), M.Grass, green, {
		parent = b.props,
		collide = false,
	})
end

local function hay(b: MapKit.Builder, at: CFrame)
	b:box(
		Vector3.new(4, 2.4, 2.6),
		at * CFrame.new(0, 1.2, 0),
		M.Grass,
		rgb(214, 186, 96),
		{ parent = b.props, name = "Hay" }
	)
end

function DustTown.build(): Model
	local b = MapKit.new("DustTown")

	-- Ground, street, outer walls
	b:span(Vector3.new(-X - 30, -4, -Z - 30), Vector3.new(X + 30, 0, Z + 30), M.Sand, SAND, { name = "Ground" })
	-- Desert floor out to the horizon (scenery)
	b:box(Vector3.new(800, 2, 800), CFrame.new(0, -3.2, 0), M.Sand, SAND:Lerp(rgb(200, 150, 100), 0.3), {
		collide = false,
		query = false,
		name = "Desert",
	})
	b:span(
		Vector3.new(-60, 0, -8),
		Vector3.new(60, 0.08, 8),
		M.Ground,
		STREET,
		{ collide = false, query = false, name = "Street" }
	)
	for _, s in { -1, 1 } do
		b:span(
			Vector3.new(-X - 1.5, 0, s * Z),
			Vector3.new(X + 1.5, 9, s * (Z + 1.5)),
			M.Plaster,
			ADOBE[2],
			{ name = "TownWall" }
		)
		b:span(Vector3.new(s * X, 0, -Z), Vector3.new(s * (X + 1.5), 9, Z), M.Plaster, ADOBE[2], { name = "TownWall" })
	end
	-- Mesas on the horizon (scenery only)
	for i, spec in
		{
			{ -170, 40, 60, 50 },
			{ 160, -60, 80, 44 },
			{ 30, 170, 90, 38 },
			{ -40, -175, 70, 46 },
			{ 200, 120, 60, 30 },
			{ -210, -110, 70, 36 },
		}
	do
		b:box(
			Vector3.new(spec[3], spec[4], spec[3] * 0.7),
			CFrame.new(spec[1], spec[4] / 2 - 2, spec[2]) * CFrame.Angles(0, i, 0),
			M.Sandstone,
			rgb(186, 110, 70),
			{
				collide = false,
				query = false,
				name = "Mesa",
			}
		)
	end

	-- Fountain plaza (symmetric on its own)
	b:cylinder(
		1.6,
		13,
		CFrame.new(0, 0.8, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)),
		M.Sandstone,
		STONE,
		{ name = "Basin" }
	)
	b:cylinder(0.2, 11.6, CFrame.new(0, 1.55, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), M.Glass, rgb(70, 150, 190), {
		collide = false,
		query = false,
		transparency = 0.25,
		name = "Water",
	})
	b:box(Vector3.new(3, 6, 3), CFrame.new(0, 3, 0), M.Sandstone, STONE, { name = "Pedestal" })
	b:box(Vector3.new(1.6, 6, 1.6), CFrame.new(0, 9, 0), M.Sandstone, TRIM, { name = "Obelisk" })
	b:wedge(Vector3.new(1.6, 1.4, 1.6), CFrame.new(0, 12.7, 0), M.Sandstone, TRIM, { name = "Cap" })
	b:light(Vector3.new(0, 13.6, 0), rgb(255, 196, 120), 18, 0.6)

	MapKit.both(function(s)
		local team = TEAM[s]

		-- Spawn courtyard: wall with three gates and a blast wall behind each
		b:wall(p(s, -60, 0, -Z), p(s, -60, 0, Z), 10, 1.4, M.Plaster, ADOBE[4], {
			{ at = 22, width = 8, height = 10 },
			{ at = 52, width = 8, height = 10 },
			{ at = 82, width = 8, height = 10 },
		})
		for _, z in { -30, 0, 30 } do
			b:span(p(s, -63, 0, z - 5.5), p(s, -64.2, 9, z + 5.5), M.Plaster, ADOBE[3], { name = "BlastWall" })
			local banner = b:box(
				Vector3.new(0.3, 5, 4),
				cf(s, -64.4, 5, z, 0),
				M.Fabric,
				team,
				{ name = "Banner", collide = false }
			)
			b:sign(banner, Enum.NormalId.Left, TEAM_NAME[s]:upper(), rgb(255, 255, 255))
			for _, dz in { -4.6, 4.6 } do
				b:box(Vector3.new(2, 11.5, 1.4), cf(s, -60, 5.75, z + dz, 0), M.Plaster, TRIM, { name = "GatePost" })
			end
		end
		for _, z in { -42, -28, -14, 0, 14, 28, 42 } do
			b:spawn(TEAM_NAME[s], p(s, -70, 0.5, z), p(s, 0, 0.5, z))
		end
		-- Shade awning at the back of the courtyard
		b:span(p(s, -76, 7.5, -20), p(s, -72, 7.8, 20), M.WoodPlanks, WOOD_LIGHT, { collide = false, name = "Shade" })
		for _, z in { -19, 0, 19 } do
			b:box(Vector3.new(0.4, 7.5, 0.4), cf(s, -72.3, 3.75, z, 0), M.Wood, WOOD, { parent = b.props })
		end
		b:box(Vector3.new(2, 1.6, 6), cf(s, -74, 0.8, -32, 0), M.Wood, WOOD, { parent = b.props, name = "Trough" })

		-- North side of the street (this half)
		adobe(b, s, -50, 12, -32, 26, 11, ADOBE[1], {
			south = { { at = 6, width = 5, height = 8 }, { at = 13, width = 4, height = 7, bottom = 4 } },
			east = { { at = 9, width = 4, height = 8 } },
			north = { { at = 12, width = 4, height = 8 } },
		}, "west")
		local cantina =
			b:box(Vector3.new(10, 2, 0.3), cf(s, -41, 9.5, 11.4, 180), M.WoodPlanks, WOOD, { name = "CantinaSign" })
		b:sign(cantina, Enum.NormalId.Front, "CANTINA", rgb(250, 230, 190))
		b:span(p(s, -48, 0, 21.5), p(s, -38, 3.6, 23), M.WoodPlanks, WOOD, { name = "Bar" })
		b:stairs(p(s, -53, 0, 8.4), MapKit.dir(s, 0, 1), 11.8, 4, M.Plaster, ADOBE[3])

		adobe(b, s, -26, 14, -14, 26, 9, ADOBE[3], {
			south = { { at = 6, width = 4, height = 8 }, { at = 10.4, width = 2.4, height = 7, bottom = 4 } },
			north = { { at = 4, width = 4, height = 8 } },
		})
		local store =
			b:box(Vector3.new(8, 1.8, 0.3), cf(s, -20, 8.2, 13.4, 180), M.WoodPlanks, WOOD, { name = "StoreSign" })
		b:sign(store, Enum.NormalId.Front, "GENERAL STORE", rgb(250, 230, 190))
		b:span(p(s, -25, 0, 23), p(s, -15, 6, 24.5), M.WoodPlanks, WOOD_LIGHT, { name = "Shelves" })

		-- South side of the street (this half)
		adobe(b, s, -44, -26, -28, -12, 10, ADOBE[2], {
			north = {
				{ at = 3.5, width = 3, height = 7.5, bottom = 4.5 } :: Opening,
				{ at = 8, width = 5, height = 8 },
				{ at = 12.5, width = 3, height = 7.5, bottom = 4.5 },
			},
			west = { { at = 4, width = 4, height = 8 } },
		}, "east")
		local sheriff =
			b:box(Vector3.new(9, 1.8, 0.3), cf(s, -36, 9, -11.4, 0), M.WoodPlanks, WOOD, { name = "SheriffSign" })
		b:sign(sheriff, Enum.NormalId.Back, "SHERIFF", rgb(250, 230, 190))
		for _, x in { -40.5, -31.5 } do
			for i = -1, 1 do
				b:box(Vector3.new(0.2, 3, 0.2), cf(s, x + i * 0.9, 6, -12, 0), M.Metal, rgb(40, 40, 44), {
					shotThrough = true,
					name = "Bars",
				})
			end
		end
		b:span(p(s, -42, 0, -24), p(s, -37, 3.4, -22.5), M.WoodPlanks, WOOD, { name = "Desk" })
		b:stairs(p(s, -25, 0, -8.4), MapKit.dir(s, 0, -1), 10.8, 4, M.Plaster, ADOBE[3])

		-- Street furniture
		wagon(b, cf(s, -36, 0, -3, 90))
		stall(b, cf(s, -22, 0, 9.4, 0), team:Lerp(rgb(240, 230, 210), 0.35))
		stall(b, cf(s, -12, 0, -10, 180), rgb(60, 140, 120))
		b:box(Vector3.new(6, 1.8, 2), cf(s, -14, 0.9, 4, 90), M.Wood, WOOD, { name = "Trough" })
		b:barrel(p(s, -48, 0, 9))
		b:barrel(p(s, -46, 0, 10))
		b:crate(cf(s, -27, 2, -9.5, 0), 4)
		-- Plaza benches and planters
		b:box(Vector3.new(5, 1.6, 1.6), cf(s, -9, 0.8, -10.5, 0), M.Sandstone, STONE, { name = "Bench" })
		b:box(Vector3.new(3, 3, 3), cf(s, -10.5, 1.5, 10.5, 0), M.Sandstone, STONE, { name = "Planter" })
		cactus(b, p(s, -10.5, 3, 10.5), 4)

		-- North alley (this half): water tower over a pump house, hay
		adobe(b, s, -27, 36, -21, 42, 7, ADOBE[4], {})
		for _, dx in { -3.5, 3.5 } do
			for _, dz in { -3.5, 3.5 } do
				b:box(Vector3.new(0.7, 16, 0.7), cf(s, -24 + dx, 8, 39 + dz, 0), M.Wood, WOOD, { name = "TowerLeg" })
			end
		end
		b:cylinder(
			7,
			9,
			CFrame.new(p(s, -24, 19.5, 39)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)),
			M.WoodPlanks,
			WOOD_LIGHT,
			{ name = "Tank" }
		)
		hay(b, cf(s, -44, 0, 44, 0))
		hay(b, cf(s, -44, 2.4, 44, 10))
		hay(b, cf(s, -40, 0, 46, 80))
		hay(b, cf(s, -8, 0, 34, 30))
		b:span(p(s, -60, 0, 31), p(s, -50, 3.2, 32), M.Plaster, ADOBE[3], { name = "LowWall" })
		cactus(b, p(s, -12, 0, 47), 7)

		-- South alley (this half): shed, corral, cacti
		adobe(b, s, -10, -44, -2, -36, 8, ADOBE[1], {
			north = { { at = 4, width = 4, height = 7 } },
		})
		b:railing(p(s, -56, 0, -46), p(s, -56, 0, -34), 3.5, WOOD)
		b:railing(p(s, -56, 0, -34), p(s, -46, 0, -34), 3.5, WOOD)
		b:crate(cf(s, -52, 2, -42, 15), 4)
		b:crate(cf(s, -52, 6, -42, 40), 4)
		hay(b, cf(s, -49, 0, -44, 0))
		cactus(b, p(s, -32, 0, -46), 7.5)
		cactus(b, p(s, -22, 0, -32), 6)
		b:span(p(s, -24, 0, -30), p(s, -14, 5.5, -29), M.Plaster, ADOBE[2], { name = "AlleyWall" })
		b:barrel(p(s, -46, 0, -28))
		-- Clutter against the town walls so the wall-hugging lanes don't run end to end
		b:span(p(s, -36, 0, -Z), p(s, -28, 6, -47), M.WoodPlanks, WOOD_LIGHT, { name = "LeanTo" })
		b:wedge(Vector3.new(8, 2, 5), cf(s, -32, 7, -49.5, 0), M.WoodPlanks, WOOD, { name = "LeanToRoof" })
		b:crate(cf(s, -30, 2, 49.5, 0), 4)

		b:span(p(s, -5.5, 0, 47), p(s, -2.5, 7, Z), M.WoodPlanks, WOOD, { name = "Outhouse" })
		b:crate(cf(s, -56, 2, -14, 0), 4)
		b:crate(cf(s, -56, 2, 18, 0), 4)
		b:crate(cf(s, -56, 6, 18, 25), 4)

		-- Lamps along the street
		for _, x in { -48, -24 } do
			b:box(
				Vector3.new(0.4, 9, 0.4),
				cf(s, x, 4.5, -8.6, 0),
				M.Metal,
				rgb(40, 40, 44),
				{ parent = b.props, name = "LampPost" }
			)
			b:light(p(s, x, 9.2, -8.6), rgb(255, 196, 120), 22, 0.8)
		end
	end)

	b:bounds(Vector2.new(-X, -Z), Vector2.new(X, Z), -2, 40)
	b:marker("Camera", CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(-40, 34, -46), Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)))
	b.model:SetAttribute("MapId", DustTown.id)

end
