ServerScriptService.Server.Maps.MapKit:
--!strict
-- Small toolkit for building arenas out of parts in code. Every map module uses it, so
-- maps are diffable text, rebuild identically every round, and can also be exported to
-- .rbxm files for editing in Studio (tools/build_maps.luau).
--
-- Conventions: +Y up, map centred on the origin, Red spawns on -X, Blue spawns on +X.
-- Only Instance.new and datatypes are used here (no services), so it also runs in Lune.

local MapKit = {}
MapKit.__index = MapKit

export type PartOptions = {
	transparency: number?,
	collide: boolean?,
	shotThrough: boolean?, -- players collide, pellets pass (railings, chain-link)
	query: boolean?,
	shadow: boolean?,
	reflectance: number?,
	shape: Enum.PartType?,
	name: string?,
	parent: any,
}

export type Builder = typeof(setmetatable(
	{} :: {
		model: Model,
		geometry: Folder,
		props: Folder,
		markers: Folder,
		lights: Folder,
		count: number,
	},
	MapKit
))

local function folder(name: string, parent: Instance): Folder
	local f = Instance.new("Folder")
	f.Name = name
	f.Parent = parent
	return f
end

function MapKit.new(name: string): Builder
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = name
	return setmetatable({
		model = model,
		geometry = folder("Geometry", model),
		props = folder("Props", model),
		markers = folder("Markers", model),
		lights = folder("Lights", model),
		count = 0,
	}, MapKit)
end

function MapKit.box(
	self: Builder,
	size: Vector3,
	cf: CFrame,
	material: Enum.Material,
	color: Color3,
	opts: PartOptions?
): Part
	local o = (opts or {}) :: PartOptions
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = o.name or "Part"
	part.Anchored = true
	part.Size = size
	part.CFrame = cf
	part.Material = material
	part.Color = color
	part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	if o.shape then
		part.Shape = o.shape
	end
	if o.transparency then
		part.Transparency = o.transparency
	end
	if o.reflectance then
		part.Reflectance = o.reflectance
	end
	if o.collide == false then
		part.CanCollide = false
	end
	if o.query == false then
		part.CanQuery = false
	end
	if o.shadow == false then
		part.CastShadow = false
	end
	part.CanTouch = false
	if o.shotThrough then
		part:SetAttribute("ShotThrough", true)
	end
	part.Parent = o.parent or self.geometry
	self.count += 1
	return part
end

-- Box from two opposite corners (handy for floors and walls laid out on a grid).
function MapKit.span(
	self: Builder,
	a: Vector3,
	b: Vector3,
	material: Enum.Material,
	color: Color3,
	opts: PartOptions?
): Part
	local minV = a:Min(b)
	local maxV = a:Max(b)
	return self:box(maxV - minV, CFrame.new((minV + maxV) / 2), material, color, opts)
end

function MapKit.wedge(
	self: Builder,
	size: Vector3,
	cf: CFrame,
	material: Enum.Material,
	color: Color3,
	opts: PartOptions?
): WedgePart
	local o = (opts or {}) :: PartOptions
	local part = Instance.new("WedgePart")
	part.Name = o.name or "Wedge"
	part.Anchored = true
	part.Size = size
	part.CFrame = cf
	part.Material = material
	part.Color = color
	part.CanTouch = false
	if o.collide == false then
		part.CanCollide = false
	end
	part.Parent = o.parent or self.geometry
	self.count += 1
	return part
end

function MapKit.cylinder(
	self: Builder,
	length: number,
	diameter: number,
	cf: CFrame,
	material: Enum.Material,
	color: Color3,
	opts: PartOptions?
): Part
	local o = table.clone(opts or {}) :: PartOptions
	o.shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	return self:box(Vector3.new(length, diameter, diameter), cf, material, color, o)
end

-- Invisible wall that stops players but not pellets or the camera.
function MapKit.barrier(self: Builder, a: Vector3, b: Vector3)
	local part = self:span(a, b, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Color3.new(1, 1, 1), {
		transparency = 1,
		query = false,
		shadow = false,
		name = "Barrier",
	})
	part:SetAttribute("Barrier", true)
	return part
end

-- Straight staircase rising along `forward` (unit, horizontal) from `bottom` (top surface
-- of the floor at the first step's front edge) up `height` studs.
function MapKit.stairs(
	self: Builder,
	bottom: Vector3,
	forward: Vector3,
	height: number,
	width: number,
	material: Enum.Material,
	color: Color3,
	stepHeight: number?
)
	local rise = stepHeight or 1
	local steps = math.max(1, math.round(height / rise))
	rise = height / steps
	local run = 1.6
	local right = forward:Cross(Vector3.yAxis)
	for i = 1, steps do
		local top = bottom.Y + rise * i
		local center = bottom + forward * (run * (i - 0.5))
		local cf = CFrame.fromMatrix(
			Vector3.new(center.X, (bottom.Y + top) / 2 - 0.0, center.Z),
			right,
			Vector3.yAxis,
			-forward
		)
		self:box(Vector3.new(width, top - bottom.Y, run), cf, material, color, { name = "Step" })
	end
	return bottom + forward * (run * steps) + Vector3.new(0, height, 0)
end

-- Railing along a line (shots pass through, players are stopped).
function MapKit.railing(self: Builder, a: Vector3, b: Vector3, height: number, color: Color3)
	local dir = b - a
	local length = dir.Magnitude
	local mid = (a + b) / 2
	local cf = CFrame.lookAt(mid, b)
	self:box(
		Vector3.new(0.25, 0.25, length),
		cf + Vector3.new(0, height, 0),
		Enum.Material.Metal,
		color,
		{ shotThrough = true, name = "Rail" }
	)
	self:box(
		Vector3.new(0.18, 0.18, length),
		cf + Vector3.new(0, height * 0.5, 0),
		Enum.Material.Metal,
		color,
		{ shotThrough = true, name = "Rail" }
	)
	local posts = math.max(2, math.floor(length / 5) + 1)
	for i = 0, posts - 1 do
		local p = a:Lerp(b, i / (posts - 1))
		self:box(
			Vector3.new(0.25, height, 0.25),
			CFrame.new(p + Vector3.new(0, height / 2, 0)),
			Enum.Material.Metal,
			color,
			{ shotThrough = true, name = "Post" }
		)
	end
end

function MapKit.light(
	self: Builder,
	position: Vector3,
	color: Color3,
	range: number,
	brightness: number,
	kind: string?
): Part
	local holder = self:box(Vector3.new(0.6, 0.2, 0.6), CFrame.new(position), Enum.Material.Neon, color, {
		collide = false,
		query = false,
		shadow = false,
		name = "LightFixture",
		parent = self.lights,
	})
	local light: any
	if kind == "Spot" then
		local spot = Instance.new("SpotLight")
		spot.Face = Enum.NormalId.Bottom
		spot.Angle = 100
		light = spot
	else
		light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	end
	light.Color = color
	light.Range = range
	light.Brightness = brightness
	light.Shadows = true
	light.Parent = holder
	return holder
end

-- Text painted on a part face.
function MapKit.sign(
	_self: Builder,
	part: BasePart,
	face: Enum.NormalId,
	text: string,
	textColor: Color3,
	opts: { font: Enum.Font?, bg: Color3?, size: number? }?
)
	local o = (opts or {}) :: { font: Enum.Font?, bg: Color3?, size: number? }
	local gui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
	gui.Face = face
	gui.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.PixelsPerStud
	gui.PixelsPerStud = 40
	gui.LightInfluence = 0.6
	gui.Parent = part
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = if o.bg then 0 else 1
	label.BackgroundColor3 = o.bg or Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = textColor
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.Font = o.font or Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	label.Parent = gui
	local padding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	padding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0.05, 0)
	padding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0.05, 0)
	padding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0.08, 0)
	padding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0.08, 0)
	padding.Parent = label
	return gui
end

-- A named marker the game reads at runtime (spawns, dummies, camera).
function MapKit.marker(self: Builder, name: string, cf: CFrame, attributes: { [string]: any }?): Part
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = name
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Size = Vector3.new(2, 1, 2)
	part.CFrame = cf
	local attrs: { [string]: any } = attributes or {}
	for k, v in attrs do
		part:SetAttribute(k, v)
	end
	part.Parent = self.markers
	return part
end

function MapKit.spawn(self: Builder, team: string, position: Vector3, lookAt: Vector3)
	local flat = Vector3.new(lookAt.X, position.Y, lookAt.Z)
	return self:marker("Spawn", CFrame.lookAt(position, flat), { Team = team })
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Symmetry. Arenas are point-symmetric around the origin (rotated 180° about Y), so Red
-- (-X) and Blue (+X) get exactly the same layout. Build one half with `side` = 1 and
-- call it again with `side` = -1:
--
--   MapKit.both(function(s) b:box(size, MapKit.cf(s, -30, 2, 10, 90), ...) end)

function MapKit.both(fn: (side: number) -> ())
	fn(1)
	fn(-1)
end

-- Point in half `side` (side -1 mirrors x and z).
function MapKit.p(side: number, x: number, y: number, z: number): Vector3
	return Vector3.new(x * side, y, z * side)
end

-- CFrame in half `side`, yawed `yawDeg` degrees (turned 180° extra in the mirrored half).
function MapKit.cf(side: number, x: number, y: number, z: number, yawDeg: number?): CFrame
	local yaw = math.rad(yawDeg or 0) + (if side < 0 then math.pi else 0)
	return CFrame.new(x * side, y, z * side) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
end

-- Unit horizontal direction in half `side`.
function MapKit.dir(side: number, x: number, z: number): Vector3
	return Vector3.new(x * side, 0, z * side).Unit
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Props

function MapKit.crate(self: Builder, cf: CFrame, size: number?, color: Color3?)
	local s = size or 4
	local c = color or Color3.fromRGB(150, 108, 64)
	local body =
		self:box(Vector3.new(s, s, s), cf, Enum.Material.WoodPlanks, c, { name = "Crate", parent = self.props })
	local trim = c:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.35)
	for _, dy in { -s / 2 + 0.2, s / 2 - 0.2 } do
		self:box(
			Vector3.new(s + 0.1, 0.35, s + 0.1),
			cf * CFrame.new(0, dy, 0),
			Enum.Material.Wood,
			trim,
			{ name = "CrateTrim", parent = self.props, collide = false }
		)
	end
	return body
end

function MapKit.barrel(self: Builder, position: Vector3, color: Color3?)
	local c = color or Color3.fromRGB(46, 120, 160)
	local body = self:cylinder(
		3.4,
		2.4,
		CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, 1.7, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)),
		Enum.Material.Metal,
		c,
		{ name = "Barrel", parent = self.props }
	)
	for _, dy in { 0.5, 2.9 } do
		self:cylinder(
			0.2,
			2.5,
			CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, dy, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)),
			Enum.Material.Metal,
			c:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.3),
			{ parent = self.props, collide = false }
		)
	end
	return body
end

-- Shipping container (8 x 8.5 x 20 studs by default) with ribbed sides. `open` cuts the
-- doors off one end so players can walk through it.
function MapKit.container(
	self: Builder,
	cf: CFrame,
	color: Color3,
	opts: { length: number?, open: boolean?, label: string? }?
)
	local o = (opts or {}) :: { length: number?, open: boolean?, label: string? }
	local length = o.length or 20
	local w, h = 8, 8.5
	local mat = Enum.Material.CorrodedMetal
	local dark = color:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.25)
	-- Walls (hollow so it can be walked through when open)
	self:box(Vector3.new(w, 0.5, length), cf * CFrame.new(0, -h / 2 + 0.25, 0), mat, dark, { name = "ContainerFloor" })
	self:box(Vector3.new(w, 0.5, length), cf * CFrame.new(0, h / 2 - 0.25, 0), mat, color, { name = "ContainerRoof" })
	for _, side in { -1, 1 } do
		local wall = self:box(
			Vector3.new(0.5, h, length),
			cf * CFrame.new(side * (w / 2 - 0.25), 0, 0),
			mat,
			color,
			{ name = "ContainerWall" }
		)
		local ribs = math.floor(length / 1.6)
		for i = 1, ribs - 1 do
			local z = -length / 2 + i * (length / ribs)
			self:box(
				Vector3.new(0.25, h - 0.8, 0.5),
				cf * CFrame.new(side * (w / 2 + 0.1), 0, z),
				mat,
				dark,
				{ collide = false, query = false, parent = self.props, name = "Rib" }
			)
		end
		if o.label and side == 1 then
			self:sign(
				wall,
				Enum.NormalId.Right,
				o.label,
				Color3.fromRGB(245, 240, 230),
				{ font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack }
			)
		end
	end
	-- Back end closed
	self:box(Vector3.new(w, h, 0.5), cf * CFrame.new(0, 0, length / 2 - 0.25), mat, dark, { name = "ContainerEnd" })
	if not o.open then
		self:box(
			Vector3.new(w, h, 0.5),
			cf * CFrame.new(0, 0, -length / 2 + 0.25),
			mat,
			dark,
			{ name = "ContainerDoors" }
		)
		self:box(
			Vector3.new(0.3, h - 1, 0.6),
			cf * CFrame.new(0, 0, -length / 2 - 0.1),
			mat,
			color,
			{ collide = false, query = false, parent = self.props }
		)
	end
end

function MapKit.pallet(self: Builder, cf: CFrame)
	local wood = Color3.fromRGB(176, 140, 92)
	for i = -1, 1 do
		self:box(
			Vector3.new(4, 0.25, 0.8),
			cf * CFrame.new(0, 0.55, i * 1.6),
			Enum.Material.WoodPlanks,
			wood,
			{ parent = self.props, name = "Pallet" }
		)
		self:box(
			Vector3.new(0.6, 0.45, 4),
			cf * CFrame.new(i * 1.7, 0.2, 0),
			Enum.Material.Wood,
			wood:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.2),
			{ parent = self.props, name = "Pallet" }
		)
	end
end

-- Wall along X or Z from a to b (floor level) with openings at the given distances
-- along the wall: { {at=, width=, height=, bottom=} } (bottom > 0 makes a window).
function MapKit.wall(
	self: Builder,
	a: Vector3,
	b: Vector3,
	height: number,
	thickness: number,
	material: Enum.Material,
	color: Color3,
	openings: { { at: number, width: number, height: number, bottom: number? } }?
)
	local dir = (b - a)
	local length = dir.Magnitude
	local unit = dir.Unit
	local right = unit:Cross(Vector3.yAxis)
	local function segment(from: number, to: number, y0: number, y1: number)
		if to - from < 0.05 or y1 - y0 < 0.05 then
			return
		end
		local center = a + unit * ((from + to) / 2) + Vector3.new(0, (y0 + y1) / 2, 0)
		local cf = CFrame.fromMatrix(center, right, Vector3.yAxis, -unit)
		self:box(Vector3.new(thickness, y1 - y0, to - from), cf, material, color, { name = "Wall" })
	end
	local list: { { at: number, width: number, height: number, bottom: number? } } = table.clone(openings or {})
	table.sort(list, function(x, y)
		return x.at < y.at
	end)
	local cursor = 0
	for _, opening in list do
		local left = opening.at - opening.width / 2
		local rightEdge = opening.at + opening.width / 2
		segment(cursor, left, 0, height)
		segment(left, rightEdge, 0, opening.bottom or 0)
		segment(left, rightEdge, opening.height, height)
		cursor = rightEdge
	end
	segment(cursor, length, 0, height)
end

-- Bounding wall of invisible barriers around a rectangle, from floorY to topY.
function MapKit.bounds(self: Builder, minXZ: Vector2, maxXZ: Vector2, floorY: number, topY: number)
	local t = 2
	self:barrier(Vector3.new(minXZ.X - t, floorY, minXZ.Y - t), Vector3.new(maxXZ.X + t, topY, minXZ.Y))
	self:barrier(Vector3.new(minXZ.X - t, floorY, maxXZ.Y), Vector3.new(maxXZ.X + t, topY, maxXZ.Y + t))
	self:barrier(Vector3.new(minXZ.X - t, floorY, minXZ.Y), Vector3.new(minXZ.X, topY, maxXZ.Y))
	self:barrier(Vector3.new(maxXZ.X, floorY, minXZ.Y), Vector3.new(maxXZ.X + t, topY, maxXZ.Y))
	-- Lid so nobody can stand on top of the barriers
	self:barrier(Vector3.new(minXZ.X - t, topY, minXZ.Y - t), Vector3.new(maxXZ.X + t, topY + 1, maxXZ.Y + t))
end

return MapKit
ServerScriptService.Server.Maps.QueueZon:
--!strict
-- Additional range furniture only; noncolliding and excluded from pellet queries.
local QueueZone = {}

function QueueZone.build(range: Model, cframe: CFrame, size: Vector3)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "MatchQueue"
	local edges: { Part } = {}
	local cyan = Color3.fromRGB(64, 214, 240)
	local function part(
		name: string,
		dimensions: Vector3,
		position: Vector3,
		color: Color3,
		material: Enum.Material
	): Part
		local p = Instance.new("Part")
		p.Name = name
		p.Size = dimensions
		p.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)
		p.Anchored = true
		p.CanCollide = false
		p.CanTouch = false
		p.CanQuery = false
		p.CastShadow = false
		p.Color = color
		p.Material = material
		p.Parent = model
		return p
	end
	local floor = cframe.Position - Vector3.new(0, size.Y / 2 - 0.06, 0)
	part("QueueFloor", Vector3.new(size.X, 0.1, size.Z), floor, Color3.fromRGB(28, 61, 72), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
	for _, sign in { -1, 1 } do
		table.insert(
			edges,
			part(
				"Boundary",
				Vector3.new(size.X, 0.12, 0.25),
				floor + Vector3.new(0, 0.1, sign * size.Z / 2),
				cyan,
				Enum.Material.Neon
			)
		)
		table.insert(
			edges,
			part(
				"Boundary",
				Vector3.new(0.25, 0.12, size.Z),
				floor + Vector3.new(sign * size.X / 2, 0.1, 0),
				cyan,
				Enum.Material.Neon
			)
		)
	end
	local anchor = part("QueueDisplay", Vector3.one, floor + Vector3.new(0, 9, 0), cyan, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
	anchor.Transparency = 1
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Name = "QueueDisplay"
	gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(360, 142)
	gui.MaxDistance = 150
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = false
	gui.Parent = anchor
	local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
	panel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 24, 32)
	panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
	panel.Parent = gui
	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
	corner.Parent = panel
	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = cyan
	stroke.Thickness = 2
	stroke.Parent = panel
	local function label(name: string, y: number, height: number, textSize: number): TextLabel
		local text = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		text.Name = name
		text.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, height)
		text.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, y)
		text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		text.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		text.TextSize = textSize
		text.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(244, 246, 250)
		text.Parent = panel
		return text
	end
	local title = label("Title", 10, 34, 27)
	local population = label("Population", 48, 30, 23)
	local status = label("Status", 88, 38, 18)
	model.Parent = range
	return function(state: string, count: number, capacity: number, minimum: number, seconds: number)
		local countdown = state == "Countdown"
		local color = if countdown then Color3.fromRGB(255, 186, 48) else cyan
		title.Text = if countdown then "MATCH STARTING" else "MATCH QUEUE"
		title.TextColor3 = color
		population.Text = `{count} / {capacity} Players`
		status.Text = if countdown
			then `Starting in {seconds} seconds`
			elseif state == "Pending" then "Arena occupied - next match pending"
			else `Waiting for players - minimum {minimum}`
		stroke.Color = color
		for _, edge in edges do
			edge.Color = color
		end
	end
end

return QueueZone
ServerScriptService.Server.Maps.Range:
--!strict
-- Practice range: always loaded, away from the arenas. Lanes at fixed distances so
-- players can learn the pellet pattern and the falloff, strafing and jumping targets,
-- and a double-pump drill booth. Players wait here when there aren't enough players
-- for a match.

local MapKit = require(script.Parent.MapKit)

local Range = {}

Range.id = "Range"
Range.displayName = "Practice Range"
Range.origin = Vector3.new(-1200, 0, 0) -- far from the arenas

local CONCRETE = Color3.fromRGB(150, 152, 158)
local FLOOR = Color3.fromRGB(92, 96, 104)
local ACCENT = Color3.fromRGB(255, 176, 32)
local DARK = Color3.fromRGB(38, 40, 46)
local WHITE = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 235)

function Range.build(): Model
	local b = MapKit.new("Range")
	local o = Range.origin
	local function at(x: number, y: number, z: number): Vector3
		return o + Vector3.new(x, y, z)
	end

	-- Hall: 120 (x) by 84 (z), 26 high. Shooters stand at x < -40, targets downrange (+x).
	b:span(at(-62, -2, -44), at(62, 0, 44), Enum.Material.Concrete, FLOOR, { name = "Floor" })
	b:span(at(-62, 0, -46), at(62, 26, -44), Enum.Material.Concrete, CONCRETE)
	b:span(at(-62, 0, 44), at(62, 26, 46), Enum.Material.Concrete, CONCRETE)
	b:span(at(-64, 0, -46), at(-62, 26, 46), Enum.Material.Concrete, CONCRETE)
	local backstop = b:span(at(62, 0, -46), at(64, 26, 46), Enum.Material.Concrete, DARK)
	b:span(at(-64, 26, -46), at(64, 27, 46), Enum.Material.Metal, DARK, { name = "Ceiling" })
	-- Roof beams and lights
	for x = -50, 50, 20 do
		b:span(
			at(x - 0.6, 23, -44),
			at(x + 0.6, 26, 44),
			Enum.Material.Metal,
			Color3.fromRGB(70, 74, 82),
			{ query = false }
		)
		for z = -30, 30, 20 do
			b:light(at(x, 22.6, z), Color3.fromRGB(255, 244, 225), 40, 1.2, "Spot")
		end
	end
	b:sign(backstop, Enum.NormalId.Left, "DOUBLE PUMP  •  PRACTICE RANGE", ACCENT, { bg = DARK })

	-- Firing line with a low counter, distance markers on the floor
	b:span(
		at(-42, 0, -40),
		at(-41, 2.6, 40),
		Enum.Material.Wood,
		Color3.fromRGB(120, 86, 56),
		{ name = "Counter", shotThrough = true }
	)
	local lanes = { -30, -15, 0, 15, 30 }
	local distances = { 5, 10, 20, 35 }
	for _, z in lanes do
		b:span(
			at(-41, 0.01, z - 0.2),
			at(60, 0.05, z + 0.2),
			Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
			ACCENT,
			{ collide = false, query = false }
		)
	end
	for _, d in distances do
		local x = -41 + d
		local stripe = b:span(
			at(x - 0.3, 0.01, -42),
			at(x + 0.3, 0.06, 42),
			Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
			WHITE,
			{ collide = false, query = false }
		)
		stripe.Name = "DistanceStripe"
		local post = b:box(
			Vector3.new(4, 2, 0.4),
			CFrame.new(at(x, 20, -43.5)),
			Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
			DARK,
			{ query = false }
		)
		b:sign(post, Enum.NormalId.Back, `{d} STUDS`, ACCENT)
	end

	-- Static target dummies at each distance on lanes -30 / -15 / 0
	for i, d in distances do
		local x = -41 + d
		b:marker(
			"Dummy",
			CFrame.lookAt(at(x, 0, lanes[((i - 1) % 3) + 1]), at(-60, 0, lanes[((i - 1) % 3) + 1])),
			{ Kind = "Static" }
		)
	end
	b:marker("Dummy", CFrame.lookAt(at(-31, 0, 0), at(-60, 0, 0)), { Kind = "Static" })
	-- Strafing targets on lane 15 (12 studs) and lane 30 (22 studs)
	b:marker("Dummy", CFrame.lookAt(at(-29, 0, 15), at(-60, 0, 15)), { Kind = "Strafe", Width = 14 })
	b:marker("Dummy", CFrame.lookAt(at(-19, 0, 30), at(-60, 0, 30)), { Kind = "Strafe", Width = 18 })
	-- Jumping target
	b:marker("Dummy", CFrame.lookAt(at(-25, 0, -8), at(-60, 0, -8)), { Kind = "Jump" })

	-- Double-pump drill booth: two dummies close together behind a low wall
	b:span(at(20, 0, 34), at(21, 3, 42), Enum.Material.Concrete, CONCRETE)
	local booth = b:box(
		Vector3.new(0.4, 3, 8),
		CFrame.new(at(-42.2, 6, 34)),
		Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
		DARK,
		{ query = false }
	)
	b:sign(booth, Enum.NormalId.Left, "DRILL: FIRE • SWAP • FIRE", ACCENT)
	b:marker("Dummy", CFrame.lookAt(at(-33, 0, 36), at(-60, 0, 36)), { Kind = "Static", Drill = true })
	b:marker("Dummy", CFrame.lookAt(at(-33, 0, 40), at(-60, 0, 40)), { Kind = "Static", Drill = true })

	-- Cover pieces to practise peeking
	b:crate(CFrame.new(at(-10, 2, -30)), 4)
	b:crate(CFrame.new(at(-10, 2, -26)), 4)
	b:crate(CFrame.new(at(-10, 6, -28)), 4)
	b:barrel(at(5, 0, -20))
	b:barrel(at(7.5, 0, -18))

	-- Player area behind the line
	for i = -3, 3 do
		b:spawn("Range", at(-54, 0.5, i * 10), at(60, 0.5, i * 10))
	end
	b:marker("Camera", CFrame.lookAt(at(-55, 12, 0), at(20, 2, 0)))
	local welcome = b:box(
		Vector3.new(0.4, 6, 24),
		CFrame.new(at(-61.6, 9, 0)),
		Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
		DARK,
		{ query = false }
	)
	b:sign(welcome, Enum.NormalId.Right, "1 / 2  EQUIP  •  Q  SWAP  •  R  RELOAD  •  HEADSHOTS x1.75", WHITE)
	b:bounds(Vector2.new(o.X - 62, o.Z - 44), Vector2.new(o.X + 62, o.Z + 44), o.Y - 2, o.Y + 26)

	b.model:SetAttribute("MapId", Range.id)
	return b.model
end

Range.lighting = {
	ClockTime = 14,
	Brightness = 1.5,
	Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 88),
	OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(110, 110, 120),
	FogEnd = 1000,
	ExposureCompensation = 0.2,
}

return Range
ServerScriptService.Server.Maps.Rooftops:
--!strict
-- ROOFTOPS: neon-lit city roofs at night, high above the street. Roofs are joined by
-- short bridges and stairs over drops; fall and you're out. Cover comes from machine
-- rooms, AC units, billboards and water tanks. Point-symmetric: Red owns -X, Blue +X.
--
-- Layout: spawn roof (raised) -> wide block roof with a penthouse -> centre roof with a
-- lift machine room. North and south roofs give each team a flank route.

local MapKit = require(script.Parent.MapKit)

local Rooftops = {}

Rooftops.id = "Rooftops"
Rooftops.displayName = "Rooftops"
Rooftops.description = "Neon city roofs joined by narrow bridges. Short gaps, long drops: watch your footing."
Rooftops.ambience = "AmbRooftops"
Rooftops.killY = -30
Rooftops.extents = { min = Vector2.new(-70, -42), max = Vector2.new(70, 42), top = 30, bottom = -30 }

local rgb = Color3.fromRGB
local M = Enum.Material

local ROOF = rgb(78, 82, 92)
local ROOF_LIGHT = rgb(104, 108, 118)
local FACADE = rgb(52, 56, 68)
local STEEL = rgb(46, 50, 58)
local TRIM = rgb(150, 156, 168)
local NEON_PINK = rgb(255, 60, 170)
local NEON_CYAN = rgb(40, 230, 255)
local NEON_AMBER = rgb(255, 170, 40)
local TEAM = { [1] = rgb(220, 60, 60), [-1] = rgb(60, 130, 240) }
local TEAM_NAME = { [1] = "Red", [-1] = "Blue" }

local BUILDING_BOTTOM = -60 -- buildings are solid blocks down to here; the street is far below

local p, cf = MapKit.p, MapKit.cf

-- A building: solid block from far below up to `top`, with a lip around the roof.
local function building(
	b: MapKit.Builder,
	s: number,
	x0: number,
	z0: number,
	x1: number,
	z1: number,
	top: number,
	color: Color3
)
	b:span(p(s, x0, BUILDING_BOTTOM, z0), p(s, x1, top, z1), M.Concrete, color, { name = "Building" })
	b:span(p(s, x0 + 0.2, top, z0 + 0.2), p(s, x1 - 0.2, top + 0.15, z1 - 0.2), M.Asphalt, ROOF, {
		collide = false,
		query = false,
		name = "RoofSurface",
	})
	-- Lit window bands on the facades (scenery)
	for y = top - 6, top - 30, -6 do
		for _, zEdge in { z0 - 0.15, z1 + 0.15 } do
			b:span(
				p(s, x0 + 1, y - 1.2, zEdge - 0.1),
				p(s, x1 - 1, y, zEdge + 0.1),
				M.Neon,
				rgb(255, 214, 150):Lerp(FACADE, 0.55),
				{
					collide = false,
					query = false,
					shadow = false,
					name = "WindowBand",
				}
			)
		end
	end
end

-- Low wall (lip) along a roof edge, crouch-height cover.
local function lip(b: MapKit.Builder, a: Vector3, c: Vector3)
	b:span(a, c + Vector3.new(0, 1.6, 0), M.Concrete, ROOF_LIGHT, { name = "Lip" })
end

-- Flat bridge between two roofs with railings both sides (rails don't stop pellets).
local function bridge(b: MapKit.Builder, a: Vector3, c: Vector3, width: number)
	local along = (c - a).Unit
	local side = along:Cross(Vector3.yAxis) * (width / 2)
	b:span(a - side - Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0), c + side, M.DiamondPlate, STEEL, { name = "Bridge" })
	b:railing(a + side, c + side, 3, TRIM)
	b:railing(a - side, c - side, 3, TRIM)
end

local function acUnit(b: MapKit.Builder, at: CFrame)
	b:box(Vector3.new(4, 3.2, 6), at * CFrame.new(0, 1.6, 0), M.Metal, rgb(170, 176, 184), { name = "ACUnit" })
	b:cylinder(0.3, 2.6, at * CFrame.new(0, 3.35, 1.4) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), M.Metal, STEEL, {
		collide = false,
		parent = b.props,
	})
	b:cylinder(0.3, 2.6, at * CFrame.new(0, 3.35, -1.4) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), M.Metal, STEEL, {
		collide = false,
		parent = b.props,
	})
end

local function waterTank(b: MapKit.Builder, base: Vector3)
	for _, dx in { -2.6, 2.6 } do
		for _, dz in { -2.6, 2.6 } do
			b:box(
				Vector3.new(0.5, 9, 0.5),
				CFrame.new(base + Vector3.new(dx, 4.5, dz)),
				M.Metal,
				STEEL,
				{ name = "TankLeg" }
			)
		end
	end
	b:cylinder(
		7,
		7,
		CFrame.new(base + Vector3.new(0, 12.5, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)),
		M.WoodPlanks,
		rgb(120, 82, 54),
		{
			name = "Tank",
		}
	)
	b:wedge(
		Vector3.new(7, 2, 7),
		CFrame.new(base + Vector3.new(0, 17, 0)),
		M.Metal,
		STEEL,
		{ collide = false, name = "TankRoof" }
	)
end

local function billboard(b: MapKit.Builder, at: CFrame, text: string, color: Color3)
	for _, x in { -5, 5 } do
		b:box(Vector3.new(0.6, 9, 0.6), at * CFrame.new(x, 4.5, 0), M.Metal, STEEL, { name = "BillboardLeg" })
	end
	local board = b:box(
		Vector3.new(14, 6, 0.6),
		at * CFrame.new(0, 10, 0),
		M.SmoothPlastic,
		rgb(20, 20, 28),
		{ name = "Billboard" }
	)
	b:sign(board, Enum.NormalId.Front, text, color, { font = Enum.Font.LuckiestGuy })
	b:sign(board, Enum.NormalId.Back, text, color, { font = Enum.Font.LuckiestGuy })
	b:box(
		Vector3.new(14.4, 0.3, 0.3),
		at * CFrame.new(0, 13.2, -0.4),
		M.Neon,
		color,
		{ collide = false, query = false, name = "BillboardNeon" }
	)
	b:light((at * CFrame.new(0, 12, -2)).Position, color, 20, 1.2)
end

function Rooftops.build(): Model
	local b = MapKit.new("Rooftops")

	-- Centre roof (symmetric on its own) with the lift machine room
	building(b, 1, -14, -14, 14, 14, 0, FACADE)
	b:box(Vector3.new(8, 6.5, 8), CFrame.new(0, 3.25, 0), M.Concrete, ROOF_LIGHT, { name = "MachineRoom" })
	b:box(Vector3.new(8.6, 0.5, 8.6), CFrame.new(0, 6.75, 0), M.Metal, STEEL, { name = "MachineRoomRoof" })
	b:light(Vector3.new(0, 7.4, 0), NEON_AMBER, 18, 0.8)

	-- The city below and around (scenery only: not solid, not hit by shots)
	b:box(
		Vector3.new(900, 2, 900),
		CFrame.new(0, -200, 0),
		M.Asphalt,
		rgb(20, 20, 26),
		{ collide = false, query = false, name = "Street" }
	)
	local rng = Random.new(41)
	for i = 1, 70 do
		local angle = rng:NextNumber(0, math.pi * 2)
		local dist = rng:NextNumber(110, 330)
		local w, d = rng:NextNumber(18, 40), rng:NextNumber(18, 40)
		local h = rng:NextNumber(120, 260)
		local x, z = math.cos(angle) * dist, math.sin(angle) * dist
		local tower = b:box(
			Vector3.new(w, h, d),
			CFrame.new(x, -200 + h / 2, z),
			M.Concrete,
			FACADE:Lerp(rgb(30, 32, 44), rng:NextNumber()),
			{
				collide = false,
				query = false,
				shadow = false,
				name = "CityTower",
			}
		)
		if i % 3 == 0 then
			local neon = ({ NEON_PINK, NEON_CYAN, NEON_AMBER })[(i // 3) % 3 + 1]
			b:box(Vector3.new(w + 0.4, 1, 0.4), tower.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, h / 2 - 3, -d / 2), M.Neon, neon, {
				collide = false,
				query = false,
				shadow = false,
				name = "CityNeon",
			})
		end
	end

	MapKit.both(function(s)
		local team = TEAM[s]

		-- Spawn roof (raised 4) with a parapet, three exits and blast walls
		building(b, s, -70, -34, -52, 34, 4, FACADE:Lerp(team, 0.12))
		b:wall(p(s, -52.6, 4, -34), p(s, -52.6, 4, 34), 6, 1.2, M.Concrete, ROOF_LIGHT, {
			{ at = 10, width = 6, height = 6 },
			{ at = 34, width = 6, height = 6 },
			{ at = 58, width = 6, height = 6 },
		})
		for _, z in { -24, 0, 24 } do
			b:span(p(s, -56, 4, z - 4.5), p(s, -57, 11, z + 4.5), M.Concrete, ROOF_LIGHT, { name = "BlastWall" })
			b:box(
				Vector3.new(1.2, 0.4, 9),
				cf(s, -56.5, 11.2, z, 0),
				M.Neon,
				team,
				{ collide = false, query = false, name = "BlastWallStrip" }
			)
			-- Stairs down onto the next roof
			b:stairs(p(s, -46, 0, z), MapKit.dir(s, -1, 0), 4, 5, M.DiamondPlate, STEEL)
			b:railing(p(s, -52, 0, z - 2.7), p(s, -46, 0, z - 2.7), 4, TRIM)
			b:railing(p(s, -52, 0, z + 2.7), p(s, -46, 0, z + 2.7), 4, TRIM)
		end
		for _, z in { -30, -20, -10, 0, 10, 20, 30 } do
			b:spawn(TEAM_NAME[s], p(s, -63, 4.5, z), p(s, 0, 4.5, z))
		end
		b:box(Vector3.new(5, 7, 9), cf(s, -67.5, 7.5, -15, 0), M.Concrete, ROOF_LIGHT, { name = "Stairwell" })
		acUnit(b, cf(s, -67, 4, 26, 0))
		local spawnSign = b:box(
			Vector3.new(0.4, 3, 12),
			cf(s, -69.6, 8, 0, 0),
			M.SmoothPlastic,
			rgb(16, 16, 22),
			{ name = "TeamSign" }
		)
		b:sign(spawnSign, Enum.NormalId.Right, TEAM_NAME[s]:upper() .. " ROOF", team)

		-- Main block roof with a penthouse
		building(b, s, -46, -40, -20, 40, 0, FACADE)
		b:wall(
			p(s, -40, 0, -10),
			p(s, -28, 0, -10),
			8,
			1,
			M.Concrete,
			rgb(200, 200, 206),
			{ { at = 6, width = 4, height = 7 } }
		)
		b:wall(
			p(s, -40, 0, 10),
			p(s, -28, 0, 10),
			8,
			1,
			M.Concrete,
			rgb(200, 200, 206),
			{ { at = 3, width = 3, height = 6.5, bottom = 3.5 } }
		)
		b:wall(
			p(s, -40, 0, -10),
			p(s, -40, 0, 10),
			8,
			1,
			M.Concrete,
			rgb(200, 200, 206),
			{ { at = 14, width = 4, height = 7 } }
		)
		b:wall(p(s, -28, 0, -10), p(s, -28, 0, 10), 8, 1, M.Concrete, rgb(200, 200, 206), {
			{ at = 6, width = 4, height = 7 },
			{ at = 13, width = 4, height = 6.5, bottom = 3.5 },
		})
		b:span(p(s, -40.5, 8, -10.5), p(s, -27.5, 8.6, 10.5), M.Concrete, ROOF_LIGHT, { name = "PenthouseRoof" })
		b:light(p(s, -34, 7.4, 0), rgb(255, 220, 180), 16, 0.7)
		acUnit(b, cf(s, -42, 0, 26, 0))
		acUnit(b, cf(s, -24, 0, -26, 90))
		waterTank(b, p(s, -26, 0, 30))
		billboard(b, cf(s, -34, 0, -36, 0), "PUMP-O  COLA", NEON_PINK)
		lip(b, p(s, -46, 0, 39), p(s, -30, 0, 40))
		lip(b, p(s, -44, 0, -18), p(s, -36, 0, -17))
		b:box(
			Vector3.new(6, 0.8, 4),
			cf(s, -24, 0.4, 14, 0),
			M.Glass,
			rgb(150, 200, 220),
			{ transparency = 0.4, name = "Skylight" }
		)
		b:box(Vector3.new(2.4, 5, 2.4), cf(s, -32, 2.5, 20, 0), M.Metal, STEEL, { name = "VentStack" })
		b:box(Vector3.new(2.4, 5, 2.4), cf(s, -38, 2.5, -26, 0), M.Metal, STEEL, { name = "VentStack" })

		-- Bridges from the main block to the centre roof
		for _, z in { -9, 9 } do
			bridge(b, p(s, -20, 0, z), p(s, -14, 0, z), 4.5)
		end

		-- Flank roof (north for Red, south for Blue), slightly raised
		building(b, s, -14, 20, 14, 40, 2, FACADE:Lerp(rgb(60, 50, 80), 0.4))
		b:stairs(p(s, -7, 0, 16.8), MapKit.dir(s, 0, 1), 2, 4, M.DiamondPlate, STEEL)
		b:span(p(s, -9, -0.5, 14), p(s, -5, 0, 16.8), M.DiamondPlate, STEEL, { name = "Bridge" })
		b:railing(p(s, -9.2, 0, 14), p(s, -9.2, 0, 20), 3, TRIM)
		b:railing(p(s, -4.8, 0, 14), p(s, -4.8, 0, 20), 3, TRIM)
		b:stairs(p(s, -17.2, 0, 32), MapKit.dir(s, 1, 0), 2, 4, M.DiamondPlate, STEEL)
		b:span(p(s, -20, -0.5, 30), p(s, -17.2, 0, 34), M.DiamondPlate, STEEL, { name = "Bridge" })
		b:railing(p(s, -20, 0, 29.8), p(s, -14, 0, 29.8), 3, TRIM)
		b:railing(p(s, -20, 0, 34.2), p(s, -14, 0, 34.2), 3, TRIM)
		b:box(Vector3.new(7, 7, 6), cf(s, 4, 5.5, 30, 0), M.Concrete, ROOF_LIGHT, { name = "Shed" })
		for i, x in { -10, -4, 9 } do
			b:box(
				Vector3.new(3.4, 3, 3.4),
				cf(s, x, 3.5, if i == 2 then 36 else 25, 0),
				M.WoodPlanks,
				rgb(110, 76, 50),
				{ name = "Planter" }
			)
		end
		lip(b, p(s, -14, 2, 39), p(s, 14, 2, 40))
		b:box(Vector3.new(4, 4, 8), cf(s, -2, 4, 24, 90), M.Concrete, ROOF_LIGHT, { name = "Hatch" })
		billboard(b, cf(s, 10, 2, 39, 180), "DOUBLE PUMP", NEON_CYAN)

		-- Centre roof cover (this half)
		b:box(Vector3.new(3, 3.2, 5), cf(s, -9, 1.6, -5, 0), M.Metal, rgb(170, 176, 184), { name = "ACUnit" })
		b:box(Vector3.new(2, 4.8, 2), cf(s, -6, 2.4, 9, 0), M.Metal, STEEL, { name = "VentStack" })
		lip(b, p(s, -12, 0, -14), p(s, -4, 0, -13))
		b:light(p(s, -10, 4, 10), NEON_PINK, 14, 0.8)
		b:light(p(s, -40, 4, -32), NEON_CYAN, 18, 0.8)

ServerScriptService.Server.Maps.Warehous:
--!strict
-- WAREHOUSE: an indoor logistics hall. Tight aisles between pallet racks, a two-storey
-- site office in the middle with a fightable roof, catwalks along the walls joined to the
-- roof by bridges, and container cover. Point-symmetric: Red owns the -X half, Blue +X.
--
-- Flow: each spawn room has three doors. The centre office is the power position;
-- reaching its roof means crossing open floor or the catwalk bridge, both of which
-- can be contested from the floor. Rack shelves have gaps you can shoot through.

local MapKit = require(script.Parent.MapKit)

local Warehouse = {}

Warehouse.id = "Warehouse"
Warehouse.displayName = "Warehouse"
Warehouse.description =
	"Pallet racks, catwalks and a site office with a roof worth fighting for. Close quarters all over."
Warehouse.ambience = "AmbWarehouse"
Warehouse.killY = -40
-- Playable area, used by the layout checks (tests/maps.spec.luau)
Warehouse.extents = { min = Vector2.new(-72, -46), max = Vector2.new(72, 46), top = 29, bottom = -1 }

local rgb = Color3.fromRGB
local M = Enum.Material

local FLOOR = rgb(118, 118, 122)
local WALL = rgb(150, 156, 164)
local WALL_DARK = rgb(70, 74, 82)
local STEEL = rgb(60, 66, 76)
local BEAM = rgb(232, 120, 40)
local CARDBOARD = rgb(186, 146, 96)
local YELLOW = rgb(250, 200, 40)
local OFFICE = rgb(214, 210, 198)
local TEAM = { [1] = rgb(200, 52, 52), [-1] = rgb(48, 110, 210) }
local TEAM_NAME = { [1] = "Red", [-1] = "Blue" }

local X, Z = 72, 46 -- half extents of the hall interior
local CEILING = 30
local ROOF = 12 -- office roof / catwalk height

local p, cf = MapKit.p, MapKit.cf

-- Pallet rack: uprights, orange beams, three levels of boxes with deliberate gaps.
local function rack(b: MapKit.Builder, at: CFrame, length: number, seed: number)
	local depth, height = 3.6, 15.6
	local bays = math.max(2, math.round(length / 4.5))
	local bay = length / bays
	for i = 0, bays do
		local x = -length / 2 + i * bay
		for _, z in { -depth / 2, depth / 2 } do
			b:box(
				Vector3.new(0.4, height, 0.4),
				at * CFrame.new(x, height / 2, z),
				M.Metal,
				STEEL,
				{ name = "Upright" }
			)
		end
	end
	local levels = { 0.25, 4.1, 7.95, 11.8 }
	for _, y in levels do
		b:box(Vector3.new(length + 0.4, 0.3, depth + 0.4), at * CFrame.new(0, y, 0), M.Metal, BEAM, { name = "Shelf" })
	end
	b:box(Vector3.new(length + 0.4, 0.3, depth + 0.4), at * CFrame.new(0, height, 0), M.Metal, BEAM, { name = "Shelf" })
	local pattern = "XX.XXX.X.XXXX.XX.XX"
	local goodsLevels = table.clone(levels)
	table.insert(goodsLevels, height)
	for level, y in goodsLevels do
		for i = 1, bays do
			local k = (seed + level * 7 + i * 3) % #pattern + 1
			if pattern:sub(k, k) == "X" then
				local h = if (i + level) % 2 == 0 then 3.1 else 2.4
				b:box(
					Vector3.new(bay - 0.7, h, depth - 0.5),
					at * CFrame.new(-length / 2 + (i - 0.5) * bay, y + 0.15 + h / 2, 0),
					M.Cardboard,
					CARDBOARD:Lerp(rgb(120, 90, 60), ((i * 13 + level * 5) % 7) / 14),
					{ name = "Goods", parent = b.props }
				)
			end
		end
	end
end

local function forklift(b: MapKit.Builder, at: CFrame)
	local body = rgb(240, 180, 30)
	local dark = rgb(30, 30, 34)
	b:box(Vector3.new(4, 2.4, 6), at * CFrame.new(0, 1.7, 0), M.Metal, body, { parent = b.props, name = "Forklift" })
	b:box(Vector3.new(3.6, 0.3, 3), at * CFrame.new(0, 5.6, 0.6), M.Metal, dark, { parent = b.props })
	for _, x in { -1.7, 1.7 } do
		b:box(
			Vector3.new(0.25, 3.0, 0.25),
			at * CFrame.new(x, 4.1, 2),
			M.Metal,
			dark,
			{ parent = b.props, collide = false }
		)
		b:box(
			Vector3.new(0.25, 3.0, 0.25),
			at * CFrame.new(x, 4.1, -0.9),
			M.Metal,
			dark,
			{ parent = b.props, collide = false }
		)
		b:box(Vector3.new(0.3, 6, 0.3), at * CFrame.new(x * 0.7, 3, -3.2), M.Metal, dark, { parent = b.props })
		b:box(Vector3.new(0.4, 0.2, 3.4), at * CFrame.new(x * 0.5, 0.5, -4.8), M.Metal, dark, { parent = b.props })
		for _, z in { -1.9, 1.9 } do
			b:cylinder(
				0.8,
				1.4,
				at * CFrame.new(x * 1.2, 0.7, z),
				M.SmoothPlastic,
				dark,
				{ parent = b.props, collide = false }
			)
		end
	end
	b:pallet(at * CFrame.new(0, 0.6, -5.6))
end

function Warehouse.build(): Model
	local b = MapKit.new("Warehouse")

	-- Shell
	b:span(Vector3.new(-X - 2, -2, -Z - 2), Vector3.new(X + 2, 0, Z + 2), M.Concrete, FLOOR, { name = "Floor" })
	b:span(
		Vector3.new(-X - 2, CEILING, -Z - 2),
		Vector3.new(X + 2, CEILING + 1, Z + 2),
		M.Metal,
		WALL_DARK,
		{ name = "Roof" }
	)
	for _, s in { -1, 1 } do
		b:span(Vector3.new(-X - 2, 0, s * Z), Vector3.new(X + 2, CEILING, s * (Z + 2)), M.CorrodedMetal, WALL)
		b:span(Vector3.new(s * X, 0, -Z), Vector3.new(s * (X + 2), CEILING, Z), M.CorrodedMetal, WALL)
	end
	-- Roof trusses and skylight strips (light only, not walkable)
	for x = -60, 60, 20 do
		b:span(
			Vector3.new(x - 0.5, CEILING - 3, -Z),
			Vector3.new(x + 0.5, CEILING, Z),
			M.Metal,
			STEEL,
			{ query = false }
		)
	end
	for x = -50, 50, 20 do
		b:span(
			Vector3.new(x - 3, CEILING - 0.2, -30),
			Vector3.new(x + 3, CEILING + 0.4, 30),
			M.Glass,
			rgb(200, 220, 235),
			{ transparency = 0.45, query = false, shadow = false, name = "Skylight" }
		)
	end
	for x = -60, 60, 24 do
		for z = -32, 32, 16 do
			b:light(Vector3.new(x, CEILING - 3.5, z), rgb(255, 238, 210), 34, 0.9, "Spot")
		end
	end
	-- Floor lane markings
	for _, z in { -14, 14 } do
		b:span(
			Vector3.new(-54, 0, z - 0.25),
			Vector3.new(54, 0.05, z + 0.25),
			M.SmoothPlastic,
			YELLOW,
			{ collide = false, query = false }
		)
	end

	-- Centre office (symmetric itself): walls 11 high, roof slab 11..12
	local OX, OZ = 11, 8
	b:span(
		Vector3.new(-OX - 0.5, ROOF - 1, -OZ - 0.5),
		Vector3.new(OX + 0.5, ROOF, OZ + 0.5),
		M.Concrete,
		rgb(170, 170, 172),
		{ name = "OfficeRoof" }
	)
	b:box(Vector3.new(5, 3.2, 5), CFrame.new(0, ROOF + 1.6, 0), M.Metal, rgb(120, 126, 134), { name = "RoofHatch" })
	b:span(Vector3.new(-1, 0, -3), Vector3.new(1, 3, 3), M.Wood, rgb(120, 86, 56), { name = "Desk" })

	MapKit.both(function(s)
		local team = TEAM[s]
		-- Spawn room: partition with three doors, wall to the ceiling
		b:wall(p(s, -56, 0, -Z), p(s, -56, 0, Z), CEILING, 1.2, M.CorrodedMetal, WALL, {
			{ at = 16, width = 8, height = 10 },
			{ at = 46, width = 8, height = 10 },
			{ at = 76, width = 8, height = 10 },
		})
		for _, z in { -30, 0, 30 } do
			local frame = b:box(Vector3.new(1.4, 1.2, 9), cf(s, -56, 10.6, z), M.Metal, team, { name = "DoorFrame" })
			b:sign(frame, Enum.NormalId.Right, TEAM_NAME[s]:upper(), rgb(255, 255, 255))
		end
		local dock =
			b:box(Vector3.new(0.4, 14, 30), cf(s, -71.7, 8, 0), M.Metal, rgb(90, 96, 108), { name = "RollerDoor" })
		b:sign(dock, Enum.NormalId.Right, if s == 1 then "DOCK A" else "DOCK B", team)
		b:crate(cf(s, -69, 2, -40, 0), 4)
		b:crate(cf(s, -69, 2, 40, 0), 4)
		b:crate(cf(s, -69, 6, 40, 15), 4)
		-- Blast walls just inside each door: nobody can look into the spawn room
		for _, z in { -30, 0, 30 } do
			b:span(p(s, -59.5, 0, z - 5.5), p(s, -60.5, 11, z + 5.5), M.Concrete, WALL_DARK, { name = "BlastWall" })
			b:box(Vector3.new(1.2, 0.6, 11), cf(s, -60, 11.3, z), M.Metal, team, { name = "BlastWallCap" })
		end
		for _, z in { -36, -24, -12, 0, 12, 24, 36 } do
			b:spawn(TEAM_NAME[s], p(s, -65, 0.5, z), p(s, 0, 0.5, z))
		end

		-- Pallet racks
		rack(b, cf(s, -38, 0, -22, 0), 18, 1)
		rack(b, cf(s, -32, 0, 14, 0), 13.5, 4)
		rack(b, cf(s, -44, 0, 26, 90), 9, 9)

		-- Container stack in the near corner, blocks the opposite catwalk's sightline
		b:container(cf(s, -38, 4.25, -40, 90), rgb(40, 120, 90), { label = "DPX 2041" })
		b:container(cf(s, -38, 12.75, -40, 90), team:Lerp(rgb(60, 60, 60), 0.3), { label = "DPX 7730" })
		-- Walk-through container mid-flank
		b:container(cf(s, -24, 4.25, 30, 90), rgb(196, 120, 40), { open = true, length = 16, label = "CARGO" })

		-- Low cover around mid
		b:crate(cf(s, -18, 2, -4, 10), 4)
		b:crate(cf(s, -18, 2, -8.5, -5), 4)
		b:crate(cf(s, -18, 6, -6, 30), 4)
		b:crate(cf(s, -24, 1.5, 4, 0), 3)
		b:pallet(cf(s, -14, 0, 18, 0))
		b:crate(cf(s, -14, 2.1, 18, 0), 3.5)
		b:barrel(p(s, -6, 0, -16))
		b:barrel(p(s, -3.5, 0, -17))
		b:barrel(p(s, -26, 0, -32))
		forklift(b, cf(s, -46, 0, -6, 70))
		-- Crate stacks and jersey barriers to break up the open floor
		b:crate(cf(s, -44, 2, -16, 0), 4)
		b:crate(cf(s, -40, 2, -16, 0), 4)
		b:crate(cf(s, -42, 6, -16, 8), 4)
		b:span(p(s, -30.5, 0, -14), p(s, -29.5, 3.2, -6), M.Concrete, rgb(200, 200, 196), { name = "Barrier" })
		b:crate(cf(s, -14, 2, -28, 0), 4)
		b:crate(cf(s, -14, 6, -28, -12), 4)
		b:crate(cf(s, -10, 2, -28, 5), 4)
		b:span(p(s, -8, 0, -32.5), p(s, 0, 3.2, -31.5), M.Concrete, rgb(200, 200, 196), { name = "Barrier" })
		-- Stock stored under this side's catwalk
		b:crate(cf(s, -20, 2, 42, 0), 4)
		b:crate(cf(s, -20, 6, 42, 10), 4)
		b:crate(cf(s, -24, 2, 42, 0), 4)
		b:pallet(cf(s, -36, 0, 42, 0))
		b:crate(cf(s, -36, 2.1, 42, 0), 3.5)
		b:crate(cf(s, -36, 5.6, 42, 20), 3.5)
		b:crate(cf(s, -48, 2, 31, 0), 4)

		-- Office walls on this side: front face (door) and one long side (door + windows)
		b:wall(p(s, -OX, 0, -OZ), p(s, -OX, 0, OZ), ROOF - 1, 1, M.Concrete, OFFICE, {
			{ at = 11, width = 5, height = 8 },
		})
		b:wall(p(s, -OX, 0, -OZ), p(s, OX, 0, -OZ), ROOF - 1, 1, M.Concrete, OFFICE, {
			{ at = 5, width = 5, height = 8 },
			{ at = 16, width = 6, height = 7.5, bottom = 4.5 },
		})
		-- Window band on the long side (glass is shot-through: you can trade through it)
		b:box(Vector3.new(6, 3, 0.3), cf(s, 5, 6, -OZ, 0), M.Glass, rgb(170, 210, 230), {
			transparency = 0.6,
			shotThrough = true,
			name = "Window",
		})
		-- Stairs up to the office roof along the front face
		b:stairs(p(s, -30.6, 0, -4.5), MapKit.dir(s, 1, 0), ROOF, 5, M.Metal, STEEL)
		b:railing(p(s, -OX, ROOF, OZ), p(s, -9.2, ROOF, OZ), 3, YELLOW)
		b:railing(p(s, -3.8, ROOF, OZ), p(s, OX, ROOF, OZ), 3, YELLOW)
		b:railing(p(s, -OX, ROOF, -1.5), p(s, -OX, ROOF, OZ), 3, YELLOW)

		-- Catwalk along this side's wall, joined to the office roof by a bridge
		b:span(p(s, -54, ROOF - 0.6, Z - 8), p(s, -2, ROOF, Z), M.DiamondPlate, STEEL, { name = "Catwalk" })
		b:railing(p(s, -50.8, ROOF, Z - 8), p(s, -9.5, ROOF, Z - 8), 3, YELLOW)
		b:railing(p(s, -2, ROOF, Z - 8), p(s, -2, ROOF, Z), 3, YELLOW)
		b:span(p(s, -9, ROOF - 0.6, OZ + 0.5), p(s, -4, ROOF, Z - 8), M.DiamondPlate, STEEL, { name = "Bridge" })
		b:railing(p(s, -9, ROOF, OZ + 0.5), p(s, -9, ROOF, Z - 8), 3, YELLOW)
		b:railing(p(s, -4, ROOF, OZ + 0.5), p(s, -4, ROOF, Z - 8), 3, YELLOW)
		-- The catwalk ends at a bulkhead so it can't look down the whole hall
		local bulkhead =
			b:span(p(s, -1.4, ROOF, Z - 8), p(s, -2.4, CEILING, Z), M.CorrodedMetal, WALL_DARK, { name = "Bulkhead" })
		b:sign(bulkhead, if s == 1 then Enum.NormalId.Left else Enum.NormalId.Right, "NO ACCESS", YELLOW)
		-- Hanging tarp between the catwalk and the far side (above head height on the floor)
		b:span(
			p(s, -54, 15, -0.2),
			p(s, -14, CEILING - 3, 0.2),
			M.Fabric,
			team:Lerp(rgb(30, 30, 30), 0.35),
			{ name = "Tarp" }

		for _, x in { -50, -36, -22 } do
			b:box(

ServerScriptService.Server.Services.Char:
--!strict
-- Player characters: spawning at a chosen CFrame, health, movement stats, crouch,
-- aim pitch, the third-person shotgun on the body, spawn protection, death ragdoll.
-- Characters are spawned manually (Players.CharacterAutoLoads = false) by MatchService.

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local Collision = require(Shared.Collision)
local Combatants = require(Shared.Combatants)
local GameConfig = require(Shared.Config.GameConfig)
local Net = require(Shared.Net)
local RateLimiter = require(Shared.Util.RateLimiter)
local ShotgunModel = require(Shared.Weapons.ShotgunModel)
local Signal = require(Shared.Util.Signal)

local CharacterService = {}

CharacterService.Spawned = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<Player, Model>
CharacterService.Died = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<Player, Model>

local pendingSpawn: { [Player]: CFrame } = {}
local retiring: { [Model]: boolean } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) :: any
local limiter = RateLimiter.new(GameConfig.Network.GeneralBurst * 3, GameConfig.Network.LookUpdateRate + 4)
local skinProvider: ((Player) -> any)? = nil

local MOUNT_C0 = CFrame.new(0.45, 0.25, -0.55) -- right of the chest, from UpperTorso centre

local function setupHumanoid(humanoid: Humanoid)
	local move = GameConfig.Movement
	humanoid.MaxHealth = GameConfig.Player.MaxHealth
	humanoid.Health = GameConfig.Player.MaxHealth
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = move.WalkSpeed
	humanoid.UseJumpPower = false
	humanoid.JumpHeight = move.JumpHeight
	humanoid.BreakJointsOnDeath = false
	humanoid.RequiresNeck = false
	humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
	humanoid.HealthDisplayType = Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
	humanoid.NameDisplayDistance = 0
	-- Hard crouch/swim/climb states we don't use
	humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming, false)
	humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing, false)
	humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll, false)
	humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, false)
end

-- Newer avatars can use AnimationConstraint physics joints; swap to classic Motor6Ds so
-- poses (crouch, aim) and hit boxes behave the same on every client and the server.
local function useClassicJoints(character: Model)
	for _, d in character:GetDescendants() do
		if d:IsA("AnimationConstraint") then
			local a0, a1 = d.Attachment0, d.Attachment1
			local p0 = a0 and a0.Parent
			local p1 = a1 and a1.Parent
			if a0 and a1 and p0 and p1 and p0:IsA("BasePart") and p1:IsA("BasePart") then
				local motor = Instance.new("Motor6D")
				motor.Name = d.Name
				motor.Part0 = p0
				motor.Part1 = p1
				motor.C0 = a0.CFrame
				motor.C1 = a1.CFrame
				motor.Parent = d.Parent
				d:Destroy()
			end
		elseif d:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") and not d:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Accessory") then
			d:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

local function prepareBody(character: Model)
	for _, d in character:GetDescendants() do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			if d.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then
				d.CollisionGroup = Collision.ROOT
			elseif d:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Accessory") then
				-- Hats and hair don't block pellets and have no hit zone
				d.CanQuery = false
				d.CanTouch = false
			end
		end
	end
end

-- The third-person shotgun (what other players see), on a Motor6D from the chest so
-- each client can tilt it with the aim pitch.
local function mountWorldGun(player: Player, character: Model)
	local upperTorso = character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
	if not upperTorso or not upperTorso:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end
	local gun = ShotgunModel.new("ThirdPerson")
	if skinProvider then
		gun:applySkin(skinProvider(player))
	end
	local rootPart = gun:weldForThirdPerson()
	gun:syncRoot()
	gun.model.Name = "WorldShotgun"
	-- Place the gun so the Grip point is at the mount, muzzle forward
	local gripOffset = gun.root:ToObjectSpace(gun:point("Grip"))
	local rootToPart = gun.root:ToObjectSpace(rootPart.CFrame)
	local motor = Instance.new("Motor6D")
	motor.Name = "GunMount"
	motor.Part0 = upperTorso
	motor.Part1 = rootPart
	motor.C0 = MOUNT_C0
	motor.C1 = rootToPart:Inverse() * gripOffset
	motor.Parent = rootPart
	for _, d in gun.model:GetDescendants() do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			d.CanQuery = false
			d.CanTouch = false
			d.CanCollide = false
			d.Massless = true
		end
	end
	gun.model.Parent = character

	-- Hands on the gun, solved on every client by Roblox's IK
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local function addIK(name: string, chainRoot: string, effector: string, pointName: string)
		local root = character:FindFirstChild(chainRoot)
		local hand = character:FindFirstChild(effector)
		if not (humanoid and root and hand) then
			return
		end
		local target = Instance.new("Attachment")
		target.Name = pointName .. "Target"
		target.WorldCFrame = gun:point(pointName)
		target.Parent = rootPart
		local ik = Instance.new("IKControl")
		ik.Name = name
		ik.Type = Enum.IKControlType.Position
		ik.ChainRoot = root :: Instance
		ik.EndEffector = hand :: Instance
		ik.Target = target
		ik.Weight = 1
		ik.Parent = humanoid
	end
	addIK("RightHandIK", "RightUpperArm", "RightHand", "Grip")
	addIK("LeftHandIK", "LeftUpperArm", "LeftHand", "SupportHand")
end

-- Death presentation: the body goes limp (ball sockets at each joint) and stops blocking shots.
local function ragdoll(character: Model)
	for _, motor in character:GetDescendants() do
		if motor:IsA("Motor6D") and motor.Name ~= "GunMount" and motor.Name ~= "RootJoint" and motor.Name ~= "Root" then
			local p0, p1 = motor.Part0, motor.Part1
			if p0 and p1 then
				local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
				a0.CFrame = motor.C0
				a0.Parent = p0
				local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
				a1.CFrame = motor.C1
				a1.Parent = p1
				local socket = Instance.new("BallSocketConstraint")
				socket.Attachment0 = a0
				socket.Attachment1 = a1
				socket.LimitsEnabled = true
				socket.TwistLimitsEnabled = true
				socket.UpperAngle = 60
				socket.Parent = p1
				motor.Enabled = false
			end
		end
	end
	for _, d in character:GetDescendants() do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			d.CanQuery = false
			if
				d.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart"
				and not d:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Accessory")
				and not d:FindFirstAncestor("WorldShotgun")
			then
				d.CanCollide = true
				d.CollisionGroup = Collision.EFFECTS
			end
		end
	end
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	if root then
		root.CanCollide = false
	end
end

-- Called after LoadCharacterAsync returns: CharacterAdded precedes Roblox's final
-- rig build and spawn placement, which would otherwise overwrite our team spawn.
local function prepareCharacter(player: Player, character: Model)
	local spawnAt = pendingSpawn[player]
	pendingSpawn[player] = nil
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10) :: Humanoid?
	local root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
	if not humanoid or not root or player.Character ~= character or not player.Parent then
		return
	end
	if spawnAt then
		character:PivotTo(spawnAt)
	end
	-- Rebuilding avatar joints can temporarily remove the neck. Disable the
	-- engine's neck-death rule before that work, not after restoring health.
	humanoid.RequiresNeck = false
	useClassicJoints(character)
	setupHumanoid(humanoid)
	retiring[character] = nil
	character:SetAttribute("Dead", false)
	character:SetAttribute("Frozen", false)
	character:SetAttribute("Crouching", false)
	prepareBody(character)
	character.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and d:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Accessory") then
			d.CanQuery = false
			d.CanTouch = false
		end
	end)
	if player.Team then
		character:SetAttribute("Team", player.Team.Name)
	end
	character:SetAttribute("EquippedSlot", 1)
	character:SetAttribute("AimPitch", 0)
	CollectionService:AddTag(character, Combatants.TAG)
	CharacterService.protect(character, GameConfig.Player.SpawnProtection)
	task.defer(mountWorldGun, player, character)

	local handledDeath = false
	humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
		-- An engine initialization death may have been queued before preparation
		-- restored health. It must not mark a living, prepared spawn as dead.
		if humanoid.Health > 0 or handledDeath or retiring[character] or player.Character ~= character then
			return
		end
		handledDeath = true
		character:SetAttribute("Dead", true)
		ragdoll(character)
		CharacterService.Died:Fire(player, character)
	end)
	-- Replicate the intended facing explicitly; CharacterAdded can reach clients
	-- before the engine finishes loading or this final placement is replicated.
	character:SetAttribute("SpawnCFrame", spawnAt or character:GetPivot())
	character:SetAttribute("SpawnRevision", 1)
	CharacterService.Spawned:Fire(player, character)
end

function CharacterService.protect(character: Model, duration: number)
	local untilTime = workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + duration
	character:SetAttribute("ProtectedUntil", untilTime)
end

function CharacterService.isProtected(character: Model): boolean
	local untilTime = character:GetAttribute("ProtectedUntil")
	return typeof(untilTime) == "number" and workspace:GetServerTimeNow() < untilTime
end

function CharacterService.endProtection(character: Model)
	character:SetAttribute("ProtectedUntil", 0)
end

-- Spawns (or respawns) a player's character at `cframe`.
function CharacterService.spawn(player: Player, cframe: CFrame)
	if not player.Parent then
		return
	end
	pendingSpawn[player] = cframe + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
	-- LoadCharacterAsync can kill the old humanoid before replacing it. That is
	-- a transfer, not an elimination/reset requiring a second delayed respawn.
	if player.Character then
		retiring[player.Character] = true
	end
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		player:LoadCharacterAsync()
	end)
	if not ok then
		pendingSpawn[player] = nil
		warn(`[Double Pump] couldn't spawn {player.Name}: {err}`)
	elseif player.Parent and player.Character and pendingSpawn[player] then
		prepareCharacter(player, player.Character)
	end
end

-- Moving a living participant between the range and arena is not a death. Keep
-- the prepared rig and its listeners; loading another avatar here can race the
-- engine's old-character teardown and create delayed, stale death notifications.
function CharacterService.transfer(player: Player, cframe: CFrame)
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	if not character or not humanoid or not root or humanoid.Health <= 0 or character:GetAttribute("Dead") == true then
		CharacterService.spawn(player, cframe)
		return
	end
	local spawnAt = cframe + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
	character:SetAttribute("SpawnCFrame", nil)
	character:SetAttribute("SpawnRevision", ((character:GetAttribute("SpawnRevision") :: number?) or 0) + 1)
	setupHumanoid(humanoid)
	character:SetAttribute("Frozen", false)
	character:SetAttribute("Crouching", false)
	character:SetAttribute("EquippedSlot", 1)
	character:SetAttribute("AimPitch", 0)
	root.Anchored = false
	root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	character:PivotTo(spawnAt)
	CharacterService.protect(character, GameConfig.Player.SpawnProtection)
	character:SetAttribute("SpawnCFrame", spawnAt)
	CharacterService.Spawned:Fire(player, character)
end

function CharacterService.despawn(player: Player)
	pendingSpawn[player] = nil
	local character = player.Character
	if character then
		player.Character = nil
		character:Destroy()
	end
end

function CharacterService.setFrozen(character: Model, frozen: boolean)
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	character:SetAttribute("Frozen", frozen)
	if humanoid then
		local crouching = character:GetAttribute("Crouching") == true
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = if frozen
			then 0
			elseif crouching then GameConfig.Movement.CrouchSpeed
			else GameConfig.Movement.WalkSpeed
		humanoid.JumpHeight = if frozen then 0 else GameConfig.Movement.JumpHeight
	end
end

function CharacterService.setSkinProvider(fn: (Player) -> any)
	skinProvider = fn
end

-- Re-applies the skin to the gun other players see (after equipping a new skin).
function CharacterService.refreshSkin(player: Player)
	local character = player.Character
	local model = character and character:FindFirstChild("WorldShotgun", true)
	if skinProvider and model and model:IsA("Model") then
		ShotgunModel.wrap(model):applySkin(skinProvider(player))
	end
end

local function onPlayerAction(player: Player, action: any, value: any)
	if not limiter:allow(player, os.clock()) then
		return
	end
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not character or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end
	if action == "Crouch" and typeof(value) == "boolean" then
		if character:GetAttribute("Crouching") == value then
			return
		end
		character:SetAttribute("Crouching", value)
		if character:GetAttribute("Frozen") ~= true then
			humanoid.WalkSpeed = if value then GameConfig.Movement.CrouchSpeed else GameConfig.Movement.WalkSpeed
		end
	elseif action == "Look" and typeof(value) == "number" and value == value then
		character:SetAttribute("AimPitch", math.clamp(value, -1.5, 1.5))
	end
end

function CharacterService.start()
	Players.CharacterAutoLoads = false
	Net.event("PlayerAction").OnServerEvent:Connect(onPlayerAction)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		pendingSpawn[player] = nil
		limiter:forget(player)
	end)
end

return CharacterService
ServerScriptService.Server.Services.Comb:
--!strict
-- Server-owned participation, independent of client-supplied attributes/remotes.
-- Attributes only mirror this table for client raycast prediction.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local CombatContext = {}
type Entry = { kind: string, matchId: number }
local entries: { [Player]: Entry } = {}
local activeMatch: number? = nil

function CombatContext.set(player: Player, kind: string, matchId: number?)
	entries[player] = { kind = kind, matchId = matchId or 0 }
	local character = player.Character
	if character then
		character:SetAttribute("CombatContext", kind)
		character:SetAttribute("CombatMatchId", matchId or 0)
	end
end

function CombatContext.refresh(player: Player)
	local entry = entries[player]
	if entry then
		CombatContext.set(player, entry.kind, entry.matchId)
	end
end

function CombatContext.activate(matchId: number?)
	activeMatch = matchId
end

function CombatContext.forget(player: Player)
	entries[player] = nil
end

function CombatContext.resolve(attacker: Player, target: Model): string
	local a = entries[attacker]
	local shooter = attacker.Character
	if not a or not shooter or shooter == target then
		return "Blocked"
	end
	if target:GetAttribute("Dummy") == true then
		return if a.kind == "Lobby" then "Dummy" else "Blocked"
	end
	local victim = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(target)
	local b = victim and entries[victim]
	if not victim or victim.Character ~= target or not b then
		return "Blocked"
	end
	if a.kind == "Lobby" and b.kind == "Lobby" then
		return "Practice"
	end
	if a.kind == "Match" and b.kind == "Match" and a.matchId == activeMatch and b.matchId == activeMatch then
		local at, bt = attacker.Team, victim.Team
		if at and bt and at ~= bt then
			return "Match"
		end
	end
	return "Blocked"
end

return CombatContext

--!strict
-- Server authority for the two shotguns.
--
-- Clients predict their own shots for instant feedback and send what they saw:
-- slot, origin, aim, and which pellet hit which body part where. The server:
--   1. type-checks and rate-limits the request,
--   2. runs the shot through the same WeaponState rules (ownership, equipped slot,
--      swap time, per-gun cooldown, global shot interval, ammo, alive),
--   3. recomputes every pellet direction itself (deterministic pattern),
--   4. checks each claimed hit against the pellet line, the target's lag-compensated
--      position, line of sight through the map, range, team and alive state,
--   5. computes damage itself and applies it through DamageService.
-- A rejected shot gets an authoritative state snapshot back so the client resyncs.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local Collision = require(Shared.Collision)
local Combatants = require(Shared.Combatants)
local Damage = require(Shared.Weapons.Damage)
local GameConfig = require(Shared.Config.GameConfig)
local Net = require(Shared.Net)
local PositionHistory = require(Shared.Weapons.PositionHistory)
local RateLimiter = require(Shared.Util.RateLimiter)
local ShotValidation = require(Shared.Weapons.ShotValidation)
local Signal = require(Shared.Util.Signal)
local Spread = require(Shared.Weapons.Spread)
local WeaponConfig = require(Shared.Config.WeaponConfig)
local WeaponState = require(Shared.Weapons.WeaponState)

local CharacterService = require(script.Parent.CharacterService)
local DamageService = require(script.Parent.DamageService)
local CombatContext = require(script.Parent.CombatContext)

local CombatService = {}

-- (player, slot, pelletsFired, pelletsHit, headshot)
CombatService.ShotFired = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<Player, number, number, number, boolean>

local rules = WeaponState.rulesFromConfig(WeaponConfig)
local timing = WeaponConfig.Timing
local V = WeaponConfig.Validation

local states: { [Player]: WeaponState.State } = {}
local histories: { [Model]: PositionHistory.History } = {}
local airborneSince: { [Player]: number } = {}
local limiter = RateLimiter.new(GameConfig.Network.WeaponActionBurst, GameConfig.Network.WeaponActionRate)

local weaponEvent: RemoteEvent
local canFireCheck: ((Player) -> boolean)? = nil
local worldRootsProvider: (() -> { Instance })? = nil

-- Debug counters (visible in the F3 overlay / tests)
CombatService.stats = { accepted = 0, rejected = 0, hitsAccepted = 0, hitsRejected = 0 }

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function snapshot(state: WeaponState.State, now: number)
	local slots = {}
	for i, slot in state.slots do
		local view = WeaponState.view(state, i, now)
		slots[i] = {
			ammo = view.ammo,
			reloading = slot.reloading,
			cooldown = view.cooldownRemaining,
		}
	end
	return {
		equipped = state.equipped,
		slots = slots,
		shotCounter = state.shotCounter,
		readyIn = math.max(0, state.readyAt - now),
		shotIn = math.max(0, state.nextShotTime - now),
	}
end

local function sendSnapshot(player: Player, reason: string?)
	local state = states[player]
	if state then
		weaponEvent:FireClient(player, "Snapshot", snapshot(state, os.clock()), reason)
	end
end

function CombatService.getState(player: Player): WeaponState.State?
	return states[player]
end

function CombatService.resetPlayer(player: Player)
	local now = os.clock()
	local state = states[player]
	if state then
		WeaponState.reset(state, now)
	else
		states[player] = WeaponState.new(rules, now)
	end
end

-- MatchService decides when shooting is allowed (e.g. not during the countdown).
function CombatService.setCanFire(fn: (Player) -> boolean)
	canFireCheck = fn
end

function CombatService.setWorldRoots(fn: () -> { Instance })
	worldRootsProvider = fn
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Lag compensation

local function recordHistories()
	local t = os.clock()
	for _, model in Combatants.all() do
		local history = histories[model]
		if not history then
			history = PositionHistory.new(V.MaxRewind + 0.5)
			histories[model] = history
			model.Destroying:Once(function()
				histories[model] = nil
			end)
		end
		local parts = {}
		for _, name in Combatants.HitParts do
			local part = model:FindFirstChild(name)
			if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
				parts[name] = part.CFrame
			end
		end
		history:record(t, parts)
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Shot validation

type ClaimedHit = { i: number, part: BasePart, pos: Vector3 }

local function parseHits(raw: any): { ClaimedHit }?
	if typeof(raw) ~= "table" or #raw > V.MaxHitsPerShot then
		return nil
	end
	local out = {}
	local seen = {}
	for _, hit in raw do
		if typeof(hit) ~= "table" then
			return nil
		end
		local i, part, pos = hit.i, hit.part, hit.pos
		if typeof(i) ~= "number" or i ~= math.floor(i) or i < 1 or i > WeaponConfig.Damage.PelletCount or seen[i] then
			return nil
		end
		if typeof(part) ~= "Instance" or not part:IsA("BasePart") then
			continue -- part may have been destroyed in transit; ignore that pellet
		end
		if not ShotValidation.isFiniteVector(pos, 1e5) then
			return nil
		end
		seen[i] = true
		table.insert(out, { i = i, part = part, pos = pos })
	end
	return out
end

local function isAirborne(humanoid: Humanoid): boolean
	return humanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air
end

local function checkClaimedHit(
	shooter: Model,
	origin: Vector3,
	direction: Vector3,
	hit: ClaimedHit,
	ping: number,
	worldParams: RaycastParams
): (Model?, Damage.Zone?, number?)
	local target, humanoid = Combatants.fromPart(hit.part)
	if not target or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or target:GetAttribute("Dead") == true then
		return nil
	end
	local shooterPlayer = Combatants.player(shooter)
	if not shooterPlayer or CombatContext.resolve(shooterPlayer, target) == "Blocked" then
		return nil
	end
	local zone: Damage.Zone? = Damage.zoneForPart(hit.part.Name)
	if not zone or hit.part.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then
		return nil
	end

	local rayTol = V.RayTolerance
	local boxTol = ShotValidation.scaled(V.HitboxTolerance, V.HitboxTolerancePerSecondPing, V.HitboxToleranceCap, ping)
	local maxRange = WeaponConfig.Damage.MaxRange

	-- Test the claim against where the target was over the plausible latency window.
	local history = histories[target]
	local now = os.clock()
	local window = math.min(ping * 2 + 0.12, V.MaxRewind)
	local ok, along = false, 0
	local samples = 5
	for s = 0, samples do
		local t = now - window * s / samples
		local cf = if history then history:sample(hit.part.Name, t) else nil
		local partCFrame = cf or hit.part.CFrame
		local good, _, distance = ShotValidation.checkHit({
			origin = origin,
			direction = direction,
			hitPosition = hit.pos,
			partCFrame = partCFrame,
			partSize = hit.part.Size,
			maxRange = maxRange,
			rayTolerance = rayTol,
			hitboxTolerance = boxTol,
		})
		if good then
			ok, along = true, distance
			break
		end
	end
	if not ok then
		return nil
	end

	-- Nothing solid between the muzzle line and the hit point.
	local toHit = hit.pos - origin
	local length = toHit.Magnitude
	if length > 0.6 then
		local blocked = workspace:Raycast(origin, toHit.Unit * (length - 0.5), worldParams)
		if blocked then
			return nil
		end
	end
	return target, zone, along
end

local function onFire(player: Player, payload: any)
	local state = states[player]
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local head = character and character:FindFirstChild("Head") :: BasePart?
	if not state or not character or not humanoid or not head or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end
	if typeof(payload) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	local slot, origin, aim = payload.slot, payload.origin, payload.aim
	if typeof(slot) ~= "number" or not state.slots[slot] then
		return
	end
	if
		not ShotValidation.isFiniteVector(origin, 1e5)
		or not ShotValidation.isFiniteVector(aim, 2)
		or aim.Magnitude < 0.5
	then
		sendSnapshot(player, "BadPayload")
		return
	end
	aim = aim.Unit
	local hits = parseHits(payload.hits)
	if not hits then
		CombatService.stats.rejected += 1
		sendSnapshot(player, "BadPayload")
		return
	end
	if canFireCheck and not canFireCheck(player) then
		sendSnapshot(player, "NotAllowed")
		return
	end

	local now = os.clock()
	local ok, reason, shotNumber = WeaponState.fire(state, slot, now, timing.ServerTolerance)
	if not ok then
		CombatService.stats.rejected += 1
		sendSnapshot(player, reason)
		return
	end
	CombatService.stats.accepted += 1

	-- Firing ends spawn protection.
	CharacterService.endProtection(character)

	-- Origin must be near the server's view of the shooter's head (allowing for ping).
	local ping = math.clamp(player:GetNetworkPing(), 0, 1)
	local maxOffset =
		ShotValidation.scaled(V.MaxOriginOffset, V.MaxOriginOffsetPerSecondPing, V.MaxOriginOffsetCap, ping)
	local originValid = (origin - head.Position).Magnitude <= maxOffset

	-- Spread multiplier: crouch comes from the server's attribute. Airborne is believed
	-- unless the server saw the player on the ground for a while (airborne is wider, so
	-- claiming it is never an advantage; claiming "grounded" is checked).
	local crouching = character:GetAttribute("Crouching") == true
	local claimedAirborne = payload.air == true
	local serverAirborne = isAirborne(humanoid)
	local airborne = claimedAirborne
	if not claimedAirborne and serverAirborne then
		local since = airborneSince[player]
		if since and now - since > 0.35 + ping then
			airborne = true
		end
	end
	local multiplier = Spread.stateMultiplier(WeaponConfig.Spread, crouching, airborne)
	local directions = Spread.directions(WeaponConfig.Spread, aim, shotNumber, multiplier)

	-- Tell everyone else to show the shot.
	for _, other in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if other ~= player then
			weaponEvent:FireClient(other, "Shot", character, {
				origin = origin,
				aim = aim,
				shot = shotNumber,
				mult = multiplier,
				slot = slot,
			})
		end
	end

	if not originValid then
		CombatService.stats.hitsRejected += #hits
		CombatService.ShotFired:Fire(player, slot, #directions, 0, false)
		sendSnapshot(player, "Origin")
		return
	end

	local roots = if worldRootsProvider then worldRootsProvider() else { workspace }
	local worldParams = Collision.worldParams(roots)
	local perTarget: { [Model]: { { zone: Damage.Zone, distance: number } } } = {}
	local hitCount = 0
	for _, hit in hits do
		local target, zone, distance = checkClaimedHit(character, origin, directions[hit.i], hit, ping, worldParams)
		if target and zone and distance then
			local list = perTarget[target]
			if not list then
				list = {}
				perTarget[target] = list
			end
			table.insert(list, { zone = zone :: Damage.Zone, distance = distance })
			hitCount += 1
			CombatService.stats.hitsAccepted += 1
		else
			CombatService.stats.hitsRejected += 1
		end
	end

	local results = {}
	local anyHead = false
	for target, list in perTarget do
		local amount, headshot = Damage.total(WeaponConfig.Damage, list)
		local nearest = math.huge
		for _, h in list do
			nearest = math.min(nearest, h.distance)
		end
		local dealt, killed, doublePump = DamageService.apply(player, target, amount, {
			slot = slot,
			headshot = headshot,
			distance = nearest,
			origin = origin,
			pellets = #list,
		})
		anyHead = anyHead or headshot
		local targetHead = target:FindFirstChild("Head") :: BasePart?
		table.insert(results, {
			position = if targetHead then targetHead.Position else origin + aim * nearest,
			damage = math.round(dealt),
			pellets = #list,
			headshot = headshot,
			killed = killed,
			dummy = Combatants.isDummy(target), -- presentation metadata only
			doublePump = doublePump,
			protected = dealt == 0 and not killed,
		})
	end
	if #results > 0 then
		weaponEvent:FireClient(player, "Hit", results)
	end
	CombatService.ShotFired:Fire(player, slot, #directions, hitCount, anyHead)
end

local function onWeaponAction(player: Player, action: any, arg: any)
	if not limiter:allow(player, os.clock()) then
		return
	end
	local state = states[player]
	local character = player.Character
	if not state or not character then
		return
	end
	if action == "Fire" then
		onFire(player, arg)
	elseif action == "Equip" then
		if typeof(arg) ~= "number" or not state.slots[arg] then
			return
		end
		if WeaponState.equip(state, arg, os.clock()) then
			character:SetAttribute("EquippedSlot", arg)
		end
	elseif action == "Reload" then
		if WeaponState.startReload(state, os.clock()) then
			character:SetAttribute("ReloadingAt", workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
		end
	elseif action == "CancelReload" then
		WeaponState.cancelReload(state, os.clock())
	elseif action == "Sync" then
		sendSnapshot(player, nil)
	end
end

function CombatService.start()
	weaponEvent = Net.event("WeaponEvent")
	Net.event("WeaponAction").OnServerEvent:Connect(onWeaponAction)

	CharacterService.Spawned:Connect(function(player)
		CombatService.resetPlayer(player)
		weaponEvent:FireClient(player, "Reset")
	end)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		states[player] = nil
		airborneSince[player] = nil
		limiter:forget(player)
	end)

	local accumulator = 0
	local interval = 1 / V.HistoryRate
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		accumulator += dt
		if accumulator >= interval then
			accumulator = 0
			recordHistories()
		end
		-- Track how long each player has been airborne (for spread checks)
		local now = os.clock()
		for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
			local character = player.Character
			local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if humanoid and isAirborne(humanoid) then
				if not airborneSince[player] then
					airborneSince[player] = now
				end
			else
				airborneSince[player] = nil
			end
		end
	end)
end

return CombatService
ServerScriptService.Server.Services.Cosm:
--!strict
-- The Locker: buying skins with coins and equipping them. Cosmetic only: a skin changes
-- the shotgun's colours and nothing else.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local Net = require(Shared.Net)
local RateLimiter = require(Shared.Util.RateLimiter)
local Cosmetics = require(Shared.Progression.Cosmetics)

local Services = script.Parent
local DataService = require(Services.DataService)
local ProgressionService = require(Services.ProgressionService)
local CharacterService = require(Services.CharacterService)

local CosmeticService = {}

local limiter = RateLimiter.new(6, 2)
local notify: RemoteEvent

-- Set by MonetizationService (prompts a Robux coin pack).
CosmeticService.promptPack = nil :: ((Player, string) -> ())?

function CosmeticService.skinFor(player: Player): Cosmetics.Skin
	local data = DataService.get(player)
	return Cosmetics.skin(data and data.equipped.skin)
end

local function buy(player: Player, id: any)
	if not Cosmetics.exists(id) then
		return
	end
	local skin = Cosmetics.skin(id)
	local price = Cosmetics.price(skin)
	local data = DataService.get(player)
	if not data or not price then
		return
	end
	if data.owned[skin.id] then
		return
	end
	if data.coins < price then
		notify:FireClient(player, `Not enough coins for {skin.name}`, "error")
		return
	end
	DataService.update(player, function(d)
		d.coins -= price
		d.owned[skin.id] = true
		d.equipped.skin = skin.id
	end)
	notify:FireClient(player, `Bought {skin.name}`, "good")
	ProgressionService.push(player)
	CharacterService.refreshSkin(player)
end

local function equip(player: Player, category: any, id: any)
	if category ~= "skin" or not Cosmetics.exists(id) then
		return
	end
	local data = DataService.get(player)
	if not data or not data.owned[id] then
		return
	end
	DataService.update(player, function(d)
		d.equipped.skin = id
	end)
	ProgressionService.push(player)
	CharacterService.refreshSkin(player)
end

function CosmeticService.start()
	notify = Net.event("Notify")
	CharacterService.setSkinProvider(CosmeticService.skinFor)
	Net.event("ShopAction").OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, action: any, a: any, b: any)
		if not limiter:allow(player, os.clock()) then
			return
		end
		if action == "Buy" then
			buy(player, a)
		elseif action == "Equip" then
			equip(player, a, b)
		elseif action == "BuyRobux" then
			if typeof(a) == "string" and CosmeticService.promptPack then
				CosmeticService.promptPack(player, a)
			end
		end
	end)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		limiter:forget(player)
	end)
end

return CosmeticService
ServerScriptService.Server.Services.Dama:
--!strict
-- The only place health goes down. Tracks who damaged whom (assists), detects
-- double-pump eliminations, and announces eliminations. Server authoritative: clients
-- never report damage or kills, they only get told about them.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local Combatants = require(Shared.Combatants)
local GameConfig = require(Shared.Config.GameConfig)
local Net = require(Shared.Net)
local Signal = require(Shared.Util.Signal)
local WeaponConfig = require(Shared.Config.WeaponConfig)
local CharacterService = require(script.Parent.CharacterService)
local CombatContext = require(script.Parent.CombatContext)

local DamageService = {}

export type HitInfo = {
	slot: number,
	headshot: boolean,
	distance: number,
	origin: Vector3,
	pellets: number,
}

export type Elimination = {
	victim: Model,
	victimPlayer: Player?,
	killer: Player?,
	assists: { Player },
	headshot: boolean,
	doublePump: boolean,
	distance: number,
}

DamageService.Eliminated = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<Elimination>
DamageService.Damaged = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<Player?, Model, number, HitInfo>

type LogEntry = { attacker: Player, amount: number, time: number }
local damageLog: { [Model]: { LogEntry } } = {}
-- attacker -> target -> last hit (for double pump detection)
local lastHits: { [Player]: { [Model]: { slot: number, time: number } } } = {}

local combatEvent: RemoteEvent

local function teamOf(model: Model?): string?
	return model and Combatants.team(model)
end

local function nameOf(model: Model): string
	local player = Combatants.player(model)
	if player then
