		return player.DisplayName
	end
	return model.Name
end

-- Returns: damage actually dealt, killed?, doublePump?
function DamageService.apply(
	attacker: Player?,
	target: Model,
	amount: number,
	info: HitInfo
): (number, boolean, boolean)
	local humanoid = target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or target:GetAttribute("Dead") == true then
		return 0, false, false
	end
	if attacker then
		local context = CombatContext.resolve(attacker, target)
		if context == "Blocked" then
			return 0, false, false
		elseif context == "Practice" then
			-- The caller already aggregated the authoritative pellet damage. Report
			-- its full hypothetical value, without health changes, logs or signals.
			return amount, false, false
		end
	end
	if CharacterService.isProtected(target) then
		return 0, false, false
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	local dealt = math.min(amount, humanoid.Health)
	humanoid.Health -= dealt
	local killed = humanoid.Health <= 0

	local doublePump = false
	if attacker then
		local log = damageLog[target]
		if not log then
			log = {}
			damageLog[target] = log
		end
		table.insert(log, { attacker = attacker, amount = dealt, time = now })

		local byTarget = lastHits[attacker]
		if not byTarget then
			byTarget = {}
			lastHits[attacker] = byTarget
		end
		local previous = byTarget[target]
		if
			killed
			and previous
			and previous.slot ~= info.slot
			and now - previous.time <= WeaponConfig.DoublePumpWindow
		then
			doublePump = true
		end
		byTarget[target] = { slot = info.slot, time = now }
	end

	DamageService.Damaged:Fire(attacker, target, dealt, info)
	local victimPlayer = Combatants.player(target)
	if victimPlayer then
		combatEvent:FireClient(victimPlayer, "Damaged", {
			amount = dealt,
			from = info.origin,
			health = humanoid.Health,
		})
	end

	if killed then
		local assists = {}
		local seen: { [Player]: number } = {}
		local entries: { LogEntry } = damageLog[target] or {}
		for _, entry in entries do
			if entry.attacker ~= attacker and now - entry.time <= GameConfig.Player.AssistWindow then
				seen[entry.attacker] = (seen[entry.attacker] or 0) + entry.amount
			end
		end
		for player, total in seen do
			if total >= GameConfig.Player.AssistMinDamage and player.Parent then
				table.insert(assists, player)
			end
		end
		damageLog[target] = nil
		target:SetAttribute("Dead", true)

		local elimination: Elimination = {
			victim = target,
			victimPlayer = victimPlayer,
			killer = attacker,
			assists = assists,
			headshot = info.headshot,
			doublePump = doublePump,
			distance = info.distance,
		}
		local attackerCharacter = attacker and attacker.Character
		combatEvent:FireAllClients("Elimination", {
			killer = if attacker then attacker.DisplayName else "",
			killerUserId = if attacker then attacker.UserId else 0,
			killerTeam = teamOf(attackerCharacter),
			victim = nameOf(target),
			victimUserId = if victimPlayer then victimPlayer.UserId else 0,
			victimTeam = teamOf(target),
			headshot = info.headshot,
			doublePump = doublePump,
			dummy = Combatants.isDummy(target),
		})
		DamageService.Eliminated:Fire(elimination)
	end
	return dealt, killed, doublePump
end

-- Kills without an attacker (fell out of the map, reset).
function DamageService.kill(target: Model)
	local humanoid = target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
		CharacterService.endProtection(target)
		DamageService.apply(nil, target, humanoid.Health, {
			slot = 0,
			headshot = false,
			distance = 0,
			origin = Vector3.zero,
			pellets = 0,
		})
	end
end

function DamageService.forget(model: Model)
	damageLog[model] = nil
	for _, byTarget in lastHits do
		byTarget[model] = nil
	end
end

function DamageService.start()
	combatEvent = Net.event("CombatEvent")
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		lastHits[player] = nil
		for _, log in damageLog do
			for i = #log, 1, -1 do
				if log[i].attacker == player then
					table.remove(log, i)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	CharacterService.Died:Connect(function(_, character)
		task.delay(1, DamageService.forget, character)
	end)
end

return DamageService
ServerScriptService.Server.Services.Data:
--!strict
-- Loads, autosaves and releases each player's profile (see Data/ProfileStore for the
-- session locking). If DataStores aren't reachable (an unpublished place, or Studio
-- without "Enable Studio Access to API Services"), profiles live in memory for the
-- session and players are told their progress won't save.

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local Net = require(Shared.Net)
local Signal = require(Shared.Util.Signal)
local Profile = require(Shared.Progression.Profile)
local ProfileStore = require(script.Parent.Parent.Data.ProfileStore)

local DataService = {}

local STORE_NAME = "DoublePump_Profiles_v1"
local AUTOSAVE_INTERVAL = 90

DataService.Loaded = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<Player, Profile.Data>
DataService.available = false
DataService.reason = "" :: string

local profiles: { [Player]: Profile.Data } = {}
local dirty: { [Player]: boolean } = {}
local lost: { [Player]: boolean } = {}
local store: ProfileStore.ProfileStoreT? = nil

local function keyFor(player: Player): string
	return "u_" .. player.UserId
end

local function probe(): (boolean, string)
	if game.PlaceId == 0 then
		return false, "this place isn't published yet"
	end
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		DataStoreService:GetDataStore(STORE_NAME):GetAsync("__probe")
	end)
	if not ok then
		return false, tostring(err)
	end
	return true, ""
end

function DataService.get(player: Player): Profile.Data?
	return profiles[player]
end

function DataService.isReady(player: Player): boolean
	return profiles[player] ~= nil
end

-- Changes a profile through a function and marks it for the next autosave.
function DataService.update(player: Player, fn: (Profile.Data) -> ())
	local data = profiles[player]
	if data then
		fn(data)
		dirty[player] = true
	end
end

-- Saves right away (used after purchases). Returns true when the save landed.
function DataService.saveNow(player: Player, release: boolean?): boolean
	local data = profiles[player]
	if not data then
		return false
	end
	if not store or not DataService.available then
		return not release -- in-memory sessions can't persist
	end
	if lost[player] then
		return false
	end
	local ok, reason = (store :: ProfileStore.ProfileStoreT):save(keyFor(player), data, release == true)
	if ok then
		dirty[player] = false
	elseif reason == "lost" then
		lost[player] = true
		warn(`[DataService] {player.Name}'s profile is open on another server; this server stopped saving it`)
	else
		warn(`[DataService] save failed for {player.Name}: {reason}`)
	end
	return ok
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player: Player)
	local data: Profile.Data? = nil
	if store and DataService.available then
		local loaded, err = (store :: ProfileStore.ProfileStoreT):load(keyFor(player))
		if not loaded then
			warn(`[DataService] couldn't load {player.Name}: {err}`)
			if player.Parent then
				player:Kick("Your profile couldn't be loaded (Roblox data service busy). Please rejoin in a minute.")
			end
			return
		end
		data = loaded
	else
		data = Profile.new(os.time())
	end
	if not player.Parent then
		-- Left while loading: release the lock we just took
		if store and DataService.available and data then
			(store :: ProfileStore.ProfileStoreT):save(keyFor(player), data, true)
		end
		return
	end
	profiles[player] = data :: Profile.Data
	DataService.Loaded:Fire(player, data :: Profile.Data)
	if not DataService.available then
		Net.event("Notify"):FireClient(player, "Progress won't save in this session: " .. DataService.reason, "warn")
	end
end

local function onPlayerRemoving(player: Player)
	if profiles[player] then
		DataService.saveNow(player, true)
	end
	profiles[player] = nil
	dirty[player] = nil
	lost[player] = nil
end

function DataService.start()
	local ok, reason = probe()
	DataService.available = ok
	DataService.reason = reason
	if ok then
		store = ProfileStore.new(DataStoreService:GetDataStore(STORE_NAME) :: any, {
			jobId = if game.JobId ~= "" then game.JobId else "studio-" .. HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),
			clock = os.time,
			sleep = function(seconds: number)
				task.wait(seconds)
			end,
		})
	else
		warn(`[DataService] DataStores unavailable ({reason}); profiles are kept in memory only`)
	end

	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(onPlayerRemoving)
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		task.spawn(onPlayerAdded, player)
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(AUTOSAVE_INTERVAL)
			for player in profiles do
				-- Saving also refreshes the session lock, so save even when nothing changed
				task.spawn(DataService.saveNow, player, false)
			end
		end
	end)

	game:BindToClose(function()
		if not DataService.available or RunService:IsStudio() and next(profiles) == nil then
			return
		end
		local pending = 0
		for player in profiles do
			pending += 1
			task.spawn(function()
				DataService.saveNow(player, true)
				pending -= 1
			end)
		end
		local started = os.clock()
		while pending > 0 and os.clock() - started < 25 do
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
	end)
end

return DataService
ServerScriptService.Server.Services.Lead:
--!strict
-- Global leaderboards on OrderedDataStores: eliminations, wins, double pumps, level XP.
-- Scores are written after each match (throttled) and the top 10 of each board is
-- cached and refreshed every two minutes, so menus never wait on DataStores.

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserService = game:GetService("UserService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local Net = require(Shared.Net)
local Profile = require(Shared.Progression.Profile)

local Services = script.Parent
local DataService = require(Services.DataService)
local ProgressionService = require(Services.ProgressionService)

local LeaderboardService = {}

local BOARDS = {
	{
		key = "Kills",
		title = "ELIMINATIONS",
		value = function(d: Profile.Data)
			return d.stats.kills
		end,
	},
	{
		key = "Wins",
		title = "WINS",
		value = function(d: Profile.Data)
			return d.stats.wins
		end,
	},
	{
		key = "DoublePumps",
		title = "DOUBLE PUMPS",
		value = function(d: Profile.Data)
			return d.stats.doublePumps
		end,
	},
	{
		key = "Xp",
		title = "XP",
		value = function(d: Profile.Data)
			return d.xp
		end,
	},
}
local VERSION = "v1"
local REFRESH = 120
local WRITE_COOLDOWN = 60

local stores: { [string]: OrderedDataStore } = {}
local cache: any = nil
local lastWrite: { [Player]: number } = {}
local names: { [number]: string } = {}

local function resolveNames(ids: { number })
	local missing = {}
	for _, id in ids do
		if not names[id] then
			table.insert(missing, id)
		end
	end
	if #missing == 0 then
		return
	end
	local ok, infos = pcall(function()
		return UserService:GetUserInfosByUserIdsAsync(missing)
	end)
	if ok and infos then
		for _, info in infos do
			names[info.Id] = info.DisplayName
		end
	end
	for _, id in missing do
		if not names[id] then
			local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(id)
			names[id] = if player then player.DisplayName else "Player " .. id
		end
	end
end

local function refresh()
	local boards = {}
	for _, board in BOARDS do
		local store = stores[board.key]
		local entries = {}
		local ok, pages = pcall(function()
			return store:GetSortedAsync(false, 10)
		end)
		if ok and pages then
			local ids = {}
			for rank, item in pages:GetCurrentPage() do
				local id = tonumber(string.match(item.key, "%d+"))
				if id then
					table.insert(entries, { rank = rank, userId = id, value = item.value })
					table.insert(ids, id)
				end
			end
			resolveNames(ids)
			for _, entry in entries do
				entry.name = names[entry.userId]
			end
		end
		table.insert(boards, { key = board.key, title = board.title, entries = entries })
	end
	cache = { boards = boards }
end

function LeaderboardService.submit(player: Player, data: Profile.Data, force: boolean?)
	if not DataService.available then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if not force and lastWrite[player] and now - lastWrite[player] < WRITE_COOLDOWN then
		return
	end
	lastWrite[player] = now
	for _, board in BOARDS do
		local value = math.floor(board.value(data))
		if value > 0 then
			task.spawn(function()
				pcall(function()
					stores[board.key]:SetAsync("u_" .. player.UserId, value)
				end)
			end)
		end
	end
end

function LeaderboardService.start()
	Net.func("GetLeaderboards").OnServerInvoke = function()
		if not DataService.available then
			return {
				unavailable = true,
				note = "Leaderboards need a published place with DataStores enabled (" .. DataService.reason .. ").",
			}
		end
		return cache or { boards = {} }
	end
	if not DataService.available then
		return
	end
	for _, board in BOARDS do
		stores[board.key] = DataStoreService:GetOrderedDataStore("DoublePump_LB_" .. board.key .. "_" .. VERSION)
	end
	ProgressionService.ProfileChanged:Connect(function(player, data)
		LeaderboardService.submit(player, data)
	end)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		local data = DataService.get(player)
		if data then
			LeaderboardService.submit(player, data, true)
		end
		lastWrite[player] = nil
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			refresh()
			task.wait(REFRESH)
		end
	end)
end

return LeaderboardService
ServerScriptService.Server.Services.MapS:
--!strict
-- Loads arenas and the practice range, applies each map's lighting, and answers
-- "where are the spawns". Only one arena exists at a time (workspace.Arena); loading a
-- new one destroys the old one first, inside one call, so maps can't overlap.

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local Collision = require(Shared.Collision)

local Maps = script.Parent.Parent.Maps

local MapService = {}

export type MapModule = {
	id: string,
	displayName: string,
	description: string?,
	build: () -> Model,
	lighting: { [string]: any },
	ambience: string?,
	origin: Vector3?,
	killY: number?, -- players below this height are eliminated (fell off)
	extents: any?,
}

MapService.Registry = {} :: { [string]: MapModule }
MapService.ArenaIds = {} :: { string }
MapService.currentId = nil :: string?

local arena: Model? = nil
local range: Model? = nil

local function register(module: ModuleScript, isArena: boolean)
	local map = require(module) :: any
	MapService.Registry[map.id] = map
	if isArena then
		table.insert(MapService.ArenaIds, map.id)
	end
end

local function prepare(model: Model)
	for _, d in model:GetDescendants() do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			if d:GetAttribute("ShotThrough") then
				d.CollisionGroup = Collision.SHOT_THROUGH
			end
			if d:GetAttribute("Barrier") then
				CollectionService:AddTag(d, "Barrier")
			end
		end
	end
end

local function applyLighting(map: MapModule)
	local L: any = map.lighting or {}
	Lighting.ClockTime = L.ClockTime or 14
	Lighting.Brightness = L.Brightness or 2
	Lighting.Ambient = L.Ambient or Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 70)
	Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = L.OutdoorAmbient or Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)
	Lighting.ColorShift_Top = L.ColorShift_Top or Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	Lighting.ColorShift_Bottom = L.ColorShift_Bottom or Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	Lighting.FogEnd = L.FogEnd or 100000
	Lighting.FogColor = L.FogColor or Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 200)
	Lighting.ExposureCompensation = L.ExposureCompensation or 0
	Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = L.EnvironmentDiffuseScale or 0.6
	Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = L.EnvironmentSpecularScale or 0.6
	Lighting.GlobalShadows = true

	local function ensure<T>(className: string, name: string): T
		local existing = Lighting:FindFirstChild(name)
		if existing then
			return existing :: any
		end
		local inst = Instance.new(className :: any)
		inst.Name = name
		inst.Parent = Lighting
		return inst :: any
	end
	local atmosphere = ensure("Atmosphere", "MapAtmosphere") :: Atmosphere
	local A = L.Atmosphere or {}
	atmosphere.Density = A.Density or 0.25
	atmosphere.Offset = A.Offset or 0.1
	atmosphere.Color = A.Color or Color3.fromRGB(199, 199, 199)
	atmosphere.Decay = A.Decay or Color3.fromRGB(106, 112, 125)
	atmosphere.Glare = A.Glare or 0
	atmosphere.Haze = A.Haze or 0

	local cc = ensure("ColorCorrectionEffect", "MapGrade") :: ColorCorrectionEffect
	local G = L.Grade or {}
	cc.Brightness = G.Brightness or 0
	cc.Contrast = G.Contrast or 0.08
	cc.Saturation = G.Saturation or 0.1
	cc.TintColor = G.Tint or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

	local bloom = ensure("BloomEffect", "MapBloom") :: BloomEffect
	bloom.Intensity = 0.35
	bloom.Size = 20
	bloom.Threshold = 1.6

	local sunRays = ensure("SunRaysEffect", "MapSunRays") :: SunRaysEffect
	sunRays.Intensity = L.SunRays or 0.02
	sunRays.Spread = 0.6
end

function MapService.loadRange(): Model
	if range then
		return range
	end
	local map = MapService.Registry.Range
	local model = map.build()
	model.Name = "Range"
	prepare(model)
	model.Parent = workspace
	range = model
	return model
end

-- Builds an arena (destroying the previous one first) and applies its lighting.
function MapService.load(mapId: string): Model
	local map = MapService.Registry[mapId]
	assert(map, "Unknown map " .. tostring(mapId))
	if arena then
		arena:Destroy()
		arena = nil
	end
	local model = map.build()
	model.Name = "Arena"
	model:SetAttribute("MapId", mapId)
	model:SetAttribute("DisplayName", map.displayName)
	model:SetAttribute("Ambience", map.ambience or "")
	model:SetAttribute("KillY", map.killY or -40)
	prepare(model)
	model.Parent = workspace
	arena = model
	MapService.currentId = mapId
	applyLighting(map)
	return model
end

function MapService.useRangeLighting()
	applyLighting(MapService.Registry.Range)
end

local function markersIn(model: Model?, name: string, team: string?): { BasePart }
	local list = {}
	local markers = model and model:FindFirstChild("Markers")
	if not markers then
		return list
	end
	for _, m in markers:GetChildren() do
		if m.Name == name and m:IsA("BasePart") and (team == nil or m:GetAttribute("Team") == team) then
			table.insert(list, m)
		end
	end
	return list
end

function MapService.spawns(team: string): { BasePart }
	return markersIn(arena, "Spawn", team)
end

function MapService.rangeSpawns(): { BasePart }
	return markersIn(range, "Spawn", "Range")
end

function MapService.rangeDummyMarkers(): { BasePart }
	return markersIn(range, "Dummy", nil)
end

function MapService.cameraPoint(): CFrame?
	local list = markersIn(arena, "Camera", nil)
	return if list[1] then list[1].CFrame else nil
end

-- Geometry the server uses for line-of-sight checks.
function MapService.worldRoots(): { Instance }
	local roots: { Instance } = {}
	if arena then
		table.insert(roots, (arena :: Model):FindFirstChild("Geometry") or arena)
		local props = (arena :: Model):FindFirstChild("Props")
		if props then
			table.insert(roots, props)
		end
	end
	if range then
		table.insert(roots, (range :: Model):FindFirstChild("Geometry") or range)
		local props = (range :: Model):FindFirstChild("Props")
		if props then
			table.insert(roots, props)
		end
	end
	return roots
end

-- Height below which a character counts as fallen out of the world.
function MapService.killY(): number
	local value = arena and arena:GetAttribute("KillY")
	return if typeof(value) == "number" then value else -40
end

function MapService.arena(): Model?
	return arena
end

function MapService.start()
	register(Maps.Range, false)
	for _, name in { "Warehouse", "DustTown", "Rooftops" } do
		local module = Maps:FindFirstChild(name)
		if module then
			register(module :: ModuleScript, true)
		end
	end
	MapService.loadRange()
	MapService.useRangeLighting()
end

return MapService
ServerScriptService.Server.Services.Matc:
--!strict
-- Runs the game: who is playing, practice vs match, the team-deathmatch state machine
-- (MatchRules), spawning/respawning, scoring, map voting and map loading.
--
-- Player modes:
--   "Menu"     in the main menu, no character
--   "Match"    selected by the physical queue: reserved/voting, or in the arena
--   "Practice" permanent default lobby; only queue occupancy can request a match
--
-- Match state is replicated through attributes on ReplicatedStorage.MatchState so late
-- joiners see it immediately; one-off moments (countdown, results, voting) go through
-- the MatchEvent remote.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local Combatants = require(Shared.Combatants)
local GameConfig = require(Shared.Config.GameConfig)
local MatchRules = require(Shared.Match.MatchRules)
local LobbyQueue = require(Shared.Match.LobbyQueue)
local LobbyCues = require(Shared.Audio.LobbyCues)
local ActionCues = require(Shared.Audio.ActionCues)
local audioClock = ActionCues.newClock()
local Net = require(Shared.Net)
local RateLimiter = require(Shared.Util.RateLimiter)
local Signal = require(Shared.Util.Signal)
local SpawnScoring = require(Shared.Match.SpawnScoring)
local VoteTally = require(Shared.Match.VoteTally)

local CharacterService = require(script.Parent.CharacterService)
local CombatContext = require(script.Parent.CombatContext)
local QueueZone = require(script.Parent.Parent.Maps.QueueZone)
local CombatService = require(script.Parent.CombatService)
local DamageService = require(script.Parent.DamageService)
local MapService = require(script.Parent.MapService)
local TeamService = require(script.Parent.TeamService)

local MatchService = {}

export type Mode = "Menu" | "Match" | "Practice"

export type PlayerStats = {
	kills: number,
	deaths: number,
	assists: number,
	headshots: number,
	doublePumps: number,
	damage: number,
	shots: number,
	pelletsFired: number,
	pelletsHit: number,
	score: number,
	joinedAt: number,
}

export type MatchResult = {
	winner: string?,
	reason: string,
	scores: { [string]: number },
	mapId: string?,
	mvp: Player?,
	participants: { [Player]: { team: string?, stats: PlayerStats, timePlayed: number } },
}

MatchService.MatchStarted = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<string>
MatchService.MatchEnded = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<MatchResult>
-- (killer, victimPlayer?, elimination) counted eliminations (not dummies, not suicides)
MatchService.Scored = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<Player, Player?, any>

local M = GameConfig.Match
local match = MatchRules.new(M)
local modes: { [Player]: Mode } = {}
local stats: { [Player]: PlayerStats } = {}
local votes: { [Player]: string } = {}
local voteOptions: { string } = {}
local respawnThreads: { [Player]: thread } = {}
local spawnUse: { [BasePart]: number } = {}
local nextMapId: string? = nil
local rng = Random.new()
local stateFolder: Folder
local matchEvent: RemoteEvent
local voteLimiter = RateLimiter.new(6, 2)
local queue = LobbyQueue.new(GameConfig.LobbyQueue)
local lobbyReady: { [Player]: boolean } = {}
local lastNotification: { [Player]: number } = {}
local queueState = "Waiting"
local cueStates: { [Player]: LobbyCues.State } = {}
local cueSerials: { [Player]: number } = {}
local returningCharacters: { [Player]: Model } = {}
local function lobbyCue(player: Player, cue: string)
	if not player.Parent then
		return
	end
	local serial = (cueSerials[player] or 0) + 1
	cueSerials[player] = serial
	matchEvent:FireClient(player, "LobbyAudio", { cue = cue, serial = serial })
end
local drawQueue: (string, number, number, number, number) -> ()

local function sendParticipants(kind: string, data: any)
	for player, mode in modes do
		if mode == "Match" and player.Parent then
			matchEvent:FireClient(player, kind, data)
		end
	end
end

local function newStats(): PlayerStats
	return {
		kills = 0,
		deaths = 0,
		assists = 0,
		headshots = 0,
		doublePumps = 0,
		damage = 0,
		shots = 0,
		pelletsFired = 0,
		pelletsHit = 0,
		score = 0,
		joinedAt = os.clock(),
	}
end

local function statsOf(player: Player): PlayerStats
	local s = stats[player]
	if not s then
		s = newStats()
		stats[player] = s
	end
	return s
end

-- Scoreboard columns replicate as player attributes.
local function publishStats(player: Player)
	local s = statsOf(player)
	player:SetAttribute("Kills", s.kills)
	player:SetAttribute("Deaths", s.deaths)
	player:SetAttribute("Assists", s.assists)
	player:SetAttribute("Score", s.score)
	player:SetAttribute("DoublePumps", s.doublePumps)
end

local function inCombat(): boolean
	return MatchRules.inCombat(match)
end

local function matchPlayers(): { Player }
	local list = {}
	for _, p in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if modes[p] == "Match" then
			table.insert(list, p)
		end
	end
	return list
end

local function publishState()
	stateFolder:SetAttribute("State", match.state)
	stateFolder:SetAttribute("EndsAt", workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + match.timeLeft)
	stateFolder:SetAttribute("RedScore", match.scores.Red)
	stateFolder:SetAttribute("BlueScore", match.scores.Blue)
	stateFolder:SetAttribute("Target", match.target)
	stateFolder:SetAttribute("MapId", MapService.currentId or "")
	local map = MapService.currentId and MapService.Registry[MapService.currentId]
	stateFolder:SetAttribute("MapName", if map then map.displayName else "")
	stateFolder:SetAttribute("Winner", match.winner or "")
	stateFolder:SetAttribute("MatchNumber", match.matchNumber)
	stateFolder:SetAttribute("Players", #matchPlayers())
	stateFolder:SetAttribute("MinPlayers", M.MinPlayersToStart)
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Spawning

local function enemyPositions(team: string?): { Vector3 }
	local list = {}
	for _, p in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local character = p.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
		if
			modes[p] == "Match"
			and root
			and character
			and Combatants.isAlive(character)
			and TeamService.teamOf(p) ~= team
		then
			table.insert(list, root.Position)
		end
	end
	return list
end

local function lineOfSight(from: Vector3, to: Vector3): boolean
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = MapService.worldRoots()
	local eyeFrom = from + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0)
	local eyeTo = to + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
	return workspace:Raycast(eyeFrom, eyeTo - eyeFrom, params) == nil
end

local function pickSpawn(player: Player): CFrame?
	local team = TeamService.teamOf(player)
	local arenaPhase = match.state == "Starting"
		or match.state == "Active"
		or match.state == "Overtime"
		or match.state == "Results"
	local markers: { BasePart } = if modes[player] == "Match"
			and team
			and arenaPhase
			and MapService.arena()
		then MapService.spawns(team)
		else MapService.rangeSpawns()
	if #markers == 0 then
		markers = MapService.rangeSpawns()
	end
	if #markers == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	local candidates = {}
	for i, m in markers do
		candidates[i] = { position = m.Position, lastUsed = spawnUse[m] or -math.huge }
	end
	local enemies = if team then enemyPositions(team) else {}
	local index = SpawnScoring.best(candidates, enemies, now, GameConfig.Player.SpawnEnemyRadius, lineOfSight) or 1
	-- Small shuffle among equally good spawns before the first enemy appears
	if #enemies == 0 then
		index = rng:NextInteger(1, #markers)
	end
	local marker = markers[index]
	spawnUse[marker] = now
	return marker.CFrame
end

local function spawnPlayer(player: Player, transfer: boolean?)
	if not player.Parent or modes[player] == "Menu" or modes[player] == nil then
		return
	end
	local cf = pickSpawn(player)
	if cf then
		if transfer then
			CharacterService.transfer(player, cf)
		else
			CharacterService.spawn(player, cf)
		end
	end
end

local function cancelRespawn(player: Player)
	local thread = respawnThreads[player]
	if thread then
		respawnThreads[player] = nil
		pcall(task.cancel, thread)
	end
end

local function scheduleRespawn(player: Player, delay: number)
	cancelRespawn(player)
	respawnThreads[player] = task.delay(delay, function()
		respawnThreads[player] = nil
		if modes[player] == "Match" and inCombat() then
			TeamService.rebalance(player)
		end
		spawnPlayer(player)
	end)
end

local function freezeAll(frozen: boolean)
	for _, p in matchPlayers() do
		local character = p.Character
		if character and TeamService.teamOf(p) then
			CharacterService.setFrozen(character, frozen)
		end
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Transitions

local function chooseFirstMap(): string
	local ids = MapService.ArenaIds
	return ids[rng:NextInteger(1, #ids)]
end

-- Starting: load the map (if not already) and put everyone on a team at a spawn.
local function onEnterStarting()
	local mapId = nextMapId or MapService.currentId or chooseFirstMap()
	nextMapId = nil
	if MapService.currentId ~= mapId or not MapService.arena() then
		MapService.load(mapId)
	end
	local players = matchPlayers()
	TeamService.reshuffle(players)
	for _, p in players do
		stats[p] = newStats()
		publishStats(p)
		cancelRespawn(p)
		CombatContext.set(p, "Reserved")
		task.spawn(spawnPlayer, p, true)
	end
	sendParticipants(
		"Starting",
		{ mapId = mapId, mapName = MapService.Registry[mapId].displayName, countdown = M.StartingCountdown }
	)
end

local function participantsSnapshot()
	local participants = {}
	for _, p in matchPlayers() do
		local s = statsOf(p)
		participants[p] = { team = TeamService.teamOf(p), stats = table.clone(s), timePlayed = os.clock() - s.joinedAt }
	end
	return participants
end

local function pickMvp(): Player?
	local best, bestScore = nil, -math.huge
	for _, p in matchPlayers() do
		local s = statsOf(p)
		local value = s.score * 1000 + s.kills * 10 - s.deaths
		if value > bestScore then
			best, bestScore = p, value
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function onMatchEnded(winner: string?, reason: string)
	freezeAll(true)
	local mvp = pickMvp()
	local participants = participantsSnapshot()
	local board = {}
	for p, info in participants do
		table.insert(board, {
			userId = p.UserId,
			name = p.DisplayName,
			team = info.team,
			kills = info.stats.kills,
			deaths = info.stats.deaths,
			assists = info.stats.assists,
			headshots = info.stats.headshots,
			doublePumps = info.stats.doublePumps,
			damage = math.round(info.stats.damage),
			accuracy = if info.stats.pelletsFired > 0 then info.stats.pelletsHit / info.stats.pelletsFired else 0,
			score = info.stats.score,
		})
	end
	local result: MatchResult = {
		winner = winner,
		reason = reason,
		scores = table.clone(match.scores),
		mapId = MapService.currentId,
		mvp = mvp,
		participants = participants,
	}
	sendParticipants("Ended", {
		winner = winner,
		reason = reason,
		scores = result.scores,
		mvp = if mvp then { userId = mvp.UserId, name = mvp.DisplayName, team = TeamService.teamOf(mvp) } else nil,
		board = board,
		mapName = stateFolder:GetAttribute("MapName"),
	})
	MatchService.MatchEnded:Fire(result)
end

local function onEnterVoting()
	table.clear(votes)
	voteOptions = VoteTally.options(MapService.ArenaIds, 3, MapService.currentId, rng)
	local options = {}
	for _, id in voteOptions do
		local map = MapService.Registry[id]
		table.insert(options, { id = id, name = map.displayName, description = map.description or "" })
	end
	stateFolder:SetAttribute("VoteOptions", table.concat(voteOptions, ","))
	sendParticipants("Voting", { options = options, duration = M.VotingTime })
end

local function broadcastVotes()
	local counts = VoteTally.counts(votes, voteOptions)
	sendParticipants("VoteCounts", counts)
end

local function onVotingEnded()
	if #voteOptions > 0 then
		nextMapId = VoteTally.winner(votes, voteOptions, MapService.currentId, rng)
		sendParticipants(
			"VoteResult",
			{ mapId = nextMapId, name = MapService.Registry[nextMapId :: string].displayName }
		)
	end
	table.clear(votes)
end

local function onWaiting()
	for _, p in matchPlayers() do
		-- Living transfers get a return cue; replacement characters use the existing Spawn cue.
		returningCharacters[p] = p.Character
		cancelRespawn(p)
		lobbyReady[p] = false
		if p.Character then
			DamageService.forget(p.Character)
		end
		modes[p] = "Practice"
		TeamService.clear(p)
		CombatContext.set(p, "Lobby")
		p:SetAttribute("Mode", "Practice")
		p:SetAttribute("Queued", false)
		stats[p] = newStats()
		publishStats(p)
		-- Character loading yields: never block the single match/queue clock.
		task.spawn(spawnPlayer, p, true)
	end
	MapService.useRangeLighting()
end

local function handle(events: { MatchRules.Event })
	for _, e in events do
		if e.kind == "State" then
			local to = (e :: any).to
			CombatContext.activate(if to == "Active" or to == "Overtime" then match.matchNumber else nil)
			if to == "Starting" then
				onEnterStarting()
				freezeAll(true)
			elseif to == "Active" then
				freezeAll(false)
			elseif to == "Voting" then
				onEnterVoting()
			elseif to == "Waiting" and (e :: any).from ~= "Waiting" then
				onWaiting()
			end
			sendParticipants("State", to)
		elseif e.kind == "MatchStarted" then
			sendParticipants("Started", { target = match.target })
			MatchService.MatchStarted:Fire(MapService.currentId or "")
		elseif e.kind == "MatchEnded" then
			onMatchEnded((e :: any).winner, (e :: any).reason)
		elseif e.kind == "VotingEnded" then
			onVotingEnded()
		elseif e.kind == "Countdown" then
			sendParticipants("Countdown", (e :: any).seconds)
		end
	end
	publishState()
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Players

function MatchService.setMode(player: Player, mode: Mode)
	if mode == "Match" then
		return -- queue admission is the only way to reserve a match slot
	end
	cancelRespawn(player)
	lobbyReady[player] = false
	if player.Character then
		DamageService.forget(player.Character)
	end
	modes[player] = "Practice"
	TeamService.clear(player)
	CombatContext.set(player, "Lobby")
	player:SetAttribute("Mode", "Practice")
	player:SetAttribute("Queued", false)
	task.spawn(spawnPlayer, player, true)
	publishState()
end

function MatchService.modeOf(player: Player): Mode
	return modes[player] or "Menu"
end

function MatchService.inCombat(): boolean
	return inCombat()
end

function MatchService.state(): string
	return match.state
end

local function onPlayerAction(player: Player, action: any, value: any)
	if action == "Deploy" then
		-- Legacy menu button explains the physical queue; it cannot admit anyone.
		Net.event("Notify"):FireClient(player, "Enter the Match Queue Zone in the firing range.")
	elseif action == "Practice" or action == "Menu" then
		if modes[player] == "Match" then
			MatchService.setMode(player, "Practice")
		end
	elseif action == "Vote" then
		if
			modes[player] ~= "Match"
			or match.state ~= "Voting"
			or typeof(value) ~= "string"
			or not table.find(voteOptions, value)
		then
			return
		end
		if not voteLimiter:allow(player, os.clock()) then
			return
		end
		votes[player] = value
		broadcastVotes()
	end
end

local function onEliminated(elimination: DamageService.Elimination)
	local victimPlayer = elimination.victimPlayer
	local killer = elimination.killer
	if victimPlayer and modes[victimPlayer] == "Match" and inCombat() then
		local s = statsOf(victimPlayer)
		s.deaths += 1
		publishStats(victimPlayer)
	end
	if not killer or Combatants.isDummy(elimination.victim) then
		return
	end
	local killerTeam = TeamService.teamOf(killer)
	if
		not killerTeam
		or modes[killer] ~= "Match"
		or not victimPlayer
		or modes[victimPlayer] ~= "Match"
		or not inCombat()
	then
		return
	end
	local s = statsOf(killer)
	s.kills += 1
	s.score += 100 + (if elimination.headshot then 25 else 0) + (if elimination.doublePump then 50 else 0)
	if elimination.headshot then
		s.headshots += 1
	end
	if elimination.doublePump then
		s.doublePumps += 1
	end
	publishStats(killer)
	for _, assister in elimination.assists do
		if modes[assister] ~= "Match" then
			continue
		end
		local a = statsOf(assister)
		a.assists += 1
		a.score += 50
		publishStats(assister)
		lobbyCue(assister, "Assist")
	end
	MatchService.Scored:Fire(killer, victimPlayer, elimination)
	handle(MatchRules.addScore(match, killerTeam))
end

function MatchService.start()
	stateFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	stateFolder.Name = "MatchState"
	stateFolder.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	matchEvent = Net.event("MatchEvent")
	publishState()

	Net.event("PlayerAction").OnServerEvent:Connect(onPlayerAction)
	DamageService.Eliminated:Connect(onEliminated)
	DamageService.Damaged:Connect(function(attacker, _, dealt)
		if attacker and modes[attacker] == "Match" and inCombat() and stats[attacker] then
			stats[attacker].damage += dealt
		end
	end)
	CombatService.ShotFired:Connect(function(player, _, pellets, hits)
		local s = stats[player]
		if s and modes[player] == "Match" and inCombat() then
			s.shots += 1
			s.pelletsFired += pellets
			s.pelletsHit += hits
		end
	end)
	CombatService.setCanFire(function(player)
		local character = player.Character
		if not character or character:GetAttribute("Frozen") == true then
			return false
		end
		return modes[player] == "Practice" or (modes[player] == "Match" and inCombat())
	end)
	CombatService.setWorldRoots(MapService.worldRoots)

	CharacterService.Died:Connect(function(player, character)
		local delay = GameConfig.Player.RespawnDelay
		matchEvent:FireClient(player, "Respawning", { delay = delay })
		scheduleRespawn(player, delay)
		task.delay(delay + 2, function()
			if character.Parent and player.Character ~= character then
				character:Destroy()
			end
		end)
	end)

	local function onPlayerAdded(player: Player)
		publishStats(player)
		MatchService.setMode(player, "Practice")
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		task.spawn(onPlayerAdded, player)
	end
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		cancelRespawn(player)
		modes[player] = nil
		lobbyReady[player] = nil
		lastNotification[player] = nil
		cueStates[player] = nil
		cueSerials[player] = nil
		returningCharacters[player] = nil
		CombatContext.forget(player)
		stats[player] = nil
		votes[player] = nil
		voteLimiter:forget(player)
		-- Defer so the player is really gone from GetPlayers when counting
		task.defer(publishState)
	end)

	local range = workspace:FindFirstChild("Range") :: Model
	local rangeOrigin = MapService.Registry.Range.origin or Vector3.new(-1200, 0, 0)
	local zoneCFrame = CFrame.new(rangeOrigin + GameConfig.LobbyQueue.Offset)
	drawQueue = QueueZone.build(range, zoneCFrame, GameConfig.LobbyQueue.Size)
	local function stepQueue(): boolean
		local occupants = {}
		local candidates = Players:GetPlayers()
		table.sort(candidates, function(a, b)
			return a.UserId < b.UserId
		end)
		for _, p in candidates do
			local character = p.Character
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
			if
				modes[p] == "Practice"
				and lobbyReady[p]
				and character
				and root
				and Combatants.isAlive(character)
				and LobbyQueue.contains(zoneCFrame, GameConfig.LobbyQueue.Size, root.Position)
			then
				table.insert(occupants, p)
			end
		end
		local previous = queueState
		local selected, state =
			LobbyQueue.step(queue, occupants, workspace:GetServerTimeNow(), match.state == "Waiting")
		queueState = state
		for _, p in candidates do
			local queued = table.find(queue.order, p) ~= nil
			local audioState = cueStates[p] or LobbyCues.new()
			cueStates[p] = audioState
			local cue = LobbyCues.step(
				audioState,
				queued,
				state,
				if queue.deadline then math.max(0, math.ceil(queue.deadline - workspace:GetServerTimeNow())) else 0,
				workspace:GetServerTimeNow(),
				table.find(selected, p) ~= nil
			)
			if cue then
				lobbyCue(p, cue)
			end
			if p:GetAttribute("Queued") ~= queued then
				p:SetAttribute("Queued", queued)
				local now = os.clock()
				if not table.find(selected, p) and now - (lastNotification[p] or -math.huge) >= 1 then
					Net.event("Notify"):FireClient(p, if queued then "Joined Match Queue" else "Left Match Queue")
					lastNotification[p] = now
				end
			end
			if queued and previous ~= state and (state == "Countdown" or state == "Waiting") then
				Net.event("Notify"):FireClient(
					p,
					if state == "Countdown"
						then `Match starting in {GameConfig.LobbyQueue.Countdown} seconds`
						else "Waiting for more players"
				)
			end
		end
		stateFolder:SetAttribute("QueueState", state)
		stateFolder:SetAttribute("QueueCount", #queue.order)
		stateFolder:SetAttribute("QueueEndsAt", queue.deadline or 0)
		drawQueue(
			state,
			#queue.order,
			GameConfig.LobbyQueue.Capacity,
			GameConfig.LobbyQueue.Minimum,
			if queue.deadline then math.max(0, math.ceil(queue.deadline - workspace:GetServerTimeNow())) else 0
		)
		if #selected == 0 then
			return false
		end
		-- This entire selection/admission path is non-yielding. Only roots validated
		-- in this exact sample are admitted; spawn loads happen asynchronously later.
		for _, p in selected do
			modes[p] = "Match"
			lobbyReady[p] = false
			CombatContext.set(p, "Reserved")
			lobbyCue(p, "Admitted")
			p:SetAttribute("Mode", "Match")
			p:SetAttribute("Queued", false)
			cancelRespawn(p)
		end
		TeamService.reshuffle(selected)
		freezeAll(true)
		return true
	end

	-- One loop drives the whole match: no competing timers.
	local accumulator = 0
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		accumulator += dt
		if accumulator < GameConfig.LobbyQueue.PollInterval then
			return
		end
		local step = accumulator
		accumulator = 0
		local admitted = stepQueue()
		local events =
			MatchRules.step(match, step, { players = #matchPlayers(), voluntary = true, admitted = admitted })
		if #events > 0 then
			handle(events)
		end
		local cue = ActionCues.clock(audioClock, match.matchNumber, match.state, match.timeLeft)
		if cue then
			for _, p in matchPlayers() do
				lobbyCue(p, cue)
			end
		end
	end)
	-- Falling off the map (Rooftops' drops, or out of the world) eliminates you
	local fallCheck = 0
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		fallCheck += dt
		if fallCheck < 0.25 then
			return
		end
		fallCheck = 0
		for _, p in Players:GetPlayers() do
			local character = p.Character
			local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
			local killY = if modes[p] == "Match" then MapService.killY() else -40
			if character and root and root.Position.Y < killY and Combatants.isAlive(character) then
				DamageService.kill(character)
			end
		end
	end)
	-- Anyone who (re)spawns into the arena outside live play stays frozen until it starts
	CharacterService.Spawned:Connect(function(player, character)
		if modes[player] == "Match" and (match.state == "Starting" or inCombat() or match.state == "Results") then
			CombatContext.set(player, "Match", match.matchNumber + (if match.state == "Starting" then 1 else 0))
		else
			CombatContext.refresh(player)
		end
		lobbyReady[player] = modes[player] == "Practice"
		local returned = returningCharacters[player]
		returningCharacters[player] = nil
		if returned == character and lobbyReady[player] then
			lobbyCue(player, "ReturnToRange")
		end
		if TeamService.teamOf(player) and not inCombat() then
			CharacterService.setFrozen(character, true)
		end
	end)
end

MatchService._match = match

return MatchService
ServerScriptService.Server.Services.Mone:
--!strict
-- Robux coin packs (cosmetic currency only). OFF by default: nothing is sold until the
-- owner fills in real Developer Product IDs and sets Products.Enabled (see
-- docs/PUBLISHING.md).
--
-- Receipts are processed idempotently: each PurchaseId is recorded in the buyer's
-- profile in the same save that grants the coins, and PurchaseGranted is only returned
-- once that save has landed. A repeated receipt is acknowledged without granting again.

local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local Net = require(Shared.Net)
local Products = require(Shared.Config.Products)

local Receipts = require(script.Parent.Parent.Data.Receipts)
local Services = script.Parent
local DataService = require(Services.DataService)
local ProgressionService = require(Services.ProgressionService)
local CosmeticService = require(Services.CosmeticService)

local MonetizationService = {}

local notify: RemoteEvent

function MonetizationService.prompt(player: Player, key: string)
	local pack = Products.byKey(key)
	if not pack or not Products.available(pack) then
		notify:FireClient(player, "Coin packs aren't on sale yet.", "info")
		return
	end
	MarketplaceService:PromptProductPurchase(player, pack.productId :: number)
end

function MonetizationService.start()
	notify = Net.event("Notify")
	CosmeticService.promptPack = MonetizationService.prompt
	if not Products.Enabled then
		return -- no ProcessReceipt handler: nothing can be bought
	end
	MarketplaceService.ProcessReceipt = function(receipt: any)
		return Receipts.process(receipt, {
			getPlayer = function(userId)
				return Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
			end,
			getProfile = DataService.get,
			save = function(player)
				return DataService.saveNow(player, false)
			end,
			onGranted = function(player, coins)
				notify:FireClient(player, `+{coins} coins. Thanks for supporting Double Pump!`, "reward")
				ProgressionService.push(player)
			end,
		})
	end
end

return MonetizationService
ServerScriptService.Server.Services.Prac:
--!strict
-- Training dummies in the practice range: R15-proportioned targets with real hit zones
-- (Head, UpperTorso, arms, legs) that take damage through the normal combat pipeline,
-- some standing still, some strafing or jumping. They respawn shortly after being
-- eliminated. Dummies never shoot back.

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local Combatants = require(Shared.Combatants)
local GameConfig = require(Shared.Config.GameConfig)
local MapService = require(script.Parent.MapService)

local PracticeService = {}

type Dummy = {
	model: Model,
	marker: BasePart,
	kind: string,
	width: number,
	phase: number,
	base: CFrame,
}

local dummies: { Dummy } = {}
local folder: Folder

-- name, size, offset from the root (root centre is 3 studs above the floor)
local BODY: { { any } } = {
	{ "Head", Vector3.new(1.2, 1.2, 1.2), Vector3.new(0, 1.75, 0) },
	{ "UpperTorso", Vector3.new(2, 1.6, 1), Vector3.new(0, 0.4, 0) },
	{ "LowerTorso", Vector3.new(2, 0.4, 1), Vector3.new(0, -0.6, 0) },
	{ "LeftUpperArm", Vector3.new(1, 1.2, 1), Vector3.new(-1.5, 0.6, 0) },
	{ "LeftLowerArm", Vector3.new(1, 1.1, 1), Vector3.new(-1.5, -0.55, 0) },
	{ "LeftHand", Vector3.new(1, 0.3, 1), Vector3.new(-1.5, -1.25, 0) },
	{ "RightUpperArm", Vector3.new(1, 1.2, 1), Vector3.new(1.5, 0.6, 0) },
	{ "RightLowerArm", Vector3.new(1, 1.1, 1), Vector3.new(1.5, -0.55, 0) },
	{ "RightHand", Vector3.new(1, 0.3, 1), Vector3.new(1.5, -1.25, 0) },
	{ "LeftUpperLeg", Vector3.new(1, 1.2, 1), Vector3.new(-0.5, -1.4, 0) },
	{ "LeftLowerLeg", Vector3.new(1, 1.2, 1), Vector3.new(-0.5, -2.4, 0) },
	{ "LeftFoot", Vector3.new(1, 0.3, 1), Vector3.new(-0.5, -2.85, 0) },
	{ "RightUpperLeg", Vector3.new(1, 1.2, 1), Vector3.new(0.5, -1.4, 0) },
	{ "RightLowerLeg", Vector3.new(1, 1.2, 1), Vector3.new(0.5, -2.4, 0) },
	{ "RightFoot", Vector3.new(1, 0.3, 1), Vector3.new(0.5, -2.85, 0) },
}

local SKIN = Color3.fromRGB(235, 140, 40)
local DARK = Color3.fromRGB(45, 48, 56)

local function buildDummy(at: CFrame, drill: boolean): Model
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = if drill then "Drill Bot" else "Training Bot"
	local root = Instance.new("Part")
	root.Name = "HumanoidRootPart"
	root.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 1)
	root.Transparency = 1
	root.Anchored = true
	root.CanCollide = false
	root.CanQuery = false
	root.CFrame = at * CFrame.new(0, 3, 0)
	root.Parent = model
	model.PrimaryPart = root
	for _, spec in BODY do
		local name, size, offset = spec[1], spec[2], spec[3]
		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		part.Name = name
		part.Size = size
		part.Anchored = true
		part.CanCollide = true
		part.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.new(offset)
		part.Material = if name == "Head" or name:find("Torso")
			then Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			else Enum.Material.Metal
		part.Color = if name == "Head" or name:find("Torso") then SKIN else DARK
		part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		part.Parent = model
		if name == "UpperTorso" then
			-- Target rings on the chest
			local gui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
			gui.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
			gui.PixelsPerStud = 60
			gui.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.PixelsPerStud
			gui.Parent = part
			for i, scale in { 0.9, 0.6, 0.3 } do
				local ring = Instance.new("Frame")
				ring.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
				ring.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
				ring.Size = UDim2.fromScale(scale * 0.8, scale)
				ring.BackgroundColor3 = if i % 2 == 1 then Color3.new(1, 1, 1) else Color3.fromRGB(220, 40, 40)
				ring.Parent = gui
				local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
				corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
				corner.Parent = ring
			end
		elseif name == "Head" then
			local visor = Instance.new("Part")
			visor.Name = "Visor"
			visor.Size = Vector3.new(1, 0.3, 0.1)
			visor.Anchored = true
			visor.CanCollide = false
			visor.CanQuery = false
			visor.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
			visor.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 255)
			visor.CFrame = part.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.15, -0.62)
			visor.Parent = model
		end
	end
	local humanoid = Instance.new("Humanoid")
	humanoid.MaxHealth = GameConfig.Player.MaxHealth
	humanoid.Health = GameConfig.Player.MaxHealth
	humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
	humanoid.HealthDisplayType = Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
	humanoid.RequiresNeck = false
	humanoid.Parent = model
	model:SetAttribute("Dummy", true)
	CollectionService:AddTag(model, Combatants.TAG)
	return model
end

local function respawn(dummy: Dummy)
	local old = dummy.model
	local drill = dummy.marker:GetAttribute("Drill") == true
	dummy.model = buildDummy(dummy.base, drill)
	dummy.model.Parent = folder
	if old then
		old:Destroy()
	end
	local humanoid = dummy.model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") :: Humanoid
	humanoid.Died:Once(function()
		local model = dummy.model
		-- Topple over, then come back
		for _, p in model:GetChildren() do
			if p:IsA("BasePart") then
				p.CanQuery = false
				p.Transparency = math.max(p.Transparency, 0.5)
			end
		end
		task.delay(GameConfig.Practice.TargetRespawn, function()
			if dummy.model == model then
				respawn(dummy)
			end
		end)
	end)
end

function PracticeService.start()
	folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "Dummies"
	folder.Parent = workspace
	for _, marker in MapService.rangeDummyMarkers() do
		local dummy: Dummy = {
			model = nil :: any,
			marker = marker,
			kind = (marker:GetAttribute("Kind") :: string?) or "Static",
			width = (marker:GetAttribute("Width") :: number?) or 12,
			phase = math.random() * math.pi * 2,
			base = marker.CFrame,
		}
		respawn(dummy)
		table.insert(dummies, dummy)
	end

	-- Moving targets (server-side, anchored, replicated at network rate)
	local t = 0
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		t += dt
		for _, dummy in dummies do
			if dummy.kind == "Static" or not dummy.model or dummy.model:GetAttribute("Dead") then
				continue
			end
			local offset = CFrame.identity
			if dummy.kind == "Strafe" then
				local speed = GameConfig.Practice.MovingTargetSpeed
				local period = dummy.width * 2 / speed
				-- Triangle wave: constant speed with sharp direction changes, like a strafing player
				local u = ((t + dummy.phase) % period) / period
				local x = (if u < 0.5 then u * 2 else 2 - u * 2) - 0.5
				offset = CFrame.new(x * dummy.width, 0, 0)
			elseif dummy.kind == "Jump" then
				local cycle = (t + dummy.phase) % 1.6
				local h = if cycle < 0.7 then math.sin(cycle / 0.7 * math.pi) * 6 else 0
				offset = CFrame.new(0, h, 0)
			end
			dummy.model:PivotTo(dummy.base * offset * CFrame.new(0, 3, 0))
		end
	end)
end

return PracticeService
ServerScriptService.Server.Services.Prog:
--!strict
-- XP, levels, coins, career stats, shotgun mastery and daily/weekly challenges.
-- Rewards are granted once per finished match from the server's own match stats; the
-- client never reports anything that counts toward progression.
--
-- Anti-idle: each second a player in a live match counts as active if they moved,
-- turned or fired. Completion and win rewards scale with that active time (Levels).

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local Net = require(Shared.Net)
local Signal = require(Shared.Util.Signal)
local RateLimiter = require(Shared.Util.RateLimiter)
local Levels = require(Shared.Progression.Levels)
local Challenges = require(Shared.Progression.Challenges)
local Cosmetics = require(Shared.Progression.Cosmetics)
local Profile = require(Shared.Progression.Profile)
local Products = require(Shared.Config.Products)

local Services = script.Parent
local DataService = require(Services.DataService)
local MatchService = require(Services.MatchService)
local CombatService = require(Services.CombatService)
local TeamService = require(Services.TeamService)

local ProgressionService = {}

-- Fired after rewards are applied (LeaderboardService listens).
ProgressionService.ProfileChanged = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<Player, Profile.Data>

local profileEvent: RemoteEvent
local settingsLimiter = RateLimiter.new(4, 0.5)

-- Activity tracking for the anti-idle rule
type Activity = { lastPos: Vector3?, lastPitch: number?, lastShot: number, active: number }
local activity: { [Player]: Activity } = {}
local matchStartedAt = os.clock()

local function challengeView(kind: "daily" | "weekly", set: Challenges.Set?, now: number): any
	local current = Challenges.current(kind, set, now)
	local entries = {}
	for _, entry in current.entries do
		local def = Challenges.find(entry.id)
		if def then
			table.insert(entries, {
				id = entry.id,
				text = def.text,
				progress = entry.progress,
				goal = def.goal,
				done = entry.done,
				xp = def.xp,
				coins = def.coins,
			})
		end
	end
	return { entries = entries, secondsLeft = Challenges.secondsLeft(kind, now) }
end

-- What the client sees of its own profile.
function ProgressionService.snapshot(data: Profile.Data): any
	local now = os.time()
	local info = Levels.fromXp(data.xp)
	local packs = {}
	for _, pack in Products.CoinPacks do
		table.insert(
			packs,
			{ key = pack.key, name = pack.name, coins = pack.coins, available = Products.available(pack) }
		)
	end
	return {
		xp = data.xp,
		level = info.level,
		coins = data.coins,
		stats = data.stats,
		masteryKills = data.masteryKills,
		owned = data.owned,
		equipped = data.equipped,
		daily = challengeView("daily", data.daily, now),
		weekly = challengeView("weekly", data.weekly, now),
		settings = data.settings,
		tutorialDone = data.tutorialDone,
		packs = packs,
	}
end

function ProgressionService.push(player: Player)
	local data = DataService.get(player)
	if data then
		profileEvent:FireClient(player, "Profile", ProgressionService.snapshot(data))
	end
end

-- Grants every level/mastery skin the player now qualifies for. Returns new unlocks.
local function grantEarned(data: Profile.Data): { Cosmetics.Skin }
	local unlocked = {}
	local level = Levels.fromXp(data.xp).level
	local tier = Levels.mastery(data.masteryKills).tier
	for _, skin in Cosmetics.Skins do
		if not data.owned[skin.id] and Cosmetics.earned(skin, level, tier) then
			data.owned[skin.id] = true
			table.insert(unlocked, skin)
		end
	end
	return unlocked
end

local function rollChallenges(data: Profile.Data)
	local now = os.time()
	data.daily = Challenges.current("daily", data.daily, now)
	data.weekly = Challenges.current("weekly", data.weekly, now)
end

local function onMatchEnded(result: any)
	local length = math.max(1, os.clock() - matchStartedAt)
	for player, info in result.participants do
		local data = DataService.get(player)
		if not data or not player.Parent then
			continue
		end
		local s = info.stats
		local won = result.winner ~= nil and info.team == result.winner
		local act = activity[player]
		local summary: Levels.MatchSummary = {
			kills = s.kills,
			assists = s.assists,
			headshotKills = s.headshots,
			doublePumps = s.doublePumps,
			won = won,
			timePlayed = math.min(info.timePlayed, length),
			matchLength = length,
			activeTime = if act then act.active else 0,
		}
		local reward = Levels.matchReward(summary)
		local levelBefore = Levels.fromXp(data.xp).level
		local masteryBefore = Levels.mastery(data.masteryKills).tier
		local completedChallenges = {}

		DataService.update(player, function(d)
			local st = d.stats
			st.kills += s.kills
			st.deaths += s.deaths
			st.assists += s.assists
			st.headshots += s.headshots
			st.doublePumps += s.doublePumps
			st.damage += math.round(s.damage)
			st.pelletsFired += s.pelletsFired
			st.pelletsHit += s.pelletsHit
			st.timePlayed += summary.timePlayed
			if not reward.idle then
				st.matches += 1
				if won then
					st.wins += 1
				elseif result.winner ~= nil then
					st.losses += 1
				end
			end
			d.masteryKills += s.kills
			d.xp += reward.xp
			d.coins += reward.coins

			rollChallenges(d)
			local delta = {
				kills = s.kills,
				headshots = s.headshots,
				doublePumps = s.doublePumps,
				assists = s.assists,
				damage = math.round(s.damage),
				wins = if won and not reward.idle then 1 else 0,
				matches = if reward.idle then 0 else 1,
			}
			for _, set in { d.daily :: Challenges.Set, d.weekly :: Challenges.Set } do
				for _, def in Challenges.progress(set, delta) do
					d.xp += def.xp
					d.coins += def.coins
					table.insert(completedChallenges, { text = def.text, xp = def.xp, coins = def.coins })
				end
			end
		end)

		local unlocked = grantEarned(data)
		local totalXp = reward.xp
		local totalCoins = reward.coins
		for _, ch in completedChallenges do
			totalXp += ch.xp
			totalCoins += ch.coins
		end
		profileEvent:FireClient(player, "Reward", {
			xp = totalXp,
			coins = totalCoins,
			breakdown = reward.breakdown,
			challenges = completedChallenges,
			idle = reward.idle,
			levelBefore = levelBefore,
			unlocks = #unlocked,
			masteryBefore = masteryBefore,
			masteryAfter = Levels.mastery(data.masteryKills).tier,
			levelAfter = Levels.fromXp(data.xp).level,
			totalXp = data.xp,
		})
		for _, skin in unlocked do
			profileEvent:FireClient(player, "Unlock", { id = skin.id, name = skin.name })
		end
		ProgressionService.push(player)
		ProgressionService.ProfileChanged:Fire(player, data)
	end
end

-- Settings come from the client, so only known keys with sane values are kept.
local SETTING_TYPES: { [string]: string } = {
	sensitivity = "number",
	gamepadSensitivity = "number",
	touchSensitivity = "number",
	fov = "number",
	masterVolume = "number",
	musicVolume = "number",
	effectsVolume = "number",
	crouchToggle = "boolean",
	wheelSwitching = "boolean",
	showDamageNumbers = "boolean",
	reducedEffects = "boolean",
	cameraBob = "boolean",
	crosshairStyle = "string",
	crosshairColor = "string",
	crosshairSize = "number",
	touchLayout = "table",
	touchLayoutV2 = "table",
	controlLayout = "string",
	weaponHand = "string",
	tutorialDone = "boolean",
}

local function cleanSettings(raw: any): { [string]: any }?
	if typeof(raw) ~= "table" then
		return nil
	end
	local out = {}
	for key, kind in SETTING_TYPES do
		local v = raw[key]
		if typeof(v) == kind then
			if kind == "number" then
				if v == v and math.abs(v) < 1000 then
					out[key] = v
				end
			elseif kind == "string" then
				if
					#v <= 24
					and (
						(key ~= "controlLayout" and key ~= "weaponHand")
						or v == "right"
						or v == "left"
						or (key == "controlLayout" and (v == "Right-Handed" or v == "Left-Handed"))
					)
				then
					out[key] = v
				end
			elseif kind == "table" then
				-- touchLayout: { [button] = { x, y [, scale] } } with numbers in 0..1.5
				local layout = {}
				local count = 0
				for name, pos in v do
					count += 1
					if count > 16 then
						break
					end
					if typeof(name) == "string" and #name <= 16 and typeof(pos) == "table" then
						local x, y, sc = pos[1], pos[2], pos[3]
						if typeof(x) == "number" and typeof(y) == "number" and x == x and y == y then
							layout[name] = {
								math.clamp(x, 0, 1),
								math.clamp(y, 0, 1),
								if typeof(sc) == "number" and sc == sc then math.clamp(sc, 0.5, 1.6) else 1,
							}
						end
					end
				end
				out[key] = layout
			else
				out[key] = v
			end
		end
	end
	local presentation = require(Shared.Preferences).normalize(out)
	out.controlLayout = presentation.controlLayout
	out.weaponHand = presentation.weaponHand
	return out
end

local function onSettingsAction(player: Player, action: any, value: any)
	if not settingsLimiter:allow(player, os.clock()) then
		return
	end
	if action == "Save" then
		local clean = cleanSettings(value)
		if clean then
			DataService.update(player, function(d)
				d.settings = clean
			end)
		end
	elseif action == "TutorialDone" then
		DataService.update(player, function(d)
			d.tutorialDone = true
		end)
	end
end

local function trackActivity(dt: number)
	if not MatchService.inCombat() then
		return
	end
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if not TeamService.teamOf(player) then
			continue
		end
		local act = activity[player]
		if not act then
			act = { lastShot = -math.huge, active = 0 }
			activity[player] = act
		end
		local character = player.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
		local pitch = character and character:GetAttribute("AimPitch")
		local moved = false
		if root then
			moved = act.lastPos ~= nil and (root.Position - (act.lastPos :: Vector3)).Magnitude > 1.5
			act.lastPos = root.Position
		end
		local turned = typeof(pitch) == "number"
			and act.lastPitch ~= nil
			and math.abs(pitch - (act.lastPitch :: number)) > 0.01
		if typeof(pitch) == "number" then
			act.lastPitch = pitch
		end
		local fired = os.clock() - act.lastShot < 2
		if moved or turned or fired then
			act.active += dt
		end
	end
end

function ProgressionService.start()
	profileEvent = Net.event("ProfileEvent")

	DataService.Loaded:Connect(function(player, data)
		rollChallenges(data)
		local unlocked = grantEarned(data)
		ProgressionService.push(player)
		for _, skin in unlocked do
			profileEvent:FireClient(player, "Unlock", { id = skin.id, name = skin.name })
		end
	end)
	Net.func("GetProfile").OnServerInvoke = function(player: Player)
		local data = DataService.get(player)
		return if data then ProgressionService.snapshot(data) else nil
	end
	Net.event("SettingsAction").OnServerEvent:Connect(onSettingsAction)

	MatchService.MatchStarted:Connect(function()
		matchStartedAt = os.clock()
		table.clear(activity)
	end)
	MatchService.MatchEnded:Connect(onMatchEnded)
	CombatService.ShotFired:Connect(function(player)
		local act = activity[player]
		if act then
			act.lastShot = os.clock()
		end
	end)
	local accumulator = 0
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		accumulator += dt
		if accumulator >= 1 then
			trackActivity(accumulator)
			accumulator = 0
		end
	end)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		activity[player] = nil
		settingsLimiter:forget(player)
	end)
end

return ProgressionService
ServerScriptService.Server.Services.Team:
--!strict
-- Red and Blue teams: assignment, balancing, and the Team objects Roblox replicates
-- (so player.Team works everywhere, including friendly-fire checks).

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Teams = game:GetService("Teams")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local GameConfig = require(Shared.Config.GameConfig)
local TeamBalance = require(Shared.Match.TeamBalance)

local TeamService = {}

local teamObjects: { [string]: Team } = {}

function TeamService.team(name: string): Team
	return teamObjects[name]
end

function TeamService.members(name: string): { Player }
	local list = {}
	local team = teamObjects[name]
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if team and player.Team == team then
			table.insert(list, player)
		end
	end
	return list
end

function TeamService.teamOf(player: Player): string?
	local team = player.Team
	if team == teamObjects.Red then
		return "Red"
	elseif team == teamObjects.Blue then
		return "Blue"
	end
	return nil
end

local function snapshot()
	return { Red = TeamService.members("Red"), Blue = TeamService.members("Blue") }
end

local function setTeam(player: Player, name: string?)
	player.Team = (if name then teamObjects[name] else nil) :: any
	player.Neutral = name == nil
	local character = player.Character
	if character then
		character:SetAttribute("Team", name)
	end
end

-- Puts a player on the team that needs them. Returns the team name, or nil if full.
function TeamService.assign(player: Player, scores: { [string]: number }?): string?
	local current = TeamService.teamOf(player)
	if current then
		return current
	end
	local name = TeamBalance.pick(snapshot(), scores, GameConfig.Match.MaxTeamSize)
	if name then
		setTeam(player, name)
	end
	return name
end

function TeamService.clear(player: Player)
	setTeam(player, nil)
end

-- Fresh, even teams for a new match from the given players (shuffled).
function TeamService.reshuffle(players: { Player })
	local list = table.clone(players)
	for i = #list, 2, -1 do
		local j = math.random(1, i)
		list[i], list[j] = list[j], list[i]
	end
	for _, p in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if not table.find(list, p) then
			setTeam(p, nil)
		end
	end
	local split = TeamBalance.split(list)
	for name, members in split do
		for _, p in members do
			setTeam(p, name)
		end
	end
end

-- Called when a player is about to respawn: if the teams are lopsided and this player
-- is on the bigger team, move them. Returns true if they moved.
function TeamService.rebalance(player: Player): boolean
	local from, to = TeamBalance.needsMove(snapshot(), GameConfig.Teams.RebalanceGap)
	if from and to and TeamService.teamOf(player) == from then
		setTeam(player, to)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function TeamService.start()
	for _, name in { "Red", "Blue" } do
		local cfg = (GameConfig.Teams :: any)[name]
		local team = Teams:FindFirstChild(name) :: Team?
		if not team then
			local t = Instance.new("Team")
			t.Name = name
			t.Parent = Teams
			team = t
		end
		assert(team, "team missing")
		team.TeamColor = BrickColor.new(cfg.BrickColor)
		team.AutoAssignable = false
		teamObjects[name] = team
	end
end

return TeamService

--!strict
-- Plays every sound: 2D (UI, your own gun), 3D at a position or on a part (other
-- players' guns, impacts), music and map ambience. Volumes follow Settings through
-- SoundGroups. Sound ids come from Config/AssetIds (the original sounds in
-- assets/audio, once uploaded). Missing ids fall back to a few sounds that ship with
-- the Roblox client, or stay silent, and are listed once in the output.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local AssetIds = require(Shared.Config.AssetIds)
local Settings = require(script.Parent.Settings)
local Net = require(Shared.Net)
local LobbyCues = require(Shared.Audio.LobbyCues)
local ActionCues = require(Shared.Audio.ActionCues)
local lastLobbySerial = 0

local AudioController = {}

type Group = "Effects" | "UI" | "Music"

-- Built into the Roblox client, used only until the real sounds are uploaded.
local FALLBACKS: { [string]: string } = {
	HitBody = "rbxasset://sounds/electronicpingshort.wav",
	HitHead = "rbxasset://sounds/electronicpingshort.wav",
	UIClick = "rbxasset://sounds/clickfast.wav",
	Swap = "rbxasset://sounds/swoosh.wav",
	Equip = "rbxasset://sounds/swoosh.wav",
	Death = "rbxasset://sounds/uuhhh.mp3",
}

-- Per-sound mix (volume, and how far 3D sounds carry)
local MIX: { [string]: { volume: number, rolloff: number? } } = {
	StepConcrete = { volume = 0.13 },
	StepMetal = { volume = 0.13 },
	StepSand = { volume = 0.13 },
	StepWood = { volume = 0.13 },
	Landing = { volume = 0.65 },

	ReloadEnd = { volume = 0.3 },
	ImpactHard = { volume = 0.25, rolloff = 70 },
	ImpactMetal = { volume = 0.25, rolloff = 70 },
	ImpactWood = { volume = 0.25, rolloff = 70 },
	Overtime = { volume = 0.5 },
	TimeWarning = { volume = 0.4 },
	Error = { volume = 0.3 },
	Confirm = { volume = 0.3 },
	Unlock = { volume = 0.6 },
	Assist = { volume = 0.35 },
	Fire = { volume = 0.9, rolloff = 160 },
	Pump = { volume = 0.55, rolloff = 50 },
	PumpBack = { volume = 0.38, rolloff = 50 },
	PumpForward = { volume = 0.42, rolloff = 50 },
	Equip = { volume = 0.5 },
	Swap = { volume = 0.55, rolloff = 40 },
	ShellInsert = { volume = 0.5 },
	ReloadStart = { volume = 0.4 },
	EmptyClick = { volume = 0.6 },
	ShellBounce = { volume = 0.25, rolloff = 25 },
	HitBody = { volume = 0.55 },
	HitHead = { volume = 0.6 },
	Elimination = { volume = 0.75 },
	DoublePumpElim = { volume = 0.85 },
	DamageTaken = { volume = 0.6 },
	Death = { volume = 0.6 },
	Spawn = { volume = 0.45 },
	CountdownTick = { volume = 0.6 },
	MatchStart = { volume = 0.7 },
	MatchEnd = { volume = 0.7 },
	Victory = { volume = 0.75 },
	Defeat = { volume = 0.7 },
	UIClick = { volume = 0.45 },
	UIHover = { volume = 0.25 },
	Vote = { volume = 0.5 },
	Reward = { volume = 0.55 },
	LevelUp = { volume = 0.7 },
	MasteryMilestone = { volume = 0.7 },
	QueueJoin = { volume = 0.4 },
	QueueLeave = { volume = 0.35 },
	QueueCountdown = { volume = 0.35 },
	QueueCancel = { volume = 0.4 },
	Admitted = { volume = 0.5 },
	ReturnToRange = { volume = 0.4 },
}

local groups: { [string]: SoundGroup } = {}
local master: SoundGroup
local missing: { string } = {}
local warned = false
local musicSound: Sound? = nil
local ambientSound: Sound? = nil
local ambientName: string? = nil
local ambienceWorker = false

local function idFor(name: string): string?
	local id = (AssetIds.Sounds :: any)[name]
	if typeof(id) == "string" and id ~= "" then
		if id:match("^%d+$") then
			return "rbxassetid://" .. id
		end
		return id
	end
	if not table.find(missing, name) then
		table.insert(missing, name)
	end
	return FALLBACKS[name]
end

local function warnMissing()
	if warned or #missing == 0 then
		return
	end
	warned = true
	task.delay(5, function()
		warn(
			`[Double Pump] {#missing} sound(s) not uploaded yet, using fallbacks or silence: {table.concat(
				missing,
				", "
			)}.` .. " Upload assets/audio (docs/ASSET_PIPELINE.md)."
		)
	end)
end

local function makeSound(name: string, group: Group): Sound?
	local id = idFor(name)
	warnMissing()
	if not id then
		return nil
	end
	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.Name = name
	sound.SoundId = id
	local mix = MIX[name]
	sound.Volume = if mix then mix.volume else 0.6
	sound.SoundGroup = groups[group]
	if mix and mix.rolloff then
		sound.RollOffMaxDistance = mix.rolloff
		sound.RollOffMinDistance = 8
		sound.RollOffMode = Enum.RollOffMode.InverseTapered
	end
	return sound
end

export type PlayOptions = {
	parent: any,
	position: Vector3?,
	pitch: number?,
	volume: number?,
	group: Group?,
}

function AudioController.configured(name: string): boolean
	local id = (AssetIds.Sounds :: any)[name]
	return typeof(id) == "string" and id ~= ""
end

function AudioController.stop(sound: Sound?)
	if not sound or not sound.Parent then
		return
	end
	local fade = TweenService:Create(sound, TweenInfo.new(0.015), { Volume = 0 })
	fade.Completed:Once(function()
		if sound.Parent then
			sound:Stop()
			sound:Destroy()
		end
	end)
	fade:Play()
	Debris:AddItem(sound, 0.1)
end

function AudioController.play(name: string, options: PlayOptions?): Sound?
	local o = (options or {}) :: PlayOptions
	local sound = makeSound(name, o.group or (if name:sub(1, 2) == "UI" then "UI" else "Effects"))
	if not sound then
		return
	end
	if o.pitch then
		sound.PlaybackSpeed = o.pitch
	end
	if o.volume then
		sound.Volume *= o.volume
	end
	local holder: Instance
	if o.position then
		local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
		attachment.WorldPosition = o.position
		attachment.Parent = workspace.Terrain
		holder = attachment
		Debris:AddItem(attachment, 4)
	else
		holder = o.parent or SoundService
	end
	sound.Parent = holder
	sound:Play()
	sound.Ended:Once(function()
		sound:Destroy()
	end)
	Debris:AddItem(sound, 6)
	return sound
end

local function loop(name: string, group: Group, volume: number): Sound?
	local sound = makeSound(name, group)
	if not sound then
		return nil
	end
	sound.Looped = true
	sound.Volume = volume
	sound.Parent = SoundService
	sound:Play()
	return sound
end

function AudioController.setMusic(name: string?)
	if musicSound and (not name or musicSound.Name ~= name) then
		musicSound:Destroy()
		musicSound = nil
	end
	if name and not musicSound then
		musicSound = loop(name, "Music", 0.5)
	end
end

function AudioController.setAmbience(name: string?)
	-- Serialize fades: destroy the outgoing bed before creating the current target.
	-- Coalescing rapid mode/map refreshes prevents overlapping or stale loops.
	local target = if name and AudioController.configured(name) then name else nil
	if target == ambientName then
		return
	end
	ambientName = target
	if ambienceWorker then
		return
	end
	ambienceWorker = true
	task.spawn(function()
		while (if ambientSound then ambientSound.Name else nil) ~= ambientName do
			if ambientSound then
				local previous = ambientSound
				TweenService:Create(previous, TweenInfo.new(0.25), { Volume = 0 }):Play()
				task.wait(0.25)
				previous:Destroy()
				ambientSound = nil
			end
			if ambientName then
				ambientSound = loop(ambientName, "Effects", 0)
				if ambientSound then
					TweenService:Create(ambientSound, TweenInfo.new(0.35), { Volume = 0.025 }):Play()
				end
			end
		end
		ambienceWorker = false
	end)
end

local function applyVolumes()
	local v = Settings.values
	master.Volume = v.masterVolume
	groups.Music.Volume = v.musicVolume
	groups.Effects.Volume = v.effectsVolume
	groups.UI.Volume = v.effectsVolume
end

function AudioController.start()
	master = Instance.new("SoundGroup")
	master.Name = "Master"
	master.Parent = SoundService
	for _, name in { "Effects", "UI", "Music" } do
		local group = Instance.new("SoundGroup")
		group.Name = name
		group.Parent = master
		groups[name] = group
	end
	applyVolumes()
	Settings.Changed:Connect(applyVolumes)
	Net.event("MatchEvent").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind, payload)
		if kind ~= "LobbyAudio" then
			return
		end
		local serial, cue = LobbyCues.accept(lastLobbySerial, payload)
		lastLobbySerial = serial
		if cue then
			AudioController.play(cue)
		end
	end)
	-- Only confirmed responses create UI feedback. Initial snapshots stay silent.
	local lastError, lastConfirm, previousSkin = -math.huge, -math.huge, nil
	local function confirm()
		local now = os.clock()
		if now - lastConfirm < 0.4 then
			return
		end
		lastConfirm = now
		AudioController.play("Confirm", { group = "UI" })
	end
	Net.event("Notify").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(_, kind)
		if kind == "error" then
			local now = os.clock()
			if now - lastError < 0.4 then
				return
			end
			lastError = now
			AudioController.play("Error", { group = "UI" })
		elseif kind == "good" then
			confirm()
		end
	end)
	Net.event("ProfileEvent").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind, snapshot)
		if kind ~= "Profile" then
			return
		end
		local changed
		previousSkin, changed = ActionCues.skinChanged(previousSkin, snapshot)
		if changed then
			confirm()
		end
	end)
	-- Readiness diagnostics never block player spawning or input.
	task.spawn(function()
		local preload = {}
		for _, name in
			{
				"StepConcrete",
				"StepMetal",
				"StepSand",
				"StepWood",
				"Landing",
				"ReloadEnd",
				"ImpactHard",
				"ImpactMetal",
				"ImpactWood",
				"Overtime",
				"TimeWarning",
				"Error",
				"Confirm",
				"Unlock",
				"Assist",
				"RangeAir",
				"AmbWarehouse",
				"AmbDustTown",
				"AmbRooftops",
				"Fire",
				"PumpBack",
				"PumpForward",
				"Swap",
				"EmptyClick",
				"HitBody",
				"HitHead",
				"DamageTaken",
				"Equip",
				"ReloadStart",
				"ShellInsert",
				"ShellBounce",
				"Elimination",
				"DoublePumpElim",
				"Death",
				"Spawn",
				"CountdownTick",
				"MatchStart",
				"MatchEnd",
				"Victory",
				"Defeat",
				"UIClick",
				"Reward",
				"QueueJoin",
				"QueueLeave",
				"QueueCountdown",
				"QueueCancel",
				"Admitted",
				"ReturnToRange",
				"LevelUp",
				"MasteryMilestone",
				"Vote",
			}
		do
			local id = idFor(name)
			if id then
				local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
				sound.SoundId = id
				table.insert(preload, sound)
			end
		end
		local loaded = 0
		local ok, message = pcall(function()
			game:GetService("ContentProvider"):PreloadAsync(preload, function(id, status)
				if status == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success then
					loaded += 1
				else
					warn(`[Double Pump Audio] unavailable {id}: {status.Name}`)
				end
			end)
		end)
		for _, sound in preload do
			sound:Destroy()
		end
		if ok then
			print(`[Double Pump Audio] approved cues ready: {loaded}/{#preload}`)
		else
			warn(`[Double Pump Audio] preload failed: {message}`)
		end
	end)
end

return AudioController

--!strict
-- First-person camera, written from scratch so sensitivity, FOV, recoil and gamepad /
-- touch aiming behave the same everywhere. The character's body yaw follows the camera.
--
-- Modes:
--   "Combat"  first person at the character's eyes (locked mouse)
--   "Dead"    looks at your body / your eliminator for the respawn delay
--   "Scenic"  slow orbit over the current map (menus, results, voting)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local GameConfig = require(Shared.Config.GameConfig)
local WeaponConfig = require(Shared.Config.WeaponConfig)
local Settings = require(script.Parent.Settings)
local DragAim = require(Shared.Mobile.DragAim)

local CameraController = {}

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local C = GameConfig.Camera

export type Mode = "Combat" | "Dead" | "Scenic"
CameraController.mode = "Scenic" :: Mode
CameraController.yaw = 0
CameraController.pitch = 0
CameraController.touchInputEnabled = false

local recoil = 0 -- current extra pitch from recoil (radians)
local recoilYaw = 0
local eyeY: number? = nil
local bobTime = 0
local cursorRequests = 0
local gamepadLook = Vector2.zero
local touchDelta = Vector2.zero
local dragAim = DragAim.new()
local scenicCenter = Vector3.new(0, 20, 0)
local scenicRadius = 60
local scenicAngle = 0
local deathFocus: Model? = nil
local deathTarget: Model? = nil
local deathTime = 0
local alignOrientation: AlignOrientation? = nil
local fovKick = 0
