-- Touches that start on these GUI regions (buttons) don't steer the camera.
CameraController.isTouchOnControl = function(_position: Vector2): boolean
	return false
end

function CameraController.clearTouchLook()
	dragAim:clear()
	touchDelta = Vector2.zero
end

function CameraController.requestCursor(): () -> ()
	cursorRequests += 1
	local released = false
	return function()
		if not released then
			released = true
			cursorRequests -= 1
		end
	end
end

function CameraController.cursorVisible(): boolean
	return cursorRequests > 0 or CameraController.mode ~= "Combat"
end

function CameraController.kick(strength: number?)
	local s = strength or 1
	recoil += math.rad(WeaponConfig.Recoil.ViewKickPitch) * s
	recoilYaw += math.rad(WeaponConfig.Recoil.ViewKickYawRange) * s * (if math.random() < 0.5 then -1 else 1)
	fovKick = 2.5 * s
end

function CameraController.setScenic(center: Vector3, radius: number)
	CameraController.clearTouchLook()
	scenicCenter = center
	scenicRadius = radius
	CameraController.mode = "Scenic"
end

function CameraController.setDead(body: Model?, killer: Model?)
	CameraController.clearTouchLook()
	deathFocus = body
	deathTarget = killer
	deathTime = 0
	CameraController.mode = "Dead"
end

function CameraController.setCombat()
	CameraController.mode = "Combat"
	eyeY = nil
	recoil = 0
	recoilYaw = 0
end

-- Faces the camera along a CFrame's look direction (on spawn).
function CameraController.lookAlong(cf: CFrame)
	local look = cf.LookVector
	CameraController.yaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)
	CameraController.pitch = 0
end

function CameraController.aimCFrame(): CFrame
	return workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame
end

local function applyDeadzone(v: Vector2): Vector2
	local m = v.Magnitude
	if m < 0.15 then
		return Vector2.zero
	end
	local scaled = (m - 0.15) / 0.85
	-- Response curve: fine control near the centre, fast at the edge.
	return v.Unit * math.pow(math.min(scaled, 1), 1.7)
end

local function ensureAlign(root: BasePart)
	if alignOrientation and alignOrientation.Parent == root then
		return
	end
	local attachment = root:FindFirstChild("DPYawAttachment") :: Attachment?
	if not attachment then
		local a = Instance.new("Attachment")
		a.Name = "DPYawAttachment"
		a.Parent = root
		attachment = a
	end
	local align = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
	align.Name = "DPYaw"
	align.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
	align.Attachment0 = attachment
	align.RigidityEnabled = true
	align.Parent = root
	alignOrientation = align
end

local function update(dt: number)
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if camera.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
		camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
	end
	local values = Settings.values
	local mode = CameraController.mode
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = humanoid and humanoid.RootPart

	-- Mouse
	local wantLock = mode == "Combat" and cursorRequests == 0
	UserInputService.MouseBehavior = if wantLock then Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter else Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
	UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = not wantLock

	if mode == "Combat" and root and humanoid then
		-- Look input
		if wantLock and not CameraController.touchInputEnabled then
			local delta = UserInputService:GetMouseDelta()
			local k = C.MouseRadiansPerPixel * values.sensitivity
			CameraController.yaw -= delta.X * k
			CameraController.pitch -= delta.Y * k
		end
		local stick = applyDeadzone(gamepadLook)
		if stick.Magnitude > 0 then
			local k = C.GamepadRadiansPerSecond * values.gamepadSensitivity * dt
			CameraController.yaw -= stick.X * k
			CameraController.pitch += stick.Y * k
		end
		if touchDelta.Magnitude > 0 then
			local k = C.TouchRadiansPerPixel * values.touchSensitivity
			CameraController.yaw -= touchDelta.X * k
			CameraController.pitch -= touchDelta.Y * k
			touchDelta = Vector2.zero
		end
		CameraController.pitch = math.clamp(CameraController.pitch, -C.MaxPitch, C.MaxPitch)

		-- Recoil springs back
		local recover = math.exp(-dt / (WeaponConfig.Recoil.RecoverTime / 3))
		recoil *= recover
		recoilYaw *= recover
		fovKick *= math.exp(-dt * 14)

		-- Eye position, smoothed vertically (steps, crouch)
		local targetY = root.Position.Y + C.EyeHeight
		if not eyeY or math.abs((eyeY :: number) - targetY) > 6 then
			eyeY = targetY
		else
			eyeY = (eyeY :: number) + (targetY - (eyeY :: number)) * (1 - math.exp(-dt * C.EyeSmoothing))
		end
		local bob = 0
		local speed = (root.AssemblyLinearVelocity * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Magnitude
		if values.cameraBob and humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air and speed > 2 then
			bobTime += dt * speed * 0.55
			bob = math.sin(bobTime) * C.BobAmount * math.min(speed / 16, 1.2)
		end
		local eye = Vector3.new(root.Position.X, (eyeY :: number) + bob, root.Position.Z)
		camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(eye)
			* CFrame.Angles(0, CameraController.yaw + recoilYaw, 0)
			* CFrame.Angles(CameraController.pitch + recoil, 0, 0)
		camera.FieldOfView = values.fov + fovKick

		-- Body faces where you look
		humanoid.AutoRotate = false
		ensureAlign(root)
		if alignOrientation then
			alignOrientation.CFrame = CFrame.Angles(0, CameraController.yaw, 0)
		end
	elseif mode == "Dead" then
		deathTime += dt
		local focus = deathFocus and deathFocus:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
		local killerRoot = deathTarget and deathTarget:FindFirstChild("Head") :: BasePart?
		local base = if focus then focus.Position else camera.CFrame.Position
		local look = if killerRoot then killerRoot.Position else base
		local back = camera.CFrame.LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
		if back.Magnitude < 0.1 then
			back = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
		end
		local pos = base - back.Unit * (6 + deathTime * 1.5) + Vector3.new(0, 5 + deathTime, 0)
		camera.CFrame = camera.CFrame:Lerp(CFrame.lookAt(pos, look), 1 - math.exp(-dt * 4))
		camera.FieldOfView = values.fov
	else
		scenicAngle += dt * 0.06
		local pos = scenicCenter
			+ Vector3.new(
				math.cos(scenicAngle) * scenicRadius,
				scenicRadius * 0.45,
				math.sin(scenicAngle) * scenicRadius
			)
		camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(pos, scenicCenter)
		camera.FieldOfView = 60
	end
end

function CameraController.start()
	RunService:BindToRenderStep("DoublePumpCamera", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, update)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Thumbstick2 then
			gamepadLook = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
		elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			touchDelta += dragAim:move(input, Vector2.new(input.Delta.X, input.Delta.Y))
		end
	end)
	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Thumbstick2 then
			gamepadLook = Vector2.zero
		end
		dragAim:finish(input)
	end)
	UserInputService.TouchStarted:Connect(function(input, processed)
		local pos = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
		dragAim:begin(
			input,
			processed
				or CameraController.mode ~= "Combat"
				or CameraController.cursorVisible()
				or CameraController.isTouchOnControl(pos)
		)
	end)
	UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(CameraController.clearTouchLook)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		CameraController.clearTouchLook()
		alignOrientation = nil
		eyeY = nil
	end)
end

return CameraController

--!strict
-- Visual and audio feedback for shooting: muzzle flash, smoke, pellet tracers, impacts,
-- shell casings, and the third-person presentation of other players (gun pitch, crouch
-- legs, swap dip, pump animation, their shots). Kept light: pooled parts, short lifetimes,
-- and a "reduced effects" setting.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local AnimPlayer = require(Shared.Weapons.AnimPlayer)
local Collision = require(Shared.Collision)
local Combatants = require(Shared.Combatants)
local Net = require(Shared.Net)
local ShotgunModel = require(Shared.Weapons.ShotgunModel)
local Spread = require(Shared.Weapons.Spread)
local WeaponConfig = require(Shared.Config.WeaponConfig)
local Feedback = require(Shared.Audio.Feedback)
local ActionCues = require(Shared.Audio.ActionCues)

local AudioController = require(script.Parent.AudioController)
local Settings = require(script.Parent.Settings)
local ViewmodelController = require(script.Parent.ViewmodelController)
local WeaponController = require(script.Parent.WeaponController)

local EffectsController = {}

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local folder: Folder
local holePool: { BasePart } = {}
local holeIndex = 0
local MAX_HOLES = 60
local localPumpSound: Sound? = nil
local handlingSound: Sound? = nil
local shells: { [BasePart]: { position: Vector3, falling: boolean } } = {}

local function stopLocalPump()
	AudioController.stop(localPumpSound)
	localPumpSound = nil
	AudioController.stop(handlingSound)
	handlingSound = nil
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Building blocks

local function effectPart(size: Vector3, color: Color3, material: Enum.Material?): Part
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CastShadow = false
	part.Size = size
	part.Color = color
	part.Material = material or Enum.Material.Neon
	part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	return part
end

local function fadeOut(part: BasePart, time: number)
	TweenService
		:Create(part, TweenInfo.new(time, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Transparency = 1 })
		:Play()
	Debris:AddItem(part, time + 0.05)
end

local function burst(
	at: CFrame,
	color: ColorSequence,
	count: number,
	speed: NumberRange,
	size: number,
	lifetime: number,
	texture: string?
)
	local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	attachment.WorldCFrame = at
	attachment.Parent = workspace.Terrain
	local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	emitter.Color = color
	emitter.Speed = speed
	emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(lifetime * 0.6, lifetime)
	emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, size), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) })
	emitter.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
	emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(35, 35)
	emitter.Drag = 4
	emitter.Acceleration = Vector3.new(0, -20, 0)
	emitter.LightEmission = 0.4
	emitter.Rate = 0
	emitter.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Front
	if texture then
		emitter.Texture = texture
	end
	emitter.Parent = attachment
	emitter:Emit(count)
	Debris:AddItem(attachment, lifetime + 0.2)
end

local SPARK = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 140), Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 40))
local DUST = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(190, 175, 150), Color3.fromRGB(120, 110, 95))
local HIT = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70))
local SMOKE = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(210, 210, 210), Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150))

local METALLIC: { [Enum.Material]: boolean } = {
	[Enum.Material.Metal] = true,
	[Enum.Material.DiamondPlate] = true,
	[Enum.Material.CorrodedMetal] = true,
	[Enum.Material.Foil] = true,
}

local function muzzleFlash(at: CFrame, big: boolean)
	local reduced = Settings.values.reducedEffects
	local flash = effectPart(Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.9) * (if big then 1 else 0.8), Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 110))
	flash.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
	flash.CFrame = at * CFrame.new(0, 0, -0.35) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.random() * math.pi)
	flash.Transparency = 0.15
	flash.Parent = folder
	local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
	light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 110)
	light.Range = 14
	light.Brightness = 3
	light.Shadows = false
	light.Parent = flash
	fadeOut(flash, 0.06)
	if not reduced then
		burst(at, SMOKE, 4, NumberRange.new(2, 5), 0.5, 0.7)
		burst(at, SPARK, 6, NumberRange.new(20, 35), 0.12, 0.12)
	end
end

local function tracer(from: Vector3, to: Vector3)
	local length = (to - from).Magnitude
	if length < 1 then
		return
	end
	local part = effectPart(Vector3.new(0.04, 0.04, math.min(length, 40)), Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 150))
	local dir = (to - from).Unit
	local start = from + dir * math.min(2, length * 0.2)
	local shown = math.min(length, 40)
	part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(start + dir * shown / 2, to)
	part.Transparency = 0.35
	part.Parent = folder
	fadeOut(part, 0.07)
end

local function impact(position: Vector3, normal: Vector3, material: Enum.Material?, isCharacter: boolean)
	local at = CFrame.lookAt(position, position + normal)
	if isCharacter then
		burst(at, HIT, 5, NumberRange.new(6, 12), 0.18, 0.25)
		return
	end
	if Settings.values.reducedEffects then
		return
	end
	if material and METALLIC[material] then
		burst(at, SPARK, 5, NumberRange.new(12, 22), 0.1, 0.18)
	else
		burst(at, DUST, 3, NumberRange.new(3, 8), 0.35, 0.5)
	end
	-- Pellet mark, recycled from a small pool
	holeIndex = holeIndex % MAX_HOLES + 1
	local hole = holePool[holeIndex]
	if not hole then
		local newHole =
			effectPart(Vector3.new(0.14, 0.14, 0.02), Color3.fromRGB(25, 22, 20), Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
		newHole.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		holePool[holeIndex] = newHole
		hole = newHole
	end
	hole.Size = Vector3.new(0.02, 0.16, 0.16)
	hole.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position + normal * 0.01, position + normal * 2) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0)
	hole.Transparency = 0.1
	hole.Parent = folder
end

local function spawnShell(at: CFrame)
	local template = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Assets")
	local props = template and template:FindFirstChild("Props")
	local shellTemplate = props and props:FindFirstChild("Shell_Spent")
	local shell: BasePart
	if shellTemplate and shellTemplate:IsA("BasePart") then
		shell = shellTemplate:Clone()
	else
		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		part.Size = Vector3.new(0.25, 0.085, 0.085)
		part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(175, 32, 32)
		part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		local brass = Instance.new("Part")
		brass.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
		brass.Size = Vector3.new(0.06, 0.09, 0.09)
		brass.Color = Color3.fromRGB(205, 165, 75)
		brass.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
		brass.CanCollide = false
		brass.Massless = true
		brass.CFrame = part.CFrame * CFrame.new(-0.11, 0, 0)
		local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
		weld.Part0 = part
		weld.Part1 = brass
		weld.Parent = brass
		brass.Parent = part
		shell = part
	end
	shell.Anchored = false
	shell.CanCollide = true
	shell.CanQuery = false
	shell.CanTouch = false
	shell.CollisionGroup = Collision.EFFECTS
	shell.CFrame = at * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0)
	shell.Parent = folder
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame
	shell.AssemblyLinearVelocity = camera.RightVector * (7 + math.random() * 3)
		+ camera.UpVector * (6 + math.random() * 2)
		+ camera.LookVector * -1
	shell.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(math.random() * 20 - 10, 15, math.random() * 20 - 10)
	Debris:AddItem(shell, 2.5)
	shells[shell] = { position = shell.Position, falling = false }
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Local player's shots

local function playImpacts(hits: { any })
	for _, hit in ActionCues.impacts(hits) do
		AudioController.play(hit.cue, { position = hit.position })
	end
end

local function onLocalFired(info: WeaponController.FireInfo)
	stopLocalPump()
	local muzzle = ViewmodelController.muzzle(info.slot)
	local from = if muzzle then muzzle.Position else info.origin + info.aim * 2
	if muzzle then
		muzzleFlash(muzzle, true)
	end
	AudioController.play("Fire", { pitch = 0.97 + math.random() * 0.06 })
	playImpacts(info.pellets)
	for _, pellet in info.pellets do
		tracer(from, pellet.position)
		if pellet.instance then
			impact(pellet.position, pellet.normal, pellet.material, pellet.isCharacter)
		end
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Other players: third-person gun, poses, shots

type Remote = {
	character: Model,
	gun: ShotgunModel.ShotgunModel?,
	anim: AnimPlayer.AnimPlayer,
	slot: number,
	swapDip: number, -- 1 right after a swap, decays to 0
	kick: number,
	crouch: number, -- 0..1 blended
	audioEpoch: number,
	pumpSound: Sound?,
}

local remotes: { [Model]: Remote } = {}

local function stopRemotePump(entry: Remote)
	entry.audioEpoch += 1
	AudioController.stop(entry.pumpSound)
	entry.pumpSound = nil
end

local function getRemote(character: Model): Remote?
	if character == player.Character then
		return nil
	end
	local entry = remotes[character]
	if entry then
		return entry
	end
	entry = {
		character = character,
		gun = nil,
		anim = AnimPlayer.new("ThirdPerson"),
		slot = (character:GetAttribute("EquippedSlot") :: number?) or 1,
		swapDip = 0,
		kick = 0,
		crouch = 0,
		audioEpoch = 0,
		pumpSound = nil,
	}
	remotes[character] = entry
	character:GetAttributeChangedSignal("EquippedSlot"):Connect(function()
		local e = remotes[character]
		if e then
			e.swapDip = 1
			e.slot = (character:GetAttribute("EquippedSlot") :: number?) or 1
			stopRemotePump(e)
			if character.PrimaryPart then
				AudioController.play("Swap", { parent = character.PrimaryPart })
			end
		end
	end)
	for _, attribute in { "Dead", "SpawnRevision" } do
		character:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attribute):Connect(function()
			local current = remotes[character]
			if current then
				stopRemotePump(current)
			end
		end)
	end
	character.Destroying:Once(function()
		local current = remotes[character]
		if current then
			stopRemotePump(current)
		end
		remotes[character] = nil
	end)
	return entry
end

local function remoteGun(entry: Remote): ShotgunModel.ShotgunModel?
	if entry.gun and entry.gun.model.Parent == entry.character then
		return entry.gun
	end
	local model = entry.character:FindFirstChild("WorldShotgun")
	if model and model:IsA("Model") then
		entry.gun = ShotgunModel.wrap(model)
		return entry.gun
	end
	return nil
end

local function onRemoteShot(character: Model, info: any)
	if typeof(info) ~= "table" or not character or not character.Parent then
		return
	end
	local entry = getRemote(character)
	if not entry then
		return
	end
	stopRemotePump(entry)
	local audioEpoch = entry.audioEpoch
	entry.kick = 1
	local gun = remoteGun(entry)
	local muzzle = if gun then gun:point("Muzzle") else CFrame.new(info.origin)
	local distance = (workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position - muzzle.Position).Magnitude
	if distance < 300 then
		muzzleFlash(muzzle, false)
		AudioController.play("Fire", { position = muzzle.Position, pitch = 0.95 + math.random() * 0.08 })
		-- Pellet traces: same deterministic pattern the shooter used
		if typeof(info.aim) == "Vector3" and typeof(info.origin) == "Vector3" and typeof(info.shot) == "number" then
			local dirs = Spread.directions(WeaponConfig.Spread, info.aim, info.shot, info.mult or 1)
			local params = Collision.shotParams({ character, folder })
			local audioHits = {}
			for _, d in dirs do
				local result = workspace:Raycast(info.origin, d * WeaponConfig.Damage.MaxRange, params)
				local to = if result then result.Position else info.origin + d * 80
				tracer(muzzle.Position, to)
				if result then
					impact(result.Position, result.Normal, result.Material, Combatants.fromPart(result.Instance) ~= nil)
					table.insert(audioHits, {
						instance = result.Instance,
						position = result.Position,
						material = result.Material,
						isCharacter = Combatants.fromPart(result.Instance) ~= nil,
					})
				end
			end
			playImpacts(audioHits)
		end
	end
	-- Pump after the recoil, like the first-person model
	task.delay(0.2, function()
		if entry.character.Parent and character:GetAttribute("Dead") ~= true and entry.audioEpoch == audioEpoch then
			entry.anim:play("TP_Pump", {
				fadeIn = 0.03,
				onEvent = function(event)
					local cue = Feedback.pumpCue(event)
					if
						cue
						and entry.audioEpoch == audioEpoch
						and character:GetAttribute("Dead") ~= true
						and character.PrimaryPart
					then
						AudioController.stop(entry.pumpSound)
						entry.pumpSound = AudioController.play(cue, { parent = character.PrimaryPart })
					end
				end,
			})
		end
	end)
end

local function poseRemotes(dt: number)
	for character, entry in remotes do
		if not character.Parent or character:GetAttribute("Dead") == true then
			continue
		end
		local pitch = (character:GetAttribute("AimPitch") :: number?) or 0
		entry.swapDip = math.max(0, entry.swapDip - dt / 0.3)
		entry.kick = math.max(0, entry.kick - dt / 0.2)
		local crouchTarget = if character:GetAttribute("Crouching") == true then 1 else 0
		entry.crouch += (crouchTarget - entry.crouch) * (1 - math.exp(-dt * 14))

		local waist = character:FindFirstChild("Waist", true) :: Motor6D?
		local neck = character:FindFirstChild("Neck", true) :: Motor6D?
		if waist and waist:IsA("Motor6D") then
			waist.Transform = CFrame.Angles(pitch * 0.45, 0, 0)
		end
		if neck and neck:IsA("Motor6D") then
			neck.Transform = CFrame.Angles(pitch * 0.4, 0, 0)
		end
		local gunPart = nil
		local gun = remoteGun(entry)
		if gun then
			gunPart = gun.model.PrimaryPart
		end
		local mount = gunPart and gunPart:FindFirstChild("GunMount") :: Motor6D?
		if mount then
			local dip = math.sin(entry.swapDip * math.pi)
			mount.Transform = CFrame.new(0, -0.6 * dip, 0.25 * entry.kick)
				* CFrame.Angles(pitch * 0.15 + 0.12 * entry.kick - 0.9 * dip, 0, 0)
		end
		if gun then
			gun:setPose(entry.anim:update(dt))
		end
		if entry.crouch > 0.01 then
			local c = entry.crouch
			for _, side in { "Left", "Right" } do
				local hip = character:FindFirstChild(side .. "Hip", true) :: Motor6D?
				local knee = character:FindFirstChild(side .. "Knee", true) :: Motor6D?
				local ankle = character:FindFirstChild(side .. "Ankle", true) :: Motor6D?
				if hip and hip:IsA("Motor6D") then
					hip.Transform = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(62) * c, 0, 0)
				end
				if knee and knee:IsA("Motor6D") then
					knee.Transform = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-105) * c, 0, 0)
				end
				if ankle and ankle:IsA("Motor6D") then
					ankle.Transform = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(43) * c, 0, 0)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function track(character: Model)
	task.defer(function()
		if character.Parent then
			getRemote(character)
		end
	end)
end

function EffectsController.elimination(position: Vector3, color: Color3?)
	local c = color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
	burst(
		CFrame.new(position),
		ColorSequence.new(c, Color3.new(1, 1, 1)),
		if Settings.values.reducedEffects then 10 else 24,
		NumberRange.new(8, 18),
		0.35,
		0.6
	)
end

function EffectsController.start()
	folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "Effects"
	folder.Parent = workspace
	table.insert(WeaponController.excluded, folder)

	WeaponController.Fired:Connect(onLocalFired)
	WeaponController.DryFire:Connect(function()
		AudioController.play("EmptyClick")
	end)
	WeaponController.Equipped:Connect(function(_, _, isSpawn)
		stopLocalPump()
		handlingSound = AudioController.play(if isSpawn then "Equip" else "Swap")
	end)
	WeaponController.ReloadStarted:Connect(function()
		stopLocalPump()
		handlingSound = AudioController.play("ReloadStart")
	end)
	WeaponController.ShellInserted:Connect(function()
		AudioController.stop(handlingSound)
		handlingSound = AudioController.play("ShellInsert", { pitch = 0.95 + math.random() * 0.1 })
	end)
	ViewmodelController.ShellEjected:Connect(function(_, at)
		spawnShell(at)
	end)
	WeaponController.Reset:Connect(stopLocalPump)
	player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(stopLocalPump)
	ViewmodelController.AnimEvent:Connect(function(slot, event)
		local cue = Feedback.pumpCue(event)
		if event == "ReloadDone" and WeaponController.active and slot == WeaponController.state.equipped then
			AudioController.stop(handlingSound)
			handlingSound = AudioController.play("ReloadEnd")
		end
		if cue and WeaponController.active and slot == WeaponController.state.equipped then
			stopLocalPump()
			localPumpSound = AudioController.play(cue)
		end
	end)

	Net.event("WeaponEvent").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind, a, b)
		if kind == "Shot" then
			onRemoteShot(a, b)
		end
	end)

	local function watchPlayer(other: Player)
		if other == player then
			return
		end
		other.CharacterAdded:Connect(track)
		if other.Character then
			track(other.Character)
		end
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watchPlayer)
	for _, other in Players:GetPlayers() do
		watchPlayer(other)
	end
	RunService.Stepped:Connect(function(_, dt)
		if not WeaponController.active then
			stopLocalPump()
		end
		local roots: { Instance } = { workspace.Terrain }
		for _, name in { "Range", "Arena" } do
			local root = workspace:FindFirstChild(name)
			if root then
				table.insert(roots, root)
			end
		end
		local params = Collision.worldParams(roots)
		params.CollisionGroup = Collision.EFFECTS
		params.RespectCanCollide = true
		for shell, state in shells do
			if not shell.Parent then
				shells[shell] = nil
				continue
			end
			local position = shell.Position
			local travel = position - state.position
			local contact = if travel.Magnitude > 0.001 then workspace:Raycast(state.position, travel, params) else nil
			contact = contact
				or workspace:Raycast(position, Vector3.new(0, -shell.Size.Magnitude / 2 - 0.05, 0), params)
			if contact and state.falling and contact.Normal.Y >= 0.5 then
				shells[shell] = nil -- first floor contact only
				AudioController.play("ShellBounce", { position = contact.Position, pitch = 0.9 + math.random() * 0.2 })
			else
				state.position = position
				state.falling = state.falling or shell.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y < -0.5
			end
		end
		poseRemotes(dt)
	end)
end

return EffectsController

--!strict
-- Decides what the local player is looking at: menu, first-person combat, death cam,
-- or the postgame screens. Every other controller just does its job; this one switches
-- them on and off as the player's mode, character and the match state change.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Controllers = script.Parent
local UI = script.Parent.Parent.UI
local CameraController = require(Controllers.CameraController)
local InputController = require(Controllers.InputController)
local WeaponController = require(Controllers.WeaponController)
local ViewmodelController = require(Controllers.ViewmodelController)
local MatchClient = require(Controllers.MatchClient)
local AudioController = require(Controllers.AudioController)
local MovementController = require(Controllers.MovementController)
local Hud = require(UI.Hud)
local MainMenu = require(UI.MainMenu)
local DeathScreen = require(UI.DeathScreen)
local Scoreboard = require(UI.Scoreboard)
local Postgame = require(UI.Postgame)
local MobileControls = require(UI.MobileControls)

local ActionCues = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared.Audio.ActionCues)

local GameFlow = {}
GameFlow.feedbackOpen = false

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local releaseCursor: (() -> ())? = nil
local lastKiller: Model? = nil
local alignedCharacter: Model? = nil
local alignedRevision: any = nil
local watched: { [Model]: boolean } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

local function alive(): boolean
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	return character ~= nil
		and humanoid ~= nil
		and humanoid.Health > 0
		and typeof(character:GetAttribute("SpawnCFrame")) == "CFrame"
end

local function postgame(): boolean
	local state = MatchClient.state()
	return MatchClient.myTeam() ~= nil and (state == "Results" or state == "Voting")
end

local function scenicTarget(): (Vector3, number)
	local arena = workspace:FindFirstChild("Arena")
	local markers = arena and arena:FindFirstChild("Markers")
	local cam = markers and markers:FindFirstChild("Camera") :: BasePart?
	if cam then
		return cam.Position + cam.CFrame.LookVector * 40, 70
	end
	local range = workspace:FindFirstChild("Range")
	local rangeMarkers = range and range:FindFirstChild("Markers")
	local rangeCam = rangeMarkers and rangeMarkers:FindFirstChild("Camera") :: BasePart?
	if rangeCam then
		return rangeCam.Position + rangeCam.CFrame.LookVector * 40, 60
	end
	return Vector3.new(0, 10, 0), 60
end

-- Re-evaluates everything. Cheap; called on any relevant change.
function GameFlow.refresh()
	local mode = MatchClient.mode()
	local feedbackOpen = GameFlow.feedbackOpen
	local menuOpen = MainMenu.isOpen or feedbackOpen
	local isAlive = alive()
	local inPostgame = postgame()
	local playing = mode ~= "Menu" and isAlive and not inPostgame

	if mode == "Menu" and not menuOpen then
		MainMenu.open("Play")
		menuOpen = true
	end

	-- Camera
	if playing then
		if CameraController.mode ~= "Combat" then
			CameraController.setCombat()
		end
		local character = player.Character :: Model
		local revision = character:GetAttribute("SpawnRevision")
		if alignedCharacter ~= character or alignedRevision ~= revision then
			CameraController.lookAlong(character:GetAttribute("SpawnCFrame") :: CFrame)
			alignedCharacter = character
			alignedRevision = revision
		end
	elseif mode ~= "Menu" and not isAlive and not inPostgame then
		if CameraController.mode ~= "Dead" then
			CameraController.setDead(player.Character, lastKiller)
		end
	else
		local center, radius = scenicTarget()
		CameraController.setScenic(center, radius)
	end

	-- Input, viewmodel, HUD
	InputController.combatEnabled = playing and not menuOpen
	WeaponController.active = InputController.combatEnabled
	if not InputController.combatEnabled then
		InputController.releaseAll()
	end
	ViewmodelController.setEnabled(playing and not feedbackOpen)
	MobileControls.setActive(InputController.combatEnabled)
	Hud.setVisible(mode ~= "Menu" and not inPostgame and not menuOpen)
	if isAlive or mode == "Menu" or inPostgame then
		DeathScreen.hide()
	end
	if menuOpen and mode ~= "Menu" then
		if not releaseCursor then
			releaseCursor = CameraController.requestCursor()
		end
	elseif releaseCursor then
		releaseCursor()
		releaseCursor = nil
	end
	if not playing then
		MovementController.setCrouch(false)
	end

	-- Sound bed: menu music in the menu, map ambience in the arena
	if mode == "Menu" then
		AudioController.setMusic("MusicMenu")
		AudioController.setAmbience(nil)
	else
		AudioController.setMusic(nil)
		local arena = workspace:FindFirstChild("Arena")
		local ambience = arena and arena:GetAttribute("Ambience")
		AudioController.setAmbience(
			ActionCues.ambience(mode, MatchClient.myTeam() ~= nil, MatchClient.state(), ambience)
		)
	end
end

function GameFlow.toggleMenu()
	if GameFlow.feedbackOpen then return end
	if MatchClient.mode() == "Menu" then
		return -- the menu is the screen; nothing to close to
	end
	if MainMenu.isOpen then
		MainMenu.close()
	else
		MainMenu.open()
	end
	GameFlow.refresh()
end

local function onCharacter(character: Model)
	if watched[character] then
		return
	end
	watched[character] = true
	lastKiller = nil
	local function suppressDefaultDeath(child: Instance)
		if child:IsA("Sound") and child.Name == "Died" and AudioController.configured("Death") then
			child.Volume = 0
		end
	end
	for _, child in character:GetDescendants() do
		suppressDefaultDeath(child)
	end
	character.DescendantAdded:Connect(suppressDefaultDeath)
	character:GetAttributeChangedSignal("SpawnCFrame"):Connect(GameFlow.refresh)
	character:GetAttributeChangedSignal("SpawnRevision"):Connect(GameFlow.refresh)
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10) :: Humanoid?
	if humanoid then
		humanoid.Died:Once(function()
			if player.Character ~= character then
				return
			end
			AudioController.play("Death")
			GameFlow.refresh()
		end)
	end
	-- Entering play from the menu closes it
	if MainMenu.isOpen and MatchClient.mode() ~= "Menu" then
		MainMenu.close()
	end
	if player.Character == character and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
		AudioController.play("Spawn")
	end
	GameFlow.refresh()
end

function GameFlow.start()
	-- Arena replication can arrive after phase/team attributes; retry bed selection
	-- when the model or its cue attribute becomes available, without another timer.
	local function watchArena(child: Instance)
		if child.Name ~= "Arena" then
			return
		end
		child:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Ambience"):Connect(GameFlow.refresh)
		task.defer(GameFlow.refresh)
	end
	workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(watchArena)
	workspace.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
		if child.Name == "Arena" then
			GameFlow.refresh()
		end
	end)
	local arena = workspace:FindFirstChild("Arena")
	if arena then
		watchArena(arena)
	end
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacter)
	player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
		task.defer(GameFlow.refresh)
	end)
	if player.Character then
		task.spawn(onCharacter, player.Character)
	end
	player:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Mode"):Connect(function()
		if MatchClient.mode() ~= "Menu" and MainMenu.isOpen then
			-- Waiting for the spawn: close the menu now so the transition is immediate
			MainMenu.close()
		end
		GameFlow.refresh()
	end)
	player:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Team"):Connect(GameFlow.refresh)
	MatchClient.StateChanged:Connect(GameFlow.refresh)
	MatchClient.Elimination:Connect(function(data)
		if data.victimUserId == player.UserId and data.killerUserId ~= 0 then
			local killer = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(data.killerUserId)
			lastKiller = killer and killer.Character
		end
	end)
	InputController.Action:Connect(function(action, pressed)
		if action == "Menu" and pressed then
			GameFlow.toggleMenu()
		elseif action == "Scoreboard" then
			Scoreboard.setVisible(pressed and MatchClient.myTeam() ~= nil and not MainMenu.isOpen and not postgame())
		end
	end)
	-- Closing the menu with its ÃƒÆ’Ã‚Â¢Ãƒâ€¦Ã¢â‚¬Å“ÃƒÂ¢Ã¢â€šÂ¬Ã‚Â¢ button
	local wasOpen = MainMenu.isOpen
	game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if MainMenu.isOpen ~= wasOpen then
			wasOpen = MainMenu.isOpen
			GameFlow.refresh()
		end
	end)
	Postgame.hide()
	GameFlow.refresh()
end

return GameFlow

--!strict
-- Turns keyboard, mouse, gamepad and touch input into game actions.
-- Every action is a deliberate press: nothing here chains a fire into a swap.
--
--   Fire       LMB / R2 / touch Fire button
--   Equip A/B  1 / 2 (also mouse wheel when enabled in settings)
--   Swap       Q / R1 or L1 / touch Swap button
--   Reload     R / X (gamepad) / touch Reload button
--   Crouch     C or LeftCtrl / B (gamepad) / touch Crouch button
--   Scoreboard Tab / Select (hold)
--   Menu       M / Start

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")

local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared
local Signal = require(Shared.Util.Signal)

local InputController = {}

-- "Fire" | "EquipA" | "EquipB" | "Swap" | "Reload" | "Crouch" | "Scoreboard" | "Menu"
export type Action = string

-- (action, pressed) — pressed=false only for hold actions (Fire, Crouch, Scoreboard)
InputController.Action = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<Action, boolean>
InputController.LastInputKind = "Keyboard" :: "Keyboard" | "Gamepad" | "Touch"
InputController.InputKindChanged = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<string>

-- When false (menus open) combat actions are ignored.
InputController.combatEnabled = false
InputController.wheelSwitching = true

local KEYS: { [Enum.KeyCode]: Action } = {
	[Enum.KeyCode.One] = "EquipA",
	[Enum.KeyCode.KeypadOne] = "EquipA",
	[Enum.KeyCode.Two] = "EquipB",
	[Enum.KeyCode.KeypadTwo] = "EquipB",
	[Enum.KeyCode.Q] = "Swap",
	[Enum.KeyCode.R] = "Reload",
	[Enum.KeyCode.C] = "Crouch",
	[Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl] = "Crouch",
	[Enum.KeyCode.Tab] = "Scoreboard",
	[Enum.KeyCode.M] = "Menu",
	-- Gamepad
	[Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR2] = "Fire",
	[Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR1] = "Swap",
	[Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL1] = "Swap",
	[Enum.KeyCode.ButtonX] = "Reload",
	[Enum.KeyCode.ButtonB] = "Crouch",
	[Enum.KeyCode.ButtonSelect] = "Scoreboard",
	[Enum.KeyCode.ButtonStart] = "Menu",
	[Enum.KeyCode.DPadLeft] = "EquipA",
	[Enum.KeyCode.DPadRight] = "EquipB",
}

local HOLD: { [Action]: boolean } = { Fire = true, Crouch = true, Scoreboard = true }
local COMBAT: { [Action]: boolean } =
	{ Fire = true, EquipA = true, EquipB = true, Swap = true, Reload = true, Crouch = true }

local held: { [Action]: number } = {}

local function emit(action: Action, pressed: boolean)
	if COMBAT[action] and not InputController.combatEnabled and pressed then
		return
	end
	if HOLD[action] then
		local count = (held[action] or 0) + (if pressed then 1 else -1)
		count = math.max(count, 0)
		local was = (held[action] or 0) > 0
		held[action] = count
		local now = count > 0
		if now ~= was then
			InputController.Action:Fire(action, now)
		end
	elseif pressed then
		InputController.Action:Fire(action, true)
	end
end

-- For on-screen touch buttons.
function InputController.trigger(action: Action, pressed: boolean)
	emit(action, pressed)
end

function InputController.isHeld(action: Action): boolean
	return (held[action] or 0) > 0
end

-- Release everything (e.g. when a menu opens or the character dies).
function InputController.releaseAll()
	for action, count in held do
		if count > 0 then
			held[action] = 0
			InputController.Action:Fire(action, false)
		end
	end
end

local function setKind(kind: "Keyboard" | "Gamepad" | "Touch")
	if InputController.LastInputKind ~= kind then
		InputController.LastInputKind = kind
		InputController.InputKindChanged:Fire(kind)
	end
end

local function onInputBegan(input: InputObject, processed: boolean)
	local kind = input.UserInputType
	if kind == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		setKind("Touch")
		return
	elseif kind.Name:find("Gamepad") then
		setKind("Gamepad")
	elseif kind == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or kind.Name:find("Mouse") then
		setKind("Keyboard")
	end
	if processed and input.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.Tab then
		-- Typing in chat or clicking a button
		return
	end
	if GuiService.MenuIsOpen then
		return
	end
	if kind == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
		emit("Fire", true)
		return
	end
	local action = KEYS[input.KeyCode]
	if action then
		emit(action, true)
	end
end

local function onInputEnded(input: InputObject, _processed: boolean)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
		emit("Fire", false)
		return
	end
	local action = KEYS[input.KeyCode]
	if action and HOLD[action] then
		emit(action, false)
	end
end

local function onInputChanged(input: InputObject, processed: boolean)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel and not processed and InputController.wheelSwitching then
		if input.Position.Z > 0 then
			emit("EquipA", true)
		elseif input.Position.Z < 0 then
			emit("EquipB", true)
		end
	elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
		setKind("Keyboard")
	end
end

function InputController.start()
	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(onInputBegan)
	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(onInputEnded)
	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(onInputChanged)
	UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(InputController.releaseAll)
	if UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled then
		setKind("Touch")
	elseif UserInputService.GamepadEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled then
		setKind("Gamepad")
	end
end

return InputController

--!strict
-- Client view of the match: mirrors ReplicatedStorage.MatchState attributes and turns
-- MatchEvent / CombatEvent messages into signals the UI listens to.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local Net = require(Shared.Net)
local Signal = require(Shared.Util.Signal)

local MatchClient = {}

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local folder: Folder

MatchClient.StateChanged = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<string>
MatchClient.Countdown = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<number>
MatchClient.Started = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<any>
MatchClient.Starting = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<any>
MatchClient.Ended = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<any>
MatchClient.Voting = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<any>
MatchClient.VoteCounts = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<{ [string]: number }>
MatchClient.VoteResult = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<any>
MatchClient.Respawning = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<any>
MatchClient.Elimination = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<any>
MatchClient.Damaged = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<any>
MatchClient.Notify = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<string, string?>

function MatchClient.get(name: string): any
	return folder and folder:GetAttribute(name)
end

function MatchClient.state(): string
	return MatchClient.get("State") or "Waiting"
end

function MatchClient.timeLeft(): number
	local endsAt = MatchClient.get("EndsAt")
	if typeof(endsAt) ~= "number" then
		return 0
	end
	return math.max(0, endsAt - workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
end

function MatchClient.myTeam(): string?
	local team = player.Team
	return if team then team.Name else nil
end

function MatchClient.mode(): string
	return (player:GetAttribute("Mode") :: string?) or "Menu"
end

function MatchClient.inCombat(): boolean
	local s = MatchClient.state()
	return s == "Active" or s == "Overtime"
end

function MatchClient.start()
	folder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("MatchState") :: Folder
	folder:GetAttributeChangedSignal("State"):Connect(function()
		MatchClient.StateChanged:Fire(MatchClient.state())
	end)

	Net.event("MatchEvent").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind: string, data: any)
		if kind == "Countdown" then
			MatchClient.Countdown:Fire(data)
		elseif kind == "Started" then
			MatchClient.Started:Fire(data)
		elseif kind == "Starting" then
			MatchClient.Starting:Fire(data)
		elseif kind == "Ended" then
			MatchClient.Ended:Fire(data)
		elseif kind == "Voting" then
			MatchClient.Voting:Fire(data)
		elseif kind == "VoteCounts" then
			MatchClient.VoteCounts:Fire(data)
		elseif kind == "VoteResult" then
			MatchClient.VoteResult:Fire(data)
		elseif kind == "Respawning" then
			MatchClient.Respawning:Fire(data)
		end
	end)
	Net.event("CombatEvent").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind: string, data: any)
		if kind == "Elimination" then
			MatchClient.Elimination:Fire(data)
		elseif kind == "Damaged" then
			MatchClient.Damaged:Fire(data)
		end
	end)
	Net.event("Notify").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(text: string, kind: string?)
		MatchClient.Notify:Fire(text, kind)
	end)
end

return MatchClient

--!strict
-- Each client renders locally observed movement for every character. No remotes,
-- position/velocity writes, or changes to the movement controller. Engine Running
-- and Landing are muted locally so approved one-shots replace, never layer.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Cues = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Audio.MovementCues)
local Audio = require(script.Parent.AudioController)

local MovementAudio = {}
local records: { [Player]: any } = {}
local started = false

local function dispose(record: any)
	for _, connection in record.connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
end

local function bind(player: Player, character: Model): any
	local record: any = {
		character = character,
		state = Cues.new(),
		previous = nil,
		revision = nil,
		connections = {},
		defaults = {},
	}
	local function mute(item: Instance)
		if not item:IsA("Sound") or (item.Name ~= "Running" and item.Name ~= "Landing") then
			return
		end
		local name = item.Name
		local mix = {
			volume = item.Volume,
			minimum = item.RollOffMinDistance,
			maximum = item.RollOffMaxDistance,
			mode = item.RollOffMode,
		}
		record.defaults[name] = mix
		table.insert(
			record.connections,
			item:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Volume"):Connect(function()
				if item.Volume ~= 0 then
					mix.volume = item.Volume
					item.Volume = 0
				end
			end)
		)
		item.Volume = 0
	end
	for _, item in character:GetDescendants() do
		mute(item)
	end
	table.insert(record.connections, character.DescendantAdded:Connect(mute))
	records[player] = record
	return record
end

local function update(player: Player, record: any, dt: number, excluded: { Instance })
	local character = record.character :: Model
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
	if not humanoid or not root then
		return
	end
	local revision = character:GetAttribute("SpawnRevision")
	if record.revision ~= revision then
		record.state, record.previous, record.revision = Cues.new(), nil, revision
	end
	local position = root.Position
	local previous = record.previous or position
	record.previous = position
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = excluded
	params.RespectCanCollide = true
	local leg = character:FindFirstChild("Left Leg") :: BasePart?
	local height = root.Size.Y / 2 + humanoid.HipHeight
	if humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 and leg then
		height += leg.Size.Y
	end
	local floor = workspace:Raycast(position, Vector3.new(0, -height - 0.7, 0), params)
	local state = humanoid:GetState()
	local grounded = floor ~= nil
		and state ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping
		and state ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall
	local floorVelocity = Vector3.zero
	if floor and floor.Instance:IsA("BasePart") then
		floorVelocity = floor.Instance.AssemblyLinearVelocity
	end
	local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity - floorVelocity
	local delta = position - previous - floorVelocity * dt
	local distance = Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z).Magnitude
	local speed = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z).Magnitude
	local mode = player:GetAttribute("Mode")
	local enabled = (mode == "Practice" or mode == "Match")
		and humanoid.Health > 0
		and character:GetAttribute("Dead") ~= true
		and character:GetAttribute("Frozen") ~= true
		and not root.Anchored
		and (
			state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running
			or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.RunningNoPhysics
			or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Landed
			or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping
			or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall
		)
	local event = Cues.advance(record.state, dt, distance, grounded, speed, velocity.Y, enabled)
	if not event or not floor then
		return
	end
	local cue = if event == "Landing" then "Landing" else Cues.surface(floor.Material.Name)
	if not cue then
		return
	end
	local mix = record.defaults[if event == "Landing" then "Landing" else "Running"]
	-- Wait for the engine sound's audibility settings instead of inventing a range.
	if not mix then
		return
	end
	local sound = Audio.play(cue, { parent = root, volume = mix.volume / 0.65 })
	if sound then
		sound.RollOffMinDistance = mix.minimum
		sound.RollOffMaxDistance = mix.maximum
		sound.RollOffMode = mix.mode
	end
end

function MovementAudio.start()
	if started then
		return
	end
	for _, name in { "StepConcrete", "StepMetal", "StepSand", "StepWood", "Landing" } do
		if not Audio.configured(name) then
			return -- Keep defaults when this replacement set is unavailable.
		end
	end
	started = true
	local elapsed = 0
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		elapsed += dt
		if elapsed < 0.05 then
			return
		end
		local step = elapsed
		elapsed = 0
		local excluded: { Instance } = {}
		local active: { [Player]: boolean } = {}
		for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
			active[player] = true
			if player.Character then
				table.insert(excluded, player.Character)
			end
		end
		for player, record in records do
			if not active[player] or player.Character ~= record.character then
				dispose(record)
				records[player] = nil
			end
		end
		for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
			local character = player.Character
			if character then
				update(player, records[player] or bind(player, character), step, excluded)
			end
		end
	end)
end

return MovementAudio

--!strict
-- Local movement feel on top of Roblox's Humanoid:
--   * crouch (hold or toggle): lowers the body for real (HipHeight) so the hitbox drops
--   * limited air control: steering mid-air blends toward the input instead of snapping
--   * hides your own body in first person
--   * sends your aim pitch (throttled) so others see where you're looking
-- No sprint/slide/double-jump by design (see GAME_DESIGN.md).

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local GameConfig = require(Shared.Config.GameConfig)
local Net = require(Shared.Net)

local InputController = require(script.Parent.InputController)
local Settings = require(script.Parent.Settings)
local CameraController = require(script.Parent.CameraController)

local MovementController = {}
MovementController.crouching = false

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local M = GameConfig.Movement
local playerAction: RemoteEvent
local baseHipHeight = 2
local airVelocity: Vector3? = nil
local lastLookSent = 0
local lastPitchSent = 0

local function humanoidAndRoot(): (Humanoid?, BasePart?)
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid and humanoid.RootPart and humanoid.Health > 0 then
		return humanoid, humanoid.RootPart
	end
	return nil, nil
end

function MovementController.setCrouch(on: boolean)
	if MovementController.crouching == on then
		return
	end
	local humanoid = humanoidAndRoot()
	if not humanoid then
		return
	end
	MovementController.crouching = on
	local character = player.Character :: Model
	humanoid.HipHeight = if on then baseHipHeight - M.CrouchHipDrop else baseHipHeight
	if character:GetAttribute("Frozen") ~= true then
		humanoid.WalkSpeed = if on then M.CrouchSpeed else M.WalkSpeed
	end
	playerAction:FireServer("Crouch", on)
end

local function onCharacter(character: Model)
	MovementController.crouching = false
	airVelocity = nil
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10) :: Humanoid?
	if humanoid then
		baseHipHeight = humanoid.HipHeight
		humanoid.UseJumpPower = false
		humanoid.JumpHeight = M.JumpHeight
	end
	-- First person: hide our own body, hats and world gun from ourselves
	local function hide(d: Instance)
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			d.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
			d:GetPropertyChangedSignal("LocalTransparencyModifier"):Connect(function()
				if d.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= 1 and character:GetAttribute("Dead") ~= true then
					d.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
				end
			end)
		elseif d:IsA("Decal") then
			d.Transparency = 1
		end
	end
	for _, d in character:GetDescendants() do
		hide(d)
	end
	character.DescendantAdded:Connect(hide)
	-- Show the ragdoll when dead
	character:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Dead"):Connect(function()
		if character:GetAttribute("Dead") == true then
			for _, d in character:GetDescendants() do
				if d:IsA("BasePart") then
					d.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

-- Runs after Roblox's control script each frame so we can shape the move direction.
local function shapeMovement(dt: number)
	local humanoid, root = humanoidAndRoot()
	if not humanoid or not root then
		return
	end
	local airborne = humanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air
	if airborne then
		-- Limited air control: keep most of the take-off momentum, steer a little
		local wanted = humanoid.MoveDirection
		local current = airVelocity or wanted
		local blend = 1 - math.exp(-dt * 6 * M.AirControl)
		local blended = current:Lerp(wanted, blend)
		airVelocity = blended
		humanoid:Move(blended, false)
	else
		airVelocity = humanoid.MoveDirection
	end

	-- Aim pitch for third-person poses (throttled)
	local now = os.clock()
	local pitch = CameraController.pitch
	if now - lastLookSent > 1 / GameConfig.Network.LookUpdateRate and math.abs(pitch - lastPitchSent) > 0.02 then
		lastLookSent = now
		lastPitchSent = pitch
		playerAction:FireServer("Look", math.floor(pitch * 100 + 0.5) / 100)
	end
end

function MovementController.start()
	playerAction = Net.event("PlayerAction")
	InputController.Action:Connect(function(action, pressed)
		if action ~= "Crouch" then
			return
		end
		if Settings.values.crouchToggle then
			if pressed then
				MovementController.setCrouch(not MovementController.crouching)
			end
		else
			MovementController.setCrouch(pressed)
		end
	end)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacter)
	if player.Character then
		task.spawn(onCharacter, player.Character)
	end
	RunService:BindToRenderStep("DoublePumpMovement", Enum.RenderPriority.Input.Value + 1, shapeMovement)
end

return MovementController

--!strict
-- Caches the local player's profile snapshot (level, coins, stats, cosmetics,
-- challenges) sent by the server, and wraps shop/equip requests.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local Net = require(Shared.Net)
local Signal = require(Shared.Util.Signal)
local Cosmetics = require(Shared.Progression.Cosmetics)

local ProfileClient = {}

ProfileClient.data = nil :: any
ProfileClient.Changed = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<any>
ProfileClient.Reward = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<any>
ProfileClient.Unlocked = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<any>

local skinListeners: { (any) -> () } = {}

local function setData(snapshot: any)
	if typeof(snapshot) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	local previousSkin = ProfileClient.data and ProfileClient.data.equipped and ProfileClient.data.equipped.skin
	ProfileClient.data = snapshot
	ProfileClient.Changed:Fire(snapshot)
	local skin = snapshot.equipped and snapshot.equipped.skin
	if skin ~= previousSkin then
		for _, fn in skinListeners do
			fn(Cosmetics.skin(skin))
		end
	end
end

function ProfileClient.get(): any
	return ProfileClient.data
end

function ProfileClient.loaded(): boolean
	return ProfileClient.data ~= nil
end

function ProfileClient.owns(id: string): boolean
	local d = ProfileClient.data
	return d ~= nil and d.owned ~= nil and d.owned[id] == true
end

function ProfileClient.onSkin(fn: (any) -> ())
	table.insert(skinListeners, fn)
	local d = ProfileClient.data
	fn(Cosmetics.skin(d and d.equipped and d.equipped.skin))
end

function ProfileClient.buy(id: string)
	Net.event("ShopAction"):FireServer("Buy", id)
end

function ProfileClient.equip(id: string)
	Net.event("ShopAction"):FireServer("Equip", "skin", id)
end

function ProfileClient.buyPack(key: string)
	Net.event("ShopAction"):FireServer("BuyRobux", key)
end

function ProfileClient.leaderboards(): any
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return Net.func("GetLeaderboards"):InvokeServer()
	end)
	return if ok then result else nil
end

function ProfileClient.start()
	Net.event("ProfileEvent").OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind: string, data: any)
		if kind == "Profile" then
			setData(data)
		elseif kind == "Reward" then
			ProfileClient.Reward:Fire(data)
		elseif kind == "Unlock" then
			ProfileClient.Unlocked:Fire(data)
		end
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		-- The server pushes the profile once loaded; ask too in case we missed it.
		for _ = 1, 10 do
			if ProfileClient.data then
				return
			end
			local ok, result = pcall(function()
				return Net.func("GetProfile"):InvokeServer()
			end)
			if ok and result then
				setData(result)
				return
			end
			task.wait(2)
		end
	end)
end

return ProfileClient

--!strict
-- The local player's settings. Defaults here; the saved copy comes from the server
-- profile (DataService persists it) and is applied when it arrives.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local GameConfig = require(Shared.Config.GameConfig)
local Signal = require(Shared.Util.Signal)
local Net = require(Shared.Net)
local Preferences = require(Shared.Preferences)

local Settings = {}

export type Values = {
	sensitivity: number,
	gamepadSensitivity: number,
	touchSensitivity: number,
	fov: number,
	masterVolume: number,
	musicVolume: number,
	effectsVolume: number,
	crouchToggle: boolean,
	wheelSwitching: boolean,
	showDamageNumbers: boolean,
	reducedEffects: boolean,
	cameraBob: boolean,
	crosshairStyle: string, -- "Cross" | "Dot" | "Circle" | "CrossDot"
	crosshairColor: string, -- key into CROSSHAIR_COLORS
	crosshairSize: number, -- 0.6 .. 1.6
	touchLayout: { [string]: { number } }, -- button -> {xScale, yScale}
	touchLayoutV2: { [string]: { number } },
	controlLayout: string,
	weaponHand: string,
	tutorialDone: boolean,
}

Settings.CROSSHAIR_COLORS = {
	White = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
	Green = Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 120),
	Yellow = Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 60),
	Cyan = Color3.fromRGB(60, 230, 255),
	Pink = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 200),
}

local DEFAULTS: Values = {
	sensitivity = GameConfig.Camera.DefaultSensitivity,
	gamepadSensitivity = 1,
	touchSensitivity = 1,
	fov = GameConfig.Camera.DefaultFov,
	masterVolume = 0.8,
	musicVolume = 0.5,
	effectsVolume = 1,
	crouchToggle = false,
	wheelSwitching = true,
	showDamageNumbers = true,
	reducedEffects = false,
	cameraBob = true,
	crosshairStyle = "CrossDot",
	crosshairColor = "White",
	crosshairSize = 1,
	touchLayout = {},
	touchLayoutV2 = {},
	controlLayout = "right",
	weaponHand = "right",
	tutorialDone = false,
}

Settings.values = table.clone(DEFAULTS)
Settings.Changed = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<Values>

-- Copies known keys with the right types from a saved table.
function Settings.apply(saved: any)
	if typeof(saved) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	for key, default in DEFAULTS do
		local value = saved[key]
		if value ~= nil and typeof(value) == typeof(default) then
			(Settings.values :: any)[key] = value
		end
	end
	local presentation = Preferences.normalize(saved)
	Settings.values.controlLayout = presentation.controlLayout
	Settings.values.weaponHand = presentation.weaponHand
	Settings.Changed:Fire(Settings.values)
end

function Settings.set(key: string, value: any)
	(Settings.values :: any)[key] = value
	Settings.Changed:Fire(Settings.values)
end

local saveQueued = false
-- Saves (debounced) to the server profile.
function Settings.save()
	if saveQueued then
		return
	end
	saveQueued = true
	task.delay(1.5, function()
		saveQueued = false
		Net.event("SettingsAction"):FireServer("Save", Settings.values)
	end)
end

function Settings.reset()
	Settings.values = table.clone(DEFAULTS)
	Settings.Changed:Fire(Settings.values)
	Settings.save()
end

Settings.DEFAULTS = DEFAULTS

return Settings

--!strict
-- The first-person view: two copies of the imported high-detail shotgun (one per slot,
-- each with its own animation state), simple arms, weapon sway, walk bob and wall
-- avoidance. Purely visual: it listens to WeaponController and never changes game state,
-- so cancelling an animation can't affect cooldowns.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local AnimPlayer = require(Shared.Weapons.AnimPlayer)
local ShotgunModel = require(Shared.Weapons.ShotgunModel)
local ShotgunRig = require(Shared.Weapons.ShotgunRig)
local WeaponConfig = require(Shared.Config.WeaponConfig)
local Signal = require(Shared.Util.Signal)

local WeaponController = require(script.Parent.WeaponController)
local CameraController = require(script.Parent.CameraController)
local MovementController = require(script.Parent.MovementController)
local Settings = require(script.Parent.Settings)
local Presentation = require(Shared.Mobile.Presentation)

local ViewmodelController = {}

-- (slot, worldCFrame) when a spent shell leaves the port
ViewmodelController.ShellEjected = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<number, CFrame>
-- (slot, event) animation beats for sounds: "PumpBack", "PumpForward", "ShellInserted", ...
ViewmodelController.AnimEvent = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<number, string>
-- (slot, playbackSpeed) when a pump cycle starts (the pump sound is timed to the animation)
ViewmodelController.PumpStarted = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<number, number>

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local T = WeaponConfig.Timing

type Gun = {
	slot: number,
	model: ShotgunModel.ShotgunModel,
	anim: AnimPlayer.AnimPlayer,
	visible: boolean,
	lowering: boolean,
	needsPump: boolean,
	reloading: boolean,
}

local guns: { Gun } = {}
local folder: Folder
local arms: { [string]: { BasePart } } = { right = {}, left = {} }
local swayRot = CFrame.identity
local lastCamLook: CFrame? = nil
local moveOffset = Vector3.zero
local wallPush = 0
local swayTime = 0
local enabled = false
local skinDef: any = nil

local SWAP_SPEED = 0.1167 / T.SwapTime -- SwapIn's Ready event lands at the end of SwapTime
local EQUIP_SPEED = 0.3333 / T.EquipTime
local INSERT_SPEED = 0.6 / T.ReloadInsertTime

local function onEvent(gun: Gun)
	return function(event: string)
		ViewmodelController.AnimEvent:Fire(gun.slot, event)
		if event == "EjectShell" then
			gun.model:setShellVisible("Spent", false)
			ViewmodelController.ShellEjected:Fire(gun.slot, gun.model:point("ShellEject"))
		elseif event == "PumpForward" then
			gun.needsPump = false
		elseif event == "ShellInserted" then
			gun.model:setShellVisible("Live", false)
		end
	end
end

local function playPump(gun: Gun)
	gun.model:setShellVisible("Spent", true)
	-- Fit the pump into whatever is left of this gun's cooldown (never slower than 1x)
	local view = WeaponController.view(gun.slot)
	local remaining = math.max(view.cooldownRemaining - 0.05, 0.25)
	local speed = math.max(1, gun.anim:duration("Pump") / remaining)
	gun.anim:play("Pump", { speed = speed, fadeIn = 0.04, onEvent = onEvent(gun) })
	ViewmodelController.PumpStarted:Fire(gun.slot, speed)
end

local function setVisible(gun: Gun, visible: boolean)
	gun.visible = visible
	gun.model:setVisible(visible)
	if not visible then
		gun.model:setShellVisible("Spent", false)
		gun.model:setShellVisible("Live", false)
	end
end

local function playInsert(gun: Gun)
	gun.model:setShellVisible("Live", true)
	gun.anim:play("ReloadInsert", {
		speed = INSERT_SPEED,
		fadeIn = 0.03,
		onEvent = onEvent(gun),
		onEnd = function()
			if gun.reloading then
				playInsert(gun)
			end
		end,
	})
end

local function onEquipped(slot: number, previous: number?, isSpawn: boolean)
	for _, gun in guns do
		if gun.slot == slot then
			setVisible(gun, true)
			gun.lowering = false
			gun.reloading = false
			gun.model:setShellVisible("Live", false)
			local name = if isSpawn then "Equip" else "SwapIn"
			gun.anim:play(name, {
				speed = if isSpawn then EQUIP_SPEED else SWAP_SPEED,
				fadeIn = 0,
				onEvent = onEvent(gun),
				onEnd = function()
					if gun.needsPump and WeaponController.state.equipped == gun.slot then
						playPump(gun)
					end
				end,
			})
		elseif gun.visible and (gun.slot == previous or isSpawn) then
			gun.reloading = false
			if isSpawn then
				setVisible(gun, false)
			else
				gun.lowering = true
				gun.anim:play("Unequip", {
					speed = SWAP_SPEED,
					fadeIn = 0.02,
					hold = true,
					onEvent = function(event)
						if event == "Hidden" and gun.lowering then
							setVisible(gun, false)
						end
					end,
				})
			end
		end
	end
end

local function onFired(info: WeaponController.FireInfo)
	local gun = guns[info.slot]
	if not gun then
		return
	end
	gun.reloading = false
	gun.needsPump = true
	gun.model:setShellVisible("Live", false)
	CameraController.kick(if MovementController.crouching then 0.8 else 1)
	gun.anim:play("Fire", {
		fadeIn = 0,
		onEvent = function(event)
			if event == "RecoverEnd" and WeaponController.state.equipped == gun.slot then
				playPump(gun)
			end
		end,
	})
end

function ViewmodelController.muzzle(slot: number?): CFrame?
	local gun = guns[slot or WeaponController.state.equipped]
	if gun and gun.visible then
		return gun.model:point("Muzzle")
	end
	return nil
end

local function makeArmPart(name: string, color: Color3, material: Enum.Material, size: Vector3): BasePart
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = name
	part.Size = size
	part.Color = color
	part.Material = material
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CastShadow = false
	part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	part.Parent = folder
	return part
end

local function buildArms()
	for _, list in arms do
		for _, p in list do
			p:Destroy()
		end
		table.clear(list)
	end
	local team = player.Team
	local sleeve = if team
		then team.TeamColor.Color:Lerp(Color3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.12), 0.35)
		else Color3.fromRGB(60, 64, 76)
	local glove = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 36)
	for _, side in { "right", "left" } do
		local list = arms[side]
		table.insert(list, makeArmPart("Sleeve", sleeve, Enum.Material.Fabric, Vector3.new(0.42, 0.42, 1)))
		table.insert(list, makeArmPart("Cuff", glove, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Vector3.new(0.36, 0.36, 0.25)))
		table.insert(list, makeArmPart("Glove", glove, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, Vector3.new(0.3, 0.26, 0.4)))
	end
end

local function placeArm(list: { BasePart }, shoulder: Vector3, hand: CFrame)
	local handPos = hand.Position
	local delta = handPos - shoulder
	local length = delta.Magnitude
	if length < 0.05 then
		return
	end
	local dir = delta.Unit
	local elbowEnd = handPos - dir * 0.3
	local sleeveLen = math.max((elbowEnd - shoulder).Magnitude, 0.1)
	local sleeve, cuff, glove = list[1], list[2], list[3]
	sleeve.Size = Vector3.new(0.42, 0.42, sleeveLen)
	sleeve.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(shoulder:Lerp(elbowEnd, 0.5), elbowEnd)
	cuff.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(elbowEnd, handPos)
	glove.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(handPos - dir * 0.1, handPos + dir)
end

local function update(dt: number)
	if not enabled or #guns == 0 then
		return
	end
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local camCF = camera.CFrame
	local character = player.Character
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?

	-- Sway: the gun lags slightly behind fast camera turns
	if lastCamLook then
		local delta = (lastCamLook :: CFrame):ToObjectSpace(camCF)
		local rx, ry = delta:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
		local target = CFrame.Angles(
			math.clamp(rx * 0.6, -0.08, 0.08),
			math.clamp(ry * 0.6, -0.08, 0.08),
			math.clamp(-ry * 0.8, -0.1, 0.1)
		)
		swayRot = swayRot:Lerp(target, 1 - math.exp(-dt * 12))
	end
	lastCamLook = camCF

	-- Walk bob + crouch dip
	local speed = if root then (root.AssemblyLinearVelocity * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)).Magnitude else 0
	swayTime += dt * (2 + speed * 0.45)
	local walk = math.min(speed / 20, 1)
	local targetMove = Vector3.new(
		math.sin(swayTime) * 0.035 * walk,
		math.abs(math.cos(swayTime)) * -0.04 * walk + (if MovementController.crouching then -0.05 else 0),
		0
	)
	moveOffset = moveOffset:Lerp(targetMove, 1 - math.exp(-dt * 10))

	-- Wall avoidance: pull the gun back and down when standing against geometry
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { folder, character :: Instance }
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(camCF.Position, camCF.LookVector * 3.2, params)
	local targetPush = if hit then math.clamp(1 - (hit.Distance - 0.6) / 2.6, 0, 1) else 0
	wallPush += (targetPush - wallPush) * (1 - math.exp(-dt * 12))

	local base = camCF
		* CFrame.new(moveOffset)
		* swayRot
		* ShotgunRig.ViewmodelOffset
		* CFrame.new(0, -0.25 * wallPush, 0.9 * wallPush)
		* CFrame.Angles(-0.5 * wallPush, 0.25 * wallPush, 0)
	local left = Settings.values.weaponHand == "left"
	if left then
		base = camCF * Presentation.reflect(camCF:ToObjectSpace(base))
	end

	local equipped = WeaponController.state.equipped
	for _, gun in guns do
		local pose = gun.anim:update(dt)
		if left then
			local mirrored = {}
			for name, delta in pose do
				mirrored[name] = Presentation.reflect(delta)
			end
			pose = mirrored
		end
		if gun.visible then
			gun.model:setRoot(base)
			gun.model:setPose(pose)
		end
	end
	-- Hands on the equipped gun
	local gun = guns[equipped]
	if gun and gun.visible then
		local shoulderR = (camCF * CFrame.new(1.05, -1.55, 0.7)).Position
		local shoulderL = (camCF * CFrame.new(-0.35, -1.7, 0.1)).Position
		if left then
			shoulderR = (camCF * CFrame.new(0.35, -1.7, 0.1)).Position
			shoulderL = (camCF * CFrame.new(-1.05, -1.55, 0.7)).Position
		end
		placeArm(if left then arms.left else arms.right, if left then shoulderL else shoulderR, gun.model:point("Grip"))
		placeArm(
			if left then arms.right else arms.left,
			if left then shoulderR else shoulderL,
			gun.model:point("SupportHand")
		)
		for _, list in arms do
			for _, p in list do
				p.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
			end
		end
	else
		for _, list in arms do
			for _, p in list do
				p.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
			end
		end
	end
end

local function build()
	for _, gun in guns do
		gun.model:destroy()
	end
	table.clear(guns)
	for slot = 1, 2 do
		local model = ShotgunModel.new("FirstPerson")
		model:applySkin(skinDef)
		model.model.Name = "Viewmodel_" .. slot
		model.model.Parent = folder
		local anim = AnimPlayer.new("FirstPerson")
		anim:playBase("Idle")
		local gun: Gun = {
			slot = slot,
			model = model,
			anim = anim,
			visible = false,
			lowering = false,
			needsPump = false,
			reloading = false,
		}
		model:setVisible(false)
		guns[slot] = gun
	end
	buildArms()
end

function ViewmodelController.setSkin(skin: any)
	skinDef = skin
	for _, gun in guns do
		gun.model:applySkin(skin)
	end
end

function ViewmodelController.setEnabled(on: boolean)
	enabled = on
	folder.Parent = if on then workspace.CurrentCamera else nil
end

function ViewmodelController.start()
	folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "Viewmodel"
	table.insert(WeaponController.excluded, folder)
	build()

	WeaponController.Equipped:Connect(onEquipped)
	WeaponController.Fired:Connect(onFired)
	WeaponController.Reset:Connect(function()
		for _, gun in guns do
			gun.needsPump = false
			gun.reloading = false
		end
		buildArms()
	end)
	WeaponController.ReloadStarted:Connect(function(slot)
		local gun = guns[slot]
		if not gun then
			return
		end
		gun.reloading = true
		gun.anim:play("ReloadStart", {
			fadeIn = 0.05,
			onEvent = onEvent(gun),
			onEnd = function()
				if gun.reloading then
					playInsert(gun)
				end
			end,
		})
	end)
	WeaponController.ReloadEnded:Connect(function(slot, completed)
		local gun = guns[slot]
		if not gun or not gun.reloading then
			return
		end
		gun.reloading = false
		gun.model:setShellVisible("Live", false)
		if completed and WeaponController.state.equipped == slot then
			gun.anim:play("ReloadEnd", { fadeIn = 0.05, onEvent = onEvent(gun) })
		end
	end)
	player:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Team"):Connect(buildArms)
	RunService:BindToRenderStep("DoublePumpViewmodel", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 2, update)
end

return ViewmodelController

--!strict
-- Client side of the two shotguns. Runs the same WeaponState rules as the server so the
-- game reacts the instant you click (prediction), raycasts the pellets locally, and sends
-- the result for the server to validate. The server's snapshot wins on any disagreement.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local Collision = require(Shared.Collision)
local Combatants = require(Shared.Combatants)
local GameConfig = require(Shared.Config.GameConfig)
local Net = require(Shared.Net)
local Signal = require(Shared.Util.Signal)
local Spread = require(Shared.Weapons.Spread)
local WeaponConfig = require(Shared.Config.WeaponConfig)
local WeaponState = require(Shared.Weapons.WeaponState)

local InputController = require(script.Parent.InputController)
local MovementController = require(script.Parent.MovementController)

local WeaponController = {}

export type PelletResult = {
	position: Vector3,
	normal: Vector3,
	instance: Instance?,
	material: Enum.Material?,
	isCharacter: boolean,
}
export type FireInfo = {
	slot: number,
	origin: Vector3,
	aim: Vector3,
	directions: { Vector3 },
	pellets: { PelletResult },
	shotNumber: number,
}

WeaponController.Fired = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<FireInfo>
WeaponController.Equipped = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<number, number?, boolean> -- slot, previous, isSpawn
WeaponController.ReloadStarted = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<number>
WeaponController.ShellInserted = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<number, number>
WeaponController.ReloadEnded = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<number, boolean> -- slot, completed
WeaponController.DryFire = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<number>
WeaponController.HitConfirmed = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<{ any }>
WeaponController.Rejected = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<string?>
WeaponController.Reset = Signal.new() :: Signal.Signal<>

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local rules = WeaponState.rulesFromConfig(WeaponConfig)
WeaponController.state = WeaponState.new(rules, os.clock())
WeaponController.active = false -- alive and allowed to shoot
WeaponController.excluded = {} :: { Instance } -- extra instances pellets ignore (viewmodel, effects)

local weaponAction: RemoteEvent
local bufferedUntil = 0
local lastReloadShells: { [number]: number } = {}
local wasReloading: { [number]: boolean } = {}

local function state()
	return WeaponController.state
end

local function canAct(): boolean
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	return WeaponController.active
		and humanoid ~= nil
		and humanoid.Health > 0
		and character:GetAttribute("Frozen") ~= true
end

local function castPellets(origin: Vector3, directions: { Vector3 }): ({ PelletResult }, { any })
	local character = player.Character
	local exclude: { Instance } = { character :: Instance }
	for _, inst in WeaponController.excluded do
		table.insert(exclude, inst)
	end
	local params = Collision.shotParams(exclude)
	local maxRange = WeaponConfig.Damage.MaxRange
	local results: { PelletResult } = {}
	local hits = {}
	for i, direction in directions do
		local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction * maxRange, params)
		if result then
			local model = Combatants.fromPart(result.Instance)
			results[i] = {
				position = result.Position,
				normal = result.Normal,
				instance = result.Instance,
				material = result.Material,
				isCharacter = model ~= nil,
			}
			if model and character and Combatants.isEnemy(character, model) and Combatants.isAlive(model) then
				table.insert(hits, { i = i, part = result.Instance, pos = result.Position })
			end
		else
			results[i] = {
				position = origin + direction * maxRange,
				normal = -direction,
				instance = nil,
				material = nil,
				isCharacter = false,
			}
		end
	end
	return results, hits
end

local function doFire(now: number)
	local s = state()
	local slot = s.equipped
	local ok, _, shotNumber = WeaponState.fire(s, slot, now)
	if not ok then
		return
	end
	bufferedUntil = 0
	local character = player.Character :: Model
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") :: Humanoid
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local origin = camera.CFrame.Position
	local aim = camera.CFrame.LookVector
	local airborne = humanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air
	local multiplier = Spread.stateMultiplier(WeaponConfig.Spread, MovementController.crouching, airborne)
	local directions = Spread.directions(WeaponConfig.Spread, aim, shotNumber, multiplier)
	local pellets, hits = castPellets(origin, directions)

	weaponAction:FireServer("Fire", {
		slot = slot,
		origin = origin,
		aim = aim,
		air = airborne,
		hits = hits,
	})
	if wasReloading[slot] then
		wasReloading[slot] = false
		WeaponController.ReloadEnded:Fire(slot, false)
	end
	WeaponController.Fired:Fire({
		slot = slot,
		origin = origin,
		aim = aim,
		directions = directions,
		pellets = pellets,
		shotNumber = shotNumber,
	})
end

-- Seconds until the equipped gun could fire (ignoring ammo); 0 if now.
local function timeUntilReady(now: number): number
	local s = state()
	local slot = s.slots[s.equipped]
	return math.max(0, s.readyAt - now, slot.nextFireTime - now, s.nextShotTime - now)
end

function WeaponController.tryFire()
	if not canAct() then
		return
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	local s = state()
	local ok, reason = WeaponState.canFire(s, s.equipped, now)
	if ok then
		doFire(now)
	elseif reason == "Empty" then
		WeaponController.DryFire:Fire(s.equipped)
		if WeaponConfig.Ammo.AutoReloadWhenEmpty then
			WeaponController.reload()
		end
	elseif reason == "Swapping" or reason == "Cooldown" or reason == "ShotInterval" or reason == "Reloading" then
		-- Remember a slightly early press so it isn't lost
		if reason ~= "Reloading" and timeUntilReady(now) <= WeaponConfig.Timing.InputBuffer then
			bufferedUntil = now + WeaponConfig.Timing.InputBuffer + 0.02
		end
	end
end

-- Mobile requests use exactly the same prediction and remote path, without a
-- desktop input buffer that could outlive the owning fire finger.
function WeaponController.mobileReady(): (boolean, string?)
	if not canAct() then
		return false, "Inactive"
	end
	local s = state()
	return WeaponState.canFire(s, s.equipped, os.clock())
end

function WeaponController.fireMobile()
	local ready, reason = WeaponController.mobileReady()
	if ready then
		doFire(os.clock())
	elseif reason == "Empty" then
		WeaponController.DryFire:Fire(state().equipped)
		if WeaponConfig.Ammo.AutoReloadWhenEmpty then
			WeaponController.reload()
		end
	end
end

function WeaponController.equip(slot: number): boolean
	if not canAct() then
		return false
	end
	local s = state()
	local previous = s.equipped
	local reloadingBefore = wasReloading[previous]
	if WeaponState.equip(s, slot, os.clock()) then
		bufferedUntil = 0
		weaponAction:FireServer("Equip", slot)
		if reloadingBefore then
			wasReloading[previous] = false
			WeaponController.ReloadEnded:Fire(previous, false)
		end
		WeaponController.Equipped:Fire(slot, previous, false)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function WeaponController.swap()
	WeaponController.equip(WeaponState.otherSlot(state()))
end

function WeaponController.reload()
	if not canAct() then
		return
	end
	local s = state()
	if WeaponState.startReload(s, os.clock()) then
		weaponAction:FireServer("Reload")
		wasReloading[s.equipped] = true
		lastReloadShells[s.equipped] = s.slots[s.equipped].ammo
		WeaponController.ReloadStarted:Fire(s.equipped)
	end
end

function WeaponController.view(slot: number): WeaponState.SlotView
	return WeaponState.view(state(), slot, os.clock())
end

local function applySnapshot(snap: any)
	if typeof(snap) ~= "table" or typeof(snap.slots) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	local s = state()
	local now = os.clock()
	local previous = s.equipped
	s.equipped = snap.equipped
	s.shotCounter = snap.shotCounter
	s.readyAt = now + snap.readyIn
	s.nextShotTime = if snap.shotIn > 0 then now + snap.shotIn else -math.huge
	for i, slotSnap in snap.slots do
		local slot = s.slots[i]
		if slot then
			slot.ammo = slotSnap.ammo
			slot.nextFireTime = if slotSnap.cooldown > 0 then now + slotSnap.cooldown else -math.huge
			if slotSnap.reloading and not slot.reloading then
				slot.reloading = true
				slot.reloadBaseAmmo = slotSnap.ammo
				slot.reloadStartedAt = now - WeaponConfig.Timing.ReloadStartTime
			elseif not slotSnap.reloading then
				slot.reloading = false
			end
		end
	end
	if previous ~= s.equipped then
		WeaponController.Equipped:Fire(s.equipped, previous, false)
	end
end

local function onWeaponEvent(kind: string, a: any, b: any)
	if kind == "Snapshot" then
		applySnapshot(a)
		if b then
			WeaponController.Rejected:Fire(b)
		end
	elseif kind == "Hit" then
		WeaponController.HitConfirmed:Fire(a)
