	elseif kind == "Reset" then
		WeaponController.state = WeaponState.new(rules, os.clock())
		table.clear(wasReloading)
		bufferedUntil = 0
		WeaponController.Reset:Fire()
		WeaponController.Equipped:Fire(1, nil, true)
	end
end

local function step()
	local now = os.clock()
	local s = state()
	-- Buffered press
	if bufferedUntil > 0 then
		if now > bufferedUntil then
			bufferedUntil = 0
		elseif canAct() and WeaponState.canFire(s, s.equipped, now) then
			doFire(now)
		end
	end
	-- Testing option: hold to keep firing
	if GameConfig.Debug.AutoFireWhenHeld and InputController.isHeld("Fire") and canAct() then
		if WeaponState.canFire(s, s.equipped, now) then
			doFire(now)
		end
	end
	-- Reload progress events for animations and sounds
	local slotIndex = s.equipped
	if wasReloading[slotIndex] then
		local view = WeaponState.view(s, slotIndex, now)
		local before = lastReloadShells[slotIndex] or view.ammo
		if view.ammo > before then
			for n = before + 1, view.ammo do
				WeaponController.ShellInserted:Fire(slotIndex, n)
			end
			lastReloadShells[slotIndex] = view.ammo
		end
		WeaponState.syncReload(s, slotIndex, now)
		if not s.slots[slotIndex].reloading then
			wasReloading[slotIndex] = false
			WeaponController.ReloadEnded:Fire(slotIndex, true)
		end
	end
end

function WeaponController.start()
	weaponAction = Net.event("WeaponAction")
	Net.event("WeaponEvent").OnClientEvent:Connect(onWeaponEvent)

	InputController.Action:Connect(function(action, pressed)
		if action == "Fire" and pressed then
			WeaponController.tryFire()
		elseif action == "EquipA" then
			WeaponController.equip(1)
		elseif action == "EquipB" then
			WeaponController.equip(2)
		elseif action == "Swap" then
			WeaponController.swap()
		elseif action == "Reload" then
			WeaponController.reload()
		end
	end)
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(step)
end

return WeaponController

--!strict
-- Performance overlay, toggled with F2.
-- Shows frame rate, frame time, ping, client memory, instance count and the weapon
-- state the client is predicting. Off by default; only reads numbers, changes nothing.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Stats = game:GetService("Stats")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local Theme = require(script.Parent.Theme)
local UIRoot = require(script.Parent.UIRoot)
local WeaponController = require(script.Parent.Parent.Controllers.WeaponController)

local DebugOverlay = {}

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local gui: ScreenGui
local label: TextLabel
local frames = 0
local frameTimeSum = 0
local worst = 0
local elapsed = 0

local function update(dt: number)
	frames += 1
	frameTimeSum += dt
	worst = math.max(worst, dt)
	elapsed += dt
	if elapsed < 0.5 then
		return
	end
	local fps = frames / elapsed
	local avg = frameTimeSum / frames * 1000
	local ping = player:GetNetworkPing() * 2000 -- round trip in ms
	local memory = Stats:GetTotalMemoryUsageMb()
	local s = WeaponController.state
	local lines = {
		string.format("FPS %.0f   frame %.1f ms   worst %.1f ms", fps, avg, worst * 1000),
		string.format("Ping %.0f ms   Memory %.0f MB   Instances %d", ping, memory, Stats.InstanceCount),
		string.format("Parts in workspace %d", Stats.PrimitivesCount),
	}
	if s then
		for i = 1, 2 do
			local v = WeaponController.view(i)
			table.insert(
				lines,
				string.format(
					"Gun %d%s  shells %d  ready in %.2fs%s",
					i,
					if s.equipped == i then "*" else " ",
					v.ammo,
					v.cooldownRemaining,
					if v.reloading then "  reloading" else ""
				)
			)
		end
	end
	label.Text = table.concat(lines, "\n")
	frames, frameTimeSum, worst, elapsed = 0, 0, 0, 0
end

function DebugOverlay.start()
	local root
	gui, root = UIRoot.screen("DebugOverlay", 100)
	gui.Enabled = false
	label = Theme.label({
		Text = "",
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 120),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(620, 150),
		TextScaled = false,
		TextSize = 20,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
		FontFace = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/RobotoMono.json"),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.4,
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
		Parent = root,
	})
	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
		if not processed and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F2 then
			gui.Enabled = not gui.Enabled
		end
	end)
	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
		if gui.Enabled then
			update(dt)
		end
	end)
end

return DebugOverlay

local function drawCrosshair()
	local center = refs.Crosshair :: Frame
	center:ClearAllChildren()
	local v = Settings.values
	local color = (Settings.CROSSHAIR_COLORS :: any)[v.crosshairColor] or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	local size = v.crosshairSize
	local style = v.crosshairStyle
	local function bar(x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number)
		new("Frame", {
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.new(0.5, x * size, 0.5, y * size),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w * size, h * size),
			BackgroundColor3 = color,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Parent = center,
		}, { Theme.stroke(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 1, 0.3) })
	end
	if style == "Cross" or style == "CrossDot" then
		-- Gap sized to the inner pellet ring so the crosshair shows the spread
		bar(-13, 0, 10, 2)
		bar(13, 0, 10, 2)
		bar(0, -13, 2, 10)
		bar(0, 13, 2, 10)
	end
	if style == "Dot" or style == "CrossDot" then
		bar(0, 0, 3, 3)
	end
	if style == "Circle" then
		local ring = new("Frame", {
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34 * size, 34 * size),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Parent = center,
		}, { Theme.corner(100), Theme.stroke(color, 2) })
		ring.Name = "Ring"
		bar(0, 0, 3, 3)
	end
end

-- Feedback

local hitToken = 0
function Hud.hitmarker(headshot: boolean, killed: boolean)
	hitToken += 1
	local token = hitToken
	local hit = refs.Hitmarker :: Frame
	local color = if killed then C.Hot elseif headshot then C.Gold else Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	for _, tick in hit:GetChildren() do
		if tick:IsA("Frame") then
			tick.BackgroundColor3 = color
			tick.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(if headshot or killed then 18 else 14, if headshot or killed then 4 else 3)
		end
	end
	hit.Visible = true
	refs.HitScale.Scale = if killed then 1.6 elseif headshot then 1.4 else 1.15
	Theme.tween(refs.HitScale, 0.12, { Scale = 1 })
	task.delay(if killed then 0.4 else 0.22, function()
		if token == hitToken then
			hit.Visible = false
		end
	end)
end

function Hud.damageNumber(amount: number, headshot: boolean)
	if not Settings.values.showDamageNumbers or amount <= 0 then
		return
	end
	local label = Theme.label({
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 40 + math.random(-10, 10), 0.5, -30 + math.random(-6, 6)),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(110, 40),
		Text = tostring(amount),
		TextColor3 = if headshot then C.Gold else Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
		FontFace = Theme.Fonts.Display,
		Outline = 2,
		Parent = root,
	})
	Theme.tween(label, 0.6, { Position = label.Position - UDim2.fromOffset(0, 40), TextTransparency = 1 })
	task.delay(0.65, function()
		label:Destroy()
	end)
end

local bannerToken = 0
function Hud.eliminationBanner(title: string, subtitle: string, color: Color3, big: boolean)
	bannerToken += 1
	local token = bannerToken
	refs.ElimTitle.Text = title
	refs.ElimTitle.TextColor3 = color
	refs.ElimSub.Text = subtitle
	refs.ElimBanner.Visible = true
	refs.ElimScale.Scale = if big then 1.6 else 1.25
	Theme.tween(refs.ElimScale, 0.18, { Scale = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	task.delay(if big then 2.2 else 1.6, function()
		if token == bannerToken then
			refs.ElimBanner.Visible = false
		end
	end)
end

function Hud.feed(data: any)
	local me = player.UserId
	local involved = data.killerUserId == me or data.victimUserId == me
	local row = new("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 34),
		AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
		BackgroundColor3 = if involved then C.PanelLight else C.Ink,
		BackgroundTransparency = if involved then 0.05 else 0.35,
		LayoutOrder = -os.clock() * 100,
		Parent = refs.Feed,
	}, {
		Theme.corner(8),
		Theme.padding(6),
		new("UIListLayout", {
			FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
			VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
			Padding = UDim.new(0, 8),
			SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
		}),
	})
	local function text(t: string, color: Color3, order: number, font: Font?)
		local label = Theme.label({
			Text = t,
			TextScaled = false,
			TextSize = 20,
			AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 22),
			TextColor3 = color,
			FontFace = font or Theme.Fonts.Heavy,
			LayoutOrder = order,
			Outline = false,
			Parent = row,
		})
		return label
	end
	if data.killer ~= "" then
		text(data.killer, Theme.teamColor(data.killerTeam), 1)
	end
	local icon = if data.doublePump then "✦✦ DOUBLE PUMP" elseif data.headshot then "◎ PUMP" else "PUMP"
	text(icon, if data.doublePump then C.Accent elseif data.headshot then C.Gold else C.TextDim, 2, Theme.Fonts.Display)
	text(data.victim, Theme.teamColor(data.victimTeam), 3)
	table.insert(feedEntries, row)
	while #feedEntries > 5 do
		(table.remove(feedEntries, 1) :: Frame):Destroy()
	end
	task.delay(6, function()
		if row.Parent then
			Theme.tween(row, 0.4, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
			for _, child in row:GetChildren() do
				if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
					Theme.tween(child, 0.4, { TextTransparency = 1 })
				end
			end
			task.delay(0.45, function()
				local i = table.find(feedEntries, row)
				if i then
					table.remove(feedEntries, i)
				end
				row:Destroy()
			end)
		end
	end)
end

-- Per-frame update

local function updateWeapons()
	local equipped = WeaponController.state.equipped
	for slot, card in slotCards do
		local view = WeaponController.view(slot)
		local isEquipped = slot == equipped
		for i, pip in card.pips do
			pip.BackgroundTransparency = if i <= view.ammo then 0 else 0.8
			local brass = pip:FindFirstChild("Brass") :: Frame?
			if brass then
				brass.BackgroundTransparency = pip.BackgroundTransparency
			end
		end
		local ready = view.cooldownRemaining <= 0
		card.bar.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1 - view.cooldownFraction, 1)
		card.bar.BackgroundColor3 = if ready then C.Good else C.Accent
		if view.reloading then
			card.status.Text = "RELOADING"
			card.status.TextColor3 = C.Accent
		elseif view.ammo == 0 then
			card.status.Text = "EMPTY — R"
			card.status.TextColor3 = C.Hot
		elseif ready then
			card.status.Text = if isEquipped then "READY" else "READY — SWAP!"
			card.status.TextColor3 = C.Good
		else
			card.status.Text = string.format("PUMPING %.1fs", view.cooldownRemaining)
			card.status.TextColor3 = C.TextDim
		end
		local targetScale = if isEquipped then 1 else 0.86
		card.scale.Scale += (targetScale - card.scale.Scale) * 0.35
		card.frame.BackgroundTransparency = if isEquipped then 0.02 else 0.35
		card.glow.Color = if isEquipped then C.Accent else C.Stroke
		card.glow.Thickness = if isEquipped then 3 else 2
		card.glow.Transparency = if isEquipped then 0 else 0.4
	end
	local kind = InputController.LastInputKind
	refs.SwapHint.Text = if kind == "Gamepad"
		then "RB  SWAP   •   X  RELOAD"
		elseif kind == "Touch" then ""
		else "Q  SWAP   •   R  RELOAD"
	for slot, card in slotCards do
		card.key.Text = if kind == "Gamepad" then (if slot == 1 then "◀" else "▶") else tostring(slot)
		card.key.Visible = kind ~= "Touch"
	end
end

local function updateHealth()
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local health = if humanoid then math.max(0, humanoid.Health) else 0
	local max = if humanoid then humanoid.MaxHealth else 100
	local frac = math.clamp(health / max, 0, 1)
	refs.HealthFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(frac, 1)
	refs.HealthFill.BackgroundColor3 = if frac > 0.5 then C.Good elseif frac > 0.25 then C.Gold else C.Hot
	local lag = refs.HealthLag :: Frame
	local lagFrac = lag.Size.X.Scale
	lag.Size = UDim2.fromScale(if lagFrac > frac then lagFrac - math.min(lagFrac - frac, 0.02) else frac, 1)
	refs.HealthText.Text = tostring(math.ceil(health))
	refs.Vignette.ImageTransparency = if frac < 0.35 and frac > 0 then 0.55 + frac else 1
	local protectedUntil = character and character:GetAttribute("ProtectedUntil")
	refs.Protected.Visible = typeof(protectedUntil) == "number" and workspace:GetServerTimeNow() < protectedUntil
end

local function updateTop()
	local state = MatchClient.state()
	local inMatch = MatchClient.myTeam() ~= nil
	local showScores = inMatch and state ~= "Waiting" and state ~= "Intermission"
	refs.Top.Visible = showScores
	if showScores then
		refs.RedScore.Text = tostring(MatchClient.get("RedScore") or 0)
		refs.BlueScore.Text = tostring(MatchClient.get("BlueScore") or 0)
		local left = MatchClient.timeLeft()
		refs.Timer.Text = if state == "Starting" then "0:00" else Theme.formatTime(left)
		refs.Timer.TextColor3 = if state == "Overtime" or (state == "Active" and left < 30) then C.Hot else C.Text
		refs.Target.Text = `FIRST TO {MatchClient.get("Target") or 40}`
		local mine = MatchClient.myTeam()
		refs.RedYou.Visible = mine == "Red"
		refs.BlueYou.Visible = mine == "Blue"
	end
	local banner = ""
	if MatchClient.mode() == "Practice" then
		local queued = player:GetAttribute("Queued") == true
		local queueState = MatchClient.get("QueueState")
		if queued and queueState == "Countdown" then
			local left = math.max(0, (MatchClient.get("QueueEndsAt") or 0) - workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
			banner = `QUEUED  •  MATCH STARTING IN {math.ceil(left)}  •  leave the zone to cancel`
		elseif queued then
			banner = if queueState == "Pending"
				then "QUEUED  •  NEXT MATCH PENDING"
				else "QUEUED  •  WAITING FOR MORE PLAYERS"
		else
			banner = "FIRING RANGE  •  Enter the Match Queue Zone to join the next game"
		end
	elseif state == "Waiting" and MatchClient.mode() == "Match" then
		banner =
			`WAITING FOR PLAYERS  ({MatchClient.get("Players") or 1}/{MatchClient.get("MinPlayers") or 2})  •  warm up on the range`
	elseif state == "Intermission" and MatchClient.mode() == "Match" then
		banner = `MATCH STARTS IN {math.ceil(MatchClient.timeLeft())}`
	elseif state == "Overtime" then
		banner = "OVERTIME  •  NEXT ELIMINATION WINS"
	elseif state == "Starting" then
		banner = `{string.upper(MatchClient.get("MapName") or "")}  •  TEAM DEATHMATCH`
	end
	refs.Banner.Text = banner
end

local function updateDamageArcs()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame
	local now = os.clock()
	for i = #damageArcs, 1, -1 do
		local arc = damageArcs[i]
		local age = now - arc.born
		if age > 1.2 then
			arc.frame:Destroy()
			table.remove(damageArcs, i)
		else
			local rel = camera:PointToObjectSpace(arc.from)
			local angle = math.atan2(rel.X, -rel.Z)
			arc.frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.sin(angle) * 120, 0.5, -math.cos(angle) * 120)
			arc.frame.Rotation = math.deg(angle)
			arc.frame.BackgroundTransparency = age / 1.2
		end
	end
end

function Hud.setVisible(visible: boolean)
	gui.Enabled = visible
	if mobileGui then
		mobileGui.Enabled = visible
	end
end

function Hud.start()
	gui, root = UIRoot.screen("Hud", 10)
	buildTop()
	buildHealth()
	buildWeapons()
	buildCrosshair()
	buildFeed()
	-- Mobile HUD elements share the touch surface's safe coordinate space; the
	-- desktop reference-pixel layout and all card animations remain unchanged.
	mobileGui = new("ScreenGui", {
		Name = "MobileHud",
		DisplayOrder = 10,
		ResetOnSpawn = false,
		ScreenInsets = Enum.ScreenInsets.DeviceSafeInsets,
		ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
		Parent = gui.Parent,
	}) :: ScreenGui
	local mobileLayer = new(
		"Frame",
		{ Name = "MobileHud", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Parent = mobileGui }
	) :: Frame
	local ammoScale = new("UIScale", { Parent = refs.WeaponsHolder }) :: UIScale
	local healthScale = new("UIScale", { Parent = refs.HealthBox }) :: UIScale
	local function mobileLayout()
		local touch = InputController.LastInputKind == "Touch"
		local left = Settings.values.controlLayout == "left"
		local size = mobileLayer.AbsoluteSize
		local layout = MobileLayout.calculate(size.X, size.Y, left)
		for _, spec in
			{ { refs.WeaponsHolder, ammoScale, "Ammo", 460, 120 }, { refs.HealthBox, healthScale, "Health", 380, 74 } }
		do
			local f, sc = spec[1], spec[2]
			if touch then
				local r = layout.rects[spec[3]]
				f.Parent = mobileLayer
				f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.zero
				f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(r.x, r.y)
				sc.Scale = r.w / spec[4]
			else
				f.Parent = root
				sc.Scale = 1
				f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(if spec[3] == "Ammo" then 1 else 0, 1)
				f.Position = if spec[3] == "Ammo" then UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, -28) else UDim2.new(0, 28, 1, -28)
			end
		end
		for slot, card in slotCards do
			card.frame.LayoutOrder = if touch and left then 3 - slot else slot
		end
	end
	Settings.Changed:Connect(mobileLayout)
	InputController.InputKindChanged:Connect(mobileLayout)
	mobileLayer:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(mobileLayout)
	mobileLayout()
	drawCrosshair()
	Settings.Changed:Connect(drawCrosshair)

	WeaponController.HitConfirmed:Connect(function(results)
		local hit = Feedback.hit(results)
		if not hit.cue then
			return
		end
		for _, result in hit.hits do
			Hud.damageNumber(result.damage, result.headshot)
		end
		Hud.hitmarker(hit.headshot, hit.killed)
		local cue = hit.cue
		-- Until separate elimination art is approved, a real kill still confirms its hit.
		if hit.killed and not AudioController.configured(cue) then
			cue = if hit.headshot then "HitHead" else "HitBody"
		end
		AudioController.play(cue)
	end)
	MatchClient.Elimination:Connect(function(data)
		Hud.feed(data)
		if data.killerUserId == player.UserId then
			if data.doublePump then
				Hud.eliminationBanner("DOUBLE PUMP!", `eliminated {data.victim}`, C.Accent, true)
			elseif data.headshot then
				Hud.eliminationBanner("HEADSHOT", `eliminated {data.victim}`, C.Gold, false)
			else
				Hud.eliminationBanner("ELIMINATED", data.victim, C.Text, false)
			end
		end
	end)
	MatchClient.Damaged:Connect(function(data)
		Hud.damageTaken(if typeof(data.from) == "Vector3" then data.from else nil)
		AudioController.play("DamageTaken")
	end)
	MatchClient.Countdown:Connect(function(n)
		local big = refs.BigCount :: TextLabel
		big.Text = tostring(n)
		big.Visible = true
		big.TextTransparency = 0
		AudioController.play("CountdownTick")
		Theme.tween(big, 0.9, { TextTransparency = 0.6 })
	end)
	MatchClient.Started:Connect(function()
		local big = refs.BigCount :: TextLabel
		big.Text = "GO!"
		big.Visible = true
		big.TextTransparency = 0
		AudioController.play("MatchStart")
		Theme.tween(big, 1.2, { TextTransparency = 1 })
		task.delay(1.2, function()
			big.Visible = false
		end)
	end)
	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not gui.Enabled then
			return
		end
		updateWeapons()
		updateHealth()
		updateTop()
		updateDamageArcs()
	end)
end

return Hud

--!strict
-- Touch-only adapter: fixed movement stick and free-screen drag aiming, one owned finger per control,
-- deliberate swipe intents, and one cancellable held-fire follow-up per valid swap.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Shared = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Shared
local Layout = require(Shared.Mobile.Layout)
local TouchState = require(Shared.Mobile.TouchState)
local FireSequence = require(Shared.Mobile.FireSequence)
local Theme = require(script.Parent.Theme)
local Controllers = script.Parent.Parent.Controllers
local InputController = require(Controllers.InputController)
local CameraController = require(Controllers.CameraController)
local WeaponController = require(Controllers.WeaponController)
local Settings = require(Controllers.Settings)

local MobileControls = {}
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local C, new = Theme.Colors, Theme.new
local gui: ScreenGui
local holder: Frame
local editBar: Frame
local buttons: { [string]: TextButton } = {}
local knobs: { [string]: Frame } = {}
local current: Layout.Result = Layout.calculate(844, 390, false)
local touches = TouchState.new(1)
local sequence = FireSequence.new()
local moveStick = Vector2.zero
local jumpHeld = false
local wanted, editing = false, false
local controls: any = nil
local customControls = false
local editStarts: { [InputObject]: { name: string, x: number, y: number, start: Vector2 } } = {}
local labels: { [string]: string } = {
	Fire = "FIRE",
	Move = "MOVE",
	Jump = "↑",
	Reload = "R",
	Crouch = "C",
	EquipA = "1",
	EquipB = "2",
	Scoreboard = "≡",
	Menu = "II",
	Swipe = "↓ SWAP",
}
local mouseDrag: InputObject? = nil

local function point(input: InputObject): Vector2
	return Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y) - holder.AbsolutePosition
end

local function pressed(name: string, on: boolean)
	local b = buttons[name]
	if b then
		b.BackgroundTransparency = if on then 0.08 elseif name == "Swipe" then 0.94 else 0.3
	end
end

local function neutral()
	sequence:release()
	for _, role in { "Crouch", "Scoreboard" } do
		if touches.owners[role] then
			InputController.trigger(role, false)
		end
	end
	touches:clear()
	table.clear(editStarts)
	mouseDrag = nil
	moveStick = Vector2.zero
	jumpHeld = false
	CameraController.clearTouchLook()
	for name in buttons do
		pressed(name, false)
	end
	for _, knob in knobs do
		knob.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	end
end

local function place()
	if not holder then
		return
	end
	neutral()
	local size = holder.AbsoluteSize
	current = Layout.calculate(size.X, size.Y, Settings.values.controlLayout == "left", Settings.values.touchLayoutV2)
	touches.unit = current.unit
	for name, b in buttons do
		local r = current.rects[name]
		b.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(r.x, r.y)
		b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(r.w, r.h)
	end
end

local function updateVisibility()
	if not gui then
		return
	end
	local touchMode = InputController.LastInputKind == "Touch"
	local show = editing or (wanted and touchMode)
	if gui.Enabled ~= show then
		neutral()
	end
	gui.Enabled = show
	CameraController.touchInputEnabled = touchMode
	if controls and customControls ~= touchMode then
		customControls = touchMode
		if touchMode then
			controls:Disable()
		else
			controls:Enable()
		end
	end
	local defaultTouch = player.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("TouchGui")
	if defaultTouch and defaultTouch:IsA("ScreenGui") and touchMode then
		defaultTouch.Enabled = false
	end
end

function MobileControls.isOnControl(position: Vector2): boolean
	if not gui or not gui.Enabled or editing or not wanted or GuiService.MenuIsOpen then
		return true
	end
	local p = position - holder.AbsolutePosition
	for name, r in current.rects do
		if buttons[name] and Layout.contains(r, p.X, p.Y) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function swipe()
	sequence:swipe(function()
		local nextSlot = if WeaponController.state.equipped == 1 then 2 else 1
		if WeaponController.equip(nextSlot) then
			return nextSlot
		end
		return nil
	end)
end

local function changed(input: InputObject)
	if editing and mouseDrag and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
		-- Mouse is only an editor fallback. Combat touch ownership remains physical.
		local drag = editStarts[mouseDrag]
		if drag then
			local p = point(input)
			local size = holder.AbsoluteSize
			local center = Vector2.new(drag.x, drag.y) + p - drag.start
			local x = center.X / math.max(size.X, 1)
			if Settings.values.controlLayout == "left" then
				x = 1 - x
			end
			local saved = table.clone(Settings.values.touchLayoutV2)
			saved[drag.name] = { x, center.Y / math.max(size.Y, 1), 1 }
			Settings.values.touchLayoutV2 = saved
			current = Layout.calculate(size.X, size.Y, Settings.values.controlLayout == "left", saved)
			for name, b in buttons do
				local r = current.rects[name]
				b.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(r.x, r.y)
				b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(r.w, r.h)
			end
		end
		return
	end
	local drag = editStarts[input]
	if drag and editing then
		local pos = point(input)
		local delta = pos - drag.start
		local size = holder.AbsoluteSize
		local x = (drag.x + delta.X) / math.max(size.X, 1)
		if Settings.values.controlLayout == "left" then
			x = 1 - x
		end
		local saved = table.clone(Settings.values.touchLayoutV2)
		saved[drag.name] = { x, (drag.y + delta.Y) / math.max(size.Y, 1), 1 }
		Settings.values.touchLayoutV2 = saved
		-- Reflow without releasing the editor's drag ownership.
		current = Layout.calculate(size.X, size.Y, Settings.values.controlLayout == "left", saved)
		for name, b in buttons do
			local r = current.rects[name]
			b.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(r.x, r.y)
			b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(r.w, r.h)
		end
		return
	end
	local t = touches.touches[input]
	if not t then
		return
	end
	local pos = point(input)
	if t.role == "Swipe" then
		if touches:move(input, pos.X, pos.Y, os.clock()) then
			swipe()
		end
	elseif t.role == "Move" then
		local r = current.rects[t.role]
		local v = TouchState.stick(pos.X - r.x - r.w / 2, pos.Y - r.y - r.h / 2, r.w * 0.30)
		knobs[t.role].Position = UDim2.new(0.5, v.X * r.w * 0.28, 0.5, v.Y * r.h * 0.28)
		moveStick = v
	end
end

local function began(name: string, input: InputObject)
	if
		input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
		and not (editing and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
	then
		return
	end
	local p = point(input)
	if editing then
		if name ~= "Swipe" then
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
				mouseDrag = input
			end
			local r = current.rects[name]
			editStarts[input] = { name = name, x = r.x + r.w / 2, y = r.y + r.h / 2, start = p }
		end
		return
	end
	if not wanted or GuiService.MenuIsOpen or not touches:begin(input, name, p.X, p.Y, os.clock()) then
		return
	end
	pressed(name, true)
	if name == "Fire" then
		sequence:press(WeaponController.fireMobile)
	elseif name == "Move" then
		changed(input)
	elseif name == "Jump" then
		jumpHeld = true
	elseif name == "Crouch" or name == "Scoreboard" then
		InputController.trigger(name, true)
	elseif name ~= "Swipe" then
		sequence.pending = nil
		InputController.trigger(name, true)
	end
end

local function ended(input: InputObject)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and mouseDrag then
		editStarts[mouseDrag] = nil
		mouseDrag = nil
	end
	editStarts[input] = nil
	-- Some devices deliver only a final change on touch-up. Consume at most once.
	changed(input)
	local role = touches:finish(input)
	if not role then
		return
	end
	pressed(role, false)
	if role == "Fire" then
		sequence:release()
	elseif role == "Move" then
		moveStick = Vector2.zero
	elseif role == "Jump" then
		jumpHeld = false
	elseif role == "Crouch" or role == "Scoreboard" then
		InputController.trigger(role, false)
	end
	if knobs[role] then
		knobs[role].Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	end
end

function MobileControls.setActive(active: boolean)
	wanted = active
	if not active then
		neutral()
	end
	updateVisibility()
end

function MobileControls.edit()
	neutral()
	editing = true
	gui.DisplayOrder = 60
	editBar.Visible = true
	updateVisibility()
end

			})

				Outline = false,
				Parent = b,

	editBar = Theme.panel({
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.02),
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.55, 0.12),
		Visible = false,
		Parent = gui,
	})
	Theme.label({
		Text = "Drag controls • unsafe overlaps are rejected",
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.6, 1),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		Outline = false,
		Parent = editBar,
	})
	local reset = Theme.button(
		"RESET",
		"Ghost",
		{ Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.62, 0.1), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.18, 0.8), Parent = editBar }
	)
	reset.Activated:Connect(function()
		Settings.values.touchLayoutV2 = {}
		place()
	end)
	local done = Theme.button(
		"DONE",
		"Primary",
		{ Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.81, 0.1), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.18, 0.8), Parent = editBar }
	)
	done.Activated:Connect(function()
		editing = false
		editBar.Visible = false
		gui.DisplayOrder = 12
		Settings.set("touchLayoutV2", Settings.values.touchLayoutV2)
		Settings.save()
		updateVisibility()
	end)
	CameraController.isTouchOnControl = MobileControls.isOnControl
	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(changed)
	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(ended)
	UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(neutral)
	GuiService.MenuOpened:Connect(neutral)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(neutral)
	WeaponController.Reset:Connect(neutral)
	WeaponController.Rejected:Connect(function()
		sequence.pending = nil
	end)
	InputController.Action:Connect(function(action, down)
		if down and (action == "Reload" or action == "EquipA" or action == "EquipB" or action == "Swap") then
			sequence.pending = nil
		end
	end)
	InputController.InputKindChanged:Connect(function()
		neutral()
		updateVisibility()
	end)
	Settings.Changed:Connect(place)
	holder:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(place)
	place()
	task.spawn(function()
		local pm = player.PlayerScripts:WaitForChild("PlayerModule", 10)
		if pm and pm:IsA("ModuleScript") then
			controls = (require(pm) :: any):GetControls()
			updateVisibility()
		end
	end)
	RunService:BindToRenderStep("DoublePumpMobileMove", Enum.RenderPriority.Input.Value, function()
		updateVisibility()
		local active = wanted and gui.Enabled and not editing and not GuiService.MenuIsOpen
		if not active then
			if sequence.held or next(touches.touches) then
				neutral()
			end
		end
		if customControls then
			player:Move(if active then Vector3.new(moveStick.X, 0, moveStick.Y) else Vector3.zero, true)
			local char = player.Character
			local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum and active and jumpHeld then
				hum.Jump = true
			end
		end
	end)
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local ready, reason = WeaponController.mobileReady()
		sequence:step(
			wanted and gui.Enabled and not editing and not GuiService.MenuIsOpen,
			WeaponController.state.equipped,
			ready,
			reason,
			WeaponController.fireMobile
		)
	end)
	WeaponController.Equipped:Connect(function(slot)
		for name, b in buttons do
			if name == "EquipA" or name == "EquipB" then
				local stroke = b:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
				if stroke then
					stroke.Color = if (name == "EquipA") == (slot == 1) then C.Accent else C.Stroke
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	updateVisibility()
end
return MobileControls

local function showResults(data: any)
	gui.Enabled = true
	hideAll()
	resultsFrame.Visible = true
	clear(resultsFrame)

	local myTeam = MatchClient.myTeam()
	local winner = data.winner

		headline, color = "DRAW", C.Text
	elseif myTeam == nil then

	elseif winner == myTeam then
		headline, color = "VICTORY", C.Gold
	else
		headline, color = "DEFEAT", C.Hot
	end
	if myTeam then
		AudioController.play(
			if headline == "VICTORY" then "Victory" elseif headline == "DEFEAT" then "Defeat" else "MatchEnd"
		)
	else

	local title = Theme.label({

local function showReward(reward: any)
	if not rewardPanel or not rewardPanel.Parent then
		return
	end
	local pending = rewardPanel:FindFirstChild("Pending")
	if pending then
		pending:Destroy()
	end
	local list = new("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, -80),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 70),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Parent = rewardPanel,
	}, { Theme.list(Enum.FillDirection.Vertical, 4, Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left) })
	local function line(order: number, left: string, right: string, color: Color3?)
		local row = new(
			"Frame",
			{ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order, Parent = list }
		)
		Theme.label({
			Text = left,
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.65, 1),
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextColor3 = C.TextDim,
			FontFace = Theme.Fonts.Bold,
			Outline = false,
			Parent = row,
		})
		Theme.label({
			Text = right,
			Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.35, 1),
			Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.65, 0),
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
			TextColor3 = color or C.Text,
			FontFace = Theme.Fonts.Heavy,
			Outline = false,
			Parent = row,
		})
	end
	for i, item in reward.breakdown or {} do
		line(i, item.label, `+{item.xp} XP`)
	end
	for i, ch in reward.challenges or {} do
		line(20 + i, "✓ " .. ch.text, `+{ch.xp} XP`, C.Good)
	end
	line(50, "Total", `+{reward.xp} XP`, C.Accent)
	line(51, "Coins", `◉ {reward.coins}`, C.Gold)
	if reward.idle then
		line(52, "Inactive: no match bonus", "", C.Hot)
	end
	if reward.levelAfter and reward.levelBefore and reward.levelAfter > reward.levelBefore then
		line(53, "LEVEL UP!", `{reward.levelAfter}`, C.Gold)
	end
	AudioController.play(LobbyCues.rewardCue(reward))
	local info = Levels.fromXp(reward.totalXp or 0)
	local bar = new("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 10),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 1, -24),
		BackgroundColor3 = C.Ink,
		Parent = rewardPanel,
	}, { Theme.corner(5) })
	local fill = new(
		"Frame",
		{ Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = C.Accent, Parent = bar },
		{ Theme.corner(5) }
	)
	Theme.tween(fill, 0.8, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(if info.isMax then 1 else info.into / info.need, 1) })
end

local function showVoteCounts(counts: { [string]: number })
	for id, entry in voteCards do
		local n = counts[id] or 0
		entry.count.Text = if n == 1 then "1 vote" else `{n} votes`
	end
end

local function showVoteResult(data: any)
	for id, entry in voteCards do
		if id == data.mapId then
			entry.stroke.Color = C.Gold
			entry.stroke.Thickness = 8
			Theme.tween(entry.frame, 0.3, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(490, 550) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
		else
			Theme.tween(entry.frame, 0.3, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.6 })
		end
	end
	if votingTimer then
		votingTimer.Text = `Next map: {data.name}`
		votingTimer.TextColor3 = C.Gold
	end
end

function Postgame.start()
	gui, root = UIRoot.screen("Postgame", 20)
	gui.Enabled = false
	new("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		BackgroundColor3 = C.Ink,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Parent = root,
	})
	resultsFrame = new(
		"Frame",
		{ Name = "Results", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Visible = false, Parent = root }
	)
	votingFrame = new(
		"Frame",
		{ Name = "Voting", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Visible = false, Parent = root }
	)

	MatchClient.Ended:Connect(showResults)
	MatchClient.Voting:Connect(showVoting)
	MatchClient.VoteCounts:Connect(showVoteCounts)
	MatchClient.VoteResult:Connect(showVoteResult)
	ProfileClient.Reward:Connect(showReward)
	MatchClient.StateChanged:Connect(function(state)
		if state ~= "Results" and state ~= "Voting" then
			Postgame.hide()
		end
	end)
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if votingFrame.Visible and votingTimer and votingTimer.TextColor3 ~= C.Gold then
			local left = math.max(0, votingEndsAt - os.clock())
			votingTimer.Text = string.format("%d", math.ceil(left))
				.. (if myVote then "  ·  vote locked in" else "  ·  click a map")
		end
	end)
end

return Postgame

--!strict
-- Hold Tab / Select: both teams side by side, sorted by score. Columns read from the
-- per-player attributes the server keeps up to date.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Theme = require(script.Parent.Theme)
local UIRoot = require(script.Parent.UIRoot)
local MatchClient = require(script.Parent.Parent.Controllers.MatchClient)

local Scoreboard = {}

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local C = Theme.Colors
local new = Theme.new

local gui: ScreenGui
local columns: { [string]: Frame } = {}
local headers: { [string]: TextLabel } = {}
local footer: TextLabel
local lastDraw = 0

local COLS = {
	{ key = "Kills", title = "E", width = 60 },
	{ key = "Deaths", title = "D", width = 60 },
	{ key = "Assists", title = "A", width = 60 },
	{ key = "DoublePumps", title = "DP", width = 60 },
	{ key = "Score", title = "SCORE", width = 100 },
}

local function attr(p: Player, key: string): number
	local v = p:GetAttribute(key)
	return if typeof(v) == "number" then v else 0
end

local function buildColumn(parent: Instance, team: string, x: number)
	local panel = Theme.panel({
		Name = team,
		Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -10, 1, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(x, if x > 0 then 10 else 0, 0, 0),
		Parent = parent,
	})
	new(
		"Frame",
		{ Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 8), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.teamColor(team), BorderSizePixel = 0, Parent = panel },
		{ Theme.corner(4) }
	)
	headers[team] = Theme.label({
		Text = team:upper(),
		Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, 44),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 18),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextColor3 = Theme.teamColor(team),
		FontFace = Theme.Fonts.Display,
		Parent = panel,
	})
	local head = new("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 24),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 70),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Parent = panel,
	})
	local right = 0
	for i = #COLS, 1, -1 do
		local col = COLS[i]
		Theme.label({
			Text = col.title,
			AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
			Position = UDim2.new(1, -right, 0, 0),
			Size = UDim2.new(0, col.width, 1, 0),
			TextColor3 = C.TextDim,
			FontFace = Theme.Fonts.Bold,
			Outline = false,
			Parent = head,
		})
		right += col.width
	end
	local list = new("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, -110),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 100),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Parent = panel,
	}, { Theme.list(Enum.FillDirection.Vertical, 4, Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left) })
	columns[team] = list
end

local function draw()
	local scores = { Red = MatchClient.get("RedScore") or 0, Blue = MatchClient.get("BlueScore") or 0 }
	for team, list in columns do
		headers[team].Text = `{team:upper()}  {scores[team]}`
		for _, child in list:GetChildren() do
			if child:IsA("Frame") then
				child:Destroy()
			end
		end
		local members = {}
		for _, p in Players:GetPlayers() do
			if p.Team and p.Team.Name == team then
				table.insert(members, p)
			end
		end
		table.sort(members, function(a, b)
			local sa, sb = attr(a, "Score"), attr(b, "Score")
			if sa ~= sb then
				return sa > sb
			end
			return a.UserId < b.UserId
		end)
		for i, p in members do
			local mine = p == player
			local alive = p.Character ~= nil and p.Character:GetAttribute("Dead") ~= true
			local row = new("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 46),
				BackgroundColor3 = if mine then Theme.teamColor(team) else C.PanelLight,
				BackgroundTransparency = if mine then 0.55 else 0.5,
				LayoutOrder = i,
				Parent = list,
			}, { Theme.corner(6) })
			Theme.label({
				Text = p.DisplayName,
				Size = UDim2.new(1, -330, 0, 26),
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 10),
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
				TextTransparency = if alive then 0 else 0.45,
				FontFace = Theme.Fonts.Bold,
				Outline = false,
				Parent = row,
			})
			local right = 0
			for c = #COLS, 1, -1 do
				local col = COLS[c]
				Theme.label({
					Text = tostring(attr(p, col.key)),
					AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
					Position = UDim2.new(1, -right, 0, 10),
					Size = UDim2.fromOffset(col.width, 26),
					FontFace = if col.key == "Score" then Theme.Fonts.Heavy else Theme.Fonts.Bold,
					Outline = false,
					Parent = row,
				})
				right += col.width
			end
		end
	end
	local others = {}
	for _, p in Players:GetPlayers() do
		if not p.Team then
			table.insert(others, p.DisplayName)
		end
	end
	local mapName = MatchClient.get("MapName") or ""
	footer.Text = (if mapName ~= "" then mapName .. "   ·   " else "")
		.. (if #others > 0 then "Not in match: " .. table.concat(others, ", ") else "")
end

function Scoreboard.setVisible(on: boolean)
	gui.Enabled = on
	if on then
		draw()
	end
end

function Scoreboard.start()
	local root
	gui, root = UIRoot.screen("Scoreboard", 25)
	gui.Enabled = false
	local frame = new("Frame", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1300, 620),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Parent = root,
	})
	buildColumn(frame, "Red", 0)
	buildColumn(frame, "Blue", 0.5)
	footer = Theme.label({
		Text = "",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 12),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26),
		TextColor3 = C.TextDim,
		FontFace = Theme.Fonts.Bold,
		Parent = frame,
	})
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if gui.Enabled and os.clock() - lastDraw > 0.5 then
			lastDraw = os.clock()
			draw()
		end
	end)
end

return Scoreboard

--!strict
-- Settings page: builds into any parent frame (main menu tab or in-match pause menu).
-- Every change applies instantly and is saved to the profile (debounced).

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local GameConfig = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config.GameConfig)
local Theme = require(script.Parent.Theme)
local Settings = require(script.Parent.Parent.Controllers.Settings)

local SettingsPanel = {}

local C = Theme.Colors
local new = Theme.new

-- Set by the bootstrap: opens the touch-button layout editor.
SettingsPanel.editTouchLayout = nil :: (() -> ())?

local function row(parent: Instance, order: number, title: string): Frame
	local frame = new("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 56),
		BackgroundColor3 = C.PanelLight,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,
		LayoutOrder = order,
		Parent = parent,
	}, { Theme.corner(10) })
	Theme.label({
		Text = title,
		Size = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0, 26),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0.5, -13),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		FontFace = Theme.Fonts.Bold,
		Outline = false,
		Parent = frame,
	})
	return frame
end

local function header(parent: Instance, order: number, text: string)
	Theme.label({
		Text = text,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		FontFace = Theme.Fonts.Display,
		TextColor3 = C.Accent,
		LayoutOrder = order,
		Parent = parent,
	})
end

local function slider(
	parent: Instance,
	order: number,
	title: string,
	key: string,
	min: number,
	max: number,
	step: number,
	format: (number) -> string
)
	local frame = row(parent, order, title)
	local track = new("Frame", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
		Size = UDim2.new(0.32, 0, 0, 8),
		BackgroundColor3 = C.Ink,
		Parent = frame,
	}, { Theme.corner(4) })
	local fill = new(
		"Frame",
		{ Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 1), BackgroundColor3 = C.Accent, Parent = track },
		{ Theme.corner(4) }
	)
	local knob = new("Frame", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22),
		BackgroundColor3 = C.Text,
		Parent = track,
	}, { Theme.corner(11), Theme.stroke(C.AccentDark, 2) })
	local valueLabel = Theme.label({
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0.5, 0),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(90, 26),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
		FontFace = Theme.Fonts.Bold,
		Outline = false,
		Parent = frame,
	})
	local function show()
		local v = (Settings.values :: any)[key] :: number
		local a = math.clamp((v - min) / (max - min), 0, 1)
		fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(a, 1)
		knob.Position = UDim2.fromScale(a, 0.5)
		valueLabel.Text = format(v)
	end
	local function setFromX(x: number)
		local a = math.clamp((x - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(1, track.AbsoluteSize.X), 0, 1)
		local v = min + a * (max - min)
		v = math.round(v / step) * step
		Settings.set(key, v)
		Settings.save()
		show()
	end
	local dragging = false
	local hit = new("TextButton", {
		Text = "",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 24, 0, 40),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, -12, 0.5, -20),
		Parent = track,
	}) :: TextButton
	hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if
			input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
		then
			dragging = true
			setFromX(input.Position.X)
		end
	end)
	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if
			dragging
			and (
				input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
				or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
			)
		then
			setFromX(input.Position.X)
		end
	end)
	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if
			input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
		then
			dragging = false
		end
	end)
	-- Gamepad: select the row and press left/right
	local function nudge(direction: number)
		local v = (Settings.values :: any)[key] :: number
		Settings.set(key, math.clamp(v + direction * step, min, max))
		Settings.save()
		show()
	end
	local minus = Theme.button("-", "Ghost", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 34),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -14, 0.5, 0),
		Parent = frame,
	})
	minus.Activated:Connect(function()
		nudge(-1)
	end)
	local plus = Theme.button("+", "Ghost", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 34),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.82, 14, 0.5, 0),
		Parent = frame,
	})
	plus.Activated:Connect(function()
		nudge(1)
	end)
	valueLabel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0.5, 0)
	valueLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 26)
	Settings.Changed:Connect(show)
	show()
end

local function toggle(parent: Instance, order: number, title: string, key: string)
	local frame = row(parent, order, title)
	local button = Theme.button("", "Secondary", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0.5, 0),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 38),
		Parent = frame,
	})
	local function show()
		local on = (Settings.values :: any)[key] == true
		button.Text = if on then "ON" else "OFF"
		button.BackgroundColor3 = if on then C.Good else C.PanelLight
		button.TextColor3 = if on then C.Ink else C.TextDim
	end
	button.Activated:Connect(function()
		Settings.set(key, not (Settings.values :: any)[key])
		Settings.save()
		show()
	end)
	Settings.Changed:Connect(show)
	show()
end

local function choice(
	parent: Instance,
	order: number,
	title: string,
	key: string,
	options: { string },
	display: { [string]: string }?
)
	local frame = row(parent, order, title)
	local button = Theme.button("", "Secondary", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0.5, 0),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 38),
		Parent = frame,
	})
	local function show()
		local value = (Settings.values :: any)[key]
		button.Text = (if display then display[value] or tostring(value) else tostring(value)) .. "  ▸"
	end
	button.Activated:Connect(function()
		local current = table.find(options, (Settings.values :: any)[key]) or 0
		Settings.set(key, options[current % #options + 1])
		Settings.save()
		show()
	end)
	Settings.Changed:Connect(show)
	show()
end

local function action(parent: Instance, order: number, title: string, buttonText: string, fn: () -> ())
	local frame = row(parent, order, title)
	local button = Theme.button(buttonText, "Secondary", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0.5, 0),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 38),
		Parent = frame,
	})
	button.Activated:Connect(fn)
end

-- Builds the settings list into `parent` (a frame that should be fully sized).
function SettingsPanel.build(parent: Instance): ScrollingFrame
	local scroll = new("ScrollingFrame", {
		Name = "Settings",
		Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ScrollBarThickness = 6,
		ScrollBarImageColor3 = C.Stroke,
		CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
		AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
		Parent = parent,
	}, {
		Theme.list(Enum.FillDirection.Vertical, 8),
		new("UIPadding", { PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 14) }),
	}) :: ScrollingFrame
	local Cam = GameConfig.Camera
	local function decimal(v: number)
		return string.format("%.2f", v)
	end
	local function percent(v: number)
		return string.format("%d%%", math.round(v * 100))
	end
	local o = 0
	local function n()
		o += 1
		return o
	end

	header(scroll, n(), "AIM")
	slider(scroll, n(), "Mouse sensitivity", "sensitivity", Cam.MinSensitivity, Cam.MaxSensitivity, 0.05, decimal)
	slider(scroll, n(), "Controller sensitivity", "gamepadSensitivity", 0.2, 3, 0.05, decimal)
	slider(scroll, n(), "Touch sensitivity", "touchSensitivity", 0.2, 3, 0.05, decimal)
	slider(scroll, n(), "Field of view", "fov", Cam.MinFov, Cam.MaxFov, 1, function(v)
		return tostring(math.round(v)) .. "°"
	end)

	header(scroll, n(), "CROSSHAIR")
	choice(scroll, n(), "Style", "crosshairStyle", { "CrossDot", "Cross", "Dot", "Circle" })
	choice(scroll, n(), "Colour", "crosshairColor", { "White", "Green", "Yellow", "Cyan", "Pink" })
	slider(scroll, n(), "Size", "crosshairSize", 0.6, 1.6, 0.05, decimal)

	header(scroll, n(), "CONTROLS")
	if UserInputService.TouchEnabled then
		choice(
			scroll,
			n(),
			"Control Layout",
			"controlLayout",
			{ "right", "left" },
			{ right = "Right-Handed", left = "Left-Handed" }
		)
	end
	toggle(scroll, n(), "Crouch is a toggle", "crouchToggle")
	toggle(scroll, n(), "Mouse wheel switches guns", "wheelSwitching")
	choice(scroll, n(), "Weapon Hand", "weaponHand", { "right", "left" }, { right = "Right", left = "Left" })
	action(scroll, n(), "Touch button layout", "Edit layout", function()
		if SettingsPanel.editTouchLayout then
			SettingsPanel.editTouchLayout()
		end
	end)

	header(scroll, n(), "AUDIO")
	slider(scroll, n(), "Master volume", "masterVolume", 0, 1, 0.05, percent)
	slider(scroll, n(), "Music volume", "musicVolume", 0, 1, 0.05, percent)
	slider(scroll, n(), "Effects volume", "effectsVolume", 0, 1, 0.05, percent)

	header(scroll, n(), "DISPLAY")
	toggle(scroll, n(), "Damage numbers", "showDamageNumbers")
	toggle(scroll, n(), "Camera bob", "cameraBob")
	toggle(scroll, n(), "Reduced effects", "reducedEffects")

	action(scroll, n(), "Restore defaults", "Reset", function()
		Settings.reset()
	end)
	return scroll
end

return SettingsPanel

--!strict
-- Double Pump's visual language: bold, high-contrast arcade style. Dark slate panels,
-- warm "muzzle-flash" orange accent, team red/blue, heavy display type.
-- Also a tiny element builder so UI code stays declarative.

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Theme = {}

Theme.Colors = {
	Ink = Color3.fromRGB(14, 16, 22),
	Panel = Color3.fromRGB(24, 27, 36),
	PanelLight = Color3.fromRGB(38, 42, 56),
	Stroke = Color3.fromRGB(70, 76, 98),
	Text = Color3.fromRGB(245, 246, 250),
	TextDim = Color3.fromRGB(160, 166, 186),
	Accent = Color3.fromRGB(255, 168, 38), -- muzzle-flash orange
	AccentDark = Color3.fromRGB(196, 110, 12),
	Hot = Color3.fromRGB(255, 72, 96),
	Good = Color3.fromRGB(80, 230, 140),
	Gold = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 80),
	Red = Color3.fromRGB(255, 72, 72),
	Blue = Color3.fromRGB(64, 156, 255),
	Headshot = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70),
}

Theme.Fonts = {
	Display = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/LuckiestGuy.json"),
	Heavy = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/GothamSSm.json", Enum.FontWeight.Heavy),
	Bold = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/GothamSSm.json", Enum.FontWeight.Bold),
	Body = Font.new("rbxasset://fonts/families/GothamSSm.json", Enum.FontWeight.Medium),
}

function Theme.teamColor(team: string?): Color3
	if team == "Red" then
		return Theme.Colors.Red
	elseif team == "Blue" then
		return Theme.Colors.Blue
	end
	return Theme.Colors.TextDim
end

-- new("Frame", { Size = ..., [children] = {...} })
function Theme.new(className: string, props: { [any]: any }?, children: { any }?): any
	local inst = Instance.new(className :: any)
	local parent = nil
	for key, value in (props or {}) :: { [any]: any } do
		if key == "Parent" then
			parent = value
		elseif typeof(key) == "string" then
			(inst :: any)[key] = value
		end
	end
	for _, child in (children or {}) :: { any } do
		child.Parent = inst
	end
	if parent then
		inst.Parent = parent
	end
	return inst
end

local new = Theme.new

function Theme.corner(radius: number?): any
	return new("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius or 10) })
end

function Theme.stroke(color: Color3?, thickness: number?, transparency: number?): any
	return new("UIStroke", {
		Color = color or Theme.Colors.Stroke,
		Thickness = thickness or 2,
		Transparency = transparency or 0,
		ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
	})
end

function Theme.padding(px: number): any
	local u = UDim.new(0, px)
	return new("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = u, PaddingRight = u, PaddingTop = u, PaddingBottom = u })
end

function Theme.list(direction: Enum.FillDirection?, gap: number?, align: Enum.HorizontalAlignment?): any
	return new("UIListLayout", {
		FillDirection = direction or Enum.FillDirection.Vertical,
		Padding = UDim.new(0, gap or 8),
		HorizontalAlignment = align or Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
		SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
	})
end

function Theme.gradient(top: Color3, bottom: Color3, rotation: number?): any
	return new("UIGradient", {
		Color = ColorSequence.new(top, bottom),
		Rotation = rotation or 90,
	})
end

-- Text label with an outline stroke so it reads over any background.
function Theme.label(props: { [string]: any }): TextLabel
	local p = table.clone(props)
	p.BackgroundTransparency = p.BackgroundTransparency or 1
	p.FontFace = p.FontFace or Theme.Fonts.Heavy
	p.TextColor3 = p.TextColor3 or Theme.Colors.Text
	p.TextScaled = if p.TextScaled == nil then true else p.TextScaled
	local outline = p.Outline
	p.Outline = nil
	local label = new("TextLabel", p)
	if outline ~= false then
		new("UIStroke", {
			Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
			Thickness = if typeof(outline) == "number" then outline else 1.5,
			Transparency = 0.35,
			ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual,
			Parent = label,
		})
	end
	return label
end

export type ButtonStyle = "Primary" | "Secondary" | "Ghost" | "Danger"

-- Chunky arcade button with a hover/press bounce. Returns the button.
function Theme.button(text: string, style: ButtonStyle?, props: { [string]: any }?): TextButton
	local s = style or "Secondary"
	local bg = if s == "Primary"
		then Theme.Colors.Accent
		elseif s == "Danger" then Theme.Colors.Hot
		elseif s == "Ghost" then Theme.Colors.Panel
		else Theme.Colors.PanelLight
	local p: { [string]: any } = {
		Text = text,
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		BackgroundColor3 = bg,
		FontFace = Theme.Fonts.Heavy,
		TextColor3 = if s == "Primary" then Theme.Colors.Ink else Theme.Colors.Text,
		TextScaled = true,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 52),
	}
	for k, v in (props or {}) :: { [string]: any } do
		p[k] = v
	end
	local button = new("TextButton", p, {
		Theme.corner(10),
		Theme.stroke(if s == "Primary" then Theme.Colors.AccentDark else Theme.Colors.Stroke, 2),
		new("UIPadding", {
			PaddingTop = UDim.new(0.18, 0),
			PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0.18, 0),
			PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 10),
			PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10),
		}),
	}) :: TextButton
	local scale = new("UIScale", { Parent = button }) :: UIScale
	local function tween(to: number)
		TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), { Scale = to }):Play()
	end
	button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		tween(1.04)
		if Theme.onHover then
			Theme.onHover()
		end
	end)
	button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		tween(1)
	end)
	button.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
		tween(0.96)
	end)
	button.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
		tween(1.04)
	end)
	button.Activated:Connect(function()
		if Theme.onClick then
			Theme.onClick()
		end
	end)
	return button
end

-- Panel with the standard look.
function Theme.panel(props: { [string]: any }, children: { any }?): Frame
	local p = table.clone(props)
	p.BackgroundColor3 = p.BackgroundColor3 or Theme.Colors.Panel
	p.BackgroundTransparency = p.BackgroundTransparency or 0.08
	local frame = new("Frame", p, children) :: Frame
	Theme.corner(14).Parent = frame
	Theme.stroke(Theme.Colors.Stroke, 2, 0.3).Parent = frame
	return frame
end

function Theme.tween(
	inst: Instance,
	time: number,
	goal: { [string]: any },
	style: Enum.EasingStyle?,
	direction: Enum.EasingDirection?
): Tween
	local t = TweenService:Create(
		inst,
		TweenInfo.new(time, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, direction or Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
		goal
	)
	t:Play()
	return t
end

-- Set by the client bootstrap to play UI sounds.
Theme.onHover = nil :: (() -> ())?
Theme.onClick = nil :: (() -> ())?

function Theme.formatTime(seconds: number): string
	local s = math.max(0, math.ceil(seconds))
	return string.format("%d:%02d", s // 60, s % 60)
end

return Theme

-- Short notifications (server notices, unlocks, challenge completions) stacked on the
-- right side of the screen, below the kill feed.

local Theme = require(script.Parent.Theme)
local UIRoot = require(script.Parent.UIRoot)

local C = Theme.Colors
local new = Theme.new
local holder: Frame
local order = 0

local KIND_COLORS: { [string]: Color3 } = {
	info = C.Text,
	good = C.Good,
	warn = C.Gold,
	error = C.Hot,
	reward = C.Accent,
}

function Toasts.show(text: string, kind: string?, duration: number?)
	if not holder then
		return
	end
	order += 1
	local color = KIND_COLORS[kind or "info"] or C.Text
	local toast = Theme.panel({
		Name = "Toast",
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(420, 54),
		LayoutOrder = order,
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.15,
		Parent = holder,
	})
	new("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 6, 1, -16),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 8),
		BackgroundColor3 = color,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Parent = toast,
	}, { Theme.corner(3) })
	Theme.label({
		Text = text,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, -16),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 8),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		FontFace = Theme.Fonts.Bold,
		TextColor3 = C.Text,
		Parent = toast,
	})
	local scale = new("UIScale", { Scale = 0.8, Parent = toast }) :: UIScale
	Theme.tween(scale, 0.18, { Scale = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
	task.delay(duration or 3.5, function()
		Theme.tween(scale, 0.2, { Scale = 0.01 })
		task.wait(0.2)
		toast:Destroy()
	end)
	local items = holder:GetChildren()
	local count = 0
	for _, child in items do
		if child:IsA("Frame") then
			count += 1
		end
	end
	-- Keep at most 4 visible
	if count > 4 then
		local oldest: Frame? = nil
		for _, child in items do
			if child:IsA("Frame") and (oldest == nil or child.LayoutOrder < (oldest :: Frame).LayoutOrder) then
				oldest = child
			end
		end
		if oldest then
			oldest:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

	local _, root = UIRoot.screen("Toasts", 40)
	holder = new("Frame", {

		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(420, 300),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Parent = root,
	}, { Theme.list(Enum.FillDirection.Vertical, 8, Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right) })
end

--!strict
-- Interactive tutorial in the practice range. Each step waits for the player to do the
-- thing (fire, switch, reload, crouch, double pump). Skippable at any time; finishing or
-- skipping marks it done in the profile so it isn't offered again.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local Net = require(Shared.Net)
local WeaponConfig = require(Shared.Config.WeaponConfig)

local Theme = require(script.Parent.Theme)
local UIRoot = require(script.Parent.UIRoot)
local Controllers = script.Parent.Parent.Controllers
local WeaponController = require(Controllers.WeaponController)
local InputController = require(Controllers.InputController)
local AudioController = require(Controllers.AudioController)
local Settings = require(Controllers.Settings)

local Tutorial = {}

local C = Theme.Colors
local new = Theme.new

local gui: ScreenGui
local panel: Frame
local stepLabel: TextLabel
local textLabel: TextLabel
local hintLabel: TextLabel
local dots: { Frame } = {}
local step = 0
local active = false
local connections: { any } = {}

type Step = { text: string, keys: { Keyboard: string, Gamepad: string, Touch: string } }

local STEPS: { Step } = {
	{ text = "Shoot a target.", keys = { Keyboard = "Left mouse button", Gamepad = "R2", Touch = "FIRE button" } },
	{
		text = "Switch to your other shotgun.",
		keys = { Keyboard = "Press 2 or Q", Gamepad = "R1 or L1", Touch = "Swipe down in ↓ SWAP" },
	},
	{
		text = "Double pump: hit a target, switch, and hit it again within a second.",
		keys = { Keyboard = "Click, Q, click", Gamepad = "R2, R1, R2", Touch = "Hold FIRE, swipe down to swap + fire" },
	},
	{
		text = "Reload. Shells go in one at a time; firing or switching stops the reload.",
		keys = { Keyboard = "R", Gamepad = "X", Touch = "RELOAD button" },
	},
	{
		text = "Crouch. It tightens your spread a little but slows you down.",
		keys = { Keyboard = "C or Left Ctrl", Gamepad = "B", Touch = "CROUCH button" },
	},
	{
		text = "Eliminate a target with a double pump.",
		keys = {
			Keyboard = "Close range, aim high",
			Gamepad = "Close range, aim high",
			Touch = "Close range, aim high",
		},
	},
}

local function disconnectAll()
	for _, c in connections do
		c:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(connections)
end

local function render()
	local s = STEPS[step]
	if not s then
		return
	end
	stepLabel.Text = `STEP {step} OF {#STEPS}`
	textLabel.Text = s.text
	hintLabel.Text = (s.keys :: any)[InputController.LastInputKind] or s.keys.Keyboard
	for i, dot in dots do
		dot.BackgroundColor3 = if i < step then C.Good elseif i == step then C.Accent else C.PanelLight
	end
	local scale = panel:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale") :: UIScale
	scale.Scale = 0.9
	Theme.tween(scale, 0.2, { Scale = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
end

local function finish(completed: boolean)
	active = false
	disconnectAll()
	Settings.set("tutorialDone", true)
	Net.event("SettingsAction"):FireServer("TutorialDone")
	if completed then
		stepLabel.Text = "TUTORIAL COMPLETE"
		textLabel.Text = "You're ready. Enter the Match Queue Zone in the range when you want a real match."
		hintLabel.Text = ""
		AudioController.play("LevelUp")
		task.delay(5, function()
			if not active then
				gui.Enabled = false
			end
		end)
	else
		gui.Enabled = false
	end
end

local function advance(from: number)
	if not active or step ~= from then
		return
	end
	AudioController.play("Reward")
	step += 1
	if step > #STEPS then
		finish(true)
	else
		render()
	end
end

function Tutorial.isActive(): boolean
	return active
end

function Tutorial.begin()
	disconnectAll()
	active = true
	step = 1
	gui.Enabled = true
	Net.event("PlayerAction"):FireServer("Practice")
	render()

	local lastFiredSlot = 1
	local lastHit: { slot: number, time: number }? = nil
	table.insert(
		connections,
		WeaponController.Fired:Connect(function(info)
			lastFiredSlot = info.slot
			advance(1)
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		connections,
		WeaponController.Equipped:Connect(function(_slot, _previous, isSpawn)
			if not isSpawn then
				advance(2)
			end
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		connections,
		WeaponController.HitConfirmed:Connect(function(results)
			local now = os.clock()
			local landed = false
			for _, r in results do
				if not r.protected then
					landed = true
				end
				if r.killed and r.doublePump then
					advance(6)
				end
			end
			if not landed then
				return
			end
			if
				lastHit
				and lastHit.slot ~= lastFiredSlot
				and now - lastHit.time <= WeaponConfig.DoublePumpWindow + 0.2
			then
				advance(3)
			end
			lastHit = { slot = lastFiredSlot, time = now }
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		connections,
		WeaponController.ReloadStarted:Connect(function()
			advance(4)
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		connections,
		InputController.Action:Connect(function(action, pressed)
			if action == "Crouch" and pressed then
				advance(5)
			end
		end)
	)
	table.insert(connections, InputController.InputKindChanged:Connect(render))
	-- The mouse is locked while aiming, so skipping also works from the keyboard/pad
	table.insert(
		connections,
		UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
			if not processed and (input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonY) then
				Tutorial.skip()
			end
		end)
	)
end

function Tutorial.skip()
	if active then
		finish(false)
	end
end

function Tutorial.start()
	local root
	gui, root = UIRoot.screen("Tutorial", 18)
	gui.Enabled = false
	panel = Theme.panel({
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 120),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(760, 168),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0.12,
		Parent = root,
	})
	new("UIScale", { Parent = panel })
	stepLabel = Theme.label({
		Text = "",
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(400, 24),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 16),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextColor3 = C.Accent,
		FontFace = Theme.Fonts.Heavy,
		Outline = false,
		Parent = panel,
	})
	textLabel = Theme.label({
		Text = "",
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, 60),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 44),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextWrapped = true,
		FontFace = Theme.Fonts.Bold,
		Parent = panel,
	})
	hintLabel = Theme.label({
		Text = "",
		Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, 26),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 112),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextColor3 = C.Gold,
		FontFace = Theme.Fonts.Heavy,
		Outline = false,
		Parent = panel,
	})
	local dotRow = new("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 12),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -224, 0, 22),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Parent = panel,
	}, { Theme.list(Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, 8, Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right) })
	for i = 1, #STEPS do
		dots[i] = new(
			"Frame",
			{ Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 10), BackgroundColor3 = C.PanelLight, LayoutOrder = i, Parent = dotRow },
			{ Theme.corner(5) }
		)
	end
	local skip = Theme.button("SKIP  [Backspace]", "Ghost", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 40),
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -16),
		Parent = panel,
	})
	skip.Activated:Connect(Tutorial.skip)
end

return Tutorial

--!strict
-- Creates ScreenGuis that scale with the screen. UI is laid out for a 1920x1080 reference
-- in pixel offsets; a UIScale shrinks/grows it for phones, tablets and big monitors.
-- Elements anchored to edges stay on those edges at every size.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")

local UIRoot = {}

local scales: { UIScale } = {}

function UIRoot.scaleFactor(): number
	local viewport = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
	local s = math.min(viewport.X / 1920, viewport.Y / 1080)
	-- Small screens get a bit larger than proportional so text stays readable
	if s < 0.7 then
		s = s * 1.25
	end
	return math.clamp(s, 0.45, 1.25)
end

local function update()
	local s = UIRoot.scaleFactor()
	for _, scale in scales do
		scale.Scale = s
	end
end

-- A full-screen ScreenGui with a scaled root Frame. Returns (gui, root).
function UIRoot.screen(name: string, displayOrder: number, ignoreInset: boolean?): (ScreenGui, Frame)
	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = name
	gui.DisplayOrder = displayOrder
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = ignoreInset ~= false
	gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
	local root = Instance.new("Frame")
	root.Name = "Root"
	root.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	root.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	root.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	root.Parent = gui
	local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	scale.Parent = root
	table.insert(scales, scale)
	-- The root covers the screen in "reference pixels": size = screen / scale
	local function resize()
		local s = UIRoot.scaleFactor()
		local viewport = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
		root.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(viewport.X / s, viewport.Y / s)
		scale.Scale = s
	end
	resize()
	workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(resize)
	gui.Parent = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	return gui, root
end

function UIRoot.isSmallScreen(): boolean
	local viewport = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
	return math.min(viewport.X, viewport.Y) < 600
end

function UIRoot.start()
	workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(update)
	GuiService:GetPropertyChangedSignal("TopbarInset"):Connect(update)
end

return UIRoot
